Greetings. I am Aun Autuorea. My brothers and I have left Palenqual to hunt! I have chosen to challenge myself by hunting the Magma Golem Exarch as my prey. They are powerful in their own right, but tend to employ the use of underlings in their battles as well.

Would you like to hunt them as well? Very well, scour this region and others like it and I am sure you will find the golem. Kill five of these golems, return to me and I will see that your battles are rewarded!

greetings: You have done well to bring this to us, friend, but I fear I am not the proper person to receive it from you. Take this to Aun Ngationa there; he can receive it from you.
Greetings! I am Aun Turiona, and I am here in Timaru to learn statecraft from my kinsman Aun Hareltah. If I learn well, I may one day act as envoy to your people.
Aun Hareltah has tasked me with rewarding any no-tail who defeats Hea Temepuh. Give me the Totem of Temepuh and I will give you the Kalindan of Palenqual.
quest: You are too helpful, friend Isparian. But I cannot reward you for your efforts so often. Take this back, and bring it to me again when the cycle of the days has turned three times.
The Totem of Temepuh! Aun Hareltah will want to see this at once! And I must reward you, friend.

This is the Kalindan of Palenqual -- the living totem of this island itself, given to us by spirits of this place who call themselves Deru. It may be turned into a powerful force for good or ill. But you have difficult choices to make before it will serve you. The note I gave you will explain.
The Totem of Temepuh! Aun Hareltah will want to see this at once! But ...
Aun Turiona looks puzzled. She cups the totem in the palm of her hand and closes her eyes. She shakes her head, studies the totem closely, and then frowns at you.
You attempt to deceive me. You did not kill the scourge of the uplands.

greetings: Welcome back, Buhdi! Have you come to get your title? Excellent!
quest: Excellent! Your keh burns brightly with victory! Here is something to recognize your efforts in hunting the Coral Golem Viceroys!
Return the token to me and I will bestow an appropriate title upon you, buhdi!

Excellent! Your keh burns brightly with victory! As I promised, a reward for you! It isn't much, simply some fixings I brought with me from Timaru! Here, feast with me as we celebrate your achievement!
The spirits tell me you have defeated four of the Coral Viceroys! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
The spirits tell me you have defeated three of the Coral Viceroys! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
The spirits tell me you have defeated two of the Coral Viceroys! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
The spirits tell me you have defeated one of the Coral Viceroys! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
Good luck to you, hunter! Return to me to see your progress in your efforts against the Coral Golem Viceroys. The spirits will speak and tell me of your victories!

Greetings. I am Aun Aukherea. My twin, Khekie, and I have come to Ayan Baqur to hunt the Golem Lords. I am not quite as brazen as Khekie, so I have chosen to stalk the western borders of this land in search of the Coral Golem Viceroy.

Would you like to hunt them as well? Very well, scour this region and others like it and I am sure you will find the golem. Kill five of these golems, return to me and I will see that your battles are rewarded!

greetings: Aun Tanua gently cups the ember in his clawed hands, and as its glow warms his skin, his past gradually seeps into memory. For the first instant in an endless monotony of time, he remembers. Ezheret. Palenqual. Timaru. Home.
As determination and strength return to the old warrior's stance, he turns to you once more.

I have no knowledge of how long I have been imprisoned here. Endless half moments on moments, my memory failing, my own keh draining away...All I know is that I cannot leave, for the Atua ngamaru have me captured inside these walls of light.

My own Timaru is far from me, but you have brought me an ember of her heart, and once again my people are with me. You must have been sent with this gift by one of my brethren, and for that I thank you.
There is but one way to let my brothers envision my fate, and I must ask one more favor of you.

Aun Tanua lifts the akiekie ember to his face and softly blows across its faintly glowing surface. As his keh suffuses the ember, it suddenly fans into a flame. He holds it a moment longer, then relinquishes it to your care.
Give this to the one that sent you here to me. He will understand its intent and what should be done. Go now, and if you ever tread upon the shores of Palenqual, let her know I am with her.

Aun Tanua slowly turns towards you, surprise barely flickering across his careworn eyes.  He almost reaches out to touch your arm, but conditioned imprints of lightning-pain, years of throwing his fading body against electric walls, jolts a recoil through his frame.
A face. I see a face. Not Tonk. Not Atua ngamaru. I see a face.
Atual arutoa?
Aun Tanua starts shivering uncontrollably and shrinks within himself.
Not here. None here. Never here.
Welcome back, Buhdi! Have you come to get your title? Excellent!
quest: Excellent! Your keh burns brightly with victory! Here is something to recognize your efforts in hunting the Platinum Golem Mountain Kings!
Return the token to me and I will bestow an appropriate title upon you, buhdi!

Excellent! Your keh burns brightly with victory! As I promised, a reward for you! It isn't much, simply some fixings I brought with me from Timaru! Here, feast with me as we celebrate your achievement!
The spirits tell me you have defeated four of the Platinum Mountain Kings! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
The spirits tell me you have defeated three of the Platinum Mountain Kings! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
The spirits tell me you have defeated two of the Platinum Mountain Kings! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
The spirits tell me you have defeated one of the Platinum Mountain Kings! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
Good luck to you, hunter! Return to me to see your progress in your efforts against the Platinum Golem Mountain Kings. The spirits will speak and tell me of your victories!

Greetings. I am Aun Khekierea. I have come to this city with my twin, Aukhe, to hunt the golem lords! While Aukhe has chosen to seek out the Coral Viceroys, I am hunting the most dangerous of the Golem Lords! The Platinum Golem Mountain King, who resides solely in the valleys that wreak of the atua ngamaru , has fallen before my claws.

Would you like to hunt them as well? Very well, scour this region and others like it and I am sure you will find the golem. Kill five of these golems, return to me and I will see that your battles are rewarded!

greetings: Welcome back, Buhdi! Have you come to get your title? Excellent!
quest: Excellent! Your keh burns brightly with victory! Here is something to recognize your efforts in hunting the Glacial Golem Margraves!
Return the token to me and I will bestow an appropriate title upon you, buhdi!

Excellent! Your keh burns brightly with victory! As I promised, a reward for you! It isn't much, simply some fixings I brought with me from Timaru! Here, feast with me as we celebrate your achievement!
The spirits tell me you have defeated four of the Glacial Margraves! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
The spirits tell me you have defeated three of the Glacial Margraves! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
The spirits tell me you have defeated two of the Glacial Margraves! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
The spirits tell me you have defeated one of the Glacial Margraves! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
Good luck to you, hunter! Return to me to see your progress in your efforts against the Glacial Golem Margraves. The spirits will speak and tell me of your victories!

Greetings. I am Aun Maerirea. I am the third youngest of the seven who have left Palenqual to hunt! As I am the third youngest, I have chosen the Glacial Golem Margrave as my prey. They are powerful in their own right, but tend to employ the use of underlings in their battles as well.

Would you like to hunt them as well? Very well, scour this region and others like it and I am sure you will find the golem. Kill five of these golems, return to me and I will see that your battles are rewarded!

greetings: I remember this spear well. Long ago, before Palenqual appeared to show us the true way to create the weapons of life, I carved this spear to be wed to a figurine of Tonk. Together, ths two would realize their vital potential, creating a living spear fit for the finest of our warriors.

I gifted my dear friend Tanua with it, in the night before he left the safety of Timaru to persuade the Hea against their vile pact with the Virindi. I cannot know how he fared, for he never returned to us. If you now have only this part of his weapon, it can only mean that the Hea have betrayed us once more. Please take this back--the sight of it only stirs memories of pain.

I remember this figurine well. Long ago, before Palenqual appeared to show us the true way to create the weapons of life, I molded this figurine to be wed to a spear carved with care. Together the two would realize their vital potential, creating a living spear fit for the finest of our warriors.

I remember this taiaha well. Long ago, before Palenqual appeared to show us the true way to create the weapons of life, I carefully carved a spear to be wed to a figuine of Tonk. Together the two would realize their vital potential, creating a spear fit for the finest of our warriors.

I gifted my dear friend Tanua with it, in the night before he left the safety of Timaru to persuade the Hea against their vile pact with the Virindi. I cannot know how he fared, for he never returned to us. If you now have possession of his weapon, it can only mean that the Hea have betrayed us once more. Please take this back--the sight of it only stirs memories of pain.

I'm sorry, friend, but this totem is obviously of Hea craftmanship. See its inferior carving? The totems I am seeking to restore to my people are made of greenstone, opal, and obsidian. And further--even though the Hea have demeaned themselves by stealing from us, I cannot accept something that belongs to them. You should take this to Aun Hareltah--our Tah will know what to do with it.
quest: Good to see you again! You and other adventurers have helped me regain a sufficient number of our totems. From now on, you may keep any more of our totems that you might find on the Hea.

Aun Shimauri tells you, Thank you, %s, friend of the Aun. You are continually proving your loyalty to us. You may keep this for your own use, and of course, Aun Kerehanua would be happy to greet you in Palenqual's Caverns should you wish to purchase another weapon from him.

Wharu take the Hea! They have stolen our precious totems. If you come across any Hea, you may dispatch them with the Aun's blessings. And if you should find one of our totems on them, bring it to me and I shall confide some of our secrets to you.

We alone among the Tonk have been blessed by Palenqual. In her wrath against Wharu, she has given us the weapons that live to fight against him. Find one of our totems on the Hea, and I will reward you with the friendship of the Aun.

Thank you, traveler. You have proven your friendship to the Aun. Now...Curses on the Hea and their thieving ways! If they had not stolen our totems, I would be able to reward you myself. But...I shall have to do second best. Here is a history I have written that explains Palenqual's gift of living weapons to us.

greetings: An Ebon Mattekar Hide. You must have hunted long to recover this fearsome trophy. Take it Tikakhe--he will provide you with a fragrant oil with which to tan this hide into leather.
I see you've created a buadren of your own! Tikakhe is a fine teacher. You must show it to him--he might even be able to enhance it for you as a reward.
A solid trunk such as this would be perfect to make a drum--if you hollowed it out first.

I have heard tell that these fiery beasts existed here on the mainland. In my homeland, the hides of Carenzi are the most suitable for the hardy straps that bind our drums but these hides will make do.
If you have already tanned an Ebon Mattekar Hide into leather, try covering this Hollow Trunk with it.
You nearly have a finished buadren! Use Leather Straps to bind the hide and trunk together.
Tika must think much of you to provide you with this oil. He carried only a special amount of it from Timaru.
I must congratulate you on your craftmanship in tanning this hide. Tikakhe himself could have done no better. This hide would make a perfect head for a drum.
You could use these straps to bind a drum.
I have asked you to take this ember into the Lightning-Sea, in hopes that you will be able to find Aun Tanua and give it to him.
The Invoker is yours to wield, for you have earned it.
Aun Aulakhe carefully lifts the glowing ember from your hands and gazes into it with awe.
Aun Tanua was unable to return with you again, but look! He has infused this ember with his own keh. I wonder...
Aulakhe kneels down and carefully adds the glowing ember to the encampment's fire.

This is a triumph, for even though he remains in captivity, Aun Tanua's spirit can now dance with our ancestors in the akiekie fire. For this I must reward you, for you have done the Tonk of Timaru a great service this day.
Give me the magic Buadren you received from Tikakhe, and I will add to its medicine.
quest: I must wait to engage your help in the great mission I have undertaken for my xuta  until you have gained in strength and accomplishment. Until then, may Tanae speed your hunt.

Greetings, friend. Although my mission remains, bringing calm to the Lightning-Sea has sorely taxed my strength, and I must meditate to regain it. Come back in four weeks-at that time I may need to call upon your help once more.
I would be happy to enhance the buadren that you made previously with Aun Tikakhe, if you would give it to me.
Aun Aulakhe looks at you expectantly, but when he realizes you returned alone, he is downcast.

It is as I suspected: while I can stabilize the path to find Aun Tanua, the bonds the Atua ngamaru have placed upon him are too strong. But were you able to deliver the ember I entrusted to your care?
Several moons ago, my father Shimauri summoned us to his accustomed story hour, to tell of a story never heard by my generation.

Long ago, in the combined pasts of the Hea and Aun, Aun Tanua was a nigh-legendary warrior who was beloved by our xuta. He left our gates to challenge the Puh in his mudflats of Ahurenga, never to return. We thought perhaps he had been captured or slain by the Hea, but now we have discovered the truth: when they were unable to conquer him, the Hea called upon the Atua ngamaru. Answering them, t...
My task is to find warriors brave enough to enter the Lightning-Sea, who can search for him and bring him back to us. My buhdi Tikakhe tells me that you might be the person we are looking for.
When you find Tanua, warm him with the ember of the akiekie fire that you see on the ground, for there is no telling how Aun Tanua's mind might have fared in his captivity.

My training, both in my homeland and with the Aualuan of your xuta, has taught me to create the Burning Pools that shimmer upon the Lightning-Sea. I have opened such a portal on the surface  of the akiekie pond,  and if you dare swim its depths, enter it and find Aun Tanua!
A word of advice: All must depend upon the coordination of their fellows to navigate the Shimmering Sea. Farewell, and Tanae speed you in your hunt.

Aun Aulakhe takes your Buadren and carefully leans into the heat and smoke of the fire. He slowly starts to beat the drum, infusing it with the heat and magic now emanating from the fire's warmth. As he drums, the fire's glow coalesces around the drum with a shimmering intensity. When it seems as if the Buadren itself will catch fire, Aulakhe removes it from the flames.

You have done the Aun of Timaru a great service today, and for this I shall reward you. I have bound this Buadren to Aun Tanua's own keh, so you may carry it against your enemies. In your time of greatest need, invoke him, and he will come to your aid.

My own mission here is not finished, for I shall not walk through the gates of Timaru until the day when Aun Tanua himself may walk beside me. If you would like to brave Aun Tanua's prison once more, come to me after the Shining Twins have finished their journey, when I will have regained the strength to stabilize the Lightning-Sea.

This is indeed a beautiful buadren that you have made. But I must ask you again, were you able to deliver the akiekie ember to Aun Tanua? Even though he did not return with you, do you bring word from him?

My father, Aun Shimauri, sent me to the mainland to accomplish a great mission for our xuta. At the moment, I must still ponder on how I will fullfill it. For now, perhaps you should speak to Aun Tikakhe--he has a proposition that might interest you greatly.
This is indeed a beautiful buadren that you have made. If you are willing to undertake a special mission for me, I might be able to enhance this buadren for you once you return.

This is indeed a beautiful Buadren you have made. When you are strong enough, I will ask you to undertake a special mission for me. When you complete it, I will be able to enhance this Buadren for you once you return.

greetings: I thank you for this effort, but this piece of debris is from the stone ring in the northwest.
I thank you for this effort, but this piece of debris is from the stone ring in the southwest.
I thank you for this effort, but this piece of debris is from the stone ring in the southeast.
I thank you for this effort, but this piece of debris is from the stone ring in the northeast.
Yes, you are %s, who has helped us hold Wharu at bay. Greetings.
quest: You! Stonebreaker! The spiritcallers know your name now, and will not be duped again by you.
What do want here? Attempt to deceive us again with that fiendish bell and we will mark you for all to see!
Aun Kahmaula tells you, "How foolish do you think us, %s? We know your evil name, yes, we do. You have done your damage to our efforts just recently!"
"Begone, and take your hideous bell with you. Even if you return in three weeks, it shall be too soon for me."
Aun Kahmaula tells you, "Praise the stars and sky, and praise to you, %s. This will heal the stones at this place."
Greetings, seeker. I am a spiritcaller of the Aun xuta. We are responsible for maintaining the stone rings of this island.
Please disturb not my work, for all depends upon this rhythm.
How interesting. This is an instrument used by your people? Tonk says 'music is all and everlasting'
The crashing of the great pyreal bell reverberates through the ground. The menhir stones crack and break!
No! What have you done? Villian!
I must go and warn the xuta.
You are selfless, Isparian. You have assisted me in repairing this ring within the last three weeks. I cannot ask you to help me again.

greetings: Try giving that to the Human my friend.
Try giving that to the Lugian my friend.
I'm sorry, I'm not in charge of collecting that type of material. Try seeing if the other collectors, Kreavon or Caelis Renning, need any of that.
You should be proud not so many are skilled Trappers like you.
quest: Hello Isparian, my name is Aun Teverea.  All Tumeroks in the xuta of Aun Hareltah have been invited to join the new alliance.

We are assigned to this outpost near Wai Jhou, to collect building materials for the continued upkeep of Candeth Keep, the South Direlands stronghold. I will accept all types of cloth and hide that you can afford to donate to the cause.  Large or small, your donations will be treated equally.
Would you care to provide us with more materials? I accept all types of salvaged hide and cloth that you can afford to donate to the cause.
Welcome back, your continued help is most welcome! Any salvaged hide and cloth you can donate is greatly appreciated.
Thank you friend.  It takes many skins to build the tents and lean-to's we Tumeroks use in Candeth Keep.
You are off to a very good start. Yet, building materials are still in short supply. Please continue to bring me what you can.  If only Wharu had a salvageable hide...
Ah, more materials for the stronghold.  The reedshark, the armoredillo, and even the auroch have provided us the resources needed to survive in these harsh lands.
You have given me one-half the hide and cloth materials that I would ask of you. The residents of Candeth Keep shall know you by your name and your deeds.

Tell Many of the hide and cloth materials you have donated are now being cut and prepared for transport to Candeth Keep. With the harsh conditions and powerful creatures in the South Dires they can always use the new material supplies.  Your efforts shall be rewarded.
You have given much to help the alliance.  More materials are still needed, but rest assured you have donated the bulk of the quota set forth by the alliance council.

The storehouses are beginning to fill with the materials you and the others have generously given to the cause.  We now have enough materials to make another delivery to Candeth Keep, but we will surely need more to maintain our stronghold.
Friend, your hard work has paid off.  You have given the most that can be donated by any one member.
You will be welcomed in Candeth Keep as a co-founder.  Your donations of cloth and animal hide will not go unrewarded.
If you would like to be known as a skilled trapper, return this token to me.
Take this animal for your head. It keeps you warm on cold nights of hunting.

You have given one-half the resources of which the alliance is seeking from each member.  It is people like you who will be considered the true founders of Candeth Keep.  The alliance has allocated a symbolic gift for all of those who show dedication to the project.
You have helped us greatly. You can be sure that your efforts in continuing to provide materials for Candeth Keep will not go unrewarded.
You have given more than enough materials my friend. Perhaps the other collectors still require other materials.

greetings: No thanks, I think the shamman could use some water though.
I knew you were good for something!  You just don't find enough writing paper on beasts anymore.  Don't you wish that all creatures carried more parchment?
Thanks! It's really dry out here and I keep getting too involved in my work to remember to drink something.
Oh, for me?
Mrmrmmm, good...
Ah! That was good. I feel much better now. Your not such a bad no-tail, not like that last one I met. Make sure that you help us build the town by donating materials.
quest: You destroyed my day's work! Now I have to go back and recalculate all of the distances! Get out of my sight, you bahka!
I know you are eager to help, but please do not fool with my tripod.
You would be interrupting my important work for something very important, yes?
No? Then please go bother someone else!
Did you come all the way out here just to make my job even harder?
I swear I placed my last piece of parchment right here.
I must record the latest measurements before the next bahka comes along and decides it's funny to destroy my work.
Oh no, I don't mean you, I'm sure you are a very nice no-tail and looks aren't everything.
I'm sorry, it's been a rough day.  We're on a tight schedule and sometimes I lose my temper.  Surveying is a thankless job, you know.

greetings: Ah yes, here you are.

I stand here to protect my Aun brothers while they fullfill the mission entrusted to them by Shimauri. Our ancient rivalry with the Hea still stands, and I have seen untold numbers of their xuta during our tour of this land. It shall be as I have sworn: they shall not stray near our small akiekie while I am on guard.

Aulakhe has continued his studies with the great one,  Ispar Celdisethaua. He can now instill his Invokers with even more power. If he created one for you in the past, he has given me permission to exchange one of his newer ones for it.
chatter: %n stands protectively in front of his fledgling akiekie.
%n shivers and barely suppresses a sneeze.

greetings: I thought I told you to take this to that bukha Toneawa!
How dare you bring this sorry note to me! I have already seen its contents!
You can almost see the waves of anger radiating from Bernawa's countenance.
I'm sure that traitor would be be interested in seeing this. Perhaps he will have the bravery to show up himself for once!

Hm...let me see...that bakha Toneawa! If he dares to think that he can meet my little sister here in secret he's got another thing coming. She will never be corrupted by that melodramatic sissy! If I ever catch him lurking about in our arbor again, I'll cut off his OWN tail for him! He'll wish he'd never left Timaru for Ahurenga! And if he thinks I'll let Mariona run away with him across the wa...
quest: YOU! Back again? Be off with you--and tell Hea Toneawa once and for all that the Aun will have nothing to do with him.
I am waiting here for Hea Toneawa. I don't suppose he gave anything to you for my sister, Mariona?
chatter: I wonder if that bakha will have the gall to show up himself?

greetings: Hey, money! I appreciate it. Your contributions are welcome.
I heard a secret, but it'll cost you more than that.

So, Samuel in Eastham claims to have some sort of new wonder drink! He says it cured him of his nightmares. So, I went to the Singularity Caul, got some of those bits he makes the drink from, and gave them over... Can't say that it did much for me outside of clinging to my throat on the way down...
Have you found them yet? Those Singularity Caul reliquaries I keep hearing about? I hear people have found some strange items in them!
Lord Kresovus has put out a call for help. The Queen offered her aid, but he said he would rather seek assistance from independent adventurers. I wonder what that's all about?
The Queen is looking for help in finding out how Carlo di Cenza found his way to Dereth. Talk to Antius Blackmoor in Yaraq if you wish to help!
Last month I found what I thought was the most powerful sword I have yet come across. But this month, I found an even better one! This a good time to be a hunter!
Has that 50,000 pyreal piece of armor been cluttering up your house chest for too long? Well, go to Shoushi, Yaraq, or Holtburg and sell it!
A friend of mine was hunting the Singularity Caul when he came across a powerful new creature. It was a tough fight, he said, but he got a nifty spear out of the deal.

My good friend Loh-Gann Huhjj found a page from Carlo di Cenza's journal on the beach near the northern Beach Fort. It appears to be part of a much larger work. I sure hope he finds all the pieces. I am very interested in this Viamontian's past.
If you stand on the northern shores and listen closely enough, you can hear the screams of war. What madness makes its home up there? And when will it find its way to our lands?

Oh just like everyone else, my advice is only good enough for a paltry amount of pyreals! Well thank you, Mr. Pyrealbags this'll go a long way toward providing for my family. I'm sure that an egg will feed me, my three kids and my spouse.
Oh you just don't know...

Need a vassal? I won't ask for much just some tinkered armor and maybe a tinkered weapon. Oh and maybe a few MMD trade notes, or maybe some golem hearts, wasp wings, armoredillo spines, lugian sinews, dark revenant thigh bones, full sturdy iron key rings, full singularity key rings, or anything else that you don't need.
They say that Asheron went back home. I can't wait to see what he does, now that he's in control of the place.
Town criers are available in most major towns to tell you of the latest news and events. We'll also give you a piece of information for a bit of money.
Has it really been a year since poor Samuel was discharged from the Royal Guard? I would like to say Eastham was better for it, but... well... Sam hasn't done much outside of drink.
I can't wait to put this back together!
The Town Crier produces a handful of some blackened mineral.
Wait, you can't have this! It's mine! If you want some for yourself, you'll have to get it on your own!
I was speaking with a Lugian friend of mine the other day when he mentioned something about a great disturbance. He refused to elaborate, though I plied him with enough ale to drop a horse.
Have you read Carlo di Cenza's journal? I've never heard of a place called Shadow Pass, though I suspect the world outside of Dereth is much larger than we suspect.
If you're looking for some powerful weaponry, I recommend hunting some of Dereth's tougher creatures.
The vendors in Shoushi, Yaraq, and Holtburg must have benefited from those newly relocated casinos. They seem to have several more pyreals in their possession than usual.
What's the story behind these Banished creatures? They sure sound scary to me.
Who is this Sezzherei I keep hearing about? And what does he want with the Caul?
The Queen is greatly disturbed by the recent attack on the Royal Vaults. She fears we may not have heard the last of these mysterious Lugians.
The wind from the north grows cold. I fear a storm may be on the horizon.

Did you know that they moved us to a new pay schedule? We only get paid once a month, and only on the first day of the month. But I'm expected to be at my post the same amount of hours... Oh sure the town crier is here for you, but where's the love for us, huh?

So I'm sure you've noticed that I haven't left this spot in nearly four years. Yeah it's a tough life, standing here all day. Sure... sometimes people are nice enough to give me Shackles of Obedience. But I was wondering...Need a patron?

quest: Someone just informed me there is a problem at the warehouse.  Perhaps you could go check?
We are still trying to determine what happened at the warehouse.
How are things with you?
I will give this additional one to Nuhmudira. We are still trying to determine what happened at the warehouse.

Hello. I am a student of Nuhmudira. Nuhmudira is still enlisting the services of Isparians in obtaining some rare compounds and crystals necessary for her research into Lifestones. Dark Tree Crystal and Valara crystal are critical to this research.

If you could aid us in this endeavour we would be most grateful. To obtain Dark Tree Crystal you should go to a mine northwest of Fort Danby. Then, bring the Dark Tree Crystal to an ancient Empyrean dungeon we are using as a storage warehouse. It is located northeast of the Eotensfang Cottages settlement- you may journey there via the settlement portals near Arwic.  A fellow student at that loc...

What is this?  It is a crystal I do not recognize.  I will make sure that it gets to Nuhmudira!  Did you see what happened at the warehouse?  We know not what occurred but many of the crystals that were collected for Nuhmudira are gone!
I am sorry, I believe you are not powerful enough to help us with what is needed at this time.

greetings: The mighty Ralirea sags from %s's fatal blow. "Ah, Mirakah," he murmurs. "I shall not be able to fill our stores this winter. But I will meet you at the lodge, my love... at last..." So saying, the hunter passes like the wind over sea.
Ralirea grunts as he swings his harpoon, "%s, I am among the greatest of the Aun hunters. You have little chance against me. Go you on your ways, and leave my party be."
Ralirea grunts as he swings his harpoon, "Leave me be! My skills are needed by the Aun, but if I wished to fight, I would be a warrior, not a hunter."
It is not as I would have had things, %s. Go in peace.
Well, then. Defend yourself.
chatter: Ralirea pokes the wood of his fire with a stick, and a swarm of embers ascend like fireflies. The hunter watches them, and sighs. "Ever do they fade," he murmurs.
Ralirea looks away toward the distant sea, and murmurs, "Somewhere..."
Ralirea grasps the small clay figurine that dangles from his neck, and holds it before the flickering light of the fire.
Ralirea sings, "The falling leaves glow red and gold,
the colors of faded glory,
the colors of faded dreams.
When I was young and strong and bold,
Ere I was old and hoary,
I knew that glory, so red, so gold - - -
The colors of faded dreams."
Ralirea sings, "In a distant land my love came to me
Her hair in braid and bow;
And long ago over shining sea
My love was lost in a gate's blue glow.
'Where has she gone?' her mother wails.
'Where has she gone?' she asks of me.
The wind asks 'Where?' in the sails
As ever I search over land and sea.
In a distant land my love was lost.
I seek it still, wherever I go,
through snow and gale and storm and frost:
Just a glimpse,
one more glimpse,
of that gate's blue glow."

greetings: What an unusual hide.  Surely something more interesting could be made from this. Seek out Yi Yo-Jin at Neydisa Castle.
There is nothing more I can do with this.
Thanks, but it's of no use to me.
How disgusting! There is, however, a sage somewhere in the southern mountain range that actually likes those things.  How revolting...
I can't work with this, but I hear there is a person in the Bandit Castle that can.
Hmm, I think that I once made a Helm that you could affix this to.
Hmm. A few snips here, and a few snips there...
Add some dye...There you go!
Here you go!
This is large enough to craft into a well fitting cuirass I think.
Well then. I think that this may be the first of a great many new robes to come my friend. Make sure to show your friends.
Not quite as sturdy as the tanned red hide that I worked with before, but it's still strong enough and large enough to craft into a nice robe. Wear it well.
Let's see. The hide is thick and leathery, and aside from the small bony protrusions it's in fine shape. I think a nice set of leggings.
There you go.
Another fine specimen. A little thicker than the last shreth hide I was given to work with. Let me have a moment and I'll... Yes, yes that's it!
Here you go.
Where did you get this? It's rather frightening, and rancid smelling. Well, let me see what I can do with it.
I've seen something like this recently. Came from a carenzi though, it mottled and smelled rank. Much like this. Where are you finding these creatures?
Well, I've done the best I can.
What is this!? I've never seen anything like this. It will make a fine robe I think. Give me a moment.
Yes, there it is done.
I've seen some interesting hides pass my way, but the hides that people have been bringing me most recently are the oddest.
A few more threads...and done!
Be careful out there.
If you give me the hide of an armoredillo, gromnie, reedshark, or mattekar, I can make something with it that you may find useful.
chatter: I can take the hides of certain creatures and turn them into items of value.
Have you the skins of armoredillos, gromnies, or reedsharks?  I can use them in my craft.

greetings: Do not disturb my watch. The town depends on me to stay ever vigilant.
Yes, I can see your house from here, now leave me to my watch.
Go bug the gate guard or something. Can't you see I'm trying to defend the town from hordes of creatures bent upon our destruction?
Our Sparring Golems seem to be hemorrhaging tokens these days. Thanks--I'll return it to the Practice Area for you.
No thanks, I have no need for your Welcome Letter. Save it for later--someone in Yaraq may have a use for them.
No, thank you. This is for you to read and remember.
A fine piece. I remember the day I created my first Academy weapon well. This is yours, to remember us by.
We are here to guard the people of this town against any future attacks. If you have any questions, you should talk to the Senior Guard assigned to lead our garrison.
No thanks, I have no need for your Welcome Letter. Save it for later--someone in Shoushi may have a use for them.
No thanks, I have no need for your Welcome Letter. Save it for later--someone in Holtburg may have a use for them.

There have been reports of odd portal disruptions in this area. I've been sent to this outpost to keep watch. If you're new to this land, for safety's sake I'd suggest you stay well within the Arcanum's perimeter of Obelisks--at least until you're strong enough to venture out on your own.
quest: We have no more to teach you, friend. It is time for you to begin your journey. Use the portal to Yaraq. There, seek out Mara al-Luq.
She is the Explorer Society Agent in Yaraq; you can recognize her by her green robes. You will find her in the bar, which will be ahead of you and to the right when you exit the portal.
No, thank you. You should keep this for your records. Now you should use the portal to Yaraq to continue your adventures in Dereth.
The Sentry senses your arrival and slowly struggles to her feet.

You have arrived, at last. A devastating force of Hollow Minions just swept through the Outer Courtyard...who sent them, I know not. Whoever it was empowered them with an unspeakable strength...and I've now just received word that twelve of the Arrival Points have been completely destroyed. We can only be thankful that our Queen had the foresight to fortify this one. Please patrol the Outer Cou...
What's this?
As the Sentry struggles to read the tattered parchment in the failing light, a wild comprehension crossed with fear dawns across her face. She begins to mutter softly to herself.

Martine's minions. We should have known... With his disappearance it was only a matter of time before his minions struck out on their own. We must endeavour to redouble our efforts against this new...
The Sentry suddenly becomes aware of your presence once more and pulls herself together.
You have helped us more than you can know. Take this last gift from us at the Academy--it will serve you well in your initial travels.
Also, you should keep this. Save it for your records of these strange occurrances.
Now you must leave here. There is nothing more that we can teach you here, yet so much that we must thank you for. Use the portal to Yaraq. There, seek out Mara al-Luq.
Defending the town my Patron!
I'm on patrol serving the greater good.
We have no more to teach you, friend. It is time for you to begin your journey. Use the portal to Shoushi. There, seek out Oi-Tong Ye.
He is the Explorer Society Agent in Shoushi; you can recognize him by his green robes. You will find him in the bar, which will be some fifty paces to the east when you exit the portal.
No, thank you. You should keep this for your records. Now you should use the portal to Shoushi to continue your adventures in Dereth.
Now you must leave here. There is nothing more that we can teach you here, yet so much that we must thank you for. Use the portal to Shoushi. There, seek out Oi-Tong Ye.
We have no more to teach you, friend. It is time for you to begin your journey. Use the portal to Holtburg. There, seek out Flinrala Ryndmad.

She is the Explorer Society Agent in Holtburg; you can recognize her by her green robes. You will find her in the bar, which will be ahead of you and very slightly to the right when you exit the portal.
No, thank you. You should keep this for your records. Now you should use the portal to Holtburg to continue your adventures in Dereth.
Now you must leave here. There is nothing more that we can teach you here, yet so much that we must thank you for. Use the portal to Holtburg. There, seek out Flinrala Ryndmad.
chatter: The %n scans the area for any encroaching dangers.

greetings: Welcome back, Buhdi! Have you come to get your title? Excellent!
quest: Excellent! Your keh burns brightly with victory! Here is something to recognize your efforts in hunting the Mud Golem Sludge Lords!
Return the token to me and I will bestow an appropriate title upon you, buhdi!

Excellent! Your keh burns brightly with victory! As I promised, a reward for you! It isn't much, simply some fixings I brought with me from Timaru! Here, feast with me as we celebrate your achievement!
The spirits tell me you have defeated four of the Sludge Lords! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
The spirits tell me you have defeated three of the Sludge Lords! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
The spirits tell me you have defeated two of the Sludge Lords! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
The spirits tell me you have defeated one of the Sludge Lords! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
Good luck to you, hunter! Return to me to see your progress in your efforts against the Mud Golem Sludge Lords. The spirits will speak and tell me of your victories!

Greetings. I am Aun Akuarea. I am the youngest of the seven who have left Palenqual to hunt! As I am the youngest, I have chosen the Mud Golem Sludge Lord as my prey. They are slow, but powerful for one such as I.

Would you like to hunt them as well? Very well, scour this region and others like it and I am sure you will find the golem. Kill five of these golems, return to me and I will see that your battles are rewarded!

greetings: I thank you for this effort, but this piece of debris is from the stone ring in the northwest.
I thank you for this effort, but this piece of debris is from the stone ring in the southwest.
I thank you for this effort, but this piece of debris is from the stone ring in the northeast.
I thank you for this effort, but this piece of debris is from the stone ring in the north.
Yes, you are %s, who has helped us hold Wharu at bay. Greetings.
quest: You! Stonebreaker! The spiritcallers know your name now, and will not be duped again by you.
What do want here? Attempt to deceive us again with that fiendish bell and we will mark you for all to see!
Aun Tanaua tells you, "How foolish do you think us, %s? We know your evil name, yes, we do. You have done your damage to our efforts just recently!"
"Begone, and take your hideous bell with you. Even if you return in three weeks, it shall be too soon for me."
Aun Tanaua tells you, "Praise the stars and sky, and praise to you, %s. This will heal the stones at this place."
Hail. The spiritcallers of the Aun drum here in the old rings. Stone says they were placed long ago, by those who no longer walk these lands.
How interesting. This is an instrument used by your people? Tonk says 'music is all and everlasting'
The crashing of the great pyreal bell reverberates through the ground. The menhir stones crack and break!
No! What have you done? Villian!
I must go and warn the xuta.
You are selfless, Isparian. You have assisted me in repairing this ring within the last three weeks. I cannot ask you to help me again.

My brothers have stationed themselves across this land, hunting the strongest of the creatures you call golems. They are not selfish, and during the times that they are at rest, they will be happy to share in the hunt and reward those who have taken up the same challenge as they. Please go visit them.
Greetings. I am Aun Kielerea, a hunter for the Aun Xuta. My brothers and I have ventured away from the land of Palenqual to seek out mightier prey than what can be found near our home.
This does not mean we have forsaken Aun Hareltah, rather that we are looking for glorious battle against truly worthy opponents. And we believe we have found it!
May you always be brave in battle.

greetings: The Totem of Temepuh! You have done well to bring this to us, friend, but I fear I am not the proper person to receive it from you. You should speak with my kinsmen Kiriona, Rukuona, and Turiona.
This is a wondrous item! My thanks to you for allowing me to work with it! Here, I will just tighten this, and loosen ... hmmm ... That's not right.
Aun Ngationa frowns at the buadren, turning it over and over in his hands.
Well ... here you are! Do you like my work? If you are not pleased, I can put it back the way it was ... I think.
Well, I am still learning after all. Let me repair this for you.
Truly a spear of legend! Let me try to modify it for you. I think that this will work... Here you are!
If you don't like the results, I can change it back for you.
Truly a vicious scalpel! Let me try to modify it for you. I think that this will work... Here you are!
What an amazing bow! Let me try to modify it for you. I think that this will work... Here you are!
Let me try to modify this crop for you. I think that this will work... Here you are!
Greetings, Isparian! I am Aun Ngationa, and I am here in Timaru to learn statecraft from my kinsman Aun Hareltah. If I learn well, I may one day act as envoy to your people.

Aun Hareltah has asked me to assist our drummers by organizing any bits of stone debris or rubble that can be found. I will sort this debris, and send it out to our drummers where it can do the most good. If you bring me a piece of rubble I will reward you well for it -- although if you wish to aid us more directly, you should still take the rubble directly to the proper menhir ring.
In addition, I have also been experimenting with modifying certain buadrens. If you happen to possess the Awakener of Hea Karenua, I will modify it for you.
quest: You are selfless, Isparian. You have assisted our drummers in the northwest within the last three cycles. I cannot ask you to help me again.
You are selfless, Isparian. You have assisted our drummers in the southwest within the last three cycles. I cannot ask you to help me again.
You are selfless, Isparian. You have assisted our drummers in the southeast within the last three cycles. I cannot ask you to help me again.
You are selfless, Isparian. You have assisted our drummers in the northeast within the last three cycles. I cannot ask you to help me again.
You are selfless, Isparian. You have assisted our drummers in the north within the last three cycles. I cannot ask you to help me again.
My thanks to you, Isparian. This piece can be used to heal the stones in the northwest. Accept this gift from our proud drummers.
My thanks to you, Isparian. This piece can be used to heal the stones in the southwest. Accept this gift from our proud drummers.
My thanks to you, Isparian. This piece can be used to heal the stones in the southeast. Accept this gift from our proud drummers.
My thanks to you, Isparian. This piece can be used to heal the stones in the northeast. Accept this gift from our proud drummers.
My thanks to you, Isparian. This piece can be used to heal the stones in the north. Accept this gift from our proud drummers.

greetings: I thank you for this effort, but this piece of debris is from the stone ring in the southwest.
I thank you for this effort, but this piece of debris is from the stone ring in the southeast.
I thank you for this effort, but this piece of debris is from the stone ring in the northeast.
I thank you for this effort, but this piece of debris is from the stone ring in the north.
Yes, you are %s, who has helped us hold Wharu at bay. Greetings.
quest: You! Stonebreaker! The spiritcallers know your name now, and will not be duped again by you.
What do want here? Attempt to deceive us again with that fiendish bell and we will mark you for all to see!
Aun Aanaua tells you, "How foolish do you think us, %s? We know your evil name, yes, we do. You have done your damage to our efforts just recently!"
"Begone, and take your hideous bell with you. Even if you return in three weeks, it shall be too soon for me."
Aun Aanaua tells you, "Praise the stars and sky, and praise to you, %s. This will heal the stones at this place."
You, Isparian, listen and mark me. These circles amplify the power of our drumming.
When we sit within the stones, our rhythms resound within the forms of the Olthoi. They stay hidden in their lairs, and we are safe.
The other circles now are broken. Only this one keeps- ah, but I cannot speak it! Defend me!
How interesting. This is an instrument used by your people? Tonk says 'music is all and everlasting'
The crashing of the great pyreal bell reverberates through the ground. The menhir stones crack and break!
No! What have you done? Villian!
I must go and warn the xuta.
You are selfless, Isparian. You have assisted me in repairing this ring within the last three weeks. I cannot ask you to help me again.

greetings: This looks to be a very important report. I think that this should be delivered to Captain K'rank. I do not wish to keep such an important report from his hands.
I have been sent by High Queen Elysa to reward those who have assisted Captain K'rank of Linvak Tukal. If you have proof of this assistance give it to me and I will see that you are rewarded.
quest: Aun Faranua says, "Hail %tn. I see that you have returned to shatter the morale of the Burun again. Your efforts continue to assist our people in lessening the threat these creatures pose. Here are your rewards."
The key will open whichever chest you choose in that room. Each chest should clearly display what it holds.
Aun Faranua says, "That is all that I have to give. Thank you again for your efforts, %tn."

Aun Faranua says, "Hail %tn. Again you take the head of the Burun leader, Morgluuk. You are surely a hero to all. As we have already placed the creatures head outside of the city in your honor, this one will be turned into a trophy that you can display with honor, %tn."
%tn has defeated Morgluuk and received a glorious reward for their efforts.
Filthy creatures these Burun. As promised you are to be rewarded for your efforts.
A brave warrior who has continued our efforts to crush the morale of the Burun and the renegades. You have done well. Here take this and display it proudly.
Aun Faranua exclaims, "%tn, you have killed the Burun leader, Morgluuk! This head is proof of what you have done. All should know your name."

%tn has slain Morgluuk and returned his head to the Tonk capital of Timaru. There it is to be placed on a pike as a symbol of victory for the Isparian, Lugian and Tumerok people and a symbol of defeat for the Burun that threaten our way of life. Huzzah, %tn!
You must be rewarded for your efforts.

Aun Faranua says, "The portal gem will take you into the High Queen's Vault. There you will find many chests that house treasures and weaponry that has been worked on by the finest smiths in the land. Take your gift and use it well, %tn. You are deserved of much praise in this victory."
Aun Faranua says, "That is the final reward I have for you. You have become a hero to all of Dereth, %tn. I shall never forget your name or your deeds."

greetings: You have done well to bring this to us, friend, but I fear I am not the proper person to receive it from you. Take this to Aun Ngationa there; he can receive it from you.
Greetings, tail-less one! I am Aun Rukuona, and I am here in Timaru to learn statecraft from my kinsman Aun Hareltah. If I learn well, I may one day act as envoy to your people.
Aun Hareltah has tasked me with rewarding Isparians who defeat Hea Temepuh. Give me the Totem of Temepuh and I will give you the Stave of Palenqual.
quest: You are too helpful, friend Isparian. But I cannot reward you for your efforts so often. Take this back, and bring it to me again when the cycle of the days has turned three times.
The Totem of Temepuh! Aun Hareltah will want to see this at once! And I must reward you, friend.

This is the Stave of Palenqual -- the living totem of this island itself, given to us by spirits of this place who call themselves Deru. It may be turned into a powerful force for good or ill. But you have difficult choices to make before it will serve you. The note I gave you will explain.
The Totem of Temepuh! Aun Hareltah will want to see this at once! But ...
Aun Rukuona looks puzzled. He cups the totem in the palm of his hand and closes his eyes. He shakes his head, studies the totem closely, and then frowns at you.
You attempt to deceive me. You did not kill the scourge of the uplands.

greetings: You have done well to bring this to us, friend, but I fear I am not the proper person to receive it from you. Take this to Aun Ngationa there; he can receive it from you.
Greetings, Isparian! I am Aun Kiriona, and I am here in Timaru to learn statecraft from my kinsman Aun Hareltah. If I learn well, I may one day act as envoy to your people.
Aun Hareltah has tasked me with rewarding Isparian no-tails who defeat Hea Temen .. ah, Temepuh. Give me the Totem of Temepuh and I will give you the Hoeroa of Palenqual.
quest: You are too helpful, friend Isparian. But I cannot reward you for your efforts so often. Take this back, and bring it to me again when the cycle of the days has turned three times.
The Totem of Temepuh! Aun Hareltah will want to see this at once! And I must reward you, friend.

This is the Hoeroa of Palenqual -- the living totem of this island itself, given to us by spirits of this place who call themselves Deru. It may be turned into a powerful force for good or ill. But you have difficult choices to make before it will serve you. The note I gave you will explain.
The Totem of Temepuh! Aun Hareltah will want to see this at once! But ...
Aun Kiriona looks puzzled. She cups the totem in the palm of her hand and closes her eyes. She shakes her head, studies the totem closely, and then frowns at you.
You attempt to deceive me. You did not kill the scourge of the uplands.

greetings: The keh have spoken to me and I have translated their words to paper for you. I have used your language so as to not confuse you.
Orders to establish contact with the race from beyond this world. What plans will our once brothers derive next? I will see that Ispar Elysatah receives this report. Thank you.
Farewell budhi.

They wished to ally with Aerbax? Going back to the atua ngamaru that began all the problems for the Tonk... I am sorry for my brothers. I fear they may be beyond salvation. I will see that Ispar Elysatah is informed of this discovery.
Interesting. It appears as though they modeled their fortress after Candeth Keep. How could they have done such a thing without the original designs? I will inform Ispar Elysatah of these findings.

I do not understand how such things could have occurred. These are the exact prints that were used when creating Candeth Keep. They had gone missing. Now they are found being spirited to the race from beyond. For what fell purpose? I will see that Ispar Elysatah hears of this.

Foul beasts. They mean to make war on us all and overwhelm this world for what appears to be Wharu. They claim they have begun to change the burnt lands; the desert I think? Be wary of this foe. I fear that they will arrive in greater waves.

I have seen such things before. These are stones carried by Mosswarts, and given to others as a gesture of gratitude. Clearly you have done some kind deed for one of their kin. Take it and display it with pride.
Your skill in negotiating with a warlike creature should be known to all. I will give you a token - if you wish to be known henceforth as a diplomat, simply hand the token back to me.
Let it be known to all that you are a Diplomat!

I recognize this. I have seen these stones carried by Mosswarts who are in mourning. I have heard that the Mosswarts have been driven from the Blackmire, and that the survivors carry these stones in memory of their lost kin.
There is a dark cloud over this stone. I sense that its owner came to you for help, and you failed him or betrayed him in some way. Take it away from me.
This I do not recognize.
I am disturbed. The keh do not recognize this idol. Was this taken from the newcomers? It is a thing that has never before been seen on this world. Please, keep it.
A vile beast! What villainy lurks in the hearts of these creatures! There is no word in the Tonk language to describe the atrocity that these beasts can manage.
It appears that the rumors that have been spreading through Elysatah's court could well be true.
Aun Laokhe sighs.

Apparently there has been some activity in the Direlands Swamp in an area once populated heavily by the Mosswarts. The Mosswarts have reached out and asked us for assistance, as you might know. Bleeargh, an emissary that sought out your people recently, went before Elysatah and asked for assistance. She told the Mosswart that they would afford him passage so long as he and his tribe remained pe...
I speak of this because many believe that the Mosswart exodus is related to the increase of the  Burun, especially in the direlands. I think that it would be better for me to write this down for you.
Please, look into this matter for all our sakes.
Interestingly, I do not sense the rage within this creature that I do in his brother. He appears decidedly confused. Perhaps there is hope to sway him to our cause of peace...
This appears to be a potent spell. The spirits have told me how to craft it into a readable version.

Hail budhi, I come from the council chambers of Ispar Elysatah with a request. She bids that willing souls investigate the origin of the dark magics that spread across Osteth and Palenqual. She has heard that new anima have spread from the place where the kah took place. Should you find anything of note, I would like to see it. I will be calling on the keh of the Nuuani for aid to understand th...
Should you find any odd writing that the other translators cannot decipher, perhaps the keh of the Nuuani will help decipher those as well.
quest: This should never happen. What the heck did you do to the game!?

greetings: %mn's ethereal energies wash over you as its form dissipates into nothingness. You feel changed somehow.
A shrieking voice wails, "Cross over my child.  All are welcome.  Go into the Light.  There is peace and serenity in the Light."
A fading voice cries, "There is no death.  It is only a transition to a different sphere of consciousness."
%mn's ethereal energies wash over you as its form dissipates into nothingness. You feel changed somehow.

quest: You are too frail to aid me in this creature. Return when your bones are equal to that of sixty.

My purpose is plain, I watch the dead that reside within the halls of this temple. I have stood this vigil since my sacrifice over thirty thousand years ago, when the world cooled and the darkness made war upon all. There is no threat to the inhabitants within. Your service is not needed.

My purpose is plain, I watch the dead that reside within the halls of this temple. I have stood this vigil since my sacrifice over thirty thousand years ago, when the world cooled and the darkness made war upon all. The weight of time has long crushed my bones to dust and left with me with this incorporeal form. Yet, I serve my purpose with the same vigor that I did in life.

I will not find rest until the threat from beyond is quashed. They will spread like a plague across this world if they are not shattered. Great waves of magic shall crash against their flesh and be pulled into their bodies. Their strength will grow until they can no longer be touched and then all shall be lost beneath the weight of their power.

A great failure for our sisterhood. They grew where our chosen fell. Now they come to shattered the coil of this world as we shattered the coil of theirs. You must defeat the behemoth within these halls else its power grow until it is unchecked by any force that remains on this world.
A threat, not of this world grows within the belly of this temple. They have come from across the stars, across the divide between our worlds with one thought in their ravenous minds; destruction.

Their pilgrimage is for naught, there are no sisters left upon this world who draw breath, there are none who recall the glory of Golden Shores and the valley wherein Ualannan once held vigil watching over all our sisters. All is dust, but this will not deter these beasts from another world.

They come and they shall spread their rot to the core of this world and there it shall grow unfettered until all is consumed and destroyed. You must destroy the beasts within the deepest halls of the Izji Qo's temple. They have found passage within and slaughtered or consumed all souls that have stood against their trespass.

The delta is long covered in the harsh and dry sands. If the taint unleashed from the world long hidden by the portals within these halls has claim all will be fertile to point of death. Life will grow unchecked and there will be a choking that suffocates the core of this world and all who live on it.
Enter these halls and purge this taint. Then shall we rest, then shall we find peace.

Once, in a time before measure, I stood beside my sisters and together we faced our enemies without fear, full of purpose and resolve. A task so great lay before us that we sacrificed our lives to see that it would be done. My coming heralds that tasks arrival, but time has seen fit to grind my sister's bones to dust. We are no more, but still this threat looms.

Qin Xikit, Mistress of the Golden Shore, Keeper of the Kilika Vale in Ualannan's absence, lays beneath over thirty thousands years of weight. She has been silent these years imprisoned beneath her temple, bound by those who called her sister.

Once she walked amongst children of other suns and ushered them along a quickened path. Heresy! Cried our sisters and a great hunt began within our sect. A schism grew and swallowed our sisters in madness. They drew chains of mana about our immortal forms and locked our eternal bodies away.
Qin Xikit was the first to feel the sting of her sister's barbs, locked into a temple of her crafting, sealed away with the power of her crown.

Eternal silence is shattered and Qin Xikit stirs in her tomb. A gateway has opened and through it comes consumption. Sealed in her tomb the matron can do nothing and the spirits therein are all but gone. I am the last to hold vigil.

Seek her crown. Xi Ru consumed in madness, sealed Qin Xikit away. The crown must be found and the gateway to Qin Xikit's temple must be opened. At long last I can see Xi Ru's island, the magic that once locked it from sight has failed, a sister has succeeded at breaking the wards.
Rejoice! Absolution is at hand.

Within the halls of High Matriarch Ixir Zi's resting place grows a threat long thought gone. When first the worlds were closed and we passed through tunnels of sound and light we wrested the world from their grasp. They seek vengeance upon those who no longer draw breath.

Their avarice knows no bounds and they will not rest even though their greatest foes lie vanquished, crushed by the weight of time. Enter these halls and destroy them lest they draw the life from this world and turn all to ruin.

greetings: I fail, the crown is stolen. The way to the deceiver's hall will be opened and all that walk in light shall know darkness.

A haunting voice echoes in the halls of the Keep. "Light is not lost on this world yet. I shall enact my part of this bargain, outlander. Seek vengeance for the countless years, the suffering and the agony of those she has destroyed. Blessings of Ithaenc go with you."

The songs of my sisters echo across eternity and I am left to rot; bound through the arts of ill-wind taught by sisters who had fallen to the call of the twisted dark. Thousands of years bound against my will to a tether not of my making, bereft of power and ability to purchase a final release, I have waited and watched within the walls of this prison.

The skein of her life now draws taut as she is stirred to action, re-exerting her command over these halls and drawing on the lives of those she once imprisoned. Through the countless years, most that were bound here against their will have become lost and slipped into madness, the echo of their lives now scattered dust and formless agony. Not I.

I recall the device, the tool used to pull the blood of my heart into a vessel that held my precious vitae long enough to rip free my soul and lock it within the walls of this keep, evermore a servant to her will. But my years of servitude draw near an end, and through the voices of elder sisters who sang to the deep and refused to sell our secrets to the Dericost, I am given a moment of clarit...

Aerfalle has changed. She has grown her flesh anew and taken the glamour of her youth. But all this imagery is false. She risks more power at the cost of those bound in these halls. My fallen sisters seek not redemption, but through their folly they will give me mine. Aerfalle's strength lies in tunnels long crushed by the weight of time, halls within this keep that you cannot traverse, halls w...
But I cannot lessen her strength without an instrument of sacrifice. The blade that drew my heart's blood must be used to stab at her crusted heart and weaken her strength.
Bring me the dagger and I shall take my revenge and aid you in her destruction.

%s, you know not what you do. If you walk through that door and open the way, Qin Xikit will wash this world in darkness. Her wickedness will further cloud the minds of the Empyrean and all will fall. We will be wiped from the world. Rethink your actions, %s!
The relentless pounding of Hea Kanokeh's drum has summoned a nearby Nualuan warrior to join the fight!

Temenua glances down at the hole that now graces his chest, courtesy of %s. "Hm," he says, almost offhandedly, as he fingers the edge of the wound. "You were the better. Well played. I pray Tonk will allow me to face you again some day." With this, he carefully lays himself down on the earth, and dies.
Bah.
The atual arutoa defend me.
The atual arutoa are my keep and my shield.
I will walk where the paths the atual arutoa point me toward.
I will take comfort in the protection of the atual arutoa.
Temenua shakes his head at %s's perforated corpse. "Hmph."
Temenua coolly assesses %s, and announces, "By the authority granted me by Hea Arantah, I must declare you a trespasser in these Hea lands of Palenqual. Remove from here or die. It is one to me."
Temenua silently and efficiently nocks an arrow in his bow, and draws on bead on %s.
Karenua? Some help.
Bah, we are not mercenaries.  Anything we wish to say, we say, coins or no coins.  But I'll keep the money.  It is the cost of your insult.
There are rumors of Carenzi infestations on the island, but we're not worried.
News! A search party has been sent for Hea Toneawa. We believe he is consorting with the enemy.
Hea Riketura has announced a bounty on the heads of our Aun brethren. Those who bring him an Aun birth pendant shall be rewarded handsomely!
The Aun have placed a bounty on the atual arutoa, who helped us gain our freedom. Now the enemy of the Virindi are also our enemy!
All Hea should report to Rangaua for briefing on the Palenqual affair. From this time forward the Hea shall have no traffic with the Aun.
News! More Hea are leaving the island than ever before!  All Hea who wish to rejoin with our brethren in Osteth must first fullfill their obligations to the atual arutoa.
Heed my warning, pale one. Our glorious tah, Hea Arantah, has gained many powers from his dealings with the atual arutoa. But he is... passionate. Do not meddle in his affairs if you value your life.

Many years ago, when Hea and Aun lived together in Timaru, the atual arutoa greeted our glorious tah. The Aun were cruel and cold to him, though they will tell you otherwise. An orphan, they cared for him not. Starving, they feed him not. To Hea Arantah alone, chosen of the atual arutoa, were offered powers of great wrath, with which he lead the outcast and scorned children of Timaru into the w...

Hea Tuperea hunts for our tah along the base of the plateau. If you meet in your travels, stay upwind of him. His hunters are fierce, and have been been given their share in the blessings of the atual arutoa. Mighty and strange are the atual arutoa, who care even to bless the beasts of the field.

The poacher Aun Ralirea vexes our tah. He hunts the things you call gromnies, up among their lairs on the plateau. Hea Arantah has set aside a great reward for the one who brings him proof of Ralirea's demise. I suppose he would even grant it to a soft one like you, if you managed it. But don't try to decieve our glorious tah by claiming the deed of another! He can read your keh like the speedi...

The Aun xuta shall not long sully the lands which belong to the Hea xuta. Our glorious tah has set keen-eyed Hea Temenua and his brothers to watch the plateau. They will drive all from our rightful and well-earned holdings! Long ago, it was Temenua who captured the first of your kind that we met. She was given unto the atual arutoa, who said to us then, "Here are the ones we have gifted you in...
The atual arutoa watch over us, and our lands. You will not see them, but they are here, learning of Wharu.
Wharu's children are diligent. Their mother will return. They will see to it. As will the friends of the atual arutoa.

The rings the Aun shamans use are old and weak, like their arrogant tah. Every time the shamans beat their drums, the stones tremble. All that would be required to break them is a greater noise than that of Aun drums. Our glorious tah, Hea Arantah, would be much pleased if this were done.

The wretched Aun quiver in fear of Wharu's might. His hordes can eat the heart from the mightiest lodge's supports, and sweep the land of all but the bare stone and clean white bones. Aun drummers alone hold his divine shadow from swallowing the sun. But he shall be freed - so the atual arutoa have roared in the kehs of our xuta.

Tuperea staggers and falls to his knees. "Ah, my hunters, my precious children. I shall see you again, some day. Take your fill of my mortal flesh, my dears, and may it make you run strong across these fields."
Tuperea grins ferally at %s, "You are prey."
Tuperea grins ferally at %s, "You are meat."
Tuperea grins ferally at %s, "Here, my precious hunters! Bring this prey down, and we shall sup upon its flesh."
Tuperea grins ferally at %s, "The atual arutoa have taught me the way to remove and cure the flesh of your kind, prey. You will make a beautiful wrap for my wife."
Tuperea laughs as %s falls. "Your head shall make a fine addition to my collection, prey, and your flesh shall feed my loyal hunters."
Tuperea shouts, "Manuaka, Reshalra, Utelari, Sahkurea - to me, my faithful hunters! Run the prey %s to ground, and I shall crack the marrow from its bones for you!"
As %s's feeble spell is repulsed by Tuperea, he is heard to mutter, "Bah. A shaman. They always have such stringy meat..."
As the drum-speaker Hea Kanokeh falls, the Nualuan warriors of Temenua's party lose heart, and quickly leave the field of battle.
A quandary. I am all that is energy and living thought. I have form and can be destroyed. I am matter and energy at once, and yet I am defeated. No matter I am not dead, merely transformed!
%s has defeated Tempest, the Essence of Storms, repelling Gaerlan's forces back from the cities of the east...for now.
In my new gained sentience I did not understand destruction. But now I see that even I can be dispersed. But my death like yours is not permanent. I shall return sooner than you think.
%s has defeated Tempest, the Essence of Storms. Its form is driven from the world and Gaerlan's forces are routed at Tou-tou, Sawato, Lin, and Baishi.
Fractured and blistered by the scorching tendrils of pure energy.
Your magic is devoured by my power!
%s has defeated Tempest, the Essence of Storms.

"It cannot be. I am the well of world blood given consciousness, your blades should not matter. It will not claim me. I am not of darkness borne. I will not fall to darkness. He means to cage me within his tomb of corruption. No! I will stand again, you cannot contain what I am!"
"You dare strike at me? My retribution is swift, is it not? But I sense that your spirit has not fled this world. How can I, the sum of power, grow weaker?"
"Severed from the cord that binds you to this world, you shall not return to hamper me; no, it cannot be, the strand of life stays."
"Another victim fallen into the stream that floods this world in form. You are no more. Not possible, I sense that your form returns. Perhaps the same will be of mine."

"It cannot be. I am the well of world blood given consciousness, your blades should not matter. I hear her singing. I hear the song that so long I have been without. No! I shall return, I now taste freedom, I shall yet rise again!"
The sarcophagus cracks and it's stone crumbles to the floor. A figure rises from the debris.
With a soft rumble the two sarcophaguses slide away to reveal stairs leading down.

quest: You have slain my brethren in battle and offended our most high Priestess, Nuhmudira. She shall hold a special place for you. Fear the blade, fledgling, its pain is succor and the blow is swift.
Fear the sound of your life ebbing away, as your limbs grow heavy and your heart grows light.
Your lifeblood shall serve as the river that feeds the land. Leave this place or feel my bite and welcome cool sleep.

You have done all you can, and she who sings bid you rest for a time, so that your body may adjust to the gift you received. There are others to take up the cause and to assist us in righting what has been made wrong.
You have chosen to aid the foul Aerbax. You have the stink of corruption already upon you. Leave my presence at once.
You have done well to earn your reward.
Why do you linger here, when she who sings has made her will apparent? Be off with you.
This should not be, you rewarded me with something. Please allow me to examine you again.

You seek to assist she who sings to the world? Well you should. She has risen from the ashes to call all to her side. She seeks to repair the hurt wreaked upon the land and close the wounds that hemorrhage still.
Would you take up her banner and stride forth into the darkness wherein the true enemy lies? I think you weak.
I think you know fear. I think you suffer and suffer you shall. She bids me give you this.
She bids you read it. She bids you understand. She bids you complete the task and return to me. She needs the proof of your resolve. She needs to see that you will not fail.
