This book was crafted by Rurinah, a member of the last class of students here. She was quite skilled in the art of parchment-making.
The process had been passed through her family for generations. She was proud to note that her grandmother had made paper for the esteemed Maila of Knorr.
This servant recalls her well - a terribly serious silver-haired girl, given to calling more lighthearted people 'fools.'
This was once worn by the mage Sasalia, who became one of our instructors. In addition to the combat arts, Sasalia was also a master of culinary magic.
An unusual combination for a Hieromancer. She often cooked for the students.
These bring back memories. These boots were the property of Marr Areleo, one of the Exarchs of the Order.
He and his brother were responsible for patrolling certain... storehouses, ensuring they remained safely under lock and key.
This task was given to them by Caerlin I, at the behest of the mage Asheron.
It is rare to gain such a prize from the Nephol Golems, young master. This geode is said to indicate much favor. Perhaps you were born under Irihane ascendant?

This golem fears it does not recognize these letters, young master. It humbly apologizes. This golem was granted the capacity to impress its words upon the softly glowing mind, but not to read languages other than its own.
Beautiful, is it not?
This note appears to be valid... although the date seems to be... a bit off. This golem shall now teleport you to one of the five trial grounds. May light fall upon your shoulders, young apprentice.
The golem stirs to life at your touch.  "Kiya auranil..." it grumbles, then pauses.

In your mind, a mild voice says, "Good day. It has been many turns of the stars since this servant has greeted visitors. Welcome to the Ishelai Lyceum, serving in good faith His Most Serene Majesty Kellin II."
"If you are a student, the written permission of the caloyer is required for me to send you to the trials."
quest: Ah. This bauble was created by the Imperial Talespinner Mistral Tersicor. For many years he wandered the world, recording the stories of all its' people.

He disappeared from the palace at Tentael one cold night, just after Caerlin II had taken the throne. He left a note, saying that the songs of other worlds needed to be written, and that he would return in 2300 years.
Eaushi prods the orb gently. It blossoms, the blue surfaces spiraling open to reveal patches of green, brown, and white.
Well done, young master! You have defeated the first Nephol Golem. This is the first step on your path to becoming a Thaumaturge of the Order.
You must still Enkindle this girth before it may be worn.
Splendid, young master! You have defeated the second Nephol Golem. Only one remains before you may be eligible to become a Thaumaturge of the Order.
You must still Enkindle these leggings before they may be worn.
Exceptional, young master! You have defeated the final Nephol Golem. You are now eligible to become a Thaumaturge of the Order.
You must still Enkindle this coat before it may be worn, and the skill required to add the Kindling Stones to your personal battle armor is your final test before becoming a full Hieromancer.
Seek the Halls of the Hieromancers, in the northwest of Werethas.
This golem has already unlocked one of Mistral's spheres for you recently, young master. Come back in a week.
This golem was provided with the essence of the old master, and remembers. Yes, it does. He would not leave the world bereft of story.
For a moment, Eaushi's fissure-eyes twinkle a merry sea blue.
Ah, young master, you have already bested the first Nephol Golem and gained its prize recently.
If you are truly worthy of this armor, you should not require a replacement set for at least a month.
Ah, young master, you have already bested the second Nephol Golem and gained its prize recently.
Ah, young master, you have already bested the last Nephol Golem and gained its prize recently.
chatter: The ceaseless mountain winds whistle around Eaushi's facets.

greetings: Asheron did not specify that students would be arriving at the Lyceum. However since you are here I will explain transportation within this place.
Lord Master Asheron has establish a network of devices through his knowledge of Planar magic, that will ease your movement through the Lyceum construct.

I will determine the level of safety of the different areas and allow you to pass through the Planar tunnels provided that the presence of entities catalogued as, Olthoi, are small enough to allow for survival in said areas.
Hey, you're getting annoying meat wad!
The golem splits in two. The small halves turn to face you!
I'm throwing a barbeque and you're all invited! Mmm, something smells good already! Heh heh!
You can't win!
We will wreck you!
You're toast!
Congratulations! You hit me. Now it's my turn!
I could use some help with this one guys!
Snowmen cast better than you!
Feel free to scream. They all do in the end!
The Behemoth roars at the sky, perhaps cursing its opponent %s, then explodes into an enormous pile of flaming rubble!

It is forbidden to pass these walls unless you have been given the permission of he who watches the gate. To be given that passage, hand me your key so that I may verify the inscriptions and grant you access. But be forewarned, your entry to this place will place you in direct contact with the accused. Make your decision wisely, for you may cast your vote only once.
The key, had you forgotten, is a writing infused with the magic of my masters. I will infuse the writing with the power of the dias, and then return it to you.
quest: You may cast your vote only once. I will, however, infuse your writing.

The Golem lifts a metallic hand toward the dais holding the book. A soft thrum echoes through the room, as a warm glow surrounds the book. Pages twist upon one another, and a feeling of warmth cascades over you.

greetings: You are not wise enough to enter the halls of Knorr return when you have solved this riddle.
The Golem speaks in old Yalain, a language foreign and strange, but as it speaks you gain comprehension of it's words.

A moth ate a word. To me it seemed, a piteous thing when I learned the wonder that a worm had swallowed, in darkness stolen, the song of Empyrean, our glorious sayings, A great Empyrean's strength; and the thieving guest, who was no whit the wiser for the words it ate.
Hand me that which was lost to the worm that night.
Perhaps you are drunk with the folly of which is spoken, Knorr does not open its doors for fools.
The Golem speaks in old Yalain, a language foreign and strange, but as it speaks you gain comprehension of its words.

I am valued by Empyrean, fetched from afar, Gleaned on the hill-slopes, gathered in groves, In dale and on down. All day through the air, Wings bore me aloft, and brought me with cunning Safe under roof.

Empyrean steeped me in vats, to give me power to pummel and blind, To cast to the earth, the old and young. Stripped of their strength if they cease not their folly, Loud is their speech, but of power despoiled To manage their mind, their hands or their feet.
Now give me the item, who can bind all to earth, And lay fools low in the light of day.
Perhaps have not yet learned what you shall ever be without and what shall be the force to guard you against pain and strife. Come back when you are prepared

A lonely wanderer, wounded with iron, smitten with war-blades, sated with strife,Worn with the sword-edge; I have seen many battles, many hazardous fights, oft without hope of comforts or help in the carnage of war Ere I perish and fall in the fighting hands of Empyrean.
The leavings of hammers, the handiwork of smiths, Batter and bite me, hard-edged and sharp; The brunt of the battle I am doomed to endure. No healer may mend me that a fire may cure.
Hand me the item.
The little golem explodes in a gout of flame.
No!!! I'll be back!
Here I am, falling to pieces and I can still cook you!
Looks like those soggy jerks chose the wrong champion! Bwahaha!!!
Burn 'em!
Toast 'em!
Roast 'em!
Filet their souls!
Knock me down! I'll just keep coming back!
Looks like I'm harder to hit now, eh?
We are here at the behest of Lord Asheron. Our duty is to maintain peace. We ask that you observe our requests so as to not force our hands into action.
I thank you for your sacrifice.
A remnant of the Temple watched by Ixir Zi, second amongst the thirteen keepers. Impressive, but a failure nonetheless. Your blood shall be refreshing.
Foul! Your blood will be spilled and not consumed. You are of the ill get. Begone you foul usurper!
You have answered the riddle correctly and may pass through the door. The door will close within ten grains. Move quickly.
Curious. This is not what the High Matriarch desires, but it may serve to awaken her more quickly. Alas, you have failed the riddle and are mine to feast upon.

You have entered the sacred halls of Liazk Itzi, the sleeping High Matriarch of the lush and fertile Iktzil Delta. The High Matriarch sleeps and you are not of the spirits that make this temple their home. Your business then must be to bring the sacrifices that will awaken the High Matriarch and allow her to reclaim this land once more.

Beyond the door that I guard are guardians of the tunnels that lead to her resting place. They stand vigil over the spirits who were tasked to defend her temple in her absence. You may prove yourself worthy of entrance to the halls beyond by answering the riddle she has devised.

I shall act as arbiter for her and I am prepared to receive the answer that you will posit. Know this. Failure to answer this correctly will allow me to feed, and I am ever so hungry. Listen carefully, and hand me that which you believe is the answer to the High Matriarch's riddle only when you are certain. The High Matriarch wishes that the sacrifices brought to her are hers, and not mine.
The riddle is as follows: Blood of flesh has sealed me and blood can see my locks undone. Though blood came first from opened flesh, the blood to see my joints unbound is found when ground is opened.
You feel your form being torn asunder.
You have pleased me. I will sup upon the tears of her soul this night and be sated for a time. Prepare for your reward.

Within this well the wayward sister of Hizk Ri was cast beneath the world and bound by vile arts to suffer for all eternity. The restless souls, that make this place their home, have tormented the woman's soul since its imprisonment here.

If you wish to meet Hizk Ri you shall need to garner her sister's tears for me. You will need to collect them in an ancient philter, lost somewhere in this crypt. Collect them from the well and return them to me and I shall then let you pass. Go now and return to me only when you can hand me the phial of bloody tears.
Infestation spreads through these halls, the cursed are so much dust. You must push beyond these invaders to lay your life before the mistress.
You must be tested to ensure that your blood will not weaken the mistress.
Welcome to the halls of Kivik Lir's temple, child. I will now transport you to the staging area. You will be able to prepare yourself there before continuing further in your training.
I thank you for your sacrifice, unworthy one.
You enter the tomb of Mistress Qin Xikit. Lay your life before her tomb so you may see eternity. Beyond the beacon lies her receiving chamber. Welcome sister, welcome to your destiny.
quest: Portal space wells around you, causing slight discomfort.
The statue appears to be like every other statue found on Dereth; stone carved by an ancient race that has long since left this world.

As you approach the Guardian, you hear the sounds of Burun on the other side of the wall. Before you can act upon your second thoughts, the Guardian's magic pulls you forward into the next area of the temple.
A distorted and frightened voice states, "You are not fit to traverse these halls. Find a way better suited to you, or flee this place."
You have trespassed where you do not belong. Be thankful I cannot gift you with death.
You feel your form being torn asunder.
Though your body feels as though it is being ripped apart briefly, nothing happens.
You may advance through the halls of Hizk Ri, Matron of Pain. Be warned, you dwell amongst the hopeless and cruel.
You have entered the halls of Hizk Ri, the Matron of Pain. Your presence is unwelcome. You have disturbed a perfect order that has existed for eons. What right have you to enter these halls, cur?
Do not answer. Your presence marks a return of the ancient ways. You shall be tested and if not found wanting, you shall find your way to the seat of the Matron's power and wake her from her slumber.
I pray that you fail, for power such as Hizk Ri's should never be loosed upon the world. We have suffered for millennia under her cruel wiles.

The pillars scattered about the room are devoted to the bodies that hang in the sky above. A riddle seals their secret and bars entrance to the halls beyond. I shall issue this riddle after this final warning: return to me for judgment only when the riddle is solved. If you fail to do so you will be struck dead where you stand. If you return to me with only half the puzzle solved you will be st...

The riddle is as follows: Au, the light of this world, hangs in the east, opposed to star of portent. To the north, the moon run red with blood watches its twin in the south. Prove your worth, or die trying.
Au, the light of this world, hangs in the east, opposed to the star of portent. To the north, the moon run red with blood, watched its twin in the south. Prove your worth, or die trying.
The folly of speaking with me before the presenting my lady's glyph was pronounced. I shall enjoy your blood, unworthy one.

The Lady of this temple, Kivik Lir, has deemed it closed to visitors. Only her students may pass through the gates beyond. Should the student present a glyph bearing the union of blood and shadow, the doors of knowledge shall open. Those without the glyph of the Lady Kivik Lir shall be turned away from this temple, for her knowledge is not for you.
Heed my warnings. I shall sup upon your blood and send you from this place should you speak with me again, or should you fail to present the correct glyph.

As you approach the Guardian, you hear what sounds like Burun on the other side of the wall. Before you can even formulate second thoughts the Guardian pulls you forward into the next area of the temple.
As you approach the Guardian, you hear what sounds like Burun on the other side of the wall. It is apparent that the Guardian does not feel you are suited for the area beyond.

greetings: Oh, I'm just getting started!
The Golem falls apart. Each segment reforms into a smaller version of the original.
Hey, dead meat, tell your popsicle friends that I'm coming!
I'm guessing those sniveling little snow drifts sent you. You should have stayed out of this. Now you get to see what it feels like to be melted!
Come on! Is that all you got?! Give me your best shot!
Yes! Now we're having some fun!
Oho! Where did you learn to cast that? I cast bigger spells in my sleep!
I am delighted you were able to get some Whispering Venom crystals from that mine!
Nuhmudira's assistant casts several spells upon the crystal and fashions a portion of it into a ring.
Wearing this ring will allow passage through the portal. Go and get the better of the Olthoi that dwell in that foul lair!

Hello. I have been tasked by Nuhmudira to continue to collect Whispering Venom crystals.  They aided in overcoming the threat of the ancient Olthoi Queen who resided within this lair.  It is important to probe this lair lest the Queen should return here and defeat any Olthoi within it! Nuhmudira had determined there is an unknown force that seems to "drown out" mana and suppresses higher forms...

A very rare crystal, Whispering Venom crystal is required to nullify this effect- the wearing of a ring made from this crystal allows a successful journey through portal space to this lair.   Alas, Nuhmudira did possess a supply of these crystals however they were stolen once from her warehouse, together with numerous other crystals. While the other crystal types are being replaced through the...

There is a mine at desert's edge, west of Khayyaban, which used to be a source of these crystals.  It may be somewhat depleted but it is our only hope.  Please try to find some and return as soon as you are able!
No, that is not of interest to me, and I think you will need it later.  I seek the Calling Stone, which is given to all newcomers.
If you have a Calling Stone, please give it to me by DRAGGING it from your inventory onto me.  Stand near me when you give me the Stone so that I can give you your reward.
quest: Hurry! The Outer Courtyard is still under attack! You must help the Sentry immediately! Run through this area to the Central Courtyard and take the portal to the Outer Courtyard.

As you proceed through the Practice Area, warriors should read the signs on the left. Spellcasters should read the signs on the right. There are three chests filled with goodies hidden in this room--see if you can find them all!
chatter: Many newcomers forget to improve their skills.  Once you are in the world and have battled real monsters, click on the triangle with the symbol of an arm.  Then you can improve your attributes and skills.
Barkeeps in the main towns usually sell information about where to find adventure.  Be sure to seek them out!
Much of the advice I can give you is already provided via magical Help.  Click the question mark at the top right of your screen for much more information.
Traveling with friends is the safest way to travel.
Be sure to use the Lifestone in towns and outposts.
Other dungeons in Dereth are often dangerous and difficult.  Proceed slowly, and try not to get lost.  The monsters often get tougher the deeper into the dungeon you go.

If you come across a new monster or item, use the magnifying glass to try to learn more information.  Since your assessment or appraisal skills are used, you may not learn very much if those skills are low.
Do not fear: the monsters in the Training Halls are not real monsters.  They cannot hurt you, and they also do not feel pain.
I must warn you that you cannot return to the Training Halls after you progress beyond Level 1.

greetings: Hello! My master in Glenden Wood, Wils Morrem, has charged me with the mission to encourage the people of Dereth to cultivate their crafting skills.
If you bring me a greater lightning arrowhead, I will award you with the funds to further your crafting studies.
If you bring me a greater frost arrowhead, I will award you with the funds to further your crafting studies.
Hello! My master in Glenden Wood, Wils Morrem, has sent me out into the world to participate in the great Mission - encouraging the young people of Dereth to embrace a life of artistry!
If you bring me an example of your craftsmanship - say, a lightning arrowhead - I will reward you with a token of encouragement.
The apprentice coughs quietly.
Um, we're not rich yet, though, so I'm afraid I can only reward you once a week.
If you bring me an example of your craftsmanship - say, an acid arrowhead - I will reward you with a token of encouragement.
If you bring me a greater acid arrowhead, I will award you with the funds to further your crafting studies.
If you bring me an example of your craftsmanship - say, a frost arrowhead - I will reward you with a token of encouragement.
quest: Well, this is certainly a .. err .. good effort. But why don't you spend a little more time practicing and then come see me again?
Excellent! Excellent! Look at that workmanship! Good job!
Apprentices don't have the deepest pockets in the world. I'm afraid that I can only help you in your studies once a week.

greetings: High Queen Elysa, brought me back from my post on Marae Lassel to assist Asheron's Emmissary in study the changes in this area. Thus far, we have discovered little.

Aside from a rising temperature there are no oddities here that are noteworthy. We've been busy night and day studying the devastation that was levied here. This crater is nearly as large as the one left when Arwic was destroyed, but...the force that destroyed Yanshi seems untainted. Whatever Asheron senses here must be powerful though.

Having studied the crater and measuring the distance of some of the debris I have discovered that this explosion originated within the ground. It is as though a great force welled up from somewhere below the city and burned its way to surface before exploding out with a force comparable, if not greater than, the one that destroyed Arwic.
We've noticed some off fluctuations in the mana fields here. They ebb like the ocean tide, from strong to weak and back again. Something is here, I believe it now.
We think we found something, but if the indications are true, we could be looking at a most devastating force. Intelligent mana, sentient in every way.

We never seem to learn from the past, we never follow directions or show respect to the things we don't understand. Look at us now, on the verge of destruction. Not from Gaerlan, well maybe inadvertently, but you see...he is the same as us. He didn't think his actions through. Now we find this.
Antius looks over the broken city and shakes his head.
I don't know. I think if we succeed at driving Gaerlan away, and destroying whatever this thing is we should change our focus to learning instead of simply doing.
Oi, mush! Want ter do me a favor? It's tough ter get a decent drink around here, especially wiv the prices Gorth charges.
Fetch me a bottle of Olde Ispar Stout from Neydisa Castle, down the road to the west, and I'll put in a good word fer yer with MacDugal!
This seems to indicate that the Viamontians may well be on Dereth, but we cannot be sure. I need more than this. Keep searching.
This settles the matter. The Viamontians are here. And from what I can tell, they are the occupants of that mysterious landmass to the north.
I wonder, how long have they been here? What plans do they have for the rest of us? And when will they make themselves known?
I thank you for your assistance in this matter. You have done a great service to your Queen.
What creature is capable of doing this to an Olthoi? I have seen my fair share of Olthoi corpses, but this...
Do you see these ridges here? Along the neck? It appears that this head was bitten off.
What manner of creature is this from? I've never seen a tooth of this size. You say the Viamontian gave you this? What foul creatures did the blue-skins bring with them, I wonder?
A Viamontian dagger! I have not seen one of these in years!
We are in for a great deal of trouble, my friend. You would do well to prepare yourself for the worst.
Friend! A word!

As I am sure you are aware, a Viamontian recently appeared in Rithwic. His name is Carlo di Cenza. If my memory serves me correctly, he serves the house of Bellenesse, which was quite loyal - and quite close - to the King of Viamont.
As far as we can tell, Carlo di Cenza is the only Viamontian on Dereth. But we cannot be sure of that. The man has yet to speak an intelligible word so far as we've seen.
We must find out if others arrived with him. If there are Viamontians on Dereth, and if they are hiding from the Queen, then we may have a great deal of trouble ahead of us.
Do what you can. Scour the continent. If you uncover any worthwhile intelligence, return it to me.
quest: I am here against my better judgment. I had hoped that we would find an answer to the growing Burun problem, but as of yet, the Arcanum's scholars are not able to unlock the magic necessary to imbue weapons with slaying properties. Thus I am here at the request of High Queen Elysa with a proposition.

Nuhmudira was removed from the council some months ago for conduct that was not befitting of her position. No public charges were levied, but she understood that there was an unspoken accusation. I am here to see that she is given a message. That message is one that I must support

Elysa is willing to grant her clemency in return for her aid. We need you to seek her out and obtain the devices necessary for finishing the Noble Weapons. They require the addition of a complex gem. Once that gem is set in place they should become Burun slaying weapons. Nuhmudira was last known to be residing in a remote cottage outside of Uziz near an oasis on the rim of the A'mun desert.

Nuhmudira was removed from the council some months ago for conduct that was not befitting of her position. No public charges were levied, but she understood that there was an unspoken accusation. I am here to see that she is given a message. That message is one that I must support.
Antius' demeanor changes slightly.

Please, if she gives you the opportunity once you have obtained what you will need, ask her a simple question. Ask her if she let Oswald into the castle the night that Elysa was attacked. If you get an answer give that information to one of these guardians: Guard Chandler Hammett in Lytelthorpe, Guard Gabrielle in Rithwic, or Emissary Ydnew in Yanshi. They are three of the four members of the g...
This appears to be part of a much larger work. I cannot glean any useful information from this. Return to me when you find all of the pieces.

greetings: Hello.
%mn's eyes close. She kisses %tn.
This will mean much to the Duke. I thank you, kind soul.
What's this? I don't want this! Bring me my stolen notes!
What's this? You helped Ishaq? I hope that you were merely earning his trust so as to better shame him in the future! That moony malefactor!
Excellent! Excellent! You took - I mean, you found some of my notes!
Tanami Kei tries to read the sad mass of paper, to little effect.
Oh my. These are in some condition. Well, at least I have them now. And I believe I promised you a reward for your help.
Can you help me, friend? I'm a Natural Philosopher. I study the ways and means of Dereth's natural flora and fauna - and her unnatural fauna as well.

I've been making a name for myself lately, with my astute and erudite writings about the mysteries of cross-world speciation. But success breeds jealousy! And a certain man - I will not call him a colleague, nor even a rival, for in truth he is not worthy to be listed among the ranks of Natural Philosophers! - a certain man has stolen from me the notes I was compiling for my next book!
If you can retrieve any of my notes for me, in any condition, I will reward you with a handsome crossbow I have made!
Berkholt, in the bar, sells directions to this miscreant's dwelling. Please, friend, help me restore my reputation!
chatter: I must get my notes back!
Oooh! That Ishaq! I'll get even with him yet ...

greetings: My apologies, but I cannot read this. It appears to be the runic script of old Dericost.  You should bring this to Kuyiza bint Zayi, in Zaikhal.
My apologies, but I cannot read this.  It appears to be the language of the ancient Falatacot.  You should bring this to Fanzen San, in Hebian-To.
My apologies, but I cannot read this.  It appears to be the script of old Dericost.  You should bring this to Kuyiza bint Zayi, in Zaikhal.
How interesting.... This book details Asheron's plan to defeat Bael'Zharon. Here, let me transcribe this into Roulean so that you may read it as well.
Hmm...
Oh dear... How you recovered this is beyond me, but hold on a moment, I shall give you a translation. This is quite disturbing...
This is a curious and alarming little message. It appears to be an archival record of an earlier message, sent from a garrison town to the royal court of the Empire of Yalain.

Do you realize what you have here? This appears to be nothing less than an Empyrean weapons manual! What a fabulous discovery! At long last, we have a glimpse into the lost arts of their great society.
You certainly deserve a copy a this for yourself.

Curious. This is a letter home from a soldier on campaign. A singularly disturbing campaign, if I may venture the opinion. My thanks for recovering it. We may be able to cull some valuable knowledge from this.
Here is a copy for you.
How disturbing. This scroll tells the tale of a terrible defeat suffered by the great Empyrean - and perhaps something more terrible still to she who received it so long ago.

What beautiful craftsmanship... the blossoms in the paper are still fragrant. Empyrean magic was as subtle as it was powerful. This would seem to be a journal of some sort. A moment, I shall transcribe it into Roulean.
Sweet merciful Mothers... this missive would seem to be scribed by the hand of Asheron himself! A remarkable find! I wonder what this calamity he describes was?
Revolting!  This note is written on cured human skin!  Where did you get this?  Still... here is your translation.  It was not easy, translating the language of old Dericost.
Hm. This appears to be nothing of great import. A simple request for parts from one Yalaini smith to another. Where did you say you found this?
Well, this may be of use in our researches. This is a sort of record or timeline, detailing the major events in the history of the Aerlinthe port and island.
Another of these lumps? I just got the slime off my hands from the last one.
Hm. I confess I don't understand this. Oh, I can translate it well enough, but... You say this was carried on powerful Shadows?
It's nothing like any Shadow missive I've encountered before. Usually they speak almost as we do. This is... like dark poetry. I do not understand what this message's implications are.
Where are you people finding these disgusting things? I'll never be able to eat tapioca again!
Ugh! I don't know what this is, or was, but there are letters burned into its back...
Oh. An exhortation from Bael'Zharon to his troops. Nice to know our enemies hold us in such high regard. Hmph.
Blech! I swear, the Shadows use these messenger creatures to dissuade us from reading their correspondence. They're too disgusting for most people to read!
Ugh. Watch where you hold that, young one, I don't want slime on our nice clean floor. Let me see...
Hm... A message from... How interesting.
Most interesting. It appears that the town of Xarabydun holds a treasure I would not have suspected.
My apologies, but I cannot read this. It appears to be the runic script of old Dericost. You should bring this to Kuyiza bint Zayi, in Zaikhal.
Sweet...
Mothers...
%n hands back a translation with no further word, looking stunned.
Hrm... I could be wrong, but... this seems to imply that the Lady of Ithaenc foresaw the arrival of Isparians, over two thousand years ago.
A mere scrap of ancient bureaucracy, I'm afraid. Nothing of interest to us.
What is this gibberish? I can't read it. It's just a lot of letters and numbers strung together.
What a spectacular find! I haven't encountered anything so valuable to our understanding of Empyrean magic and technology since Atlan's Treatise.
This an armor handbook for an elite order of Yalaini battle mages, completely devoted to their Emperor. Rather like our Knights of the Golden Flame, I expect.
My apologies, but I cannot read this.  I couldn't even begin to be able to tell you what language this is.  Perhaps you should talk to Kuyiza bint Zayi, the translator in Zaikhal.
I am sorry, but I cannot read this.  Try talking to the Hebian-To translator, Fanzen San.
An interesting read, a bit fanatical in spot. I have made notes where they are applicable.
Will wonders never cease? This book was difficult because of the damage wrought upon it. As well the text itself was written in a variation of Dericost, akin to that of the Gelid.

I must say the first book that I translated by this author gave me pause. But this...this is a remarkably frightening man. His hatred pours onto the page. It's accentuated near the end. Also some of the secrets that are held within make me think more on Nuhmudira and her fears. It appears that they may have been well founded.
Remarkable. If you read this very carefully you may learn something about the Olthoi, and Asheron's part in their arrival here.
Disciples of Strife...a very interesting read. I've made some notes where applicable.
Disciples of Stasis...a very interesting read. I've made some notes where applicable.
Disciples of Corrosion...a very interesting read. I've made some notes where applicable.
Disciples of TEMPEST...a very interesting read. I've made some notes where applicable.
The more I read about what Gaerlan has written the more I realize that he was normal once.
I have never seen the script before, but it appears to be the same G that penned certain areas of the other books that people have brought to me lately.

This is an ancient chronicle, written in Yalaini. It is a frightening tale. If this is truth and not some fiction, there are things in this world that are best left alone to slumber in their black depths...
Looks like Harlune wasn't always an ornery old git. If I read this right he actually used to have a heart and really think he could make a difference. Hard to believe he could be so jaded.
Hard to believe... Asheron seems to be more like us than I ever thought. Real emotions, not the distant man we have come to know recently. Everything seems to weigh so heavily upon him.
The Tumerok knew about the Empyrean before who would have ever guessed. These are some interesting writings. Where did you get them again?
He didn't seem to care much for the Emperor, though he still paid him some sort of respect.
Now this was interesting it gives a little more insight to those Gromnatross things people talk about.
Yet more proof that he was the level headed one in regards to the Olthoi. Of course this was before they arrived.
A secret society, standing against darkness, this is an interesting read to me. It makes me wonder what Asheron really fancies himself what others saw him as too.
I am at a loss as to what to say about this; other than to say that this gives me pause about what this world really is.
Interesting! I think you'll giggle about what you learn in this little bit.
Bretself wipes a tear away from his eye.
I'm sorry this just made me so sad to think of all of them, and then...
Thank you, your heroism is appreciated!
Thank you, your heroism is appreciated! Take this!
This weapon uses the most modern of military technology! It is specially crafted to be extra damaging against our Tumerok foes!
Lieutenant Kenneth lowers his voice.
Of course, for political reasons, it doesn't work against the Aun or the Hea Tumerok, but only against the Virindi-controlled renegades.
Ah, an old recruit come back to finally claim your promised reward!
Oh, and here -- take this.

We'd like to give you a small gift in appreciation for your ... patience, but that item hasn't come yet. But when it does, just give me this token back and I'll give you your reward. Why don't you check back in a month or two?
Lieutenant Kenneth coughs -- or was that a snicker?
What's this? A note?
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Falcon training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
What? You want a reward? This is no trophy -- this is just a scrap of paper! Bring me some trophy ripped from the hands of our enemies and then I will reward you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Serpent training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Shreth training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Reedshark training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Gromnie training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Mask training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Hello, my name is Kenneth. I'm here to help direct an organized resistance against the renegade Tumerok attacks.
Queen Elysa has called for volunteers to help investigate the Tumerok training camps near Dryreach. You can pick up a news sheet about this menace from the barkeeper.
If you have already investigated the camps, and you have some trophy to prove it, I will gladly reward you. I also accept Tumerok insignia.
Here is a stock and mechanism for your crossbow.
Hmmm. I wouldn't know what to do with this. Perhaps you could take it to Yuan Hanzu as this sort of thing is more his field.
I am Barnar the Tinker. Mechanisms and woodworking are my specialty. If you bring me the heart of a wood golem, I can make a crossbow stock and mechanism for you.
Terese places the seed in a small pot of earth, and speaks soothingly. A sweet smell fills the air, as a colorful plant springs forth!
Now, take good care of this. Give it plenty of water and sun.
Terese places the seed in a small pot of earth, and speaks soothingly. A sweet smell fills the air, and the soil glows softly. Suddenly, three plants spring forth from the dirt!
Amazing... truly, these seeds have been touched by the Powers.
Terese places the seed in a small pot of earth, and speaks soothingly. A sweet smell fills the air, and the soil glows softly. Suddenly, two plants spring forth from the dirt!
Have you ever seen anything so lovely?
Terese places the seed in a small pot of earth, and sings lovingly. A sweet smell fills the air, and the soil glows softly. Suddenly, six plants burst forth from the dirt! Terese blinks in disbelief.
Wow. I sure didn't expect that.
Now, take good care of these. Give them plenty of water and sun.
Terese places the seed in a small pot of earth, and speaks soothingly. A sweet smell fills the air, and the soil glows softly. Suddenly, four plants spring forth from the dirt!

Terese places the seed in a small pot of earth, and sings lovingly. A sweet smell fills the air, and the soil glows softly. Suddenly, eight plants burst forth from the dirt! Terese blinks in disbelief.
Terese places the seed in a small pot of earth, and speaks soothingly. A acrid smell fills the air, as a dark plant springs forth!
How beautiful! And how rare! Please take good care of this...it would be a shame if anything happened to such a wondrous living thing!
How beautiful! And how rare! Please take good care of this... it would be a shame if anything happened to such a wondrous living thing!
What do you want? Wasting my time, no doubt, wasting my time! Don't you have some grandiose quest to do, or innocent monkeys to kill? Leave me alone with my plants. Growing them isn't easy, you know.
If I really believed you cared, I might help you grow your own plants. But I'm sure you wouldn't find them to be terribly "elite".

Yes, the Shreth have been eating the plants. That's part of Dereth's new ecology. Go look it up. But, if you happen to go rooting through Shreth droppings, as I imagine you like to do, I'll take any seeds that you might find.
Do you see all these lovely new plants? I woke up one morning and their fronds had appeared out of nowhere! Even an animal-killer such as you cannot dampen my spirits.
Here you are.

Breathtaking... I have never heard of a crystal of this size and power. You must be the one who dealt the killing blow to the great Nexus Crystal! I will make you a full suit of Koujia armor that surpasses all my previous work.
Ayeeyah! This gem would be beyond my skill even if I were not suffering the curse of the shadow assassin! Try those three arrogant collectors near Uziz, I think they wanted gems like this.

Nuhmudira has finally restored us to full health!  She has also stocked us with some extra supplies that we needed, such that we can provide you with either a version of the original Shadow Armor, or its successor.  If you wish to trade one version of your Koujia set for another, simply hand it to me.  Please take out all Atlan stones from your armor before handing it to me.

Also, if you wish to color your new Greater Shadow Armor, you may buy a vat of color from my assistant.  If you do not like the color, please give me the armor piece and I will replace it with the standard piece, which you may then choose to recolor.
quest: A small gem... I salute your accomplishment. Here is a set of Koujia leggings, infused with the power of the gem. With another gem of similar quality I can make a breastplate and sleeves to match.
This gem allows me to complete your suit of armor. Take this breastplate and these sleeves, with my compliments.
I cannot do anything more for you with these smaller gems. Please take this back.
Unless ... If you want another suit of this inferior armor, give this gem back to me and I'll see what I can do.
Admirable. A potent gem. Here are some fine Koujia leggings for you. Another gem like that will allow me to craft sleeves and a breastplate for you.
A fine accomplishment, to make this gem. Here are the sleeves and breastplate I promised you.
I have done the best I can with the materials provided.
If you want another suit of this quality, give this gem back to me and I'll see what I can do.
A gem of the best quality!
Here are your leggings. With another great gem such as this, I could make you similar upper-body armor.
Impressive! Here is the upper-body armor I promised you. It is an honor to craft for a warrior of your prowess.
Regrettably I have reached the limits of my craft, and I cannot spare any more time to make you armor. Here is your gem back.
If you *insist* on another suit of this quality, give this gem back to me and I'll see what I can do.

greetings: You say you found this note near Holtburg? You should take it to Sir Rylanan. He is overseeing the garrision in Shoushi and will be interested in any local developments.
You say you found this note near Shoushi? You should take it to Sir Tenshin. He is overseeing the garrision in Shoushi and will be interested in any local developments.
What's this? Planting? Crops? Harvest? Old Man Witshire had a farm? This requires more thought. Here, you should keep this, I have already memorized it.
You say you found this object near Holtburg? You should take it to Sir Rylanan. He is overseeing the garrison in Holtburg and will be interested in any local developments.

You say you found this uniform in Shoushi? Most irregular--no one should have these uniforms on hand except the members of the Strathelar Guard themselves. You should take it to Sir Tenshin. He is overseeing the garrision in Shoushi and will be interested in any local developments.
This letter is addressed to Sir Tenshin. You should take it to him in Shoushi.
Dame Tsaya quickly glances over the letter from her comrade in Shoushi.

What a disappointing happenstance. Not only has a farmer been allowed to stockpile an arsenal in his basement, but he is concealing stolen Guards uniforms as well? Tenshin must learn to keep better order than this.

Nonetheless, perhaps you could aid me as well.  Queen Elysa recently appointed me to lead the garrison here in Yaraq. She was deeply grieved when the 12 Training Halls were destroyed and wants to ensure that no harm will come to her subjects here.

To that end, I have a small task for you: We have heard that a newcomer to this town has moved into a villa that has lain abandoned for many years. No one knows where he came from, although it is said he speaks with a Northern accent. Would you stop by his residence, and find out more about him? He lives to the southwest, near Lubziklan al-Luq's apple orchards.
This letter is addressed to Sir Rylanan. You should take it to him in Holtburg.
Dame Tsaya sighs deeply and shuts her eyes after reading the contents of the folded note.

I was right, in all except one thing. It was Borelean's life at stake, not Elysa's. And to attempt his murder through us, the Queen's own Guard...an audacious plan. Martine deserves no mercy for this, you have my word. We of the Strathelar Guard owe you a great debt for warding off what would have been a terrible tragedy--especially for Elysa and Asheron.
quest: You are still remembered well among the Guards. Such service to the crown does not go unnoticed, comrade. There have not been any new developments for me to relate, but come back in two weeks--I am sure we have not heard the last from Martine.
I see you have come back from the Fort in one piece. Do you have any more interesting finds for me?
No doubt Fort Witshire is exceedingly more difficult than has been in the past.

Thank you for your assistance in this matter, my friend. If you haven't already, you should take the letter I gave you to Sir Rylanan in Holtburg. What I learned today worries me a great deal. I fear for the people of this peaceful town, now I know what lies up in the hills of Yaraq...
Dame Tsaya turns to you gravely.
Yes, what did you discover up in the Darkened Halls?

The stranger actually asked you to visit his new "friend" down in the Darkened Halls? That dismal place has always been just the lair of some lowly Drudges, to my knowledge...perhaps you should investigate this matter. If you find anything out of the ordinary, I'd appreciate it if you brought it to me for inspection. Something just doesn't sound quite right.
I am mentoring Sir Tenshin in the responsibilities that come with being the leader of an important garrison. Did he send any letters for me along with you? I do like to keep track of his progress.

Greetings. I believe Sir Tenshin over in Shoushi has a matter in which he requires assistance. Please go to him and offer your help in whatever he requires. As his mentor, I would normally go myself, but I am afraid I must attend to my duties here.
Appalled, Dame Tsaya gingerly handles the human husk and covers it with a linen cloth.

You found this in the Darkened Halls? Poor soul. I can only wonder what he went through in his last tortures.  What dark intent could spur the Hollow Minions into committing such an atrocity? No wonder that stranger asked you so nicely to visit his comrades in those Halls--he must have been seeded here to send weak, innocent victims to their deaths--luckily he failed in taking your measure.  I...
Please take this letter to Sir Rylanan in Holtburg. He must know immediately of the terrible crimes that are being committed here in Yaraq.
Dame Tsaya quickly glances over the letter from her comrade in Shoushi and muses aloud.

I have no doubt now that what has occurred here and in Holtburg and Shoushi are connected. Rylanan reports that the Hollow Minions are siphoning portal energy into concentrated spherules of glass. Tenshin tells me that a man has been discovered hoarding weapons and stolen Guard's uniforms. And the terrible atrocities here in Yaraq, under my own watch...
Dame Tsaya abruptly comes to a conclusion.

The Hollow Minions are creating their own Simulacra by somehow channeling portal space energy into these poor human husks. I have no doubt their plan was to clothe their Simulacra in our uniforms to infiltrate the Guard. Our Queen is in danger, and we must put a stop to this.
I have received reports that a band of Hollow Minions have barricaded themselves into Fort Witshire. I am now confident that the fort must house the headquarters of this plot.
Dame Tsaya sizes you up speculatively.

I believe I have just the plan. Fort Witshire was built upon the ruins of an old Empyrean prison. We can infiltrate the fort if we first go through its lower passageways. We created this portal to reach the prison, and I have only been waiting for the right person to grant permission to use it--and I now believe that person is you.

Press onwards to the top, and when you enter Fort Witshire itself, try to find out who is commanding the Hollow Minions there. This key may be of good use once you enter the fort--it was found among Witshire's effects when he left the fort. I cannot emphasize how much I believe the Queen's safety depends on this. Good luck.

Hail, adventurer! Queen Elysa recently appointed me to lead the garrison here in Yaraq. She was deeply grieved when the 12 Training Halls were destroyed and wants to ensure that no harm will come to her subjects here.

To that end, I have a small task for you: We have heard that a newcomer to this town has moved into a villa that has lain abandoned for many years. No one knows where he came from, although it is said he speaks with a Northern accent. Would you stop by his residence, and find out more about him? He lives to the southwest, near Lubziklan al-Luq's apple orchards.
Dame Tsaya quickly glances over the letter from her comrade in Shoushi.

What a disappointing happenstance. Not only has a farmer been allowed to stockpile an arsenal in his basement, but he is concealing stolen Guards uniforms as well? And Rylanan is having his own share of suspicious behavior up in Holtburg too...I wonder what trouble could be brewing now?

Nonetheless, perhaps you could aid me as well.  Queen Elysa recently appointed me to lead the garrison here in Yaraq. She was deeply grieved when the 12 Training Halls were destroyed and wants to ensure that no harm will come to her subjects here.

To that end, I have a small task for you: We have heard that a newcomer to this town has moved into a villa that has lain abandoned for many years. No one knows where he came from, although it is said he speaks with a Northern accent. Would you stop by his residence, and find out more about him? He lives to the east, past Lubziklan al-Luq's house.

greetings: This is not a complete Symbol of Marriage. Please find the other symbols, combine them, and return to me the Symbol of Marriage.
To begin the marriage ceremony, you must first hand me the Symbol of Marriage. If you are in search of the Symbol, a series of tests await you near Arwic.
It gives me great joy knowing those I join in union go forth to make this land a happier and healthier place to be.
quest: You have visited me too recently.  Please reconsider your vows and reread the Wedding Handbook.
Welcome, friends and family! Let us begin the ceremony of Marriage!

You have come here today to demonstrate your commitment to one another.  You come bearing the Symbol of Marriage as proof of that commitment.  I accept this Symbol as a your vow that you agree to love, cherish and honor your spouse for all your time here in Dereth.

You have made your vows under the Symbol of that which you hold important.  Before the witnesses of your friends and family, I now pronounce this union to be made.  There is one last step you must take to make this union complete.
May your marriage bring you great happiness. You should take the time to inscribe the Emblem of Marriage with words that show your commitment to your spouse, then present them.

You who stand here as witnesses are the friends and family of those seeking our blessings today.  You are charged with the task of helping them in their new role of marriage, to support them in their times of need, and to do all that you can to make their marriage a blessed and happy union.
Use this Promise Gem as a final demonstration of your love.  When used, the of Marriage becomes complete.

quest: That's not much for someone of your stature. But this is all I can give you.

Oh, I don't really need that back.  Did you happen to find my bag down there?  I dropped them both in the same room, dratted insects!

What, you say you don't know how to make a Copper Lodestone?! Why, that is what tests of knowledge are for! Get out there and experiment, my young friend!
quest: Practice certainly makes perfect. Perhaps you could bring this back to me in a week? I am saving up for a trip back to Glenden Wood at the moment.
You are on your way to becoming a true master!!
I am currently saving for a trip to visit my master back in Glenden Wood, so I can only help you out once per week.

greetings: The hermit strains to read the handwriting, then returns the note to you.
I wrote this?
Yes, yes it seems I did write this, so very long ago...
The secret...yes, the secret -- I remember something now.
The hermit's eyes grow wide as he looks at the diamond relic.
So you found the golems then?  I trust they did not give you too much trouble -- I see a stout and strong dead-eye when I look into your eyes!
Do not lose this priceless artifact.  You will need to harness the magical, protective power found within it -- eventually.

Ah, but you have so much to do yet.  Let us not delay any longer!  You must venture to the Itheanc Cathedral, in the Veseyan Islands.  The horrible fleshless dead, the blood fiends, have a most precious treasure in their possession -- a bright, silvery ring.
You must find this ring, for it contains a most vital magical element.
The hermit rolls the ring back and forth in his hand slowly, thinking deeply about the past.
A warding ring...
Long ago I took a ring identical to this one from the charred and burning hand of a fiend.  That time seems unreal to me now, beyond my grasp in memory.
I do remember some of the important details, though.  This ring conceals a small glass vial containing blood.  You will need this foul fluid.
There is no way for either of us to remove the vial from the ring, I'm afraid.  But there is one who can -- one who knows of the darker magics.
You must locate the seer that calls the wild jungles of Aphus Lassel her home, and show this ring to her.
She will know what to do, and she will help you.
So you have been to the seer's jungle abode?  You seem to be handling all of this adventure and excitement quite easily.
Hold onto this vial as if your life depended on it.  The blood will be useful...but I am having trouble remembering in what way.
Oh, what an awful smell!  I remember this stench more than ever!  I hope the experience did not make you too ill.
The old hermit thinks hard for a few moments.
I remember...I took the fur somewhere, and it was fashioned into a sturdy piece of rope, or cord if you will.
I am sorry, but I cannot recall how this was accomplished.  You will have to figure out a way to bind or weave this fur.
Ah, you've done it -- I knew you would find a way!
Suddenly a thought bursts into your mind:  "The blood will strengthen the bond."  Had Kleeoh said this?
I remember now!  The braided tusker fur is physically strong, indeed -- however it must be magically strong as well, otherwise it is useless.
The hermit pulls on the ends of the blood-soaked cord, testing it's toughness.

You could not have done better!  This braided cord, soaked in the black blood of the fiends, will serve as a bridge between the two idol guardians.  It will also bind the powerful magic of the idols to your weapon.
Speaking of idols, you will be pleased to know there is only one more relic to obtain.
The diamond relic will provide magical protection, but used alone it is heavy and unbalancing.  You would hardly be able to steady your weapon with only one idol hanging from it!
A similar idol is necessary not only to balance the weight of the first idol, but to balance it's protective powers as well.

It is getting late, so I will not keep you any longer.  You must make your way to Marae Lassel, and retrieve a relic from the Great Elariwood golems that inhabit the wild northern forests of that island.
You will know it when you see it.  An elariwood idol is very similar to a diamond idol in appearance.  Find it and return to me.
The hermit eyes the elariwood idol, hefting the weight of the relic in his hands.
You should be proud of yourself!  These creatures do not part with their treasures easily.  This elariwood idol is the final component of my secret -- and your quest.
You should now have the items necessary to create your own fetish.  Attach the blood-soaked cord to the ancient diamond idol first, then to the great elariwood idol.
You are doing well.  Do you now see why the second idol is needed?
If you were to attach this incomplete fetish to your weapon, it would become so unbalanced and unwieldy you would not be able to aim or fire it!
The great elariwood golems which roam the northern plains of Marae Lassel will provide you with the second and final idol.
quest: Do you intend to linger?  I suppose I could make some cinnamon tea if you'd like to stay a while longer...if only I could remember where I put the cinnamon.
What were we talking about?  Oh that's right, your departure!  Hurry along now and return soon!
I can't remember if you were arriving or leaving -- I am just that old.
When I was your age I had to walk uphill in the snow both ways to get to the Lyceum.  You kids have it easy these days.
If you aren't leaving, at least make yourself useful.  Go stand at the bottom of the tower and put this apple on your head.  I want to try something...
Another fetish?  This one has been bound even shoddier than the last one!
I suppose I can try to fix this one as well...
The hermit struggles with the fetish for a moment, then hands it back to you -- obviously disappointed with himself.
I am sorry, but my hands are far too weak to fix this now.
When my strength returns, I should be able to help you.  But who knows when that will be?
The hermit's eyes grow wide as he begins to speak.
Ah, I do remember now.  I didn't think it would take this long, but no matter - you are here.  If you will but listen to my story, I will reveal a great secret to you.
I once was the greatest and most feared arbalister in all of Dereth.  I once had everything a man could want from this life, and I have enjoyed all that I have experienced over the long years.

But decades of adventure and excitement have caught up finally, I'm afraid.  I find myself unable to see the bull's-eye any longer, thanks to the slow dimming of my sight.  And more often than not I find the string to be too powerful for these feeble hands to draw or load.

However, a ghost of the past still stirs in this old body.  And before death's final arrow tears through the dark night in search of this weary target, I must see to it that my secret becomes known -- it is with you I entrust this knowledge.
The old hermit shifts his position, and begins to talk with a slow and deliberate voice.
I have seen with my own eyes the devastating power of magic; how easily a burning fireball can send the most skilled archer to his demise!
It has long been said:  "The only way to combat magic is with stronger magic."  Before you sits an old man who has come to understand what this truly means.
I obtained certain artifacts and studied about old, forgotten magic.  I devised for myself a way to empower my crossbow with a powerful, arcane device - a fetish, one might call it.

Any missile weapon may be empowered similarly.  Be warned - the magic is strong, and thus irreversible by any process I know of.  I will tell you all I can remember soon enough.  But today I have talked long enough.

Travel now to Aerlinthe Island.  Find the old ones, the ancient diamond behemoths roaming that enchanted, volcanic isle.  Retrieve the ancient diamond relic, and return to me.  I should more clearly see the past when I am again holding a piece of it.
You are truly a hunter worthy of this powerful magic fetish.  I have no doubt that you are excited to head out and t--
The hermit stutters, then begins to laugh loudly.
Aha!  It's a good thing you showed this to me.  You did not properly secure the idols to the cord!
The hermit rebinds the cord to both idols, using a method of tying you have never seen before.
There you are.  It took some effort, but I have fixed it for you.
You have done well.  I am very content in the knowledge that the secret will not die with me now.
One final request:  Tell no one of what you have learned from me!

greetings: Flesh is... meaningless?  After the flesh?

There is nothing more I can do with this.
Thanks, but it's of no use to me.

Not quite as sturdy as the tanned red hide that I worked with before, but it's still strong enough and large enough to craft into a nice robe. Wear it well.
Let's see. The hide is thick and leathery, and aside from the small bony protrusions it's in fine shape. I think a nice set of leggings.
There you go.
Another fine specimen. A little thicker than the last shreth hide I was given to work with. Let me have a moment and I'll... Yes, yes that's it!
Here you go.
Where did you get this? It's rather frightening, and rancid smelling. Well, let me see what I can do with it.
I've seen something like this recently. Came from a carenzi though, it mottled and smelled rank. Much like this. Where are you finding these creatures?
Well, I've done the best I can.
What is this!? I've never seen anything like this. It will make a fine robe I think. Give me a moment.
Yes, there it is done.
I've seen some interesting hides pass my way, but the hides that people have been bringing me most recently are the oddest.
A few more threads...and done!
Be careful out there.
If you give me the hide of an armoredillo, gromnie, reedshark, or mattekar, I can make something with it that you may find useful.
Hmm. A few snips here, and a few snips there...
Add some dye...There you go!
chatter: I can take the hides of certain creatures and turn them into items of value.
Have you the skins of armoredillos, gromnies, or reedsharks?  I can use them in my craft.

greetings: I am sorry, thank you for your efforts. Take these, they will better serve you now, I have no need of them. They will only serve as painful memories of happy times that are now gone.
You should also be rewarded for your efforts.
Jaleh's necklace.
It was a gift from his mother. He always wore it, he'd never taken it off around me. Even when he slept. It was the only thing that he had to remind himself of home. Here.
I have no need of it anymore. But you might find the same comfort that he did within its embrace.
I am grateful for your efforts.

His chain shirt crafted by the hands of the finest Aluvian metal smith on Dereth. This is all the proof I need to know that my husband is no longer among the living. For him to part ways with this finery ensures that his life is over.
How I wish that you had not found this item. But you have.
Take this as payment for services well done and please, I beg you leave me to grieve for my lost husband.

Now that I know what happened to my husband there is much that must be done. I want to thank all those that helped find him. I will not go to his final resting place, along the road from the Obsidian Span toward Glendon Wood, for there is nothing there for me.
If you find his things within that place I will still reward you for finding them.
chatter: This was his favorite shirt. He had it made by To-ping Ra. Though To-ping Ra allowed an apprentice to create it.
Jaleh was more than impressed, he was astounded but true to form he berated the apprentice and had the cost of the shirt lowered.I felt bad for the apprentice but there was little that I could do.
Do me one final favor, please.Take this note to the apprentice so that they might know the truth.
I am very thankful for what you have done.
If only you had known his kindness. Though he was gruff at times and often selfish there was a part of him that was truly and deeply generous and kind.
I knew that part of his life and now that has been taken. Where is the law in this land that will punish his murderer?
Would that there was someone that could bring this criminal to justice. Alas, I must be thankful that you have found this ring, the symbol of our love.

You have done more then ever I would have expected any to achieve. Thank you for setting my mind at ease. It is horrible what has happened but never knowing what had happened to Jaleh, my love, would have been far worse.
I know that this is not much of a reward for what you have done but it is all I can manage.
Though he preferred the open air that a Qafiya afforded him he would often use his turban as a belt or sash. I thank you for returning this to me.
Soft as the desert sand. Much like his touch. I shall miss it deeply. Why must such things happen?
Were they not supposed to have disappeared with the creation of the Lifestones. But now so many are learning ways to circumvent Asheron's potent magic.
Here it is meager I know but it is all I can muster.
What defender allows this to happen to their people?
I want Jaleh back.
Aaminah breaks down in a fit of tears.

I'm sorry, I'm not in charge of collecting that type of material. Try seeing if the other collectors, Kreavon or Aun Teverea, need any of that.
You have proven yourself to be a skilled Timberman, sure enough.
quest: Hail friend, my name is Caelis.  The Aluvian, Sho, and Gharun'dim peoples united under Queen Elyssa have joined together to form the Isparian third of the new alliance.

We are assigned to this outpost near Wai Jhou, to collect building materials for the continued upkeep of Candeth Keep. I will accept all types of salvaged metal and wood that you can afford to donate to the cause.  Large or small, poor or priceless, your donations will be treated equally.
Would you care to provide us with more materials? I accept all types of salvaged metal and wood that you can afford to donate to the cause.
Welcome back, your continued help is greatly appreciated! Any salvaged metal or wood you can donate is greatly appreciated.
Thank you friend.  Keep up the good work.  In my journies, I have found that banderlings hoard many types of weapons suitable for salvaging.

You are off to a very good start. Yet, building materials are in short supply, please continue to bring me what you can.  Keeping the town in good condition requires a constant supply of wood planks and metal hardware.
Ah, more materials for the stronghold.  Do you find all of this overland, or are you one of those heroes that takes up residence in some dark dungeon?
You have given me one-half the wood and metal materials that I would ask of you.  The residents of Candeth Keep shall know you by your name and your deeds.
Many good people like yourself are bringing cartloads of raw metals and wood.  Candeth Keep can be well maintained with these materials.  Your efforts will be rewarded.
You have given much to help the alliance.  More materials are still needed, but rest assured you have donated the bulk of the quota set forth by the alliance council.

The storehouses are beginning to fill with the materials you and the others have generously given to the cause.  We now have enough materials to make another delivery to Candeth Keep, but we will surely need more to maintain our stronghold.
Friend, your hard work has paid off.  You have given the most that can be donated by any one member.
You will be welcomed in Candeth Keep as a co-founder.  Your efforts in providing the necessary metals and lumber will prove to be a valuable investment in time.
If you would like to be known as a skilled timberman, return this token to me.
Take this hat, it is a tradition to wear it when practicing your craft.

You have given one-half the resources of which the alliance is seeking from each member.  It is people like you who will be considered the true founders of Candeth Keep. The alliance has allocated a symbolic gift for all of those who show dedication to the project.
You have helped us greatly. You can be sure that your efforts in continuing to provide materials for Candeth Keep will not go unrewarded.
You have given more than enough materials my friend. Perhaps the other collectors still require other materials.

greetings: Making Masks is kind of a waste of time, since Alexander can do it as well.  I can make wondrous thrown weapons though.
Scarecrow heads have an odd magic this time of year.  If you carve them just right, and perform a little chant... Ah HA!  Success...
Mosswart head, eh? Okay Let me just umm. Yeah. I need the paint. Okay there we go and a little more green and there we go.
It's not that hard... really.

A banderling head, great. Okay so I need to stick this on something. Do you have a stick? Oh never mind I'll just put it on my other hand. Sure and with a twist of the knife here and there. Ow! No, no it's nothing.
There you go. No the bleeding will stop soon don't worry about me.
Interesting. I must say that I am glad to finally be doing something more than second--hand work. Wait a minute! This is something that Alexander didn't want to work with. Perfect! Just perfect!
%n grumbles under his breath. As he grumbles he begins to make changes to the mask.
There! That's the best work I have in me.
Alexander's Apprentice leans over his small work bench and attempts to muffle the sound of his work as much as possible.
As he hands the newly fashioned Sunstone Gauntlets back to you, he quickly brushes the gemstone chips out the nearby window.
Now I know these aren't the highest quality alterations, but I'm learning. Promise me you won't go to Alexander if they fall apart on you in combat.

Hi, I'm Calvin, Alexander's apprentice.  He only lets me practice on skulls and scarecrow heads but he has also allowed me to start work on mosswart and banderling heads, using his old designs. So if you give one of them to me, I'll make something out of it.
Making masks is kind of a waste of time.  I can turn skulls and scarecrow heads into deadly throwing weapons, however.  Just don't tell my master!

Alexander doesn't know it yet, but I am working on a side project that I hope will pad my pockets a bit better once I get better at it. Give me your Sunstone Gauntlets and I'll see about bringing out a nice orange color in them!
Thanks! To get to the cave we lived in, follow the line of apple trees directly north of here. Be careful if you go there, and follow the line of candles.
This is amazing! It isn't even torn. Thank you!

Maybe you could help my friend Ercel in East Lytelthorpe Outpost. He's been moaning about a book he lost. And I'll write you a letter of recommendation to take to Lord Aleval in Lytelthorpe proper. He's always looking for adventurers.
I'm glad you helped out Ercel. He's a bit obsessed with this flying idea but he's nice enough. It's certainly hard to read this note! It isn't for me though, I believe it's for Lord Aleval.
Many of us used to live in the caves to the north because this area was full of nasty creatures. But we drove them out and built Lytelthorpe here.
Now the monsters have retreated into the caves where we once lived. Unfortunately, I accidentally left my favorite shirt there. Maybe you could get it for me.
To get to the cave we lived in, follow the line of apple trees directly north of here. Be careful if you go there, and follow the line of candles.
chatter: I hate this grey shirt. I don't look good in it.
It's so nice to live in Lytelthorpe. We used to live in caves because there were monsters in this area.

greetings: Hey, money! I appreciate it. Your contributions are welcome.
I heard a secret, but it'll cost you more than that.

So, Samuel in Eastham claims to have some sort of new wonder drink! He says it cured him of his nightmares. So, I went to the Singularity Caul, got some of those bits he makes the drink from, and gave them over... Can't say that it did much for me outside of clinging to my throat on the way down...
Have you found them yet? Those Singularity Caul reliquaries I keep hearing about? I hear people have found some strange items in them!
Lord Kresovus has put out a call for help. The Queen offered her aid, but he said he would rather seek assistance from independent adventurers. I wonder what that's all about?
The Queen is looking for help in finding out how Carlo di Cenza found his way to Dereth. Talk to Antius Blackmoor in Yaraq if you wish to help!
Last month I found what I thought was the most powerful sword I have yet come across. But this month, I found an even better one! This a good time to be a hunter!
Has that 50,000 pyreal piece of armor been cluttering up your house chest for too long? Well, go to Shoushi, Yaraq, or Holtburg and sell it!
A friend of mine was hunting the Singularity Caul when he came across a powerful new creature. It was a tough fight, he said, but he got a nifty spear out of the deal.

My good friend Loh-Gann Huhjj found a page from Carlo di Cenza's journal on the beach near the northern Beach Fort. It appears to be part of a much larger work. I sure hope he finds all the pieces. I am very interested in this Viamontian's past.
If you stand on the northern shores and listen closely enough, you can hear the screams of war. What madness makes its home up there? And when will it find its way to our lands?

Oh just like everyone else, my advice is only good enough for a paltry amount of pyreals! Well thank you, Mr. Pyrealbags this'll go a long way toward providing for my family. I'm sure that an egg will feed me, my three kids and my spouse.
Oh you just don't know...

Need a vassal? I won't ask for much just some tinkered armor and maybe a tinkered weapon. Oh and maybe a few MMD trade notes, or maybe some golem hearts, wasp wings, armoredillo spines, lugian sinews, dark revenant thigh bones, full sturdy iron key rings, full singularity key rings, or anything else that you don't need.
They say that Asheron went back home. I can't wait to see what he does, now that he's in control of the place.
Town criers are available in most major towns to tell you of the latest news and events. We'll also give you a piece of information for a bit of money.
Has it really been a year since poor Samuel was discharged from the Royal Guard? I would like to say Eastham was better for it, but... well... Sam hasn't done much outside of drink.
I can't wait to put this back together!
The Town Crier produces a handful of some blackened mineral.
Wait, you can't have this! It's mine! If you want some for yourself, you'll have to get it on your own!
I was speaking with a Lugian friend of mine the other day when he mentioned something about a great disturbance. He refused to elaborate, though I plied him with enough ale to drop a horse.
Have you read Carlo di Cenza's journal? I've never heard of a place called Shadow Pass, though I suspect the world outside of Dereth is much larger than we suspect.
If you're looking for some powerful weaponry, I recommend hunting some of Dereth's tougher creatures.
The vendors in Shoushi, Yaraq, and Holtburg must have benefited from those newly relocated casinos. They seem to have several more pyreals in their possession than usual.
What's the story behind these Banished creatures? They sure sound scary to me.
Who is this Sezzherei I keep hearing about? And what does he want with the Caul?
The Queen is greatly disturbed by the recent attack on the Royal Vaults. She fears we may not have heard the last of these mysterious Lugians.
The wind from the north grows cold. I fear a storm may be on the horizon.

Did you know that they moved us to a new pay schedule? We only get paid once a month, and only on the first day of the month. But I'm expected to be at my post the same amount of hours... Oh sure the town crier is here for you, but where's the love for us, huh?

So I'm sure you've noticed that I haven't left this spot in nearly four years. Yeah it's a tough life, standing here all day. Sure... sometimes people are nice enough to give me Shackles of Obedience. But I was wondering...Need a patron?
Hey, money!  I appreciate it.  Your contributions are welcome.
I wonder how Flufens is faring? It has been many weeks since she started her farm out by the western shore.
Have you just arrived? Have you SEEN the Tumies up on the plateau? Sweet mothers, I didn't even recognize them! They have... have TAILS! And their magic is different from ours!

Watch out for the Tumerok they call Tuperea. He's a hunter, we think. He has a pack of trained reedsharks that he uses to flush the siraluun from cover. But to that one, everything is prey - including you.

We've had a lot of problems with brigands lately. Not just us, for that matter. The Tumies are bedeviled by them too. Queen Elysa's Advocates think they're coming from Vesayen. Doesn't it just figure? MacDugal and MacNiall cause trouble wherever they go.

We don't go up on the plateau much. It's riddled with Olthoi hives, and the land is...queer. Everything is overgrown with patches of fungus, like you find in Olthoi tunnels.  It's almost as if it's been changed to suit them. The bugs up there do seem smarter, but not enough to do something that big. Our sage likes to call it an "infection."

If you want my advice, stay off the plateau. Leave it to the Tumies. There are Olthoi up there, Saint Elysa preserve us. And not just the sorts we're become used to back on Dereth!  You ever hear about the breed they used to defend their eggs with? The kind they used to suppress slave rebellions in the hives? The Zaikhal Arcanum called that sort "praetorian," after the Roulean Imperial guard. T...
There is something that I don't trust about that Britana.  Beautiful, you say?  Like a black widow spider, perhaps.
Behdo Yii in Redspire is looking for assistance to help clear out an abandoned Tumerok Outpost.  Please help him!
News! Travelers beware: Tumerok factions are battling for possession of the island! Do not get caught in the crossfire! Adventure in groups! Ration your supplies! Watch your pyreals!
News! Burn and electrocution victims have been limping back into town for weeks. We have not yet determined what out in the wilderness could cause this much agony.

I don't know why the Tumeroks up on the plateau look different. We've noticed that the ones in Ahruenga - that's their town on the west coast - are a bit bent. And that chief of theirs is... worrying. Don't tell them I said any of this. There are stories...

The Tumeroks here are split into two warring tribes. The ones up on the plateau are funny sorts. Actually, they're rather nice. Bit preachy. The ones down here though, the ones that look like the ones on Dereth... *shudder*
We've heard from the Tumies that there are some massive Empyrean ruins up on the plateau. None of us have seen them yet, though. I think they called them "walls to stay the water."
We've heard reports of a new Mattekar roaming the northern parts of the island.  I've heard some unscruplous folks are already trying to find ways of processing the hide.  The poor, poor mattie.
Deep in the forests on the plateau, I have received word of glints of steel, surrounded by a purplish glow.  I shudder to think at what new weapons of destruction are used up there.  *Shivers*
I hear this island used to be called Marae Lassel.  It sounds Viamontian to me.  A snooty lot, eh?

We sent a few scouts up on the plateau recently. They reported a bunch of the old menhir rings standing up there. The funny Tumeroks even built their town around one. They seem awfully interested in them, if you ask me.

The great years are gone, if you ask me. Where can you find the like of Wari al-Sha'im these days, or Lord Cragstone, or Saint Elysa? Ah, I tell you, if the Olthoi could produce another queen, many would die before she could be defeated.
Every once in a while we hear a rumor that Virindi were spotted up on the plateau. If there are any of them, they hide themselves well. I can't imagine what they want there.
What news... traveler?
Wow, can you believe it's been almost five years since all you heroes started showing up? Time flies when you're having fun!

It appears as though a schism has grown in the ranks of the Burun. After Morgluuk's defeat, a good portion of the Burun fled the wounded leader. Apparently his weakness gave rise to a fear that the Guruk would soon crush the Ruuk and so a great many of the Ruuk have joined with them.

Spies inside the Renegade camp state that the remaining Burun allies that they have are leaderless and have come to admire the Renegades free will. However, the remaining forces are too small to mount a potent resistance against our forces.
