In my free time I've been undergoing the tests set forth by the Journeymen craftsmen. I'm well on my way to becoming a skilled cook! And my purse is filled with pyreal as well.
I never knew the Ust could do so much!

News! The Master Craftsmen of Glenden Wood have sent their journeymen out into the world. All those who wish to further their artisanal skills should contact the journeymen to discover what new crafting tests are available.
Hear ye! Hear ye! I plan on leaving town and raising chickens.
The Festival Season celebrations will be held late this year. Feel free to celebrate, we just won't have any festivities planned until later.
We've beaten back one of the Burun leaders. Clearing up the rest of them shouldn't be that difficult.
Let's see what Dame Fortune has in store for you!
Hey big spender, I only take the green tokens.
Hey!  What are you trying to pull?  This token is only for use at Arshid's Den of Iniquity, in the Gharu'ndim lands.
Hey!  What are you trying to pull?  This token is only for use at Gan-Zo's Den of Iniquity, in the Sho lands.
I manage the games of chance with the green tokens.  Give me a green token and see what you win!
You have found the cider! My little friend will be so excited! It makes him the least bit tipsy, you know.
Allow me to reward you.
This cheese is very strengthening. I am most grateful that you have brought it to me so that I may feed it to my beloved pet.
You have been so good to help me already, but perhaps you can do one more thing for me?

My friend Oi-Tong Ye follows the teachings of Jojii. He has been searching for four stones that represent the Jojiist principles of Discipline, Detachment, Compassion, and Humility. I have recently learned that these stones may be found in the Shreth Hive.

Here are directions that will lead you to the Shreth Hive. Please see if you can recover the four stones. When you do, take them to Oi-Tong Ye in the bar in Shoushi. He will be so pleased to have them!
I have tended this drudge since it was very young, and he is my friend. But he is still very weak.
There are two foods that he particularly likes and which help him grow strong. These are perfectly aged Greenmire Cider, and perfectly aged Greenmire Cheese.
Would you retrieve these foods from the dungeon just behind my house, called the Stone Cathedral? My little friend and I would both be very grateful.
quest: I believe that Lou Ka was looking for this. Why don't you try taking it to him? I believe he stays in the bar in Shoushi.
You found them! Quick, take this to Oi-Tong Ye in town! I'm sure he will be thrilled to have it!
Oi-Tong Ye is always talking about this type of thing. Why don't you show this to him?

greetings: As he begins his journey back to the lifestone, Torgrym is heard to mutter, "Damn. Bloke must use that Virindi thing... whassit... that funny gear stuff. I'm too... elite... for this..."
As he begins his journey back to the lifestone near, Torgrym mutters deliriously, "Anyone gotta portal to subway..?"
Torgrym glares over his orb at %s. "Come on, foight like a man. Been whackin' on these dumb local critters too long, eh? No challenge in 'em, I say."
Torgrym glares over his orb at %s. "Loik the Tumies say, mate, 'zhtufu ah gahrede.' That means 'silence, loser, or meet me outside.' Er... kinda, anyway."
Torgrym glares over his orb at %s. "Ya precious great pansy ... wossamatta, been sittin' down in Black Spawn Den too long? Do the sun hurt yer eyes?"
Torgrym winces and mumbles, "Roit, thassit. I'm recalling. I'm not dying for this."
Torgrym winces and mumbles, "Ack, that hurts. Are me buffs down already?"
"Ha!" Torgrym guffaws. "If yeh can't foight wid the best of us, go foight drudges. Suck vitae, %s."
"Woo hoo!" Torgrym crows. "I owned yeh loik a wee lil' girl!"
Torgrym laughs at %s's feeble spellcasting. "Ha! When I wozza boy I spent weeks honing my magic defense in the Zaikhal meeting hall."
Not a puppet...

Wonderful!  You found one!  Ummm, unfortunately, Mazur has brought a small problem to my attention.  As I mentioned when I first saw you, this is a fine and strong pelt.  A little too strong, in fact.  Mazur is unable to tan the hide with his existing tools.  However, he informs me that if one were to use some form of strong acid on the hide, that he should be able to treat the hide and fashion...

Well, you found the acid.  Congratulations.  Oh, you don't expect me to do the actual crafting do you?  That is why I have Mazur.  He will give you your prize.  Just remember that Britana always delivers!

Well, you found the acid.  Congratulations.  Oh, you don't expect me to do the actual crafting do you?  That is why I have Mazur.  He will give you your prize. Just remember that Britana always delivers!
Yes, it is quite beautiful, isn't it?
Ecch.  I don't need this.  Use this on your mattekar pelt, and then give the pelt to Mazur.  Do I look like a craftsperson to you?
This smells awful!  Take it away from here!  Use it on your mattekar pelt and give the pelt to Mazur.  Go, go!
Don't ever bring this piece of garbage to me again.  Just remember that this is what Ketnan stands for: Garbage.  Understood?  Britana only creates quality items.

What!  Do you think I am some shiftless slob like Ketnan?  Just because we are related doesn't mean I will take charity like him!  Well, I suppose it would be rude of me to refuse a gift, I guess I could make an exception for someone with such a discerning eye as yourself.

Greetings brave adventurer!  My name is Britana, perhaps you've heard of my...never mind, he isn't important anyway.  What is important is have I got a deal for you!  Perhaps you have heard of a small fashion accessory...The Hoary Mattekar Robe?  Yes, I am sure you have.  Well, unlike some others who seek to perpetuate fraud upon the Isparian public with cheap knockoffs, Britana only provides t...

I have come to this island upon hearing reports of a great white beast that stalks its northern coasts.  Rumor has it this is a Mattekar straight out of legend, come to rid the island of its troublesome denizens.  Which denizens, you ask?  Legend does not say.
But what I say is that a Mattekar this large and strong must produce a robe which makes the Hoary robe seem like a bath rug!  Bring me this mattekar pelt, and I will craft you a robe fit for a king!

Greetings. Asheron, my lord and creator, has sent me here in an effort to assist your Arcanum. I am working closely with Ciandra of the Arcanum Consortium at Xarabydun. Vist her, and she can enlighten you as to the task at hand.
Take these. If you so choose I will grant you the title of "Champion of Dereth" if you return the token to me. The stamp is a gift from the High Queen.
Very well, I shall grant you the title Champion of Dereth. We are indebted to you for your efforts, Champion.

With the resurgence of the Harbinger and the assaults levied against it by Nuhmudira and Aerbax, I have taken it upon myself to stand as a balance between the two. I cannot offer the same gifts that they would grant but if you return to me with proof of the Harbinger's defeat I will gladly offer you a reward and a symbol of your efforts.
quest: You have assisted me recently. Others should also help in this endeavor. Please return in a few days and I may require your assistance.

Greetings. Asheron is continuing a line of research into Lifestones which he had begun once, long ago. He has sent me to enlist the services of Isparians in obtaining a rare form of crystal. Dailantium Crystals are important to this research- there are several ancient mines in which Dailantium Crystals are yet stored.

Asheron has summoned a portal on a hill north of the town of Holtburg. From that portal you may begin this pursuit. You will discover direct portals to the mine at its destination- you should enter the portal appropriate to your abilities.  Once you have obtained a quantity of the crystal return it to me.  You shall then be granted access to the gift container Asheron has placed nearby. I wish...

Thank you for your assistance in obtaining this Dailantium Crystal for Asheron. I now grant you access to the gift container. Asheron may require more Dailantium Crystals in about four days if you wish to undertake this task again.

greetings: Ah, Abmim, I knew you would one day run afoul of something. He that chooses a thief's life has it stolen from him early. My brother became a brigand and murderer, friend traveler.
Be not as foolish as he - do not lightly discard the protection this mage Asheron provides. But, as I promised, you have earned a reward.
Abmim, my brother! Ah, to learn that at the last you had renounced your evil ways! This gives me great joy and great pain - joy that you came to your sense, and pain that it came too late!
Traveler, you have eased my troubled heart. Thank you.
Hail, traveler. Have you encountered a man named Abmim ibn Ibsar? He is my brother, who foolishly listened to those who whisper of an unsafe freedom to be gained in the Direlands.
We have not heard from him in several months, and begin to worry. If you bring me news of him, I would reward you as well as I may.
The last we heard, he had finally accepted some honest work from Akyafi the Translator. Perhaps Akyafi, who resides upstairs, can tell you more.
quest: Lubziklan al-Luq was looking for this! Why don't you try taking it to him?
I believe that Akyafi the Translator was looking for this! Why don't you try taking it to him?
Mara al-Luq is always talking about this type of thing. Why don't you show this to her?

greetings: Hello! My master in Glenden Wood, Copper Vanurp, has sent me out into the world to participate in the great Mission - encouraging the young people of Dereth to embrace a life of artistry!
If you bring me an example of your craftsmanship - say, a bowl of fish noodle - I will reward you with a token of encouragement.
The apprentice coughs quietly.
Um, we're not rich yet, though, so I'm afraid I can only reward you once a week.
If you bring me an example of your craftsmanship - say, a bowl of mushroom noodle - I will reward you with a token of encouragement.
If you bring me an example of your craftsmanship - say, a bowl of chicken noodle - I will reward you with a token of encouragement.
Hello! My master in Glenden Wood, Copper Vanurp, has charged me with the mission to encourage the people of Dereth to cultivate their crafting skills.
If you bring me some flaming kimchi, I will award you with the funds to further your crafting studies.
If you bring me a spiced apple pie, I will award you with the funds to further your crafting studies.
Hello! My master, Copper Vanurp, has charged me with the mission to encourage the people of Dereth to cultivate their crafting skills.
If you bring me some hot kimchi, I will award you with the funds to further your crafting studies.
quest: Well, this is certainly a .. err .. good effort. But why don't you spend a little more time practicing and then come see me again?
Excellent! Excellent! Look at that workmanship! Good job!
Apprentices don't have the deepest pockets in the world. I'm afraid that I can only help you in your studies once a week.
The narrow path allows all who walk upon it to attain balance.
The journey of the obstinate is to find the will to become as pliable as the reed in the riverbed.
Within the bounds of grace lies the wisdom to know strength.
Seek what you know and discover what you shall.
There is no grace in the bull. Passion is the way of the poet, not wisdom. Ignorance is a shield that protects none.
Seek the truth of Jojii. His teaching can be found in every aspect of life. To follow his words is to walk the right way in life.
Sit, Please.
In my life, I have seen a great many wonders that have challenged my beliefs, and driven me near the edge of forsaking all that I had known. But in Jojii, I have found the virtuous path.
Not so long ago, another came to me. He was as accomplished as you, more so perhaps. What he had accomplished is not as important as what he had learned.

His name is Honshu Takeda, and he has begun to learn about himself and the way of Jojii. He had lost his way, and I have set him back upon his path. He will follow the shrines to Jojii. The first lies within this very town, just beyond these doors between the trees.
His journey will end in Kara. Much wisdom can be garnered by following the path and incorporating the lessons of the four stones in your actions.
Should you wish to follow in his steps, seek the shrine and pray as I am sure he has done.
The narrow path, allows all who walk upon it, to attain balance.
The journey of the obstinate, is to find the will to become as pliable as the reed in the riverbed.
There is no grace in the bull. Passion is the way of the poet, no wisdom. Ignorance is a shield that protects none.

greetings: It is fortunate you have arrived. Without help these valiant fighters might be slaughtered after having held out for so many years.  The Olthoi seem to be on the move!
No, no I don't want to drink that.
Pretty. But I don't understand what it means.
Don't give me that again!
Yuck!
Thanks, that went down well.
Well, I suppose I'll take that back. Thanks.
Brentsella!  Why?  Oh, never mind.  Here, you can have this instead.  Take it before I change my mind.
Oh. Yeah, I have that.  If Harlune sent you, you must be getting something back from him, right? I'll tell you what.  There's this... this thing that I need.  From a volcano in the Direlands.
You'll find it at the very bottom, but you must be level 20 or above to get in.  Wait, I'll write you the location.

You got the Water of Lethe!  I don't believe it.  I... I've wanted this for...  Do you know what this does?  Do you know what it's like... the faces of so many waiting behind your eyes every night?  The children asking you where their parents are?
But... Brentsella. I'll lose her too, won't I..?
Here's Harlune's book. Please go, I have to... I need to think. Thank you, but I need to...
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Hey, looks like it got rolled in the mud... Anyway, well done!  Here, take these as a reward.
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Looks like good old F.P. went swimming or something.  Here's your reward.
Looks like you've lucked out!  Our man F.P. has finished his book, finally!  Here you go...
You found it. Oh bless you, I had lost it, thought I did but someone stole it left me with an empty mug loop on my belt and no cup with which to hold my drink. But bless you, you found it!
It smells of Ayan Baqur, I've caught the scent before, the desert and dirt and the dirty pyreals. So filthy and unclean.
But you, you've a chip or chunk of a tree from the Tiofor Forest around Glenden Wood on you. I can smell it. Might I see it?

I have been contracted by the Dereth Exploration Society to help them in their outreach program towards the Isparians who find themselves newly exiled in Dereth.  Here is a book that explains their mission.  I am also giving you a list describing the locations of the nearest stamp and portals to other towns.  If you collect any of the Society's stamped letters, you may bring them back to me for...
By the way -- if you haven't yet done so, you might want to visit Brentsella at the South Outpost, or Mindorla at the East Outpost. They often have tasks for young adventurers.
quest: Oh, Mindorla!  Well, I suppose you want a reward for delivering this to me.  Here it is.
As long as you're here, see what rumors the barkeep is selling.  You might find adventure around here, like I did when I was younger.
Celcynd takes a deep breath of the Bark.
Ah, the smell of fresh firs and the air around Glenden Wood. Indeed that is where this came from. Somewhere near the city and surrounded by firs. May I keep it?
Oh thank you. It reminds me of the area near the Glenden Wood Prison the trees there smell so nice throughout the year.
Bah, I have no time for you now!  Maybe come and see me tomorrow about Mindorla.
What's this? Not the woods. Not the woods!
You must stamp this with a Town Stamp to get a reward.  Please read your Book of Quests to find out how to get a Stamp.
No, this is for you to stamp the letters you find.  Please keep it.
Thank you, you must have journeyed far to get here.  You are a true Explorer!

You will get nothing from me for this. Go explore and find more towns.  The Society Agents in the Gharun'dim towns will exchange a piece of armor for this. If you take this to one of the Sho towns, you will receive a weapon.
chatter: Urrp.
Why me?
Brentsella...

greetings: A note from Iquba! Does that mean you seek the fabled Sword?
That is good. It is a fearsome weapon against the darkness.

Take these notes. They will tell you how to reach the Carved Cave, wherein you may journey to the sad, lost Halls. But first you must fight the lightless ones deep within the cave, and take from them the seventh key. Make no mistake! The lightless ones were the downfall of the ancients! Beware!
quest: Thank you.
Thank you, but no thank you. Perhaps later.
chatter: Caves are the place to be, indeed!
Avoid the great crater, I say; the caves there are none too pleasant, even for me!  Oh, the fumes!
Avoid the lightless ones!  Evil, evil are they!

greetings: Attentive.
The box attends the master.
Lilitha inclines her head toward you and waits, looking numbly expectant.
Lilitha blinks at you uncomprehendingly.
Why is that one on the other side of the wall?
Lilitha reaches toward you, and absently gropes her own face. She seems confused.
That one is... The box hasn't seen flesh poison in... in a long time.
Person. The box meant person.
The box used to count the days with marks on the walls. It used its fingernails. It counted four years. Then they changed the walls so they wouldn't mark. That was a long time ago.

Does that one see the hand? It is not the box's hand. They took that. They put it in a glass bubble and it turned into fog. They attached the box to this one later. Sometimes the hand talks to the box.
Temenua. That one caught the box as it slept. It brought the box to a child, and the child gave it to these things.
An angry blush colors Lilitha's cheeks, and an unexpected gleam rises in her eyes...
It BOUND me. No one EVER --
... but a faint, glissando shriek comes from her head. She flinches, and the gleam dies as quickly as it came.
They put a thing in the box's head. A crystal thing. When the box becomes agitated it screams. The Masters told the box it is a keeper.

The box doesn't know what they are. They didn't talk at first. They just kept stabbing glass pins into the box. The first thing they said was the box's own voice, like an echo. Then they started putting the box's words together in different ways.
They took the box apart twice. First they looked for what was inside the box, but they said it was empty. Then they wanted to know what made the box go.
They did it with blue lights. They drew lines on the box and it fell to pieces.
They wouldn't let the box move. The box watched it happen, until the light reached its eyes.
It... hurt me...
Lilitha abruptly falls to her knees and begins to retch, hugging herself tightly.
They brought a man here once. They split him open and scooped out his insides. They made a pile, like sticky fruit. Then they put other things inside him that glowed red and purple.
One of the Masters said they learned how to do it by studying the box. It said the man's name was Martine.
They took the box outside in a cloud. It's nothing but purple. You could fall forever, and everything was bent this way and that. But in some places there were blue ribbons that crackled and danced.

There were things around the ribbons. They looked like glowing water and trailed strings of jelly. They turned as the box went by and poked each other with the jelly-strings. They were the size of houses. Maybe. Size doesn't work right outside.

quest: I have taught you all level three spells I have.
I have taught you all level four spells I have.
I have taught you all fellowship spells I have.
I have taught you all dispel spells I have.

greetings: Hello! My master in Glenden Wood, Tiffany Comfore, has charged me with the mission to encourage the people of Dereth to cultivate their crafting skills.
If you bring me a vial of concentrated lightning oil, I will award you with the funds to further your crafting studies.
Hello! My master in Glenden Wood, Tiffany Comfore, has sent me out into the world to participate in the great Mission - encouraging the young people of Dereth to embrace a life of artistry!
If you bring me an example of your craftsmanship - say, a frost infusion - I will reward you with a token of encouragement.
The apprentice coughs quietly.
Um, we're not rich yet, though, so I'm afraid I can only reward you once a week.
If you bring me an example of your craftsmanship - say, a lightning infusion - I will reward you with a token of encouragement.
If you bring me a vial of concentrated bloodseeker oil, I will award you with the funds to further your crafting studies.
If you bring me a vial of concentrated frost oil, I will award you with the funds to further your crafting studies.
If you bring me an example of your craftsmanship - say, an acid infusion - I will reward you with a token of encouragement.
quest: Well, this is certainly a .. err .. good effort. But why don't you spend a little more time practicing and then come see me again?
Excellent! Excellent! Look at that workmanship! Good job!
Apprentices don't have the deepest pockets in the world. I'm afraid that I can only help you in your studies once a week.

greetings: Very good, you may keep your dagger. A lady near Zaikhal named Devana bint Hamudi is looking for skilled hunters.
Give this to her.
Nasty for you, if they catch you on one of these, eh?
There you are, a bit of a reward and I've made a nice spear from the horn.
Fire Auroch horns are beyond my skill, but I can trade for them. Here, take this reward.
I've heard about some master bowyer named Yuan Hanzu who makes these into bows.
Hmmm, yes, I'll take this horn. I may just trade this for something I can use. Here's your reward.
I think Yuan Hanzu, the Sho master bowyer, makes great bows from these horns.
Well, this tooth is neither that of a gromnie, nor an auroch. I used to avoid trading for these, but I've learned they have offensive properties.
As you can see, this mace will now do some nasty piercing damage.
Ah, one of the smaller Niffis shells. With a special technique I have devised I can flatten and reform these.
Here, I made this shield yesterday. That's sure to make quite a statement on the battlefield.
Hehe, the shell almost looks like a helmet now. With just a little work...
There you are! A beautiful Niffis Shell Helm.
Oh, what a beautiful niffis orb! You deserve a reward worthy of this find.
Don't hesitate to bring me more of these opalescent marvels.
These teeth are light and will fly well. They just won't do as much damage as some of your higher end spiketails.
These teeth are light and will fly well. They just won't do as much damage as some of your higher end atlatl darts.
You might get more if you put this under your pillow, haha!
Jade tooth eh? These are just the right weight for bolt heads.
Enjoy!
Swamp Gromnie teeth are exceptionally sharp. Ow! See what I mean?
Be careful with those.
This reminds me, A lady near Zaikhal is looking for hunters.
Here is your reward. If you wish to know more, hand the dagger back to me as a sign of trust.
It has taken me a few years, but I have finally figured out a use for Sable Gromnie teeth.
It has taken me a few years, but I have finally figured out a use for Ebon Gromnie teeth.
The Brass Gromnie only recently appeared on Marae Lassel. Had I not been inspired to craft, I wouldn't have even thought of making this out of Brass Gromnie teeth!
The Copper Gromnie only recently appear on Marae Lassel. Had I not been inspired to craft, I wouldn't have even thought of making this out of Copper Gromnie teeth!
I hope you don't think me macabre for collecting these.
I will give a greater reward for more unique skeleton skulls.
This skull is very unique, it will be extremely useful to me.
Thank you for bringing me this treasure.
Yes, I have found a use for these. I'll have to cleanse the skull first of course. Yech!!
I know of a sage somewhere in the southern mountain range that also collects these.
Tibia from a grievver if I am not mistaken. Interesting bone structure.
Thank you, bring me more of these and you will receive the same reward.
A Tusker Slave tusk. You can't use these on the Island of the Tuskers. It's a good thing you came to me.
These tusks are exceptionally useful since they are hollow.
Well Done! I expect the Lich didn't give this willingly.
Please convince more Liches to part with their bones.
A thighbone... hmmm, not a Dark Revenant, but I can still use it.
Bring me a Dark Revenant thighbone I will reward you fivefold.
Aha! A Dark Revenant thighbone, quite exceptional!
A fine reward for your formidable deed.
Hard to imagine that they used this as body ornamentation. Thankfully, we can use these as an augmentation of sorts.
This is a nice find. I have a friend that would like this. Thank you, and here is your reward.
With a little carving, and a little work with the top of the bone here... There we go, a rather dastardly looking dirk, don't you think?
Oh I agree... It isn't really enough, so take this too.
Hmm, if we stretch this a little here and disjoint the jaw. We can twist this little bit and then, excellent! Wear this with pride.
Since the helmet doesn't really offer much protection, I think a little monetary reward is in order as well.

Well. This is a little fleshy. Of course we can pull this, oh blech, what was that? Well whatever it was, this poor sod won't need it. Oh and the smell, well, let's just add a little touch of sunflower oil. Much better.
Here you go.
A grim looking shell. The Niffis are never this dark. Well I'll see what I can craft from it.
Odd, there seems to be magic within the shell that was left within when I finished the shield. You might be able to affix a symbol if you center on this shield.
A mite! This large? You're pulling my leg...
Let's see what I can do with this. Shave a little off here and here and...Well that is odd. I seem to have loosed some hidden qualities within the bones.
Good luck with this.
These fangs are very sharp. Pried them from a carenzi you say. Well, I think that I can get them into some useful form.
A wrap here...done.
quest: What a lovely piece of work! Look at the inlay here! Thank you for bringing this to me.
I wish to study this in depth. Perhaps I can learn this level of work ...
I have already given you one of the nice stuffed Monouga's. But I can still reward you with a little something. There's a little extra money in there for you.
Thank you, but I have plenty to study for at least a month. Perhaps if you return later I will have time to examine this.

This is an excellent find. My friend is working on a collection and has given me an exclusive special offer. You qualify for the special collector's edition Tremendous Monouga Pack Doll. Supplies are limited, so only one per person, per month.
chatter: I seek the teeth of certain creatures, the gromnies.  But I won't take just anything, I want only the most well preserved gromnie teeth!
Give me the rare tooth of the fierce gromnies, and I will craft it into something useful.  I will also take auroch horns.
I require stout gromnie teeth for my craft!
I am still experimenting with the skulls of certain skeletons.  They don't seem to be good for weapons, but I'll give you a health potion for them.

greetings: Thank you.  Here is your reward.

Hello.  Myself and my brothers-in-arms have been assigned to exchange gifts with those that donate undead trophies to the Shagar Zharalim.  We were not expecting the plethora of trophies we have received, so we have adjusted our prizes accordingly.
The literal translation of my name means daughter of the wind.  I adopted it in honor of my mentor, who recently disappeared during a journey to Uziz.

There are healing kits even more potent than the ones dropped mainly by Lugians.  The Zharalim have recently uncovered lore that enables them to treat these kits in order to make them more potent.  If you trade me a mnemosyne fragment, I will reward you in turn, depending on the quality of the fragment.

quest: What are you doing here? Why don't you give me an M note and get started on your mission? Nuhmudira and her students won't wait forever you know.

I see that you have reached the Seat of Knorr. If you pay me an MMD note I'll weave up a gem that will take you back to that very spot. Just make sure to speak to the golem there, if you want to back there quick again.
I am sorry, but I think that you lack the cognitive capacity to ascertain the memorandums and literature that we seek. Please take some time to think about your failure, perhaps 3 days.
If you've lost something of worth to you at the Lyceum or you simply wish to return to it, I can assist you but, it cost you an M note for the return trip.

Once you use this gem you will be on your own. Knorr has no portals, we assume for fear that the Olthoi that have not completely been removed would find a way through to Dereth. You will need to have your own transportation home. You have been warned.
This is all you'll get from me. I need results. If you don't bring me something this time then no more gems for you.
I am afraid that there is no more for you until you've thought about your failures for a little while shall we say... 3 days. Begone.
Speak to the Golem again and maybe I'll be able to craft another one of these for you.
Hey! You're trying to pull one over on me eh?
Olcris looks at you angrily.
I'll keep this, cause Nuhmudira might like it, but you're note getting anything else from me moneywise. Begone.
Ah, good work. Nuhmudira will be pleased that you held up your end of the bargain. Now let me take care of my end.
It has been a pleasure working with you.

Hail! It has come to my attention, through means at my disposal, that Asheron has recently visited his old school somewhere far from Dereth. I'd be willing to assist you in getting there if you promise to do something for me.

I am sure that the structure contains a great many books that pertain to the history of this world. We are looking for any information that you may be able to gather there. Return the books to me  so that Nuhmudira's school might thrive.
If you would agree to such an exchange I will only ask for a small gesture of good will, shall we say an M note?
Should you return the books to me I will ensure that you are given this expenditure upon your return.
I'm sorry I am not willing to send someone along before I have explained all there is to know of this undertaking, besides you may find my offer... beneficial.

I'm sorry, I am not willing to send someone along before I have explained all there is to know of this undertaking; besides you haven't really ever been anywhere that interesting, from the looks of you.
So what do you think you are trying to pull, I don't remember your face. You should really just get out of here.
Olcris looks at you incredulously.
What? You want this back. I have my orders and they clearly say that any and all information gathered from the Lyceum should be given to Nuhmudira. I'm not going to cross her.
I am sorry but your life would be over too quickly if you went where I would send you.
I remember you! I already gave you a Realaidain Raiment. Wear it with pride, my friend!

High Queen Elysa asked me to create a special raiment for all Isparians who have made Dereth their home. The crest up on the raiment is that of Asheron's own family, the Realaidains. Wear this raiment with pride! But please take care of it - I only have the materials to provide one to each adventurer.
I am sorry, friend. I can only provide raiments to those who had already made Dereth their home by Morningthaw, PY 15.

greetings: I'm here to Survey this land under the authority of the Arcanum.
I'm surveying this land for the Arcanum. Please move on, I have much to do.
chatter: The %n looks over the crater and makes a mark on his instrument.
The %n adjusts some metal rings on his device.
The %n sights along a line he has drawn in the dirt.

greetings: Remember, you didn't get this from me...
Listen, I just "acquired" the Seal of Dericost. It's yours if you can part with any trade note worth 50,000 pyreals.
chatter: Hey, I have something you might want...

greetings: Ah, Thank you. A fine example of Jhong Mi's writing. There are others in the dungeons near Yanshi too.
An early work, but an important one.
A work that shows Jhong Mi's dissatisfaction. Fascinating.
Thank you, you must have journeyed far to get here.  You are a true Explorer!
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Hey, looks like it got rolled in the mud... Anyway, well done!  Here, take these as a reward.
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Looks like good old F.P. went swimming or something.  Here's your reward.
Looks like you've lucked out!  Our man F.P. has finished his book, finally!  Here you go...

Hello, I am a collector of the writings of Jhong Mi, who was a philosopher who wrote his own interpretations of the teachings of Jojii.  If you find any of his writings, please give them to me, and I will reward you. You might start by talking to Lou Ei at the North Outpost, or Te Ven at the South Outpost.

Also, I have been contracted by the Dereth Exploration Society to help them in their outreach program towards the Isparians who find themselves newly exiled in Dereth.  Here is a book that explains their mission.  I am also giving you a list describing the locations of the nearest stamp and portals to other towns.  If you collect any of the Society's stamped letters, you may bring them back to...
quest: Copies of this seem to come in often.  Ah, well.  There are other writings by Jhong Mi in dungeons near Yanshi; if you find any, bring them to me.
Hmmm, I have received this letter too often from you recently to give a reward.  See me tomorrow, and I may have a reward for you then.
You must stamp this with a Town Stamp to get a reward.  Please read your Book of Quests to find out how to get a Stamp.
No, this is for you to stamp the letters you find.  Please keep it.
Thank you, you must have journeyed far to get here.  You are a true Explorer!

You will get nothing from me for this. Go explore and find more towns.  The Society Agents in the Gharun'dim towns will exchange a piece of jewelry or a wand for this. If you take this to one of the Aluvian towns, you will receive a weapon.

greetings: Thank you, your heroism is appreciated!
Thank you, your heroism is appreciated! Take this!
This weapon uses the most modern of military technology! It is specially crafted to be extra damaging against our Tumerok foes!
Ufet lowers his voice.
Of course, for political reasons, it doesn't work against the Aun or the Hea Tumerok, but only against the Virindi-controlled renegades.
Ah, an old recruit come back to finally claim your promised reward!
Oh, and here -- take this.

We'd like to give you a small gift in appreciation for your ... patience, but that item hasn't come yet. But when it does, just give me this token back and I'll give you your reward. Why don't you check back in a month or two?
Ufet coughs -- or was that a snicker?
What's this? A note?
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Falcon training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
What? You want a reward? This is no trophy -- this is just a scrap of paper! Bring me some trophy ripped from the hands of our enemies and then I will reward you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Serpent training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Shreth training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Reedshark training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Gromnie training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Mask training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Ah! Yes! That was where they were headed. Thank you for finding this! Where did you find it?
As Ufet looks over the note, you relate to him how you found it.
I see. The shreth have always been known to be vicious.
Thank you for this little bit of information, but I will need something more from you in order to reward you for your efforts.
I thank you for this. It seems as though the Order of the Raven Hand have claws in several of my companions.
I thank you for this information. With these bits of knowledge, we will seek to restore the honor of our fallen comrades.
Here is something for your efforts.
The library seems to be caked in madness and filth. Remnants of a Shadow Bulwark perhaps? Soot-layered tombs and air that maddens.
Now I see why the Raven Hand sought this place out. There may be artifacts of powerful shadows within.
It seems, though, that Yalik has done well in guarding the place. This is a hugely important task for one as young as he. I wonder how well he will handle the task in the months to come.
Ufet nearly forgets you in his musing, but quickly returns to the matter at hand.
I thank you for this. We were right to suspect the Order of the Raven Hand were up to no good. Take this as a reward for your efforts.
This came from the Shadow's Garb worn by Rayssid Ibn Alhath? Sadly I know little of the man save for his affinity for ranged weapons.
It seems only fitting that the reward I give you should reflect that. Take this periapt. May it help guide your shots with accuracy and swiftness.
Ah, Tiyol's tassel, correct? I had no liking for that contemptuous man. In fact, it would not surprise me at all if he was the first to fall under the sway of the Raven Hand.
You did the world a great justice by defeating him. And since he was such a vile man, I have no qualms about giving out his belongings.
Before the group left for the library, many of them entrusted some of their belongings to my care. Primarily items that would be of no use to them in the grasslands and forests north of here.
Tiyol left this Cowl. Here, take it. I am glad to be rid of his belongings. Surely you will put the Cowl to a more appropriate use.

You say Rheth Al' Thok wore this upon his Shadow's Garb? He was a bright man, poised to enter the ranks of the Zaikhal Arcanum. Well... that was before my compatriots offered him a place within our ranks. A shame that he was so easily enticed.
Since he joined the ranks of the Zharalim, he was striving to obtain the Shagraka- the casting focus used by many of the Zharalim's sorcerers.
As he is no longer with us, the focus reserved for his use shall be passed on to you.
Good Day. My name is Ufet, and I am here to organize the defense of Gharu'ndim from the depredations of the renegade Tumeroks.
Queen Elysa has called for volunteers to help investigate the Tumerok training camps near Dryreach. You can pick up a news sheet about this menace from the barkeeper.
If you have already investigated the camps, and you have some trophy to prove it, I will gladly reward you. I also accept Tumerok insignia.
You'll pardon me if my mind is on other matters today. Several of my comrades have left for a recently discovered library north west of this city, but they have not yet returned.
I am not usually one to worry, but with all that has happened of late, assassinations, invasions and an increase in cult activity, I can't help but do so.
I must remain at my station, but if you happen to come across them, please let me know where they are. Any information you find will put my mind at ease.
This looks to be a very important report. I think that this should be delivered to Captain K'rank. I do not wish to keep such an important report from his hands.
I have been sent by High Queen Elysa to reward those who have assisted Captain K'rank of Linvak Tukal. If you have proof of this assistance give it to me and I will see that you are rewarded.
quest: Coman ibn Rashid says, "Hail %tn. I see that you have returned to shatter the morale of the Burun again. Your efforts continue to assist our people in lessening the threat these creatures pose. Here are your rewards."
The key will open whichever chest you choose in that room. Each chest should clearly display what it holds.
Coman ibn Rashid says, "That is all that I have to give. Thank you again for your efforts, %tn."

Coman ibn Rashid says, "Hail %tn. Again you take the head of the Burun leader, Morgluuk. You are surely a hero to all. As we have already placed the creatures head outside of the city in your honor, this one will be turned into a trophy that you can display with honor, %tn."
%tn has defeated Morgluuk and received a glorious reward for their efforts.
Filthy creatures these Burun. As promised you are to be rewarded for your efforts.
A brave warrior who has continued our efforts to crush the morale of the Burun and the renegades. You have done well. Here take this and display it proudly.
Coman ibn Rashid exclaims, "%tn, you have killed the Burun leader, Morgluuk! This head is proof of what you have done. All should know your name."

%tn has slain Morgluuk and returned his head to the Gharu'ndim capital of Zaikhal. There it is to be placed on a pike as a symbol of victory for the Isparian, Lugian and Tumerok people and a symbol of defeat for the Burun that threaten our way of life. Huzzah, %tn!
You must be rewarded for your efforts.

Coman ibn Rashid says, "The portal gem will take you into the High Queen's Vault. There you will find many chests that house treasures and weaponry that has been worked on by the finest smiths in the land. Take your gift and use it well, %tn. You are deserved of much praise in this victory."
Coman ibn Rashid says, "That is the final reward I have for you. You have become a hero to all of Dereth, %tn. I shall never forget your name or your deeds."

greetings: Thank you, your heroism is appreciated!
Thank you, your heroism is appreciated! Take this!
This weapon uses the most modern of military technology! It is specially crafted to be extra damaging against our Tumerok foes!
Kiroji Matanui lowers his voice.
Of course, for political reasons, it doesn't work against the Aun or the Hea Tumerok, but only against the Virindi-controlled renegades.
Ah, an old recruit come back to finally claim your promised reward!
Oh, and here -- take this.

We'd like to give you a small gift in appreciation for your ... patience, but that item hasn't come yet. But when it does, just give me this token back and I'll give you your reward. Why don't you check back in a month or two?
Kiroji Matanui coughs -- or was that a snicker?
What's this? A note?
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Falcon training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
What? You want a reward? This is no trophy -- this is just a scrap of paper! Bring me some trophy ripped from the hands of our enemies and then I will reward you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Serpent training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Shreth training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Reedshark training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Gromnie training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Mask training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Greetings! My name is Kiroji, and I am a Shosa in the Sho Army. We must rally to deal with the renegade Tumerok alliance. We must not allow Hebian-To to fall!
Queen Elysa has called for volunteers to help investigate the Tumerok training camps near Dryreach. You can pick up a news sheet about this menace from the barkeeper.
If you have already investigated the camps, and you have some trophy to prove it, I will gladly reward you. I also accept Tumerok insignia.
My shop... where is my shop?
No thank you, but I prefer a sweeter wine.
Very good. If you could find a handful of wine I might be convinced to tell you of my adventures and heroic deeds.
Nice, but I prefer wine.

This drink reminds me of a crazy fellow I met in a desert fort south of here. He was very serious and wanted us to help him cast some spell. I saw nothing for me in that, so I headed out to find my fortune and drink my fill of wine.
If it's no bother, would you be kind enough to buy me something to wet my thirst? Byrdara seems to have locked up the liquor for some reason.
Alas I am so very thirsty after my trip from the southern reaches. I fear that I will be unable to enlighten you lest this terrible thirst is quenched.
quest: It would appear that I have told you all that I know. Or have I? Perhaps I know something that I do not know that I knew. I find drink of great utility in remembering things I have forgotten.
Yes, one more drink may finally get us to the bottom of this enigma! Run off and fetch me more wine before I forget to remember!
Mmmmm..Mmmmm..Ow!!!
Vers thomfing thuck in ma mouf!
A splinter? I guess they add all sorts of stuff to wine to give it that woody flavor.
Ulgrim tosses the splinter aside.
What's that over there, behind you?!
What, nothing? My mistake, I thought I saw something. Well never mind, here let us drink to our continued friendship.
Ulgrim watches you expectantly from over his mug.
So, I've got a small problem maybe you can help me with. There's this guy in Dryreach thats been posing as me, Ulgrim!
If you could maybe just scare him a little? You know, make him realize that there can be only one.
Yes, yes, I think I'm remembering something...
No, I've lost it.
Perhaps one more wine will help me cogitate.
Yes and what would you like my friend?
Drink? I'm sure I don't know what drink you are talking of.
No, you are mistaken, but if you were to bring me more drink I might be able to devise of an elaborate plan to track down the culprit.
So, are you looking to earn a little extra pyreal on the side? We could perhaps enter into a mutually beneficial arrangement.
Think about it. I'm always looking for bright new people to join my allegiance.

You look at me expectantly. You think this drink puts me in your debt? I would think again my friend. It is you who are in my debt. I have graced you with knowledge that you cannot acquire anywhere else. I would step carefully were I you.
Now kiss the ring.
Very Good.

greetings: These crystals must be laid into the Dragon's protective arms. Place them within the brazier. If you choose to use them alone, you can anoint them with the water I have given you, but you will not find completeness.

This should placed atop the crystals that have been laid into the brazier that represents the Dragon's power. Place it atop the crystals and brazier. You can choose to anoint this stone with the water I have given you, but you will not find completeness.

The brazier represents the power of the Dragon a shield and defense for the Unicorn and Firebird. You can place the crystals within the Brazier. If you so choose, you may alter this with the water I have given you, but you will not find completeness.

Anoint the combines pieces that represent the Dragon, Firebird and Unicorn to find a center for yourself. If you choose to anoint a single item you may release the magical properties within the item but you will still find yourself empty.
quest: You have completed your journey. Allow time for the teachings to be set within your being. If within one month you are still without direction, follow my path again, and I shall teach the steps anew.
You have done well to find the power of the Dragon.
You have done well to find the power of the Firebird.
You have traveled the same path as I, and learned the lessons of the great spirits. Now you must know how they fit together.

The base is the Dragon's power. The grace of the Unicorn must be spread within. The splendor of the Firebird can be placed atop the combination of strength and grace but...only with pure water that represents the four stones and the path of Jojii can you bring the object to life.
Here, take this.

The water can be used to waken the combined spirit of the three, or to awaken the strength of just one. I would advise against waking just one. There is little that can be finished that is not complete.
You have done well to find the splendor of the Firebird.
You have done well to find the grace of the Unicorn. You need only find the Dragon's power.
You have found the grace of the Unicorn. But you lack the splendor of the Firebird.
You have not found your way upon the path. You must first find the grace of the Unicorn, the splendor of the Firebird and the power of the Dragon.
You have found the grace of the Unicorn. But you lack the splendor of the Firebird or the power of the Dragon.
You need to find the Dragon's power and the Firebird's Splendor.
You must now find the grace of the Unicorn and the splendor of the Firebird.
I have traveled far to reach this point, and still my journey only begins. Visit the adherent to Jojii in Tou-Tou to learn my tale.

greetings: This is beneath my capabilities. Take it back.
This powerful gem allows me to make you a unique spellcasting orb! The orb is irreplaceable, mind you, so take care not to misplace it!
A noteworthy gem. I can imbue a spellcasting orb with its power. But this orb, unique as it is, cannot be replaced if lost, so be very very careful with it!

The power in this gem makes me shiver. The orb I have made for you will never be equaled. But its power also makes it irreplaceable! So if you lose it, do not come back to me expecting a replacement. Sometimes life can be cruel.
A rare gem of some power. Here is an orb infused with its essence. Remember, this orb will be difficult if not impossible to replace, so be careful with it!
This gem holds a respectable amount of crystal essence. Take this orb as your just reward for your effort. But be careful with it, as you may not ever be able to replace it if you lose it!
As powerful an orb as I have ever seen, with one exception... Here is an orb of equal power and rarity. Remember, if you lose this orb, I will not be able to replace it for you!
Look at this! I think there's even a crack in it! Let me shine it up for you.
I have heard of powerful gems, more powerful than the mediocre gems you bring to those so-called master smiths. If I had such a gem, I could make a powerful spell-casting orb with unique properties.
Of course, if you are not a masterful mage, you should speak with one of my younger brothers. If you have one of my old orbs, I will improve it for you.
Ah, my love!
Tallial sniffs and wipes her eyes.
The last time I saw Joffre... Sir Tremblant... he was exploring the mountains to the west of the castle... Looking for the entrance to that accursed city!
Please, leave me be...
Just as I suspected.  Thank you for your bravery.  People have complained about the reward I granted for service in the past.  Perhaps this antique hauberk will be more appreciated.
What's this? This note must belong to my seneschal, Gormling. Please return it to him.
Welcome to Neydisa Castle.  We are a peaceful settlement, but MacDugal's band of raiders has recently re-occupied the castle to the east.  I am sure they are planning something vile.
If you are able to bring back to me evidence of MacDugal's plans, I will grant you a reward from my castle's armory.
quest: And someone of your obvious experience deserves a bit more.

greetings: Sorry, I don't have a clue how to get that thing off.
I think you want the Master Furniture Maker, Bartholomew, for this. It's way to big for me to mess with.

Ah yes, these banners are really quite rustic. I find that a framed Tumerok Banner really adds a simple charm to a room. Here, let me frame this for you. Jordan the Wall Hanging Master sent me some frames just for this purpose.
May it brighten up your home. Don't forget to hang it level.
Hello!

My name is Jubei, and I specialize in random knickknacks that may seem worthwhile to have in your house.  Once I get around to making the necessary tools, and you have an item that might be of interest, bring it to me.
Or not...
This is beneath my capabilities. Take it back.
I can do nothing with this.  I can make arrowheads out of the smaller crystal pieces, but not pieces of this size.

This gem must surely be unique! Take this bow, imbued with the unique essence of the soul crystal. Such a powerful bow can only fire arrows with a special head. If you bring me shards from crystal fragments, I can make such arrowheads for you. And beware! If you lose this bow, it is gone forever.
If you prefer crossbows, you will have to find some way to attach it to a stock.

A unique soul crystal gem! Take this bow, imbued with the gem's power. It will only fire arrows with heads which I can craft for you, so bring me crystal shards and I will make arrowheads for you. This bow is completely unique, however, and irreplaceable if lost.
If you need a crossbow, you must attach it to a stock yourself.

A unique gem, filled with power! Impressive. Here is your gem-infused bow. Such a bow can only fire arrows made with crystal arrowheads. Bring me crystal fragments and I will make you such arrowheads. A word of warning: this bow is irreplaceable! Lose it and you will never again see its like.
If you want a crossbow, you must attach the stock yourself.

A rare and powerful gem. Here is your bow, infused with the crystal's essence. Remember that this bow can only fire ammunition made from crystal fragments, which I can make for you if you give me crystal shards. I am sure you appreciate how rare the gems are, so take care not to lose your bow!
If you desire a crossbow, you must attach it to a stock yourself. If you desire an atlatl, give me back the bow and I'll see what I can do.

A rare gem, of considerable power. Take this bow, infused with the gem's energy. Remember, the bow can only fire crystal-tipped arrows. I can make appropriate arrowheads for you if you give me crystal shards. You must be aware of the rarity of these gems, so do not lose your bow! You may not be able to find another.
If you wish to have a crossbow, I cannot help you. You must fit a stock to it yourself. If you wish an atlatl, give me back the bow and I'll see what I can do.

A wondrous gem, a miracle of rare device! Here is a bow, equally rare and precious and irreplaceable. The bow will only fire crystal-tipped ammunition, so bring me crystal shards and I will make arrowheads for you.
If you need a crossbow, you must find a way to fit a stock yourself. If you need an atlatl, give me back the bow and I'll see what I can do.
Excellent, I assume you seek crystal ammunition. Take these crystal arrowheads.
Seeking ammunition, are you? I hope you enjoy using that bow I made. Or are you a crossbow user? In any case... here are your crystal arrowheads.
A shard of this size makes for a sizable number of arrowheads! Here are your arrowheads.
Well, it's no bow, but I do have this old contraption here. Remember, this can only fire crystal-tipped darts.
Look at this! I haven't seen one of these antiques in a while! Here, let me improve it for you.

If you can find a gem more powerful than a mere scintillating gem, I would be interested in it. Give me such a gem and I will use it to craft a magical bow for you. The bow will be so powerful, in fact, that normal ammunition will not work on it. You will have to come to me for arrowheads as well. If you have one my old missile weapons, I will improve it for you.
I am not a crossbow maker, however, so if you need a crossbow you will have to attach a stock to the bow yourself.
No, this is for you.  I have no need of the Writ.  Use it to acquire your new home!  Even if you have purchased the house, some dwellings further require them for maintenance payments.

What an interesting ... umm ... mechanism! I have no idea what it's for! But you know, those Arcanum Researchers, they've been working with odd metals like this -- you should ask one of them. You can find them in the libraries in Cragstone, Hebian-To, or Zaikhal.
We need all the ingots we can get.  One day, you will be grateful we have such a stockpile.

A rare find!  My congratulations.  Here is your Writ of Refuge.  The Empyrean have left many secrets for us to puzzle out.  Their geomancy recently became transparent to us.  This powder might reveal yet another crucial part of their power.  We shall crush the enemy through their own devices!
Thank you for bringing us this Niffis Pearl. It is thought it may be useful. Take this Writ as your reward.
Well! Would you look at this! This should be useful!
We thought this jelly was useless for a time. But we've recently discovered it has certain properties which are of much interest to us. Please, take this Writ as a reward.
We feared we would never be able to lay our hands on this poison again. Thank you for choosing to part with such a rare item!
From this day forward %s shall be known as Gaerlan Slayer.
This is a strange device indeed. I have never seen anything like this before. Hmm...
The Agent ponders this strange new item momentarily.
I'll tell you what. I'll take this thing off your hands and give you a Writ of Refuge in exchange! Sounds like a good enough deal, eh? Then it is settled!

I've seen a number of pearls in my days... You know we exchange Niffis Pearls for writs correct? ... Anyway, I have seen a number of pearls before, but this is obviously not from any niffis I've seen.

Look at how dark this pearl is, it seems to eat the very light around it. This is a truly rare find, some ancient Empyrean decoration no doubt, but I can't imagine it would be very different from the niffis pearls we know of.
I'll give you a special deal on this pearl, since it is obviously of a different quality than your common niffis pearls.
Oh, the token, I guess you deserve this.
Ah yes, I seem to recall that our leather crafters stopped making shirts out of these. Don't worry, we have plenty in stock. Here, let me get you a shirt this hide.
Forge Essence! We can surely use as much of this as you can lay your hands on.
Thank you. If you need to see the list of tradable items again, just ask.
There are few beasts on Dereth as feared and hated as the Margul Sezzherei. To meet one who has personally slain the creature... I cannot believe it!
You should be commended for your efforts. From this point forward, let it be known to all that you are the Sezzherei Slayer!
quest: %n shakes their head at you condemningly.
You are still a cur unworthy of trust. I am only too grateful to the wisdom and compassion of others. With their help, and theirs alone was Nuhmudira freed.

You are fortunate that she has pity within her heart enough to grant you the trappings that you need to obtain housing. If you give me any of these items listed here, then I will grudgingly give you a Writ of Refuge.
%n smiles at you gently.
You have done much to help us. Your sacrifice and actions assisted Nuhmudira in her darkest hour and we thank you for those efforts.
If you have not yet done so, seek out Balthazar outside of Lin. He will instruct you on how you may further aid us.

Housing continues to be provided through a joint effort of the Arcanum and the High Queen. Writs are required for these domiciles. Once you possess a Writ of Refuge, seek out a Covenant Stone and determine what else is needed to purchase your homestead. Also of note are new dwellings that have been opened that offer a more communal living arrangement.
Here is a list items we will accept in exchange for writs.
%n salutes you.

Thank you for investigating this matter for the Arcanum!  No, we do not yet comprehend the extent of the schemes of this minion.  I have confidence we shall find out soon, though.  Here is your Writ.  As of this time, we do not need any further tokens from you.  We will however still take the other trophies I mentioned to you.
Wow! Great work. Here is your reward. You are looking a little green my friend. Are you feeling okay?
We only wanted to see that you had achieved what we asked. Seeing as how you did so well you should keep this.
You never know, you may find a use for it yet.
Wow! Great work. Here is your reward. Umm, I think your britches may be burning.
Wow! Great work. Here is your reward. You know your hair looks as though it is standing on end.
Wow! Great work. Here is your reward. Was it cold in there?
I have recently rewarded you for visiting revenge up on that madman. Please come back to me in one day before asking for another reward.
The Agent bows their head low and speaks softly.

Although Nuhmudira has returned to us, we have learned that there is still a way to show your support for her. Outside of Stonehold there is a portal to the dungeon where she was once imprisoned. There you can choose to sacrifice yourself for her or to abandon her to her fate. It is odd that the magic has yet to dissipate.

If you require writs we will accept any of the items on this list in exchange for a writ. Once you possess a Writ of Refuge, and have satisfied the other requirements for purchasing a home, seek out one of the homestead areas that we have built. If you would rather, you can enjoy living in one of the new dwelling areas that have been established for a more communal living arrangement.
I already informed you that we no longer need any tokens from you.  We will however still take the other trophies I mentioned to you.
Wow! You were able to navigate that place again. Great Job! We are not giving repeat offenders the Writs, but everything else is still available.
I see that you have visited revenge upon the man that wanted to bring our race to an end. Nuhmudira thanks you for this. Here is your reward.
If you hand the token back to me I will make sure that you are recognized for your efforts. The madness of his reign is over and now we can move forward.

greetings: Hold on, I'm getting your item.
Here you go.
My specialty is creating magic gems and potions from certain pieces of crafted obsidian.  If you have such an item, give it to me and I will return a useful and rare item.
My specialty is creating magic adornments from certain pieces of crafted obsidian.  If you have such an item, give it to me and I will return a useful and rare item.
chatter: Have you any spheres or jewels of obsidian?  If you give me such, I shall give back to you something of value.
I am seeking items crafted of pure obsidian, of the rarest kind.  I do not want the raw form.
My specialty is in crafting wands and orbs from crafted obsidian.
My specialty is in crafting magic adornments from crafted obsidian.

greetings: Jonas struggles with the lock intensely for a moment, then manages to release the mechanism.  You wonder if he is more intelligent than he appears.
No chain! Jonas free!
You have shiny for Jonas?
A shiny!  A shiny gift for Jonas!
Jonas have gift for you!
quest: You have shiny?
Give shiny to me! To me!
More shiny! More shiny!
Can...you...help?
Please...help...me...
Broken and dull -- for you!
Too shiny!
Bright!  Not shiny!
Tusker friend...you!
Best shiny friend!
Green not shiny!
Good shiny friend!
I trade for shiny!
Shiny friend!
You eat hungry!

greetings: Oh no! You have to find Dansha-Ki and give this to her, otherwise there is no hope in seeing her return. Please hurry!

Can you help me? My sister went south headed towards Dryreach for some much needed supplies. She has not returned and I fear the Tumeroks may have captured her again. Kind soul, can you help find her for me?  I'm really worried for her safety.
However, I can't just send anyone to rescue her. Bring me an insignia from a Tumerok to prove your strength. Then I'll trust you in saving my sister.
quest: I'm sorry, I can't possibly impose on you to rescue my sister again. But, if you find someone worthy, send them my way...

Perhaps you can help me! My sister was last seen near the outskirts of Dryreach. Please find her for me. Time is of the essence! I'll give you thirty minutes to save her, otherwise I'll have to find her myself and hope I alone can rescue her.

greetings: Barkeep... one last drink...
Rosebud.
I should have taken the red pill.
Now I'll never know what happened to Tuka...
No power in Auberean can stop me!
Get offin my land!
This is private property!
Your head'll look good in my trophy room!
Stay outta my basement!
Gettem!
chatter: We Rock!

greetings: Now we can begin to train you. Here is the key to the Practice Area Doors. It will open another door besides just this one.
No, thank you. Once you leave this Academy, this letter will serve as an introduction to others who will need your help.
No, thank you. You must use this key on the door to my office.
quest: Hurry! The Outer Courtyard is still under attack! You must help the Royal Guard immediately! Use the portal to the Central Courtyard and talk to the Senior Guard--he will send you to the Outer Courtyard.
Don't worry, I have already signed you in. Go ahead and use the key I gave you to continue to the next room to learn about picking up objects and manipulating your Viewpoints.

Hail, fellow Isparian! The kingdom is in danger, and we need more brave adventurers like you. But first, we must train you. Click on the Backpack in the lower right corner of your screen to open your Inventory. Click on the blue Calling Stone, and drag it to me.

greetings: Ahh many thanks!  You are a true hero!  Here is a reward for you.
And in recognition of your skill, I bestow you with this token, please return it to me if you wish for me to change your title to something appropriate of your valor...such as Bugstomper!

Finally, I am glad that you saw fit to help me with this little matter, but I now have a new problem.  It seems that while I was busying occupying myself with this Tumerok archaeological site, a whole new host of bugs have taken up my previous exploration site, a dungeon on the other side of the island, named the Dark Lair.  I tried to show those bugs what's what, but I'm afraid I wasn't able t...
Well, aren't you something special?  I knew you could do it!

That ring should come in handy for you, I imagine.  And since you have proven yourself so worthy, let me officially give you this token, please return it to me if you wish for me to change your title to something appropriate of your valor...such as Gardener Weeder!

Now, while you were out ridding the island of those terrible bugs, I heard tell from a passing stranger that he discovered a Crumbling Empyrean Mansion infested with ugly Olthoi in the eastern lowlands. Bring me one of those Workers' pincers, and I'll reward you well!
This is fantastic! You're the best!
And now, you deserve this token! Please return it to me if you would like the title of Worker Obliterator!

Well, you are making your way up in the world.  I was hesitant to bring this up before, but now I feel relatively certain that you are up for the challenge.  Up on the plateau, there is a nest of Olthoi Soldiers plaguing explorer parties that journey up above.  The townspeople have come to me asking if I can rid them of these horrors, and of course I immediately thought of you.  Go up to the pl...
I am most impressed!  You have accomplished much in a short time, traveler.
You might find that bracelet useful, I dare say.  And you deserve this token, please return it to me if you wish for me to change your title to Soldier Slaughterer.

I am somewhat embarrassed to bring it up, but it seems as though the townspeople have thought of me as the renowned Olthoi Slayer.  I have tried to explain to them that you are the one doing all the killing, but they don't seem to understand that.  Now they expect me to go kill off a nest of Olthoi supersoldiers!  We call them Olthoi Legionaries, and they are quite terrifying, from what I am gi...

You're back?!?  I mean, welcome!  Of course you're back!  I had the utmost faith...well, perhaps that is too...I was relatively sure that I would see you again, and the fact that you are still alive as well is pure felicity.
And of course, now let me give you this token, please return it to me if you wish for me to change your title to something appropriate of your valor... like Exterminator!

I admit it, I have been telling the townspeople that I was the one killing all the olthoi and bringing back the pincers.  As a result, they have been treating me as a hero!  You have to understand, all I wanted was to be an explorer on this new island, but I found all this unexpected attention...gratifying.  But now...now I don't know what to do.  It seems they want me to face off against a hor...
You really are a savior!  Here is your reward.
Here is a special token of my regard. Return it to me and I will give you the extra-special title of Bug Butcher!

Oh, my friend, the onslaughts never end! The moment I feel that we...I mean, you have brought these infestations to their final end, I hear that yet another swarm of even more dangerous Olthoi has made their presence known! Please, my friend, save my reputation once more. The Olthoi Warrior's Nest lies upon the northern part of the Marescent Plateau. Bring me the proof of a single Warrior's pin...
This is really amazing. How did you manage to kill all of those nasty bugs?".
I must ask you to accept this token. Return it to me and I will change your title to something more befitting one of your stature...such as Warrior Vanquisher!
Suddenly you see a strange light begin to gleam in Bedho's eye. With great alarm you realize that Bedho is preparing himself to grovel.

Oh great and powerful warrior from the east! Only you can save us from the perils that infest this land! They...they told me... stories of Mutilators boiling up from the plateau's very bowels, acid dripping from their very jaws!
Behdo's voice has now dropped to a whisper.

And they insist that I, Bedho Yi, must go and deliver them from this threat! Please...I promise this is the last time. The Mutilator Tunnels lie upon the northwestern side of the Plateau. Bring me a Mutilator pincer, and I shall reward you!
Thank goodness someone like you is out there looking out for us! Here is your reward.
And here is my final gift to you. Take this token, please return it to me if you would like me to change your title to Mutilator Annihilator!
I bestow you with the title of Bugstomper!
Well, let me officially recognize you as Gardener Weeder!
You shall henceforth be known as Worker Obliterator!
You deserve a title of Soldier Slaughterer!
And of course, now you are an Exterminator!
Here is your new title of Bug Butcher!
I shall now change your title to Warrior Vanquisher!
All shall know you as an Annhilator!
quest: Hello there stranger!  I am wondering if you can help me in a bit of a predicament I find myself in.  I was busy exploring a wonderfully well-preserved abandoned Tumerok outpost, when I was beset upon by a number of Olthoi!

I had never seen these fearsome creatures that close before, and the fact that I escaped with my life leads me to believe that these Olthoi aren't quite so tough as their mainland counterparts.  If you could journey to this tumerok outpost and rid it of these troublesome beasts I would be most grateful.

If you could bring me back some proof that you have conquered them, such as a pincer, I would reward you well.  I believe the portal to the Abandoned Tumerok Site now lies a bit to the northeast of here -- I have heard rumors that strange eddies in the currents of portal space have shifted it away from its original location.
What are you doing loitering about here?  Bring me proof of those nasty bugs' demise!
chatter: I can't believe I have this wonderful tumerok site to explore, and I am forced to loiter around here due to those pesky Olthoi.  If you head up to 42 degrees north and 82.2 degrees west, you can help me with this problem!
The Dark Lair needs a brave adventurer like yourself to rid it of those icky bugs.  I don't remember the exact coordinates, but it was around forty-four degrees north, and sixty-eight degrees west.

There are three sites up on the Plateau that beckon to a hardy young adventurer like yourself.  One is on the southern portion of the plateau, the other two are on the northern end.  Good luck!  Not that, um, you'll need it or anything.

greetings: No, use this on your Sleeves of the Arm. But in order to imbue the spear with the strength of righteousness, you must be strong and tireless, like a rain of ceaseless axe blows.
No, use this on the Staff of the Mind. But be warned, you need to have a strong mind and understanding of the ways of mana to use it successfully.

No, this must be used on the Spear of the Heart. But be warned, you must understand the nature of the Lugian heart. You must be able to pierce quick and righteously, like a spear of truth, if you wish to craft your item successfully.

My brethren of the Arm will be very glad to see this returned. Tukal has a debt to you, little Isparian. The Tukal Elders have authorized me to have sleeves fashioned from some of our most talented crafters. Here, take these Sleeves of the Arm.  While they are not quite suitable for use yet, if you can find one of our emissaries we sent to the Isparian Arrival points, they may have something of...

My people are strong. But in the immortal words of General Casarius, "Strength alone cannot win me this war. My mind must tell me where to strike." Returning the Sceptre of the Mind brings peace to many of our kin who follow the way of the Mind. The Tukal Elders have authorized me to have a Staff formed by some of our most talented crafters. I present you with this Staff of the Mind. It cannot...

Do you ever wonder why we have a blade as our totem of the heart? My brothers who believe in the Path of the Heart preach this to the uninitiated, "Trust your heart like you would trust your blade.   Use it in the cause of righteousness and none can withstand you. Leave it unguarded and you shall know the final sorrow." I thank you for mending this breach in our heritage.  One day maybe we can...
Ah yes, I remember these sleeves from the old days. Allow me to exchange these for this newer version.
Ah yes, I remember this staff from the old days. Allow me to exchange its for this newer version.
Ah yes, I remember this spear from the old days. Allow me to exchange these for this newer version.

The raiders are striking hard now. They are fearful of our efforts to reach out to the Isparians. We have lost three of our most sacred totems due to their depredations. The Cloth of the Arm, the Sceptre of the Mind, and the Blade of the Heart must be found to ensure the continued stability of Linvak Tukal.

Our scouts have compiled information as to the whereabouts of the raiders' encampments into this report. You may find it useful in retrieving our totems. Kifandel the Imbuer now carries the Book of the Arm, Mind, and Heart, which records the words of Lauriagne, our first Matriarch. Read her words you will understand why the recovery of our totems is of the utmost importance to us.
I've recently made some improvements to the Sleeves of Inexhausitibility, the Staff of Clarity, and the Spear of Purity. If you would like to have one of these items, I will gladly improve it.
quest: No, this is your reward. Go find one of the Gem Sellers. I believe there were three dispatched, each one to a different Isparian Arrival point. They can help you with this.
Congratulations!  You have earned it

greetings: These look like the Academy Blacksmith's bellows. You should take this over to him--he's been bellyaching ever since the Mosswarts stole them. He'll probably reward you, too.
You must have been fighting our Sparring Golems lately. Instructive, aren't they? I'll give this back to the Senior Guard for you.
Yes, you are certainly welcome here! Especially if you go kill those horrid Carpenter Wasps for me!
Ah, my studying days are over, my friend. You may have this back.

The Blacksmith's Oil of Rendering...looks like you've helped him with those Mosswarts that have been plaguing him lately. I don't know why they're so fond of his bellows though...maybe he should take them on as his apprentices!
The Academy Foreman guffaws loudly at the Blacksmith's expense.
If you pour this oil onto one of the Quartermaster's Training Weapons, I'm sure you'll be happy with the result.
This is one of the Training items forged by our Quartermaster. If you use the Oil of Rendering that I gave you on it, you'll find its powers will increase tremendously.
You've bought one of the Quartermaster's Training Weapons. It's a nice one! But try pouring the Blacksmith's Oil of Rendering on it--I'm sure you'll be happy with the result.
Beautiful! We're all rooting for you. Carry your new weapon with pride.
quest: The Foreman is nearly hysterical with fear.
Haven't you heard? The Outer Courtyard is under attack! What are we going to do? You must report to the Senior Guard--he will know!
I heard that you successfully helped the Blacksmith regain his bellows. Good job--I have no idea how those Mosswarts strayed in here, but they certainly don't belong.

Now, you have already helped me enough, my friend--I'm sure from now on I'll be able to manage these Wasps on my own. Good luck in the rest of the Academy! Have you already completed your Academy Weapon? You should show it to the Senior Guard--I'm sure he'd be happy to see your progress! Good luck in the rest of the Academy!

You have already helped me enough, my friend--I'm sure from now on I'll be able to manage these Wasps on my own. You should now go visit the Academy Blacksmith around the corner--the Mosswarts have been stealing from him, and I'm sure he could use your help. Good luck in the rest of the Academy!
Thank you! You are surely doing your part to ensure that this Academy will thrive. Let me reward you with experience.
You should now go visit the Academy Blacksmith--the Mosswarts have been stealing from him, and I'm sure he could use your help. Good luck with the rest of the Academy!

Perhaps you can help me out as well. Quickly, Carpenter Wasps have infested my woodpile! There are so many of them--could you help me clear out a few? They are here through this door beside me. If you bring me one of their wings to prove that you have taken some of them out, I will surely reward you.

Help has arrived at last! Quickly, Carpenter Wasps have infested my woodpile! There are so many of them--could you help me clear out a few? They are here through this door beside me. If you bring me one of their wings to prove that you have taken some of them out, I will surely reward you.
You have already helped me enough, my friend--I'm sure from now on I'll be able to manage these Wasps on my own. Good luck in the rest of the Academy!
chatter: Shoo, fly!

greetings: Hello! If you are willing, we have a task for you.

The Arcanum lost some important research when Martine raided our Research Facility near Al-Jalima. Martine seems to be gone now, but his minions remain, preventing us from retrieving the decanters we need.
