If you can go there and find the decanters, then you can journey to the Fathomless Chasm, a wellspring of pure mana, and use the decanters to collect the essence there. This essence is required to forge the new pyreal weapons, which we are calling Isparian.
Here -- I have literature that explains all this.
The locations of the Research Facility and the Fathomless Chasm are written on the flyleaves.

Things have begun to quiet down thankfully. But there are stirrings from the deeper areas of the Retreat. Hibdin knows more about it than I do. I'm content simply watching for now. I'm just glad that I am free of Gaerlan's mind control.

Thank you.  I used to try to live in a place called the Old Warehouse, a dungeon overrun with monsters now.  It's on the hill to the north, toward town.  If you go in, you can keep any treasure you find.
I don't want this.  It's not my business any more.
I used to try to live in a place called the Old Warehouse, a dungeon overrun with monsters now.  It's on the hill to the north, toward town.  If you go in, you can keep any treasure you find.
quest: Oh, memories.   I didn't really want it back, but here, have this as a token of my thanks.
I grow tired of these love games.  Maybe tomorrow I will have made up my mind.

greetings: The horn of a Fire Auroch, eh? These beasts are impressive, but very slow, which makes them easy to kill. Here, I have carved the horn into a shape suitable for use in a composite bow
Great Mattekars are worthy prey. Take this piece of carved horn. With it you may make a strong weapon.
This is not of flesh and blood. Perhaps someone with a more mechanical mind would be able to do something with it. Ask Barnar the Tinker.

Have you read my work on composite bows? I gave some to my ivory crafter associates. I can help you by carving pieces of horn to go into the bow's stave. If you are interested in crossbows, talk to my friend, Barnar the Tinker.
The horn of a Fire Auroch, eh? These beasts are impressive, but very slow, which makes them easy to kill. Here, I have carved the horn into a shape suitable for use in a composite bow.

It is a tragedy, what has befallen Ayan Baqur.  Luckily, Jaleh al-Thani and I were able to fight our way out of the town and escape.  I wonder what has become of the other townsfolk... Still, life goes on.  I can still carve horn to help you make a composite bow.
Pincer Danta turns the grub inside out and prepares a delicacy with practiced skill.
Want a grub bite? They're tasty and about all we get to eat. Okay, maybe not so tasty.
quest: I hope you're breaking lots of shell with that atlatl.
This should work.
Pincer Danta fashions an atlatl from the materials you gave her.
How many atlatls do you need? Thanks, I'll hold onto this in case mine breaks.
Hi, I'm Pincer Danta. Glad someone finally came to help us.  We got us a nice place here. Want to see my pincer collection? Every time the bugs come and try to take 'em back I get more.

I made a nice atlatl out of pincers. Seeing as how you're here fighting the bugs with us, if you get me a bug's stabbing claw I could carve it into an atlatl for you. Also need an Olthoi femur.  That's the top part of the leg, in case you don't know.  You been around Olthoi as much as us, you get to know a lot about 'em.  Femur and a stabbing claw, that's what I need.
Say, got any grub bites?
You found a femur, maybe you outsiders aren't so dumb after all. I'll need a stabbing claw too, like I said...
You found a stabbing claw. Maybe you outsiders aren't so dumb after all. I'll need a stabbing claw too, like I said...

greetings: Here you are.
This is the gem from the core of the Nexus Crystal, is it not? A worthy achievement, indeed. I will make you the greatest suit of armor in Dereth.
Though it shames me to admit so, this gem is beyond my talents. I will not tamper with it. There are some gem collectors outside of Uziz, however, who may be able to help.

Nuhmudira has finally restored us to full health!  She has also stocked us with some extra supplies that we needed, such that we can provide you with either a version of the original Shadow Armor, or its successor.  If you wish to trade one version of your Celdon set for another, simply hand it to me.  Please take out all Atlan stones from your armor before handing it to me.

Also, if you wish to color your new Greater Shadow Armor, you may buy a vat of color from my assistant.  If you do not like the color, please give me the armor piece and I will replace it with the standard piece, which you may then choose to recolor.
quest: A small gem. Hmph. Here is your lower-body armor. If you care to bring me another of these small gems, I can make upper armor as well.
Back for more, are you? Here is the upper-body armor to complete your lesser suit.
If you are so adept at slaying shadows and crystals, bring me a more powerful gem and stop bothering me with this detritus.
If you really must have another set of that inferior armor, however, give me this gem again and I will see what I can do.
A mediocre gem.  Take your reward. These leggings are of fair quality. I need another of those gems to make sleeves and a breastplate for you.
This gem allows me to complete the suit for you. Take it, and perhaps you can slay greater creatures and bring me a more powerful gem.
You have a complete suit already. Take this gem back.
A very powerful gem indeed. This is the strongest armor I am able to craft. Bring me another gem to receive upper-body armor as well.
Excellent. I can complete your suit of armor now. This is the most powerful armor I am able to craft.
I have made you the best armor I can make.
If you want another suit, give this gem back to me and I'll see what I can do.

greetings: My requests for assistance has been heard! I have been here keeping an eye on Tumerok movements ever since Ardry, Aleval, and I captured a band of Tumerok scouts. We interrogated them for their dealings with the Virindi, but all they told us was a story of a legendary spear weilded by one of their reknowned heroes...Little did we realize that their babble was but a smokescreen before they attem...

Ah, so there was something to their story after all...What an interesting find! But look here...Doesn't these slots along this side suggest it that it is missing a part? Perhaps the answer could be discovered out around the caves near the (landmark) to the (direction) where I last spotted the TumerokS gathering.

I have never seen an artifact such as this before...Some sort of Tumerok figurine? Ah...But it seems as if it is not in its entirety...Perhaps it should be married to another piece? If you bring me back the completed artifact, I will surely reward you!

A Tumerok War Taiaha!  One of the first examples of Tumerok war craft that we have found.  I must send this on to Aliester--he will be delighted to further his research on Tumerok culture.  I and the Society thank you!
Take care as you travel down this road to the south. The Tumeroks seem to be heightening their activities near Dryreach!
What... no... I don't... no.
My words... my words...
You have no idea... They... No idea...
They come... Soon... They come!
Your queen... Tell your queen...
They eat and eat... You cannot es... You...
They're everywhere! They're everywhere!
chatter: They eat and eat. They... their screams. Sir Bellas, their screams!
Eleonora. I will return... this message... Eleonora!
Where will they take... Sir Bellas, where...
It burns so much...
It burns!
%n doubles over and weeps uncontrollably.
%n looks around, as though expecting some vile foe to attack him at any second.

quest: It appears as though another grave robber has taken the bones that once rested within this sarcophagus.

You reach into the sarcophagus and begin to collect the bones of this woman. There are no adornments to her corpse. There is only a simple mosaic on the inside of the coffin. A sun, a star, a tree and what appears to be a world. The motif repeats along the entirety of the coffin. You get an ill feeling in the back of your mind and feel sick to your stomach. Your thoughts trail to the natural or...
The feeling passes, but the thought lingers in your mind for a long moment.
A sarcophagus. There seems to be nothing special about this.

greetings: What a foul creature. I have no interest in this!
What a nasty little thing! Enough with the show and tell, you can have it back now!
That's great! Now get it out of my face!
I'm not a collector of skulls! What kind of collector do you take me for?
Wonderful! Maybe I can make this into a drinking mug for you! Then again, maybe I'll just give it back to you and forget I ever saw it!
I have no need for a broken mask.
You probably want to give this to the Olthoi Hunter in Arwic. Perhaps she'll be able to do something with it.
You can't decorate your own?
Just find a carving or whittling knife and go at it!
Wha... that's HUGE! Where did you find that? Be careful when you carve or whittle that, it must be worth a fortune! Unfortunately, I don't buy produce.
Sorry, I'm not going to wear this around town!
There's no way I'm going to wear this!
I wonder if this would fool a banderling.
Thanks for sharing this with me.
Oh! Scary!
Not a bad looking mask.
Something about this mask creeps me out...
Ah yes, the Golden King. Exquisite! What a fine mask this is.
Hmmm, the Assassins Mask, I bet this is nice to have when the desert is restless.
Oh, the Ogre Mask. Somehow the crafter captured beauty in it's ugly features.
King Pwyll looks even more regal in this version of the mask.
You know, this mask is likely to keep people at a distance. No one likes to stand to close to an Assassin.
The mask of the Ogre Magi! I love this mask, but I keep mine locked up at night so I can sleep.
It's as if I'm looking upon King Pwyll himself! Amazing that Alexander could make this from memory.
The Shagar Zharala could have made this. It's a perfect recreation.
Ah!!! A monster!
Oh, hehe, just a mask of Koji's demon. It looks like it's watching me...
Hold on, I'm getting your money.
Keep those rat tails coming!
Another tan rat tail...
Tan rat tails make great boot laces.
Ah, one russet rat tail...
Here you go.
They say grey rat tails are good for the spleen.
Here's your money.
Brown, not bad. I'll get your money.
Here you are, don't forget I have higher rewards for black and red rat tails.
Oooo, this deserves more than a coin reward!
That's the Top Rat reward. I always need more black and red rat tails.
Red! Very good, you get the Top Rat reward for this!
Thanks, hmmm, I think I'll have sausages tonight.
I've been seeing a lot of these...
Next time, see if you can find a blue wasp wing.
Ah, a blue wasp wing!
Thanks, here's your reward.
You found one! I don't see many of these around here...
Here's your reward.
These are my favorite and they are hard to find.
Jingle jingle, eh?
Such a pretty looking wing!
More wings, more coin.
White like the snow. So beautiful, but so dangerous.
And I'll pay the same for more of these.
Let's see, Sandy Spine...
I buy all of the Armoredillo spines.
Spine, bronze... mhmm, here you go.
Find me some Island Spines if you can.
It's a trade then. Here are your potions.
May your magic never fail you friend.
Shore Spine, those are pretty good.
chatter: Have you a drudge charm, swamp stone, rat tail, or such? I'll pay you good money or items if you give them to me. They're hard to come by.
Did you know there are other people who collect other items, like gromnie teeth?  You might find them in some towns.  I'll take them, but I won't pay you for them!
Very rarely, you can get a perfect red phyntos wasp wing.  If you can give one to me, I'll pay you for it.  I will also pay you for the tails of rats.
I'm particularly interested in the spine of the sandy armoredillo.  Get that to me and I'll give you a health potion.  I'll also pay the same for swamp stones and the scalps of banderlings.
There are others who will reward differently for the same items I collect.  Not all types of monsters carry trophies, and of those variants that do, it's very rare.
Despite our disaster I am still accepting items. Have you a drudge charm, swamp stone, rat tail, or such? I'll pay you good money or items if you give them to me.
Did you know there are other people who collect other items, like gromnie teeth?  You might find them in towns that have not been destroyed!

I'm particularly interested in the spine of the sandy armoredillo.  I may be able to use that to make my own tent! Get that to me and I'll give you a health potion.  I'll also pay the same for swamp stones and the scalps of banderlings.

greetings: The fish plops into the water and slowly sinks to the bottom.
The Sluice Gate looks like a good place to release a fish.
quest: The fish splashes happily into the water. It seems a bit stunned, but after a few seconds it swims away.
The fish splashes happily into the water. It seems shaken, but swims away strongly.
The fish splashes happily into the water. It seems fine and swims away quickly.

greetings: Let's see what the Great Lady of Chance and Possibility has in store for you!
I am sorry, friend, but you must have red tokens at the high stakes table.
Not so fast, friend.  This token is only for use at Arshid's Den of Iniquity, in the Gharu'ndim lands.
Not so fast, friend.  This token is only for use at Monty's Den of Iniquity, in the Aluvian lands.
I am the high-stakes Gamesmaster.  Give me a red token and see what you win!
A Black Stone, so easily confused with a Black Rock. Let's see, Mana Potions for the stones.
Wonderful, I've been looking for more of these Black Rocks. Health Potions for the rocks I believe.
This is a very impressive rock!
A heart of mud.
Is it the golem's heart that animates them do you think?
A heart of water.
I am confounded by these solid pieces of water. They aren't cold like ice. Hmmm...
A heart of wood.
The most understandable and natural golem heart. Quite pretty too.
A heart of copper.
Living copper. Did you know golem hearts have hollow chambers much like our hearts.
A heart of granite.
Imagine what it would be like to have a heart of stone.
A heart of iron.
The materials these hearts are made of are purer than our blacksmiths can refine.
A heart of ice! How apt.
At least this one is cold.
A heart of obsidian.
These are among the most beautiful of the golem hearts. See how it shines when I polish it?
A heart of diamond.
The materials toughness seems to have a direct correlation to the golems toughness.
A heart of pure pyreal!
This is very valuable.
A heart of pure platinum!
A heart of... vapor.
These are even more mystifying than the Water Golem Hearts.
Spines are nice.
Thank you.
Spines are good.
Come again.
Spines are great!
Spines are wonderful!
Well, would you look at that? I can probably make a slightly better axe from this.
Oh wonderful, a new spine! Maybe I can .. No .. Well .. Hmm. I'll just hold onto it for now.
A fine quality horn.
May your future see good fortune.
I can resecure this to a haft.
And now you have a Basalt Axe instead.
And now you have an Obsidian Axe instead.
I am interested in armoredillo spines and golem hearts of all kinds.  If you give me one I will craft an item from it, or give you something else of value.
chatter: I can craft you an axe from an armoredillo spine.  Any spine will do.  I'll also return something for a wood or iron heart.
I don't have a use for gromnie teeth.  But I will reward you for auroch horns.
Spines and golem hearts are what I use.  Have any?

greetings: Thank you for the donation, go right in!

Hey, right this way for the Tusker Emporium of Deadly Doom!  Thrills. Chills. Spills!  Bask in the warmth of our volcanic tunnels. Marvel at the ancient, trap-filled Empyrean architecture. Run shrieking like a little girl from tuskers galore.
And please be sure to visit our fully stocked refreshment stand and souvenir gift shop.
Ah, yes, that's it, that's it!
Here, let me grant you the shortcut.  May your journeys be blessed with danger, just as Loredane's was.
Safety-weary traveler, seek you true danger from others like yourself?
Then I will give you a shortcut to that which you seek.  This is my service to those who wish to be free of Asheron's bonds.
Bring me the Broken Sigil from the dungeon to the south, and I will give you the shortcut you desire!
chatter: Hee hee hee!
They tried to wall off the portals.  Hee!
Freedom!  Freedom from safety!  The path of strife!
Hic!

greetings: I'm afraid I don't know what to do with this.
What should I do with a half drunk mug of cider that smells funny? How long was this in the sun? No thank you. I am not thirsty.
It's a mug, and there is a name scratched on the bottom. Maybe it belongs to that person.
This looks like the silk that I used to make a shirt for Jaleh al-Thani. Oh I remember it very well. He asked for a shirt made in a very ornate and overly pretentious way.

This was the first item that my master had me craft. When Jaleh came to collect it he pointed out a tiny flaw in my weaving and demanded the cost be lowered. It was, but so was my pay. I was very angry with him. Very angry with him.
I have heard that he is missing. Surely you don't think that I had anything to do with it. Please you must believe me. Look at my sollerets if you don't.
This clears a lot up. I had thought that the shirt was some of my best work. Now I know that it was.
I am truly sorry that Jaleh is dead. That is a tragedy.
My thanks for delivering this to me.
Oh my. This does look bad, but I swear. I've never been to the desert. I've spent most of my life just around this area, I'm a tailor, not a kidnapper.
You think back to the way the scene looked. The tracks left there were distinctly boots, not sollerets. Someone is trying to frame this poor girl.
You have to believe me.
Hello I am an apprentice of To-ping Ra. He is teaching me the venerable art of tailoring. I have seen a few setbacks in my studies recently but I am sure that my confidence will return.
Since Martine... left the simulacra that used to assist me in the armory have begun acting strange.
It's starting to become a chore to keep them in line. But so far so good. Hibdin is a good man, but the things down there don't listen to him the same.
Tai Wo examines the mould intensely.
Tai Wo crafts a fine replica of Thorsten's Axe.
You took a fine mould!  Here is an exacting replica of Thorsten Cragstone's Axe. Use it with care! I pray you do not come to the same end as he!
quest: A friend of mine in Baishi saw you speaking with that terrible woman, Lia Tze.  I cannot trust anyone who deals with her.  Go away!
Are you having trouble finding where Thorsten Cragstone's Armor is? Read the letter I gave you!

Good, I see Brontynn Marshad sent you.  Here is the letter I was going to give him. A learned colleague of mine who examined it believes this letter holds a clue to the location of Thorsten Cragstone's Axe.
Have you been sent by Brontynn Marshad or by Glysander Cartoth in Cragstone?  No, I see you have not. Go see Glysander Cartoth in Cragstone and he will tell you what he needs done.

greetings: I see that you have helped recover one of my mother's knives.  Thank you!  Just southwest of town is a dungeon that was once a small but diverse community of Aluvians and Gharu'ndim, before Al-Arqas was built.

You have helped Sarqah!  Thank you.  I have a key that is used in a dungeon just to the southwest of town.  It was once a small but active community of Gharu'ndim and Aluvians, before Al-Arqas was founded.

Wonderful!  I hear these were originally Empyrean drinks, from elsewhere in Dereth.  We had a number of oldtimer Aluvians here for a while, so perhaps one of them brought them.  I'd be delighted if there were more such liquids somewhere.
In any case, here is something that should be more useful to you.
Oh, how rare!  It's not as good as Distillery Ambrosia, but good nonetheless.
Amazing!  It's much better than Distillery Ambrosia.  Here is a reward for you.  Thank you for thinking of me.
Greetings.  I hope you enjoy your stay in Al-Arqas.
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Hey, looks like it got rolled in the mud... Anyway, well done!  Here, take these as a reward.
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Looks like good old F.P. went swimming or something.  Here's your reward.
Looks like you've lucked out!  Our man F.P. has finished his book, finally!  Here you go...

I have been contracted by the Dereth Exploration Society to help them in their outreach program towards the Isparians who find themselves newly exiled in Dereth.  Here is a book that explains their mission.  I am also giving you a list describing the locations of the nearest stamp and portals to other towns.  If you collect any of the Society's stamped letters, you may bring them back to me for...
By the way -- if you haven't yet done so, you might want to visit Sarqah bint Ak at the North Outpost, or Nurbaha bint Dah at the West Outpost. They often have tasks for young adventurers.
quest: You must stamp this with a Town Stamp to get a reward.  Please read your Book of Quests to find out how to get a Stamp.
No, this is for you to stamp the letters you find.  Please keep it.
Thank you, you must have journeyed far to get here.  You are a true Explorer!

You will get nothing from me for this. Go explore and find more towns.  The Society Agents in the Sho towns will exchange a piece of jewelry or a wand for this. If you take this to one of the Aluvian towns, you will receive a piece of armor.

greetings: Ah, a drink!  Hee, hee!
I know the secret walled portal path, and I will let you enter it. See?
Ah, What's this?
That wasn't too nice. I'd like some sake, please.
Hmm. This doesn't look like sake.
Doesn't taste like sake either!
This doesn't smell like sake...
If I wanted coffee I would have asked for it.
Apple Juice! You must be kidding!
Ale? Thanks! I'm real partial to sake though. *hiccup*!
Didn't you understand me? I want sake, not cider!
Hah! This isn't sake, you fool.
I'd thank you for this drink, but I asked for sake.
What's this? It doesn't look like sake.
Not Sake!? NOT Sake! YOU!!! I'll g...
Oh right, you must want to see Ulgrim. He said people might be looking for him. Ok, I'll portal you there this time, but next time you better bring me sake!
You probably didn't hear me. I want sake, not red wine.
What is this? Doesn't look like sake....
And it's broken!  Now leave me alone!
I forgot to tell you...I'm a vegetarian!
Oh! That was fun!
Entering damn portal-space!
Have you read the note on the pedestal?
If that is what you desire, then fetch me a good drink of sake, and I shall grant your wish.  Otherwise, leave this place.  Hee, hee!
chatter: Hee hee hee!
They tried to wall off the portals.  Hee!
Freedom!  Freedom from safety!  The path of strife!
Hic!

Through your efforts we have succeeded in defeating Gaerlan and holding the Harbinger at bay. But our fight is not yet done. We have earned this respite, and I truly hope that this time of peace continues to grow.

In the coming months I intend to see universities built so that future generations of our children born on this world can learn of the dangers that we faced and the sacrifices that were made to make this land ours.
Together with the Arcanum, headed now by Ciandra, we shall establish the first such university in the newly rebuilt town of Arwic.

There scholars will come not from just the races of Ispar but also from the Tumerok and Lugian settlements. We are a diverse people that over time may set aside our differences and come to exist peacefully.
The process will be slow and will not be without its difficulties but I believe that we can overcome anything that we shall face in the future.

Please join me now in honoring all of those that have been lost to us in the years that we have come to Dereth. Their company may have been taken from us, but their spirits and their acts shall live forever within our memories.

I wish to acknowledge the efforts of Sir Candeth Martine who through valor and a courage, that proved to be unshakable, knowingly sacrificed himself so that we could stand against Gaerlan.  Without his efforts the world we know here would still be covered in a blanket of elemental beings.

Nuhmudira, as she imprisoned Gaerlan, stated this best. This land is ours now. We have fought against great enemies and emerged victorious. We have met the challenges of Dereth and stood proud at each test.
My thanks, to the true heroes of Dereth!

greetings: Yes, I cut Virindi Jewels. Mind you I get to keep the rest of the stone for myself.
A bit of the stones magic seems to become active in the cut gems.
These strange jewels don't cut like a normal stone. It sounds crazy, but I feel like the stone almost guides my hand.
Excellent! I've been waiting for another of these jewels for my project.
These jewels cast colors I've never seen and can't begin to describe.
These yellow jewels somehow intensify light. If you find more, I will pay well for them.
I'm collecting gemstones to build a window that will transform sunlight into a beautiful show of color and light.
Funny thing, these Swamp Gems always feel somewhat slick.
I find it soothing to look into it's murky green center.
Most people don't appreciate the hidden beauty of these gems.
It's unpolished state belies it's lambent shine.
The reflections in this jewel are stunning.
I think I may cut this into gems for my mosaic.
The light flickers in it's facets like a black fire. Definitely magical.
I have just the place for this in my window.
Oh good, I'm running low on diamond powder.
I've been mixing it into glass to form a lustrous grout for my window.
This is truly an odd find. It is obviously the eye of a gromnie, but it seems to have solidified after the beast's death and turned into this gem.
Oh, I'm sorry, you'll be wanting something correct? Take this oculus. I've taken some samples of the jewel, the rest is yours.
I collect only the rarest of trophy jewels.   I will take gems that have been crafted by other trophy collectors and give you money for them.
But my true specialty lies in the jewels from the strange masked creatures.
chatter: I will give you money for certain trophy gems that you have, such as the swamp gem.
Have you, in your possession, the rare and unusual jewels of the strange masked creatures?  I shall craft them into something different for you.
I'm not interested in  normal gems or jewels.

greetings: Not bad. Not bad at all. You got connections kid. This will get me in real good.
%n snickers and looks you over.
I guess that means that I've got some singing to do. No problem. Grab a chair maybe.
%n pauses a long moment.

Gaerlan, yeah that was the guys name. Where he came from nobody knows but Martine came right close to turning him into slag after he got back from opening the portals to Marae Lassel. The only thing that allowed the guy to stay was that he groveled better than anyone I had ever seen grovel. Even better than Ketnan.

Anyway, this guy said that he had the ability to help Martine, so long as he kept him alive. Martine was wary at first. When I say wary I mean really wary. You see Martine was really trying to get himself back on the straight and narrow. Kind of like what he did for us and all. But he listened to the guy anyway. It went well. I guess. Martine allowed him to stay. Heck he even gave him his own r...
Where is it? Keep the goodies coming.
Hmm, nice trinket.
Okay so this Gaerlan guy, he starts "assisting" Martine with some of his endeavours, going with him out to blow up the arrival points around Dereth. See it went like this.

Martine told this guy about the fact that he had it in for Asheron. Mistake one, this guy was into that and used that to his advantage. See, this guy never looked at us as anything more than vermin. Really it's true. Once or twice I overheard him talking about how we had bred as quickly as the vermin that had come from our world.

I guess they brought them back after they visited us. Now this was something that was a little odd to hear, but I guess that a long time ago they used to go to different worlds and watch. Then the portals started opening to other places...I never pieced that together. But I know that this guy Gaerlan put the poison thoughts into Martine's head.

Martine had been getting better. He was less whimsical from time to time. More stable really. Then the poison started and the high-pitched voice came back. Then he set out to destroy the arrival points from Ispar.
Martine had no idea what was happening with that, but I know that this guy did. He even wrote about it I'd guess.
In his little diary. He carried it with him a lot. Sorry pal, no more until there is more payment.
Pulling out all the stops now aren't you.

Okay then. Martine went to those places where the portals dropped people from Dereth and together with Gaerlan they sealed them closed. No more people that went through the portals that lead there could get through.

Kind of makes you wonder, huh? At any rate the deed was done. Martine was happy, no content, you can never really say that he has been happy. I mean the guy did lose his wife and child and then his humanity. That has to be rough right?

So this Gaerlan guy starts riling him up and getting him to listen to his hatred, or the Virindi in him, whatever that is. Then Martine builds a son. I wouldn't say it if it wasn't true. He thought about it and it happened. Of course Gaerlan was there the entire time, assisting him in the creation of this thing. A Hollow Minion. I tell you, he called it son and embraced it. And sent it out onto...

He did that three times in all. Each time, they got a little tougher. But still Martine wasn't done. He set about a plan to kill the Queen. But then that was twisted. Gaerlan made sure of that. "The boy he said. The boy. You have a son now, Martine. You won't need two." Martine listened and lo, he set about to kill Borelean.
%n shakes his head.
That was just not like Martine. Just not like him. I'm sorry I can't talk about this anymore.
These won't help me much, but...

That should help you a little. See, I want these for a specific reason. They'd remind Martine of what the Virindi did to him. We don't want that happening to him ever again. By we I mean the majority of us here. All of us had problems. Some greater than others, but we did all have problems and Martine gave us something that none of us had, Hope.
In a sense he was our savior. He took us out of the darkest times that any of us had ever faced, brought us back from that brink and got us motivated to live again.

Not easy to do with a bunch of ne'er do wells. But he did it. We started working with him to build places that we could call our own. Do things that we could have pride in. We struggled it's true but in the end we were feeling better and things were looking up. Until Gaerlan came back. And then the voice returned.
%n lowers his eyes.
It was like watching your best friend disappear. He had beaten that thing back. It was gone, forever. But now it was back.
Nothing more I can say about that.
Nice one.

Settle in. So Martine set his sights on the kid. Vile. Out of character. Why did we stay you wonder? We're loyal to Martine. Loyal cause he saved us from something worse than any death could be. He saved us from despair.

What else could we do? We stayed with him. But this guy Gaerlan preyed on him more. He helped him with the Olthoi. He demonstrated some intense understanding about their bodies. Strong points, weak points. The best place to strike them to incapacitate but not kill them. Things that no one of us would have known. Where he got that knowledge I don't know.

He helped Martine where the Virindi failed. He made a hollow version of the Olthoi. Weaker. But damn they hit hard and there was no way to defend against them. Funny thing is Gaerlan would never go near them.
But he convinced Martine to invade the mainland of Dereth. That Elysa and Asheron were joined now, making war on his son. Trying to bring about Martine's destruction now.

And also about this time, Gaerlan started to gain more freedom, and he used it. We'd inform Martine but he didn't care. He was busy off on his own. Not until recently did we start to realize that he was visiting Elysa.
There's more, but we made a deal.
Hmm more trinkets. Good job.

Martine started getting a little more lucid around this time. Not a lot mind you, but with Gaerlan taking some time away from constant contact with Martine he started to act more normal. Though something had really changed within him and every night he would leave here to go visit Elysa.
He watched her from afar at first, then got closer and closer until recently he came back here and became very solemn. No silent.
He hasn't spoken in the longest time. Not since Gaerlan shunted him like a child. Not since he killed Asheron.
%n lowers his eyes and shakes his head.

Now, things are breaking down. We need him you see. Some of us still think that we can pull him around. Others think that we'd be best to foster his hate and tell him to finish the job. Still others...like me think he did the job. There is no hope left. Asheron is dead. And Martine has finally realized the truth.
%n looks you dead in the eye and speaks solemnly.
Asheron never meant harm to anyone. This world, the Olthoi, the pain. It was never him. It was never him...and now Martine has killed the brightest light that this world had.
I knew if I whispered long enough one of you outsiders would make your way over to me. The names Josef, and before you ask no there's no surname. Just Josef. Don't ask cause I ain't tellin'.
Now listen up, and listen up well cause i don't like taking to much time in repeating myself. It makes me waste precious air and that's not fun.
%n clears his throat and then drops his voice into a deep whisper.

A while back the boss, Martine, was planning on opening the way to Marae Lassel. A new home for people. Thing is there were people there already, like us but they grew up different. No big deal right? Well the thing is when he did his spell or whatever something else happened.

He finished his little trick and suddenly a portal storm hit the center of the living area here. Portal energy was whipping off the walls and down the corridors. Next thing we know there's a guy sitting in the middle of the room, naked as the day he was born and about eight, maybe nine feet tall.
He was real confused. Had no clue where he had come from or where he was, just his name. Gaerlan. And he said over and over again...is Asheron among you.
Now here's the rub. I know a lot more than that, but I need some help. So you help me...I help you. Take this.
quest: You should have already gotten your reward. Take this back and use it for yourself. You've already helped me out quite enough.
This is the best possible thing you could give me friend.
Martine likes these the most because it means that you not only killed one of their most powerful members, but you have also found a way to steal some of their treasures.
%n manages a weak smile.
Take this.
chatter: Psst!
Hey over here!
Yeah you, I'm talking to you!
Psst! Buddy!
C'mere friend I need to talk to you.
Over here.
Watcha lookin' around for? That was me that called you.
Hey you! Get over here a minute I need to talk to you.

greetings: We're under Attack!

You think, "She looked me over like a jeweler appraising a fine gem, sunstone maybe, or white sapphire. Whatever the look meant, it made me feel appreciated. I was pleased that I had figured out what the Dame wanted. I could see by the expression on her face I'd done well."
This is interesting. This man will certainly have information that we can use. Pretty swell work...
You think, " I felt proud, like an adventurer who killed his first drudge. I showed my pride by standing like a conquering hero."
You think, "She handed me two gifts..."

You think, "...a hat and a token. She said she'd take the token and give me a new title. Something like, gumshoe. I didn't ken what the Dame was saying, but the words felt pretty good. Praise is best served warm and meaningful."
It's broken...

You think, "No getting that past this Dame. She spotted the missing line and reel before I handed the broken pole over. I made some quick comment to her about finding it in the bandit hideout. Maybe it'd turn up a clue here or there. It was a lie. It felt like a lie, thinking quick I scratched my head..."
You think, "That threw her off, I don't believe it...it threw her off. Wait, why am I thinking this? Ooo, did she just say something funny..."
You think, "...drat, a second too late and now I look foolish, Hmmm...what to do?"
You think, "The Dame paused and then turned away a moment...I stopped acting like a jerk..."
You think, "Apparently she knew my ruse...still this was better than a useless fishing rod. She bowed..."

You think, "I bowed in response then headed out to join the festival celebrations. I wish that there was something I could do with this mask, this note and this scroll case. Something gnawed at my conscience, like a reedshark gnawing a shin bone, I didn't think that I'd found all there was to know. For now, I was content to enjoy the holiday cheer."
You think, "She started motioning..."
You think, "Next thing I knew she was calling me a Gumshoe."
Interesting, looks like they like to dress up... You too?

You think, "I didn't know if it was a question. It sounded more like a statement. I stood there, bewildered, like a mage waiting for his spell to kill a drudge, only to see the mana disappear into nowhere. She turned away from me as I shrugged."
quest: You think,  "As I approached, I noticed a hint of recognition on the Dame's face. I was here not that long ago, I'd have to wait a little longer. For now, I couldn't go on."
We need to know if there are any clues. Please...
You think, "There it was again. That slow grating tone. We need your help. Can't you help us? Of course I could. The question was - would I?"
The last spot we had heard about him was in a copse of trees, north of Nanto.
You must have seen the sign. Please sit down.
I'm so glad you came...

You think, "They were always glad. It meant that they no longer had to shoulder the weight of what they knew alone. Camaraderie came from such knowledge. She kept talking and I was having trouble listening."

You think, "My mind kept drifting away to other thoughts. She talked fast, like the buzzing of bees around the first flower in spring. I was doing my best to keep up with the conversation but...there was too much. After a moment or two, I didn't care anymore. I got comfortable..."

You think, "The Dame kept going, talking about some man. Maybe in green armor, with a green dagger or something like that; I didn't care anymore. Her voice was grating on my nerves, like cheese drawn over a cheese grater. I shifted and got really comfortable."
You think, "The Dame was worried. I felt like I should stand up, clear my throat, tell her everything would be fine. But that would mean she'd sob."
You think, "Too late. The buzzing sound of her voice gave way to delirious talk about assassination. I pretended to listen and leaned forward..."

You think, "Then it ceased. It was like opening a Singularity Chest to find three perfectly matched dual major armor pieces, each enhancing a skill I possessed. But like every dream, it ended. Reality smacked me in the jaw, like a Peerless Drudge catching me with my faceplate up. The droning pitch of her voice returned. I got comfortable and listened to the rest of the Dame's tale."
...and that's why I need you to help me.
You think, "I stood quickly. Better she thought I had heard everything that she had to say, rather than tell her the truth. I crossed my arms and gave her a stern look."
You think, "Before I could think, I said 'I'll do it.'"
You say, "I'll do it."
You think, "She gave me a clean towel..."
You think, "...a trade note for my trouble..."
You think, "...and a location..."
The last spot we knew he could be found was off the road in a copse of trees, north of Nanto.
You think, "I didn't have to ask what to expect there. Like I said before, Dames were always trouble. I was knee deep with this one."
Thank you, again.

You think, "The kiss was a nice touch. Though it left me with a sinking feeling. Like getting caught off your guard when the Hopeslayer asks you a question. Never peeve the 24 foot tall Lord of Darkness, you might find yourself falling from the top of the world and believe me, you can't see your house from there."
You think, "I weighed my choices and decided what I needed to do. The entrance to the place would be hidden amongst the trees, but I'd find a way in."
This looks like it could be something. I'll have it looked over. You've done well. You deserve a reward-

You think, "She was talking again, but her voice wasn't as annoying as before. There was a pleasurable quality to it now. I'd done good. The Dame was pleased and I knew that I'd be handsomely rewarded. Well earned in my book. She said something funny and we both laughed."
You think, "Then she handed me a gift..."
You think, "Not bad. I bowed..."

You think, "...and headed off to join the festival celebrations. I wish that there was something I could do with this broken fishing pole, the mask and this note. Something gnawed at my conscience, like a reedshark gnawing a shin bone, I didn't think that I'd found all there was to know. For now, I was content to enjoy the holiday cheer."

You think, "...and headed off to join the festival celebrations. I wish that there was something I could do with this broken fishing pole, this mask and this note. Something gnawed at my conscience, like a reedshark gnawing a shin bone, I didn't think that I'd found all there was to know. For now, I was content to enjoy the holiday cheer."
You think, "She turned back, holding a trinket. I tried to tell her no."
You think, "She'd hear nothing of it..."
You think, "She dropped the trinkent into my hands. A reward for a job well done."

You think, "Again, she blew me a kiss. This Dame was strange, it was just a note. Sure it might be a lead to solving a question about who tried to kill the High Queen, but then again it might lead to an interesting new recipe for chicken. I smiled either way, bowed..."

You Think, "...and headed out to join the festival celebrations. I wish that there was something I could do with this broken fishing pole and this scroll case. Something gnawed at my conscience, like a reedshark gnawing a shin bone, I didn't think that I'd found all there was to know. For now, I was content to enjoy the holiday cheer."
You think, "When she turned back she gave me the best gift of all."
You think, "She curtseyed as I stared at her in quiet disbelief. Of all the gifts the High Queen bestowed on me for this little task, this was the best."
Oh, and yes...you can dye it.
You think, "I bowed..."

You think, "...and headed out to join the festival celebrations. Something gnawed at my conscience, like a reedshark gnawing a shin bone, I didn't think that I'd found all there was to know. For now, I was content to enjoy the holiday cheer."
You think, "I curtseyed..."
Houston, we have a problem.

greetings: I have never before heard of a Drudge carrying paper! It is well known that they are far too feebleminded to understand the written word. Allow me to reward you for this fascinating discovery.
I wonder what this means? Give me a moment; I believe I may be able to translate it.

There you are. This is ... intriguing. I wish to study this more closely. In the meantime, I would like you to investigate the Mad Star more carefully. Search the nearby Crypt, if you would, and bring me anything you find.
What is this? Can this be the creature the drudges' note referred to?
Akyafi fishes a note from his pocket and reads it carefully.
No ... no ... I do not ... No, I do not know. I must study!
But thank you, friend.

If you are looking for more adventure, you might want to peruse the rumors that Jubal has at the bar. Or perhaps you should journey to Shoushi. I hear that there are many good people there who may need some help!
I am a humble scholar from Zaikhal. Of late, we have heard of the unusually large number of Drudges in the hills around the Yaraq Cove.

They seem to gather near the ruin of the Empyrean port on the far side of the cove, where the Mad Star flickers. Perhaps you could investigate, and bring me back something which would explain their presence?
I recently sent young Abmim to investigate, but he has not yet returned.
If you are having difficulty locating the Mad Star, you may buy directions from the barkeeper, Jubal. He's afraid of the Mad Star; ask him instead how to reach the Pillars of the Inner Sea.
quest: Lubziklan al-Luq was looking for this! Why don't you try taking it to him?
Hmmm? No, this isn't mine. Why don't you try asking Ma'yad about it?
Mara al-Luq is always talking about this type of thing. Why don't you show this to her?

greetings: My notes! My notes! What have you done to my notes?
Not only have you betrayed my trust, but you ruined my work! My great manuscript! Ahhh!
Begone! Get out of my sight! And never return! I will remember your infamy until the end of my days!
What's this? Tanami's Crossbow ... Oh! That clever young man in Ayan Baqur! Nice enough fellow, although perhaps not much of a scholar.
quest: What? What?! You were in my chest? And after I asked you specifically not to pry into my things?!
Well! I don't know how you were raised, but in my family we call that thieving! Get out! Get out of my house now! I won't have anything more to do with you!
It's you! Well, did you find my lost key? Come on, hand it over! Or ... wait ... did you already give it to me? Damn my frail old memory!
Well, hello there, stranger! What brings you to this forsaken corner of Osteth? I myself came for some peace and quiet!
Oh, no, I didn't mean it that way! You are welcome here! In fact, I could use your help ...
Ishaq sighs loudly.
I'm having some trouble remembering where I left the key to my storage chest. My memory isn't so good these days, I'm afraid. And all my notes are in that chest!
Until I find the key, I can't continue on my great work, Volume 12 of "The Peculiar Nature and Behavior of Derethian Fauna with Especial Emphasis on Cross-World Speciation".
Ishaq looks at you hopefully.

Tell you what! If you can find the key for me, I'll let you read my manuscript! How about that? ... No? ... Well, I understand - not everyone is a scholar, I suppose. Hmm ... I do have a nice mace I would be happy to give you. I don't have much use for it myself anymore.

Do we have a deal? Good! I believe I left the key in my cellar - you can find it behind my house. But please - don't go prying into my belongings. I am trusting you in my house; I trust that you will repay me with your good behavior.
chatter: Now where did I put that book ... ?
Did you know that the Phyntos Wasp is strictly matriarchal? Oh ... wait, that may have been Monougas. Or maybe Mites.  ... I can't quite remember.
Was it 'red sky at night, reedshark's delight'? Or 'black sky at night'? Black makes rather more sense, but ... I know I wrote it down somewhere.
There it is! The key to my storage chest! Thank you so much! Now I can continue my great work!

greetings: Please deliver this package to my brother, Suzuhara Sheshumi. You can find him at the Beach Fort at 76N, 49W.
A portal to the Beach Fort lies at the bottom of the the Pit, which is located at 23.4W, 64.3N.
Thank you for your help, my friend! My brother's health means all the world to me. I do not know what I would do without him.
Please accept this meager reward.
Hello, brave adventurer! I wonder if you might aid me in a small task.
My brother, Suzuhara Sheshumi, suffers from a dreadful ailment of the lungs. He used to reside with me in Stonehold, but has since retired to the Beach Fort.

I tried to take a Care Package to him, but lost it in a nearby dungeon. There is a portal to the Beach Fort at the bottom of the Pit. I was hoping to take that portal, but the Monougas there are much tougher than I remember. I am afraid the package is still there.
I fear I am not strong enough to re-enter the Pit. But perhaps you could do it! Go to the Pit at 64N, 23W. Find the package, then take it to my brother at the Beach Fort at 76N, 49W!
chatter: Excuse me, is anyone going to the Beach Fort?
Might someone be able to help me?

greetings: Oi, mush! Want ter do me a favor? It's tough ter get a decent drink around here, especially wiv the prices Gorth charges.
Fetch me a bottle of Olde Ispar Stout from Neydisa Castle, down the road to the west, and I'll put in a good word fer yer with MacDugal!
quest: Wot? Not enough? Well don' ye have the big britches! Here, then.
chatter: Right, thanks.  Ye're a toff.  Take this note to MacDugal and he'll treat yer right.  Now sod off and let me drink in peace!
Wotcha, mush. Keep this on the hush-hush, will yer? Here's somefin' fer yer troubles. Got 'em off some passing rogue in green armor. Shifty-eyed manker.

greetings: Lia Tze examines the mould intensely.
You took a fine mould!
Lia Tze crafts a fine replica of Thorsten's Armor.
Here is an exacting replica of Thorsten Cragstone's Armor. It will make a fine decoration!
quest: A friend of mine in Tou-Tou observed you speaking with that vile excuse of a man, Tai Wo.  I do not trust anyone who deals with him.  Be gone!
Are you having trouble finding where Thorsten Cragstone's Armor is? Read the letter I gave you!

Ah, yes, Brontynn Marshad sent you. Here is the letter I intended to give him. I came across it a long time ago, I remember not where. It seems to offer a clue to where Thorsten Cragstone's Armor was hidden.

If you seek it and find it, I doubt you can remove the armor. Nor should you. However, I have also given you a quantity of wax with which you may make a mould of the armor. Having some armorsmithing skills myself, I have a historical interest in the armor. Bring me the mould with the impression of the armor and I will give you a fine replica of the armor which will serve as an exquisite decorat...
Have you been sent by Brontynn Marshad, who is helping Glysander Cartoth in Cragstone?  No, I think you have not. Go see Glysander Cartoth in Cragstone and he will tell you what he needs done.

greetings: I'm here to Survey this land under the authority of the Arcanum.
I'm surveying this land for the Arcanum. Please move on, I have much to do.
chatter: The %n looks over the crater and makes a mark on his instrument.
The %n adjusts some metal rings on his device.
The %n sights along a line he has drawn in the dirt.

greetings: Ugh! I hate this stuff, but I have a friend who likes it. Maybe you should drop in on him.
Hmmm, I can't use a stamp... Oh! Very funny! Very funny! Get outta my house Mr. Funnyman!
What do you want me to do with this? Pick my teeth? Stop bothering me I have some serious drinking to do.
You find enough of this you might be able to have some tailor make a really fine shirt.
Hey. This is stolen property. I might swill my share of ale, but I'm not swilling my brew from Celcynd's mug.
I can drink five times my weight in stout!
You don't want me angry with you. Most of my punches tend to land below the belt.
I can't decide. Do you think I should decorate in Neo-Aluvian or Classic Sho?
I'm looking for a growth spell. If you find one let me know.
You know what they say. Small something or other, big something something.
Did you notice that everything seems to have gotten larger?
Small am I? I could drink you under the table!
No, not drink under the table! You rasell frassin! Get out of here!
People are always coming up to me "Oh, look how cute! A little Ulgrim!"
Gits!
One advantage to my size is that all my stout mugs are bigger!
You know it's good when you have to stop and breathe.
Great! You found my Home Brew!
Ahh!!! If that ain't the mothers milk to me! I've been saving that stout for a special occasion like this one.
What special occasion? Why my coming home party of course!
Let's see, I think I have a reward for you here.
Don't say I never gave you anything!
No thanks, I never get hangovers. You keep it.
Wah Chon's winter brew!
Ulgrim tips the stein and drains it in one long draught.
Gasp! Great Mattekar that's tasty! This inspires me to rhyme!
A larger lager lather is the taste I'd rather gather
when my lesser lager's suds are in the drink.
Then I mull the flavor over with it's hops and malts and clover
and again about the pub is what I think.
What's this?
Hey! This is half of that spell I wrote!
Good thing I was able to find the other half. Now let's see...
A little here...
A little there...
There good as new... almost. Wow, this is a really good spell. Let me just copy this down...
Ulgrim crouches and writes the spell on the back of his hand.
Here...
Aha! Another ring for my collection.
Of course I already found the only ring I'll ever need, but thanks.
Wait, This ring looks familiar.
This is MY RING!!!
You stoles it!!!
Get out of my house you nasty thief!!!
Hey, good stuff, thanks. Tough to find this around here. What? You're standing there looking at me with your mouth open. You expect me to say something special for this? I'm not a performing monkey!
Expect me to drink this eh?
Ulgrim drinks the mead quickly.
Bleh! Too sweet, I prefer something a bit... stouter.
Ale? I don't drink water unless I have to.
But, I might have to so I'll just hold onto this.
Ptooey!
Ulgrim pours out the water.
Ulgrim crosses his arms and mutters something under his breath.
Never touch the stuff.
I just figured it out!
It was so simple. Now we can all go home!
Oh, what's this then? Red? Well...I'll try any drink once.
Do you hear that?
Oh, hello! Were you saying something?
I'm feeling particularly good today for some reason.
chatter: Aw! None Left!
Ahem, I like my privacy when I can get it!
Rotten tourists.
You know, this isn't some vacation hotspot. This is my home!
Wipe your feet! Cleaning house takes time away from my life's endeavor.
Nothing you see here is for sale! Not even for...
How much did you say you had?
Hey, down here bozo!
I can't even see out the window!
This sucks!
Think they're so big! I'll show'em.
My boots don't fit anymore.

greetings: I see that you are stout enough to fight through wood golems.  Well, then, I have a task for you. Go to my Cellars and retrieve a bottle of Old Nectar for me.
It's an Empyrean drink that I collect.  I'll pay you for your services afterward.
Pay no attention to any rumors of swamp creatures deep within it.  That's absurd.
Ah, wonderful.  I can scarcely set foot in my own cellar these days.  A travesty.  What are they doing in Cragstone about this monster problem?  Nothing, I imagine.
Anyway, here is your reward.
I am Raxaza Folthid.  Unless you have business with me, I do not wish to speak with you.
Yes, you would be great for this task.  To the west of here is a crypt in which drudges have taken up residence.
Some drudges are known to carry charms, and I know there is usually one lying around in that crypt.  Please get it to me, and I shall help you out.
Hello.  I have a task that I am just too tired to do myself.  There is a crypt near here from which I would like an item.
quest: Thank you.  I turn these in to Collectors for a monetary reward.  But I will give you something better.
Here is a letter to take to Jilsaya bint Dah in Al-Arqas.
Thank you, but I have enough for now.  Why don't you check again tomorrow?

greetings: Ah, a delicate red with a translucent mottling...
Thank you, it's a beautiful wing.
Green as jade. I need a lot of these. Good thing they're common.
Good, blue is my favorite color.
Oooo, look at the colors!
This will make a great addition to my collection.
I don't know about you, but I enjoy collecting wasp wings.
This will be the prize of my collection!
I usually only deal with wasp wings, but these are simply too rare of a find to pass by!
I collect only phyntos wasp wings.  If you happen to have any, I'll pay you for them in pyreals.  If you get me a gold wasp wing, I will reward you with a little extra experience.
chatter: I collect only phyntos wasp wings.  I'll reward you well for any you happen to have.
Phyntos wasps are not my favorite creature, but I do admire the wings.
I'll reward you for any kind of phyntos wasp wing you can give me.

greetings: Ling Xiao over in Redspire has been rewarding well for these.  You ought to go talk to him.
He thinks I'm envious of his growing collection, but I'd much rather collect other things.
You might want to give this to Shalon--he's more interested in collecting these than I am.
The last time I saw him was in Greenspire. He may still be there, if you're lucky.
My new associate, Hea Riketura, has asked me to send more items like this his way. He's a nice chap--for a Tumerok.
Try looking for him in Ahurenga. Interesting place--I wouldn't want to live there myself.  Too many odd happenings going on all the time...

An interesting find!  I don't think I've ever seen one like this before.  I've heard that there is a Tumerok who will craft this into some kind of weapon over in their city...but I've never met the fellow.
Good luck.  Sorry I can't help you more.
Sorry, but I have no use for these.
Nope, I have no use for that item.
I have no use for these.
Feathers? Thanks, but I'm not a fletcher.
You can have them back--there must be someone else who wants them.
What a pretty bag! But I'm not not interested, thanks.
You can have this back--there must be someone else who wants them.
Feathers?  Thanks, but I'm not a fletcher.
Why, it's a sparkly!  But must I repeat myself?  I collect Carenzi Pouchling pelts, Marsh Siraluun claws, Drudge charms, and Mud Golem hearts.
I'm not a rock hound.
Thank you--these will look perfect in my trophy case. Allow me to reward you for your time and efforts.
There's more where that came from if you come across another.
I am gathering Carenzi Pouchling Pelts, Marsh Siraluun claws, Drudge charms, and Mud Golem Hearts. If you bring me one of these items, I will surely reward you.
chatter: Have you seen those beautiful birds around the island? I'm collecting their claws, but only those of a certain kind.
If you come across any trophies on the island, I would certainly be interested in rewarding you for some of them.
When I first came to the island, I wasn't sure how I was going to make a living.  But now I'm trading in island trophies--they don't see many like these on the mainland.
I'll reward you for Carenzi pelts, Siraluun claws, Drudge charms, and Golem hearts--but only specific kinds.

greetings: You found one of my father's axes! Oh, thank you so much! You know, he was going to make me an axe of my own, as soon as I was big enough to hold one ...
I'm sorry ... I just miss him still ...
No, no, I'm okay ... Allow me to reward you. It's the least I can do, really.

What's this? A letter from my father to my mother? ... oh! And he wrote it in the Redoubt, as he was waiting for the end to come. This is ... I cannot speak ... It is so kind of you, to return this to me.  To read his last words ...
No, no, I'll be alright. It just overwhelms me sometimes, how much I miss him. I must reward you for this.
You have been so kind to bring me this remembrance of my father, perhaps you can help my friend Alfrin, just over there by Worcer.
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Hey, looks like it got rolled in the mud... Anyway, well done!  Here, take these as a reward.
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Looks like good old F.P. went swimming or something.  Here's your reward.
Looks like you've lucked out!  Our man F.P. has finished his book, finally!  Here you go...
Greetings! Welcome to Holtburg! I am the local representative of the Explorer Society. My job is to help new arrivals in Dereth get settled in and learn their way around.
If you have just arrived in Dereth, you should talk to my friend Worcer. He is looking for some help with an errand. He's a good man - if you help him out, he will help you out.
Or you can peruse the rumors at the bar. Wilomine always knows something that needs doing.
quest: My father, Brogord, was a mighty man. He crafted his own great axe to fell timber. Alas, he was slain at the old Redoubt when I was just a babe in swaddling.

This letter speaks highly of you. If you can bring me some remembrance of my father, you will have whatever reward I can offer you. Rumor has it that his axe has come to rest in the Cave of Alabree. Wilomine, at the bar, has directions to that fell place.
I believe that Worcer was looking for this! Why don't you try taking it to him?
I believe that Alfrin was looking for this! Why don't you try taking it to him?
Ahha! Thank you for bringing this to me!

I have been contracted by the Dereth Exploration Society to help them in their outreach program towards the Isparians who find themselves newly exiled in Dereth.  Here is a book that explains their mission.
I will also give you a list describing the locations of the nearest stamp and portals to other towns.  If you collect any of the Society's stamped letters, you may bring them back to me for a reward.
Thank you, you must have journeyed far to get here.  You are a true Explorer!

You will get nothing from me for this. Go explore and find more towns.  The Society Agents in the Gharun'dim towns will exchange a piece of armor for this. If you take this to one of the Sho towns, you will receive a weapon.

greetings: Thank you for the Auroch horn. Let's see you must be tired from all that hunting, take these.
My reward for a Fire Auroch Horns is better.
A Fire Auroch Horn! Thank you for bringing this to me. You look a little singed...
Take those with you in case you get horribly burned.
Thank you for the Mattekar horn. You have to be careful hunting those big ones. Here take this batch of potions I just made.
I can also use auroch horns if you find them.
There you go!  A nice supply of Sunflower oil.
Nasty stuff, but it is essential to my research.
It's also very good for cleaning the horns I use in my potions. Please bring me more if you can.
I'm still testing this acid's corrosive properties for alchemical uses. It's a good way to get rid of useless items though.
Oh, a strange substance. The label claims it is the soul of a virindi...
Well, I don't know a way of bottling a soul, but I will be very interested to find out what this substance is.
What an amazing potion! So spicy!
This will go wonderfully in my new concoction. Thank you.
Lilly sniffs at the infusion carefully.
Whew! Better be careful with this one.
Egad! What a disgusting mess! I'll just destroy this right now!
I use Auroch horns in the making of my potions. I discovered how to use Mattekar horns to produce health elixirs and Sunflowers to make Sunflower oil.
If you give me a horn, I'll give you some of my potion in return. If you give me a Sunflower I'll give you some Sunflower oil.
The stout pours right through poor Ulgrim.
Maybe I can drink something lighter.
The mugs hard to hold. Ok, I think I have it.
The stout spills all over the floor where Ulgrim stands.
I wish I could taste it.
Just nod if you can see me.
Good, I thought I'd faded out all together.
I could really use a drink.
I remember trying to lifestone tie somewhere and then boom, everything went dark.
Something must have gone wrong. I'm not quite here.
I - I can see things... horrible things. They're everywhere. Swimming around and through everything like it's not there.
I don't think they've noticed me... You have to figure out what happened. Go to Dryreach where I tried to lifestone and see if there are any clues.
Hurry!
quest: Thanks, have you found out anything?
Have you even been to Dryreach? Look, I don't have much time left. You have to help me!
What about that splinter I gave you? I think it's part of the wand I used to cast my lifestone tie. That could be important.
Oh, thank you!
I don't know how much more of this I can handle. You have to help me.
Here, take this, it's the only thing I have that seems to still be solid. Maybe it has something to do with what happened to me.
Please hurry, those things seem to be looking for me. They're getting closer!
Ulgrim seems to be yelling something, but you only hear a faint whisper.
The floor feels like sand almost.
I almost fell through a little while ago. I'm afraid to think where I might end up if that happens.
Ah, I could taste that one.
I just want you to know that I'm thankful for everything you've done.
Whatever happens, it wasn't your fault.
Not long now.
They... can definitely see something.
It's when they brush against me that I want to scream.
My friends seem to like you.
Gah! Oh nooooo. Please, no!
It's...
Ulgrim's voice fades out, but his face is contorted in a crazed scream.

greetings: I'm sure you can do better than a white rat tail. Next time, try finding something a little less common.
Not my favorite kind of rat tail, but still worth something for your trouble.
Mmm, I hear these russet rat tails are good eaten.
You have to cook them just right of course.
Well, this is better than those common white rat tails...
A lucky find indeed. Thanks for bringing this to me!
Good. Someone finally brought me a black rat tail. It looks damaged, but I suppose it's worth something.
Not everyone is lucky enough to find one of these, and I'm grateful you brought it to me first!
Amazing! Judging by the size of this tail I would say the rat was unusually large.
You've earned this reward my friend.
Once upon a time, Dereth was nearly overrun with rats.  But through the efforts of many people, most of the rats have been eradicated.
They can be hard to kill because one must aim low to hit them.  I will take any rat tail trophies you find, but rats are much rarer now.
I do know of a small lair of rats southwest of the waterfalls.  Do not go if you hate rats.
%n turns the item over in his hands, scrutinizing the metal.
Hmm ... It looks to be intact. Those filthy snakebeasts did not harm this one, it appears. That means it can still be imbued.
As %n speaks words that sound like gibberish, the metal of the necklace glows softly and then returns to normal.
Well then, I suppose that I should explain what you are to do with this item, eh? Hrmph.
%n leans over his table and picks up a book.
The most important thing to understand about this item is that it is yours. You make it, you wear it. And once you've made it, you can't change it -- you'll have to make another one.

This one seems to be of the lowest quality -- when you imbue it, it will only hold lesser spells. I assume that you were unable to enter the more dangerous areas of the storehouse. Well, for now you may as well imbue this one.
You have been into the hive of sclavus then, and lived to tell the tale. Excellent work.
%n examines the metal ring and smiles as if very pleased.
Here, you will need this guide.

Now, you must be know that once you make one of these things, you can't change it. That means that you should think long and hard on what you would like to create for yourself. This book will explain the process in greater detail.
%n looks at the gorget and tears well in his eyes.
She has done so much to help us. This is the most minor of her efforts. Here, this was made for one such as you in the first place.
You may only alter this item once each month, so take care and make the correct decision for you. You will need this as well.

This will impart to you the details that are necessary in the crafting of your new gift. Remember well what you have done to earn this gift. She was ... is vigilant in her protection of us, fellow. Remember that.
This is an odd base. Nothing like the other dais I have seen. Nicely detailed, but very light. You say that Fanzen San believes it is hollow? Hmm...

After a brief examination of it, I do believe that it is indeed hollow. Here, take this Etheric Seal and use it to open the Dais. I can't imagine what might be inside, so please be careful when you open it.
quest: %n looks you over with disgust.
No, I do not think I will speak with you.
%n surveys you with the scrutiny of a jeweler appraising a fine gem.
I see that you are an adventurer of sorts. I find most adventurers to be fools. But ... you have helped Nuhmudira. That makes you a noble fool, at least.
%n sighs.
If you assisted Balthazar and you obtained a necklace or gorget of sorts, then be quick -- hand it to me.

If you have not, perhaps you had best go see if Balthazar and the High Queen's Royal Guard need your help in getting the job done in Lin. Though I wouldn't put much faith in the woman, or anyone loyal to her. Don't look so surprised -- not everyone follows the High Queen blindly. I think that our recent contact with Asheron is an affront to Nuhmudira.
%n raises an eyebrow and studies you grimly.
No ... I do not believe the lies that are spread about Nuhmudira. But you are welcome to your own opinion.
I am a very busy man. If you have no dealings with me or messages from the High Queen's man in Lin, Balthazar, please leave me be.

greetings: So. You are a competent warrior. You may be strong enough to suit my purposes. My father resides in the Mountain Fortress, well south of Qalaba'r. I am... concerned for his well-being.
Please bring this letter to him. If you bring me back a letter from him, I will reward you. You will also need this key to reach him.  Do not go to find him if you fear the darkness.
Thank you. This is what I needed to know.
Take this as my thanks. It was given to me by a master assassin dressed in green armor. Please... leave me now. I have much to think on.
I have slain others for speaking to me without a proper introduction.

Welcome to the Aluvian branch of the Bestowers' Guild.  We have chartered ourselves to bestow titles upon worthy applicants.  My assistant Caranis sells instructions and skill puzzle pieces.  On the other side of the room, you can find the base piece for the skill puzzle.  But you may only attempt the test once per day, and you may only hold one title at a time.
chatter: What is in a name other than the significance we give it?

greetings: Greetings to you, kind sir.  My name is Zenzaburou Hensu, and I am the leader of Kryst.
Can you tell us what happened to the Olthoi?  I noticed that many of you newcomers seem more concerned about strange floating crystals...
The Mosswarts seem to be fighting each other.  It is certainly odd, but I know good fortune when I see it.

It heartens me to hear the Olthoi have been dispatched.  Now, can you tell me who Elyssa Strathelar is?  And who this mysterious mage is that helped her?  If he was so powerful, why did he not tell her about Kryst's existence?
Welcome to Kryst.  Beware the Jungles, for they are dangerous.
These islands were named after one of my dear friends.  He gave his life to ensure we all reached safety.  He will never be forgotten.
There are dark secrets in the heart of the jungle.  Consider yourself forewarned.
Thanks for the green taper
awarding 1000 xp via the AwardXp emote!

greetings: Thank you, I'm conducting some experiments on motes. Are you working on the formulas for the new spells? How many tapers are you using? You may not need as many as you think...
Thank you, this will be useful. Are you researching those new War Magic spells? Have you tried replacing a taper with a scarab?
Thank you. In my travels, a powerful mage told me how to rid oneself of unwanted enchantments. Unfortunately, in the process the caster is also stripped of his beneficial spells.
Thank you. I've received some new information that's allowing me to brew potions to counteract enchantments placed upon the imbiber.
A sliver of pyreal, excellent.  If you're interested in learning the new War Magic spells, I know they use the talisman of old. I just forget which property of the spell that affects...
A pyreal sliver, how generous of you! While researching the new War Magic spells, I found the herb used in the slow moving wall spells has its ties in the realms of portal magic.
A sliver? I can certainly use this! As far as I can tell, the herb used in the ring spells is used nowhere else.
Excellent, a sliver! Thankfully, I did not need to smelt any new alchemical substances to determine the elements of the new War Magic spells.
A fine sliver! There are new counter-magics being found! The current research indicates that to use these spells, the counter spell must be a full order above the unwanted spell.
An excellent piece of pyreal! Thank you. I've been thinking a great deal about these 'dispels' and how they relate to the newly discovered war magics.
I'm not sure, but I don't think the dispels are using only diamond scarabs.
It's a tiny one... but it's definitely a sliver of pyreal. I think I've finally realized what's happening with the new anti-magic spells.
They use two scarabs, the first is used to focus the spell down to the power of the unwanted spells and the second is a powerful scarab used to amass the energies for the countereffects.
Ooh, a fine sliver, indeed. It's become obvious in my research that I need to lean on the negative properties of the components.
Apparently whomever discovered these spells thought that getting rid of enchantments was a bad thing.

Ahh, a nugget of pyreal! Thank you. As a sign of gratitude, take these scarabs. I no longer need many since I've researched the new spells and they seem to burn far less once I was actually able to cast the spells.

Ooh, I always forget how heavy an entire bar is. Thank you. With all of my spell research done, I've taken to writing down the formulas on scrolls. Here, take this scroll, I hope you can learn from it.

I see that K'rank is still interested in keeping our deal running. Well, tell him that I am still willing to uphold my end of the bargain. Not long ago, I even saw the blood witch talking to Olcris, making sure that he was well taken care of I assume. She makes me uneasy when she is around. Oh, there's more, but that is left for Captain K'rank to report on.
I'll be looking forward to the next delivery.
I trade in rare metals and information. I am only interested in motes from golems and the new ore the Lugians have been mining.
If you bring me motes, slivers, nuggets and bars of pyreal, I will share some of my knowledge with you.
quest: Ah, a piece of that new ore. I'll wager you had to dodge a lot of Lugians to get this! Let me purify it for you. Good luck finding someone to smith it, though.
This is that chorizite, then, is it? Peculiar stuff... The medium grade you have here is too brittle to forge, but it does break up easily.
This is the very purest grade of chorizite. You must be formidable to have survived in the mines of the Lugians. I don't know of any smiths with a forge hot enough to shape it, though.
I'm sorry, I really don't have the supplies to purify metals for you right now. Please come back later, as I hope to be getting more in soon.

greetings: Thanks, but I am not in the market for these. Merlonna might still be interested in them--you should take this to her.
She might still be in Bluespire, if she hasn't already moved on.
Sorry, but I have a very specialized collection. This just won't do.
Ling Xiao doesn't quite share my aesthetics.  Take this to him--he might like it.
I'm not interested in collecting these.  But I've heard there is a collector over in that Tumerok town, Ahurenga.  You might want to try over there...although I wouldn't if I were you.
It's much safer here in the Spires.
Something gives me a really funny feeling about this pendant...
I don't want it. Try taking it to Ahurenga.
Aha!  I met a Tumerok crafter who will make this into a weapon for you.  Hea Ihipura's his name. Strange ideas about nature, but nonetheless he seemed alright.
Try taking this to him.
This looks mothbitten.
No thanks.
I'm not in the market for these right now.
Disgusting!  I hate bugs!.
Get it off me!
I asked for claws, not feathers!
What happened to the rest of the bird?
Why are you giving me this empty bag?
I already have plenty of bags, thanks.
Where's the rest of the bird?
I have no idea what I would do with all of these feathers.
I'm not in the market for trophy jewels at this time.  I'm sure there's someone else on the island who is.
Good luck in finding someone.
Just what I was looking for! Half a moment, I will get your reward.
Just what I was looking for!  Half a moment, while I get your reward.
Thank you.
I am looking for Carenzi Burrower pelts, Littoral Siraluun claws, Drudge charms, and Sand Golem hearts. I will pay highly for them!
chatter: There are many fascinating creatures on the island that I have never seen before.  I am rewarding handsomely for certain trophies.
We're a tightly knit community here on the island.  If you bring me something that I'm not interested in, I can probably tell you who is.
I've never been happier since I came to the island and started collecting here.  Soon my collection will be the envy of all!
I'll reward you for Carenzi pelts, Siraluun claws, Drudge charms, and Golem hearts--but only specific kinds.

greetings: Greetings. I assume my fellow student sent you to obtain Daichroic crystals.  If you are pure of heart and strong of bone you should be successful in navigating the perils beyond this portal.

Adroth spits blood and teeth upon the ground, and grins a gap-toothed, bloodstained smile at %s. "If yer not carrying a full pack of vitae, yer not a real man. Roight then. I'll be back for you, bub. Ye'll get yers soon enough." The wicked gleam in his eyes fades as his spirit is whisked away to the lifestone.
You hear the clanking of heavy boots nearby.
Adroth's boots clank loudly as he lunges at %s!
Adroth grins down at %s's corpse. "Kiss them boots while yer down there, kid."

Adroth spits on the ground as he sizes up %s. "Dunno how yeh found us, mate. Seems like the longer we all stay in this world, the more we get a sixth sense for danger, eh? Anyway. Time to pay yer toll."
Adroth spits on the ground as he sizes up %s. "Roight. Stand and deliver."
"C'mon yeh dumb bastards, fight like a team!" Adroth bellows over the clash of battle.
Oh, another letter from Ji-Ra?  My thanks.  If you find the Water Temple on the mountain to the west and retrieve the Water Bottle, I will repay you.
Ah, I do take those.  Inuo-Kon must have sent you.
Wonderful.  Here is a reward for your efforts.
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Hey, looks like it got rolled in the mud... Anyway, well done!  Here, take these as a reward.
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Looks like good old F.P. went swimming or something.  Here's your reward.
Looks like you've lucked out!  Our man F.P. has finished his book, finally!  Here you go...

I have been contracted by the Dereth Exploration Society to help them in their outreach program towards the Isparians who find themselves newly exiled in Dereth.  Here is a book that explains their mission.  I am also giving you a list describing the locations of the nearest stamp and portals to other towns.  If you collect any of the Society's stamped letters, you may bring them back to me for...
By the way -- if you haven't yet done so, you might want to visit Ji Ra Ping at the North Outpost, or Inuo KonKou at the East Outpost. They often have tasks for young adventurers.
quest: You must stamp this with a Town Stamp to get a reward.  Please read your Book of Quests to find out how to get a Stamp.
No, this is for you to stamp the letters you find.  Please keep it.
Thank you, you must have journeyed far to get here.  You are a true Explorer!
