You will get nothing from me for this. Go explore and find more towns.  The Society Agents in the Gharun'dim towns will exchange a piece of jewelry or a wand for this. If you take this to one of the Aluvian towns, you will receive a weapon.

greetings: Oh, thank you most sincerely. I have been quite distraught over its loss but have been unable to retrieve it myself. Take this moonstone as a token of my gratitude.

Perhaps you can assist me. I am known as Miyako, the poet. I left a precious volume of my poetry in some pretty tunnels east of here when I was searching for inspiration. Were you to return the poems to me, I would reward you.

quest: You know where Eastham is, right? Please go find Brontynn Marshad's cottage south of there and see if he left any letters in his chest. He said his cottage was between the beach and the road.
You gave me that one recently. Is this a copy? It is worthless to me, I will dispose of it.
You gave me that one recently and it broke my heart. Is this a copy? It is worthless to me, I will dispose of it!

Hello, I hope that you are here to help me!  My name is Glysander Cartoth.  I seek to recover a series of letters that Elysa Strathelar wrote to my older sister, Lania Cartoth.  They were friends from childhood on Ispar and they corresponded for some time here in Dereth.  One day my sister disappeared.  I believe the letters may hold a clue to her disappearance.  I will reward you with Experien...

There is a man, Brontynn Marshad, who promised to try to track down the letters but I have not heard from him in some time. He was staying in a cottage south of Eastham, near the beach. There is a chest in the cottage inside which he said he would leave letters for me to pick up periodically. I give you the key to the chest, for I am unable to make this journey. Please see if there are letters...
Thank you, that is one of the letters! Here is your reward.
Oh Lania, why did you have to go there!
Thank you for bringing me the letter. Here is your reward. Please leave me to my sorrow.
I am sorry, I believe you are not powerful enough to help me.  Please come back when you have reached Level Twenty.

greetings: The Hopeslayer has been destroyed, but you may wish to visit his lair nonetheless.  This gem will bring you there.

This item is not yet complete, nor is it needed any longer. The Hopeslayer has been defeated. If you wish, you may still bring me an assembled Dark Crucible to gain access to the Lair of the Hopeslayer.
You were one of the worthies who helped defeat the Hopeslayer. Please, take this casting staff, imbued with the gem's essence. I and my lord Asheron thank you, Lightbringer.

My lord conveys his gratitude for the efforts of your people. If you are one of the champions who took part in the defeat of Bael'Zharon, I can take your Soul Crystal Gem and give you a spellcasting staff to commemorate your achievement.
You were one of the worthies who helped defeat the Hopeslayer. Please, take this helm, imbued with the gem's essence. I and my lord Asheron thank you, Lightbringer.

My lord conveys his gratitude for the efforts of your people. If you are one of the champions who took part in the defeat of Bael'Zharon, I can take your Soul Crystal Gem and give you a helmet to commemorate your achievement.
With this my lord Asheron may work the ritual to weaken the Hopeslayer. Take this, Isparian, and bring strong companions. The Hopeslayer will not fall easily. Go with the light.
This item is not yet complete. You must combine the three artifacts or they are useless to my lord.
Greetings, Isparian. My lord Asheron requests the cooperation of your people. Take this.
I think I'de like something to drink. Do you think I should drink something? Maybe I shouldn't... how this whole mess got started... never learn.
I should go back, but I don't want to. If I go back I might not get to go anywhere. What'll I do?
quest: I already gave you what you were looking for.
I did... didn't I?
Ummm, thanks for the drink.
I think you should have this.
Yes, I agree.
Wait, no I don't.
On second thought.
Well, maybe.
Should I stay or should I go?
Thanks.
What would you do if you were a duplicate of someone else?
Really? But...
Where would I get a pair of oven mitts that large?
You go and talk to him. He's in Dryreach. Tell him that I'm sorry and I'm not coming back.
Well, maybe I will, but not right away... probably.
Don't tell him where I am.
You shouldn't never not remove those labels from mattresses. I don't... wait, yes I do.

greetings: Let's see what the Great Lady of Chance and Possibility has in store for you!
You should try this at a lower stakes table, my friend.
This is beyond my responsibility.  Try this at the high stakes table.
Not so fast, friend.  This token is only for use at Arshid's Den of Iniquity, in the Gharu'ndim lands.
Not so fast, friend.  This token is only for use at Monty's Den of Iniquity, in the Aluvian lands.
I am the mid-stakes Gamesmaster.  Give me a blue token and see what you win!
Greetings. If you are a newcomer, I have a small task for you. If you succeed, I shall reward you.
Nearby, just to the east and in a stand of trees, is a small cave infested with drudges. They've stolen my favorite bracelet. If you recover it for me, I'll give you a reward.
chatter: Wonderful! As a reward, Scholar Dai Ya in town might be interested in this piece of writing.

greetings: I used to heal... but I cannot awaken...
Welcome to our humble castle.  I am Gormling, Lady Tallial's seneschal.  Take care not to cause too much trouble around here, hm?
quest: Mmmm, delicious drink... Here, you're a good chappie.  Take this note over to the Bandit Castle for me, will you?  Give it to Jourgensson.  He'll make it worth your while.
Oh, I've had quite enough, thanks...You go ahead and drink, though.
chatter: Yes, fool, I gave this to you.  Now deliver it to Jourgensson, please!  And tell no one of this!

greetings: Teeth and bones, teeth and bones...
Very good, you may keep your dagger. A lady near Zaikhal named Devana bint Hamudi is looking for skilled hunters.
Give this to her.
Nasty for you, if they catch you on one of these, eh?
There you are, a bit of a reward and I've made a nice spear from the horn.
Fire Auroch horns are beyond my skill, but I can trade for them. Here, take this reward.
I've heard about some master bowyer named Yuan Hanzu who makes these into bows.
Hmmm, yes, I'll take this horn. I may just trade this for something I can use. Here's your reward.
I think Yuan Hanzu, the Sho master bowyer, makes great bows from these horns.
Well, this tooth is neither that of a gromnie, nor an auroch. I used to avoid trading for these, but I've learned they have offensive properties.
As you can see, this mace will now do some nasty piercing damage.
Ah, one of the smaller Niffis shells. With a special technique I have devised I can flatten and reform these.
Here, I made this shield yesterday. That's sure to make quite a statement on the battlefield.
Hehe, the shell almost looks like a helmet now. With just a little work...
There you are! A beautiful Niffis Shell Helm.
Oh, what a beautiful niffis orb! You deserve a reward worthy of this find.
Don't hesitate to bring me more of these opalescent marvels.
These teeth are light and will fly well. They just won't do as much damage as some of your higher end spiketails.
These teeth are light and will fly well. They just won't do as much damage as some of your higher end atlatl darts.
You might get more if you put this under your pillow, haha!
Jade tooth eh? These are just the right weight for bolt heads.
Enjoy!
Swamp Gromnie teeth are exceptionally sharp. Ow! See what I mean?
Be careful with those.
This reminds me, A lady near Zaikhal is looking for hunters.
Here is your reward. If you wish to know more, hand the dagger back to me as a sign of trust.
It has taken me a few years, but I have finally figured out a use for Sable Gromnie teeth.
It has taken me a few years, but I have finally figured out a use for Ebon Gromnie teeth.
The Brass Gromnie only recently appeared on Marae Lassel. Had I not been inspired to craft, I wouldn't have even thought of making this out of Brass Gromnie teeth!
The Copper Gromnie only recently appear on Marae Lassel. Had I not been inspired to craft, I wouldn't have even thought of making this out of Copper Gromnie teeth!
I hope you don't think me macabre for collecting these.
I will give a greater reward for more unique skeleton skulls.
This skull is very unique, it will be extremely useful to me.
Thank you for bringing me this treasure.
Yes, I have found a use for these. I'll have to cleanse the skull first of course. Yech!!
I know of a sage somewhere in the southern mountain range that also collects these.
Tibia from a grievver if I am not mistaken. Interesting bone structure.
Thank you, bring me more of these and you will receive the same reward.
A Tusker Slave tusk. You can't use these on the Island of the Tuskers. It's a good thing you came to me.
These tusks are exceptionally useful since they are hollow.
Well Done! I expect the Lich didn't give this willingly.
Please convince more Liches to part with their bones.
A thighbone... hmmm, not a Dark Revenant, but I can still use it.
Bring me a Dark Revenant thighbone I will reward you fivefold.
Aha! A Dark Revenant thighbone, quite exceptional!
A fine reward for your formidable deed.
Hard to imagine that they used this as body ornamentation. Thankfully, we can use these as an augmentation of sorts.
This is a nice find. I have a friend that would like this. Thank you, and here is your reward.
With a little carving, and a little work with the top of the bone here... There we go, a rather dastardly looking dirk, don't you think?
Oh I agree... It isn't really enough, so take this too.
Hmm, if we stretch this a little here and disjoint the jaw. We can twist this little bit and then, excellent! Wear this with pride.
Since the helmet doesn't really offer much protection, I think a little monetary reward is in order as well.

Well. This is a little fleshy. Of course we can pull this, oh blech, what was that? Well whatever it was, this poor sod won't need it. Oh and the smell, well, let's just add a little touch of sunflower oil. Much better.
Here you go.
A grim looking shell. The Niffis are never this dark. Well I'll see what I can craft from it.
Odd, there seems to be magic within the shell that was left within when I finished the shield. You might be able to affix a symbol if you center on this shield.
A mite! This large? You're pulling my leg...
Let's see what I can do with this. Shave a little off here and here and...Well that is odd. I seem to have loosed some hidden qualities within the bones.
Good luck with this.
These fangs are very sharp. Pried them from a carenzi you say. Well, I think that I can get them into some useful form.
quest: What a lovely piece of work! Look at the inlay here! Thank you for bringing this to me.
I wish to study this in depth. Perhaps I can learn this level of work ...
I have already given you one of the nice stuffed Monouga's. But I can still reward you with a little something. There's a little extra money in there for you.
Thank you, but I have plenty to study for at least a month. Perhaps if you return later I will have time to examine this.

This is an excellent find. My friend is working on a collection and has given me an exclusive special offer. You qualify for the special collector's edition Tremendous Monouga Pack Doll. Supplies are limited, so only one per person, per month.
chatter: I seek the teeth of certain creatures, the gromnies.  But I won't take just anything, I want only the most well preserved gromnie teeth!
Give me the rare tooth of the fierce gromnies, and I will craft it into something useful.  I will also take auroch horns.
I require stout gromnie teeth for my craft!
I am still experimenting with the skulls of certain skeletons.  They don't seem to be good for weapons, but I'll give you a health potion for them.

greetings: What are you waiting for? Go make yourself some peg legs!
Get!
I can't do anything with this. You see how the wood appears sort of striated and well... if I may say so - ugly? That's poor craftsmanship, there.
Now, if you were to bring me a left peg leg, I might be able to do something for you.
Ah, now that is one nice pair of peg legs!
My, my! I haven't seen one of these in a while. Half a moment, while I slightly alter it for you...
Done! Now, if you sew this together with a right peg leg, you'll be able to make yourself a peg leg set!

Welcome to MacNiall's Freehold.  You must be one of those people who has... rediscovered our island. Those who live here have earned their place by the strength of their arms and the power of their convictions. Do what you will is the whole of the law.

You are a newcomer here? Does that mean the mainland is free of Olthoi? In any case, welcome to the Vesayen Isles, and to MacNiall's Freehold. If you like, I have written a history of our island. It is sold by our barkeep, Jesren.
chatter: I spit upon the tenets of Jojii.
Strangers to our island... Does this mean the Olthoi are gone?
I wonder what that tame Mosswart is up to?

greetings: Here you are.
You are the brave soul who slew the great Nexus Crystal? Take this suit of Amuli armor as a tribute to your prowess.
I have no idea what to do with a  gem of this power. But I have heard of three collectors, two brothers and a sister, who may seek a gem like this. I believe they live near Uziz.

Nuhmudira has finally restored us to full health!  She has also stocked us with some extra supplies that we needed, such that we can provide you with either a version of the original Shadow Armor, or its successor.  If you wish to trade one version of your Amuli set for another, simply hand it to me.  Please take out all Atlan stones from your armor before handing it to me.

Also, if you wish to color your new Greater Shadow Armor, you may buy a vat of color from my assistant.  If you do not like the color, please give me the armor piece and I will replace it with the standard piece, which you may then choose to recolor.
quest: A small gem... delightful. Take these leggings. Another glimmering gem will allow me to make you a coat as well.
Here is a coat to complete your suit of armor.
Back again? I can do no more for you unless you make a more powerful gem. Unless ...
If you really must have another set of that inferior armor, however, give me this gem again and I will see what I can do.
A gem of moderate power. Here is a fine set of Amuli leggings for you. With another sparkling gem, I could make you an Amuli Coat to match.
Another gem. I will make for you an Amuli coat imbued with the gem's power.
You have a complete suit already. Take this gem back.
A great gem. You must have slain many shadows and crystals.  Take these leggings as a reward. And remember, I can also make you a coat with another gem.
Another great gem.  Allow me to complete your suit of armor with this Amuli coat. Take vengeance for me and my colleagues against the shadows!
You already possess armor as strong as I am currently able to craft. Take this back.
Unless ... If you want another suit, give this gem back to me and I'll see what I can do.

greetings: Hold on, I'm getting your item.
Here you go.
My specialty is creating magic orbs and potions from certain pieces of crafted obsidian.  If you have such an item, give it to me and I will return a useful and rare item.
chatter: Have you any spheres or jewels of obsidian?  If you give me such, I shall give back to you something of value.
I am seeking items crafted of pure obsidian, of the rarest kind.  I do not want the raw form.
My specialty is in crafting magic orbs and potions from crafted obsidian.

greetings: This looks like one of those Idol heads those crazy Vesayen mosswarts worship. Hmmm, it's a lot smaller though. You could see if Grearrk, the mosswart living outside Sawato, knows anything about this.
Very pretty.
Such a deep blue. A fine jewel.
Very nicely cut! I'll take this.
A pleasure doing business.
This is quite a fancy jewel!
I might be able to cut a gem like this given enough time...
Ah, yes, these make fine jewels.
Here is a finished one for you.
Ah, not a stone lover?
Take these then, everyone finds pyreal useful.
I work these into perfect spheres.
Nice craftsmanship, eh?
This is a very impressive rock! Here, take one that I've finished cutting and polishing.
The light flickers in it's facets like a black fire. Use that in an Empyrean Weapon.
Here's what I make of those stones.
If you stare into the gems dark center for awhile you can almost make out... movement.
Haha, an unsettling optical illusion. Probably related to it's magical properties.
Oh good, a banderling scalp. Here, take this unpolished gem if you like.
I cure these to make soft rags that I use to polish my stones and gems.
You don't want it? Well, ok, take some coin instead.
It may look dull now, but wait till I'm through with it.
Yes, very good.
I have something for that.
Thank you.
Golem hearts are fine.
Good, good.
Granite? Yes, I need that.
Very pure Iron.
My thanks.
This is a nice chunk of ice.
Nice hunk of obsidian.
You're lucky to find one of these!
A heart of pure pyreal!
This is very valuable.
A heart of pure platinum!
Not sure what to do with it.
Perhaps I'll try cutting it.
Good for magic, but I can use it too.
I will take a number of trophy stones and jewels, such as virindi jewels, swamp stones, iron, copper, and granite golem hearts.
I'll also take banderling trophies.  But what I really specialize in are the rare black rocks and black stones.
chatter: Have you seen any strange black rocks or stones?  If you give me one, I will give you back a piece of it cut into the shape of a pretty gem.
I'm looking for various stones.  Not just any, but only from certain monsters.  I'll also take swamp stones or banderling scalps.
I hear that obsidian comes from volcanoes, or from intense magical disruptions.
The great Obsidian Plain in the Direlands is quite a sight, but I do not like the feel of the place.  I hear it was caused by some kind of powerful magic.
I'll also give you money for some of the trophy jewels you may have, but people tell me my prices aren't very good.

greetings: A moment, please.
If you paint your armor with this, it will have highlights as blue as the sky.
If you paint your armor with this, it will shine like the setting sun in summer vibrant and purple hued.
If you paint your armor with this, it will have edges the color of blood.
quest: The power of the Dragon must be tempered by the Unicorn's grace and Firebird's splendor; else it is a shield used by the ignorant.
One must possess humility so as to not be filled with pride.
One must become detached to avoid desire.
One must possess compassion to alleviate suffering.
One must know discipline to not become soft.

Though I try to live my life according to Jojii's path I sometimes find that I lack discipline. I have begun painting, and hope to continue doing so. I have noticed that many who come here seek the armor that is wrought by Koga Hideki and his peers.

I wish to assist those who wish to bring the colors of the rainbow to the armor he makes. If you hand me vials of Lapyan, Hennacin and Relanim dyes, I will make them into paints that will stay upon the shadow armor that has been enhanced with the new magical shards.

You seek the power of the dragon, as did Honshu. Very well. I shall tell you were he was sent. In the valley, across the stretch of land, and water. Through the hills that bite, atop the crest where the sun sets, there is a portal into the place where the Dragon's flame smolders in a basin of metal. Honshu went there to find the Dragon's power.
Go there and find the strength that I hope he found.

greetings: Well done!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Sharpshooter!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Sniper!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Ballisteer!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Axe Warrior!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Dagger Fighter!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Mace Warrior!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Spear Warrior!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Staff Warrior!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Swordfighter!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Unarmed Brawler!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Apothecary!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Chef!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Fletcher!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called War Adept!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Life Adept!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Item Adept!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Creature Adept!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Deadeye!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Sureshot!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Projectilist!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Skullsplitter!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Slicer!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Skullcrusher!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Impaler!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Master of Staves!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Duelist!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Pugilist!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Alchemist!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Iron Chef!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Master Fletcher!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Warlock!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Theurgist!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Artifex!
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called Evoker!
This token is filthy! Well, I guess that proves it's from one of the beggars.
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven worthy to be called a Philanthropist!
This token only proves that you're a grave robber. Are you sure you want everyone to know that?
Well, ok, it's your life.
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven to be a low down good for nothing Grave Robber!

I am the examiner here at the Sho outpost of the Bestowers' Guild.  Please speak with Naba Ko-Zin if you wish to arrange for an examination.  The base piece of the skill puzzle is available in the other corner of this tent.  Be warned, however, that the test can only be taken once per day, and one may only be called by one title.
chatter: Does a thing determin its name, or does the name determine the thing?

greetings: Good, but it's a bit bland isn't it.
I prefer something a bit richer.
Refreshing, but none too fulfilling. Isn't there a drink with some spice to it?
Boooooring. I want something that will warm me up out here. This stuff is worse than that swill they served in Dryreach.
You should join me. It's liberating!
Can you buy me a drink? I seem to have left my money in my other pants.
Oh, and get me a drink with a bit of zing to it.
You know your a real hero if you can fight naked.
quest: Nope, I gave you the only toothpick I had.
I do have a toothbrush if you want to borrow it though.
No? Suit yourself.
Sure I have a toothpick.
Here you go.
Go on, take it.
Where did I pull that from?
You don't want to know.
No, I'm not a sheriff. Why do you ask?
Ummm, I don't think so. What's a wardrobe malfunction?
Thanks!
Say, what's a Ursuin Shot? I heard someone talking about one. Are they a good drink?
Clothes are for the weak. I save all my money for lager.
I'm naked as a Siraluun!
Hmph! I hear they aren't so prudish on Tusker Island.
Nope, it's just a nanner.
chatter: What are you looking at?

quest: I already made ya a axe.  Why you not out there kickin' chitin an' takin' claws?
This is a nice one. Lemme see...
Narg fashions an axe from the materials. It is crude but sharp.
How many axes you think I can make?  Go kill something.
Yeah this is good. I'll cut it down. I get to keep the rest, see?
How many axes you want? Thanks, I can use this. You gotta problem with that?
We been here for years fightin' off the bugs.  We kills 'em when they sleep sometimes.  And sometimes they does the same to us.

Hey, ya bring me a Olthoi crest and I make ya a fine axe.  Nothin' busts bug shell like bug shell, I always say. Need some wood too though, and that's rare here. An old quarterstaff might do if ya got one. A plain, old wood quarterstaff.
Yeah this should do but I still need a quarterstaff, if ya take my meaning.

Nice quarterstaff. Bop a bug on the head is all's I can do with this, though. Bug'll laugh and spit acid at me. Ya gotta get me an Olthoi crest if ya wanna axe. Gimme a crest, I cut this staff down, bugga bing, bugga bam, I make ya an axe, you're happy, you kill bugs, I'm happy.

greetings: Off to the east, over the river, is a ruin where I used to live before I was offered this place to stay.  Could you retrieve my old treasure, a flawed gem that is precious to none but myself?
Thank you!  In return, here is the stone of humility, which represents the humility that of our existence, no matter how proud we are.
It speaks of the kind of life I have lived.  Take this to Oi-Tong Ye in Shoushi proper.
Welcome, welcome.  Perhaps you have seen my flawed gem someplace?
Thanks!
You're very kind...
Wing collectors will reward you for the wings of gold phyntos wasps that are found in the Direlands, but no one else will.
Near the main tumerok camp, outside of town, is a portal into the Direlands.  Supposedly there's a portal that comes back from the Direlands, too, but it's guarded by tumeroks on the other side.
Thank you.

I heard that a few brave men and women live in the Direlands in isolated outposts.  But even so, there aren't any towns as big or as extensive as, say, Cragstone.  Direlands travel is dangerous, no matter how you look at it.

I heard about some mage who got captured by Tumeroks. Heh! These absent-minded wizards. I think she's got some rare spell components on her. Her sister, Yu Vuo-Ki, sometimes walks around to the northwest of here. But good luck finding her!
Thank you stranger! I can get a good meal and a hot bath with this!
The snake sighs and uncoils from the coin.
"You have lifted the curse. Finally, I may rest." The small snake coils in on itself biting its tail.
Here, a small token of my gratitude.
Could you spare me some money so I can buy food for my family?
chatter: Could you spare me some money?
The wind carries a strong odor of tumeroks.

greetings: Ahh, I've been waiting for these. Not long mind you. The Lugians are very prompt in their delivery, nothing at all like the vermin I'm used to working with back on Ispar. Never mind the dogs living here on Dereth. This be for Captain K'rank.
Tell 'im that I'm willing to continue this advantageous relationship, so long as he's willing to keep supplying me with these herbs.

Arrr, and welcome to MacNiall's Freehold. Have ye seen them funny statue things the Mosswarts like to worship? I thinks their eyes is kinda pretty. Bring me one, and I'll see what I can do to reward ye.
quest: Errukh, look at the sparkle! Look, youngster, I'll give ye this note for my cousin MacDugal. I hear tell he's taken up residence with our old gang at some place called the Bandit Castle. Bring this note to him, and he'll reward ye right.
Oi mucker, I've already given ye the note to pass on to MacDugal! Don't tell me ye've lost it! Take this bauble back too, simpleton!
chatter: Bloody Pwyll-worshipping lackeys...
Don't believe what the townies on the other island tell ye, the bunch of bleating sheep that they are... Hrm. It's been a while since I seen a sheep.
Well, Jourgensson says you're all right.  Maybe you can help.  Down underneath the castle, there's a prison full of beasties.  That idiot Gwillim dropped some notes and his bag in there.
Now he says he can't mix potions!  Bring the bag back to him, and he'll reward you.  You'll need this to get in there.

greetings: Ugh! I hate this stuff, but I have a friend who likes it. Maybe you should drop in on him.
What do you want me to do with this? Pick my teeth? Stop bothering me I have some serious drinking to do.
You find enough of this you might be able to have some tailor make a really fine shirt.
Hey. This is stolen property. I might swill my share of ale, but I'm not swilling my brew from Celcynd's mug.

No, no, that's your robe now. I have quite a few of them myself. Thanks again for finding those wand splinters. I can't stand the thought of a bunch of semi-literate drunken fools ruining my good name.
Bwahahaha!!! People are still trying to bring me these things?
Ayan Baqur used to be such a wonderful place to live. People were always so... respectful of...
Who am I kidding? That place has been a hive of scum and villainy for years. But the state of affairs in my hometown has little to do with my latest excursion!

Let's look at this situation from a practical standpoint. Yes, it is cold here. Yes, there was no brew here before I came along. But there's no incessant wars between people just beside the lifestone. There's no chance that those blasted Burun coming here. They hate cold!
So, this really isn't a bad place to be right now.
Get beer.
Get beer from keg.
Get beer from keg now.
Get out! Geesh, some people just don't understand an adventure.
I drank that sake crud the other day. You know what it did to me?

Hallucinations! I saw myself in the belly of the beast literally. It was horrible. A stomach surrounded me on all sides, my legs burned and itched as acid ate away at my clothing and flesh. Then the most horrible thing of all happened. I dropped my beer!
This little mosswart fellow came into town screaming about the Burun.
I gave him a drink to calm him down. He gave me a stone that smells like something plucked from a mattekar's hind quarters. I figure I'll throw it at the next Burun I see.
Guess what I'm doing tomorrow night.
The same thing I do every night.
You know you're a real hero if you can fight naked.
I wish I could fly. You think with all this magic in the world we would have magical flight.
I want to fly!
I need a cape too.
I met this small man yesterday. He had a mask on and these big red gloves. He talked about scrolls and buttons. We shared a few cold ones and then he had to get back to his chainmail or something.
Strong little fellow...
Are you naive enough to think Elysa runs Dereth? Hmm.

There is a conspiracy that those in power don't want you to know. I can't tell you everything, not yet. I can tell you there is a cabal of mages in the upper echelons of our government who control every aspect of our society. Do you think that the Olthoi Invasion happened by chance?
Just ask yourself, who is the fourth man?
You know, Muldaveus and Niarltah asked me to join their Renegade cause. I was going to join too...

Then they told me that they didn't supply the Breakfast Beer, Morning Mickeys, Spring-to-Action Ale, Midday Mead, Late-Night Lager or Sleepy-Time Stout. So I told them that they could take their Mattekar Swill and stuff it. My allegiance to Elysa could never be bought!
Fill me up a Beer Stein and I'll tell you the story of how I tied to a broken lifestone.
You the man!
You say, "No, You the man!"
You're right, I am.
There aren't a lot of stimulating people to talk to around here.
I don't mean you of course, you're fascinating.
I had a bad dream the other night. I was in the ruins of some town and I couldn't get anyone to talk to me or give me stout.
That wasn't the worst part of the dream though. There were these horrible wormy things floating around and I was terrified they would see me.
I thought Mosswarts smelled bad, but Burun smell like Tremendous Monouga feet. At least you know when they're close.
I saw a cute little Ursuin Cub the other day. I tried to pat it on the head. Cute little teeth on that cub. See my cute little bite mark?
Have you noticed how dazed the people at fishing holes look?
Just try talking to one of them. You'll be lucky if they even acknowledge you. More than likely they'll just stand there casting and casting and casting.
They're Fishing Zombies! Fishing Zombies I tells you!
Wish I could take my sword with me. I'd at the very least like to have it on my wall at home.

It's really good to be back in Ayan Baqur. It hasn't changed all that much. The big difference is I see more crazy fools running around killing each other than I used to. How can they stand all the Vitae?
I hear old Jaleh got killed. Aaminah really looks as if she's broken up over it. I think we should elect a new leader for Ayan Baqur.
Now let's see... who would make a good leader?
No, I couldn't!
Could I?
I'll do it! I will shoulder the heavy burden of leadership.
First law I pass? Free drinks for the Mayor!
I visited Claude and Leopold yesterday.
Same old virindi. Still think that we can't tell they aren't human.
I asked them to go cliff diving with me tomorrow. Hehe.
I told them it was a traditional human activity.
I'll just make sure they jump first.
People were surprised that I changed my portal recall spell. Hey, I warned people it would change. It's my spell and I go where I like. Plus, I don't really trust Lifestone Recall anymore...
If you want to get to my island then talk to the Drunken Madman, he knows the way.
Now I have the power of ten Uglrims!
quest: I don't need these splinters anymore, but seeing as you went to all that work.
I bestow upon you the Robe of Extraordinary Comfort!
Thanks, but I don't need anymore splinters.
chatter: Aw! None Left!
Nothing like an Ulgrim's Brew in the crisp mountain air.
Cold-brewed to warm the bones.

greetings: Many thanks, friend traveler.
Would you have the time to bring this to Ahyara in the East Yaraq Outpost? She is also a friend of Mara's, and would wish to sign this small note as well.
As ever, Ahyara is swifter to act than I.  Ah well.
My friend, could I trouble you to bring this to Mara at her father's villa outside Yaraq? I am sure she will be pleased to receive it.
My friend Mara al-Luq, the flower of Yaraq, has just received some happy news, and I want to congratulate her.
quest: Ah, Mara's spirit is as lovely as her face!  You have my thanks, friend traveler,  for performing this little errand. I pray it was not too onerous.
Please accept this small token of my appreciation.
But you just gave me her letter!  Maybe if you come back tomorrow, I will believe that she has written me again.

greetings: Excellent work! This gorget may be imbued with the elixirs that I give out in exchange for ruined amulets.

If you need to know more, then take this to the Arcanum Consortium, in the desert sands above Xarabydun, and seek out the Artificer there by the name of Hiro. He will be pleased to see you and your find.

So you fought through the sclavus horde and emerged victorious with a prize! Excellent work, hero. This gorget that you have found may be imbued with the elixirs that I give out in exchange for ruined amulets.
Ahh, a prize worthy of the great efforts you undoubtedly put forth! This gorget that you have found may be imbued with the elixirs that I give out in exchange for ruined amulets.
Excellent work! Hmm taken from the grasp of a Banderling Berserker I see. You are truly a talented hunter. Here take this.
Thank you for retrieving this from the Scrawed Grievver's gullet. We could not possibly do all of our work without your help. Here take this, with my thanks.
You've hunted a Virulent Grievver and lived to tell the tale I see. I applaud your efforts Isparian. As promised, I have a reward for you.
It must have been a difficult fight against the Lich Lord but you appear to have emerged victorious. Here take this as a reward for your efforts.
So you tracked down and killed a Ferocious Monouga to reclaim this amulet. You have done excellent work. Take this and be proud of your efforts.
Was it a difficult fight? Certainly not daunting for one of your talents, aye? Well you have proven that you do wish to assist our High Queen and the Arcanum, take this.
Drudge Lurker you say! Ha! That must have been a very simple fight indeed. Yet still you have found what was lost and I will see that you are rewarded. Here.

Raveners? You have done well to procure this item for us, I only hope that the Arcanum can repair them, all that have been returned to us have been befouled by the creatures who stole them. Ah yes...your reward. Here.

Mosswarts! And from the Vesayen Islands no less. What foul trickery is afoot? We shall dispatch a cadre of warrior to discern greater truths once we have this storage facility cleared. For now I will see that you are rewarded.

Another of the mosswarts from the Vesayen Isles carried this, you say? Well they certainly traveled a great distance after the sclavus. I wonder why they wanted these things so badly. Alas it appears ruined. No matter for you however, here.
Soul Trapper? Those mosswarts have been traveling all over it seems. Well you have done very well to bring this item to me, and you shall be rewarded for your efforts.

Those maddened mosswarts from the islands, the Zealot you say? You have performed this task in a most excellent fashion friend. The Arcanum and your High Queen thank you. Here take this as recompense for your efforts.
A Brutish Monouga had taken this? Well then I am glad you were able to wrest it free from its grasp. Here is your reward.
A Banderling Striker, eh? Well good work! You're a fine hunter, and I applaud your efforts to assist us in the dark time. Here take this.
quest: %n spits at your feet.

How dare you speak to me? You who think yourself above a woman who was willing to sacrifice all, her sanity, her body, her life for all of us. You make me sick. Leave my presence for I will have nothing more to do with you.
Ah ... You have helped the captured Nuhmudira. You are a very noble person.
%n snaps to attention, and salutes you.

I have been sent here to ensure that none venture into this hold. It is overrun by a horde of Sclavus -- they have stolen some of the items that were collected here by Nuhmudira, the Arcanum and their Agents. These Sclavus are of a potent and singular mind, it seems, and all attempts to root them from their positions have met with great casualties.

Our High Queen has organized a unit of her elite forces and established a foothold within the first rooms of this storehouse. If you are brave enough, you may assist us in restoring the stolen items. In return, you may claim one of the special items that was stored within. Speak to the guards inside the storehouse to learn more.
%n looks you over speculatively.

With your skill you might be able to ... Yes, yes I think you can. When the Sclavus overran this building they were pursued by a variety of creatures that they upset along their migration here. Here is a list of the creatures.

Each of these creatures may have escaped with some of the relics that were stored in this facility. Hunt them, and see if you can't find any of the ... odd relics. If you do find anything out of the ordinary, return it to me, and I will reward you with an elixir which will make the item you claim from the storehouse more powerful.
%n snaps to attention and salutes you.

Hail, fellow Isparian. I have been sent here to ensure that none venture into this hold. It is overrun by a horde of Sclavus -- they have stolen some of the items that were collected here by Nuhmudira, the Arcanum and their Agents. These Sclavus are of a potent and singular mind, it seems, and all attempts to root them from their positions have met with great casualties.

Our High Queen has organized a unit of her elite forces and established a foothold within the first rooms of this storehouse. If you are brave enough, you may assist us in restoring the stolen items. However ...
%n sighs.

I do not know you, Isparian. And I fear that trust is in short supply these days. I must ask you to prove yourself before I can accept your assistance. If you journey to Stonehold and there choose to support Nuhmudira with the sacrifice of your own life essence, then I will know that you are truly on our side.

greetings: What a foul creature. I have no interest in this!
What a nasty little thing! Enough with the show and tell, you can have it back now!
That's great! Now get it out of my face!
I'm not a collector of skulls! What kind of collector do you take me for?
Wonderful! Maybe I can make this into a drinking mug for you! Then again, maybe I'll just give it back to you and forget I ever saw it!
I have no need for a broken mask.
You probably want to give this to the Olthoi Hunter in Arwic. Perhaps she'll be able to do something with it.
You can't decorate your own?
Just find a carving or whittling knife and go at it!
Wha... that's HUGE! Where did you find that? Be careful when you carve or whittle that, it must be worth a fortune! Unfortunately, I don't buy produce.
Sorry, I'm not going to wear this around town!
There's no way I'm going to wear this!
I wonder if this would fool a banderling.
Thanks for sharing this with me.
Oh! Scary!
Not a bad looking mask.
Something about this mask creeps me out...
Ah yes, the Golden King. Exquisite! What a fine mask this is.
Hmmm, the Assassins Mask, I bet this is nice to have when the desert is restless.
Oh, the Ogre Mask. Somehow the crafter captured beauty in it's ugly features.
King Pwyll looks even more regal in this version of the mask.
You know, this mask is likely to keep people at a distance. No one likes to stand to close to an Assassin.
The mask of the Ogre Magi! I love this mask, but I keep mine locked up at night so I can sleep.
It's as if I'm looking upon King Pwyll himself! Amazing that Alexander could make this from memory.
The Shagar Zharala could have made this. It's a perfect recreation.
Ah!!! A monster!
Oh, hehe, just a mask of Koji's demon. It looks like it's watching me...
Hold on, I'm getting your money.
Keep those rat tails coming!
Another tan rat tail...
Tan rat tails make great boot laces.
Ah, one russet rat tail...
Here you go.
They say grey rat tails are good for the spleen.
Here's your money.
Brown, not bad. I'll get your money.
Here you are, don't forget I have higher rewards for black and red rat tails.
Oooo, this deserves more than a coin reward!
That's the Top Rat reward. I always need more black and red rat tails.
Red! Very good, you get the Top Rat reward for this!
Thanks, hmmm, I think I'll have sausages tonight.
I've been seeing a lot of these...
Next time, see if you can find a blue wasp wing.
Ah, a blue wasp wing!
Thanks, here's your reward.
You found one! I don't see many of these around here...
Here's your reward.
These are my favorite and they are hard to find.
Jingle jingle, eh?
Such a pretty looking wing!
More wings, more coin.
White like the snow. So beautiful, but so dangerous.
And I'll pay the same for more of these.
Let's see, Sandy Spine...
I buy all of the Armoredillo spines.
Spine, bronze... mhmm, here you go.
Find me some Island Spines if you can.
It's a trade then. Here are your potions.
May your magic never fail you friend.
Shore Spine, those are pretty good.
chatter: Have you a drudge charm, swamp stone, rat tail, or such? I'll pay you good money or items if you give them to me. They're hard to come by.
Did you know there are other people who collect other items, like gromnie teeth?  You might find them in some towns.  I'll take them, but I won't pay you for them!
Very rarely, you can get a perfect red phyntos wasp wing.  If you can give one to me, I'll pay you for it.  I will also pay you for the tails of rats.
I'm particularly interested in the spine of the sandy armoredillo.  Get that to me and I'll give you a health potion.  I'll also pay the same for swamp stones and the scalps of banderlings.
There are others who will reward differently for the same items I collect.  Not all types of monsters carry trophies, and of those variants that do, it's very rare.

greetings: Let's see what Dame Fortune has in store for you!
Hey, friend, maybe you weren't aware, but this is the high stakes table.
Hey!  What are you trying to pull?  This token is only for use at Arshid's Den of Iniquity, in the Gharu'ndim lands.
Hey!  What are you trying to pull?  This token is only for use at Gan-Zo's Den of Iniquity, in the Sho lands.
I manage the games of chance with the red tokens.  Give me a red token and see what you win!
No, I insist you keep this.  You've earned it.
This looks to be a key of some sort. You better keep it. It might be important.
This looks like it's a part of something. You better keep it. It might be important.

This is obviously an important banderling token. Look! The sides have scrape marks on it. It looks as if it was meant to fit into something. Search the village carefully. I'm sure whatever this fits into is there.
Those heathens were worshipping some kind of spirit, huh? I guess with you killing their 'god' they won't be coming back.
Good job! Here's a little something for your troubles.
quest: Thanks for your help in clearing away those bothersome banderlings. Now I can starting building my resort.
Hmm...for the life of me I still can't drop that Oily Stone you gave me.
You're back. Any luck getting those banderlings to relocate their village?
No? Well hurry up then. If you don't do it I'll hire someone else who is more persuasive.
Remember, the banderling village is east of here. I don't care how you do it, but get those banderlings to leave.
Greetings! I'm Cyphis Suldow and you are? Nevermind, who you are is unimportant. The important thing is I need some help and you seem to be more than qualified to do so.
I want to build a resort for the weary adventurer and I found the perfect spot just to the east of here.
The only problem is that some banderlings have a village there. That is where you come in my friend. Go and...relocate those banderling.
Come back when the job is done. I'll give you a nice reward, but I'll need proof that the banderlings won't come back.
I need some help, but apparently so do you. Come back when you have a bit more experience under your belt.

greetings: Ah, a fine robe - but the style is just too wild for my tastes.  Let's see here, I know I have one of those older patterns lying around somewhere...
Ah! Here you go!
So you'd rather have the newer style?  Can't say I agree with you, but a deal is a deal!
Enjoy!
Hello, my name is Balarazo.  I am a traveling tailor, but I have decided to make my home here in Greenspire.
I noticed there was a stockpile of older Canescent robe patterns laying around here.  If you have a new or old style Canescent robe, I will gladly exchange it for you, free of charge!

quest: Thank you for looking for Tamian.  I don't know what to say.

No word of Tamian? I suppose not, I spoke with most people here myself. I know Delton is still angry at him.  Well, Tamian acted a bit wild that day when he and Delton fought, but perhaps he is just not used to swordplay and grew furious when Delton swatted him.  Delton is quite good with a sword. Tamian knows nothing about them.
Astara sighs

Of late, Tamian had been extremely interested in something a Scribe who was travelling through here had given him.  It had to do with a tower.  Tamian is always drawing towers and such. The Scribe was named Tian Li Quan and resides in Lin, I believe. Tamian is no great traveler and that is quite a way from here. Strange that he would go and say nothing, but perhaps...
Have you found anything out about Tamian yet?
You gave me that already.
You gave me before.

Hello. Have you seen Tamian Wilmit around at all lately?  I have not seen him in quite some time now. I am concerned about him, he had been acting a bit strange lately.  He is a very dear friend.  If you could find where he is I would very much appreciate it.  He had a row with my friend Delton Hardor. Very out of character for Tamian.
I... I did not know...
Thank you for giving me this.
Oh, Tamian!

greetings: The Stone of Discipline! This stone represents the discipline that a follower of Jojii must maintain - discipline over their fears and their desires.
Thank you for bringing this to me.
The Stone of Detachment! This stone represents the detanchment that a follower of Jojii must maintain - detachment from the illusions and pitfalls of the material realm.
The Stone of Compassion! A follower of Jojii must temper their detachment with compassion. Compassion cuts through the illusion of the material realm as a ray of light through the gloom.

The Stone of Humility! A follower of Jojii must temper their discipline with humility. When you discipline your fears and desires, you bring yourself closer to the central principle of life - but no mere human can maintain that closeness indefinitely. You will make mistakes. When you no longer make mistakes, you will no longer be human.
If you are looking for more adventure, friend, then you might want to speak with the lovely Nin Hong upstairs. She maintains a library of gossip and rumors that may serve you well in this.
Take this -- but if you would prefer an atlatl, I have those too. Just hand the bow back to me.
Take this -- but if you would prefer at atlatl, I have those too. Just hand the bow back to me.
Ah, a truly adventurous soul. Here you are!
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Hey, looks like it got rolled in the mud... Anyway, well done!  Here, take these as a reward.
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Looks like good old F.P. went swimming or something.  Here's your reward.
Looks like you've lucked out!  Our man F.P. has finished his book, finally!  Here you go...
Greetings, and welcome to Shoushi. I am the local representative of the Explorer Society. My job is to help new arrivals in Dereth.
If you have just arrived in Dereth, you should talk to my friend Lou Ka, who stands just over there. He is looking for some help with an errand.
Or you might investigate the rumors that the lovely Nin Hong sells upstairs.
quest: I believe that Lou Ka was looking for this! Why don't you try taking it to him?
I believe that Nen Ai was looking for this! Why don't you try taking it to her?
Ahha! Thank you for bringing this to me!

I have been contracted by the Dereth Exploration Society to help them in their outreach program towards the Isparians who find themselves newly exiled in Dereth.  Here is a book that explains their mission.
I will also give you a list describing the locations of the nearest stamp and portals to other towns.  If you collect any of the Society's stamped letters, you may bring them back to me for a reward.
Thank you, you must have journeyed far to get here.  You are a true Explorer!

You will get nothing from me for this. Go explore and find more towns.  The Society Agents in the Gharun'dim towns will exchange a piece of jewelry or a wand for this. If you take this to one of the Aluvian towns, you will receive a weapon.

greetings: Lai Fanli grunts. "I keep telling Oswald... archers can't compete against opponents this difficult. Where is the 'love' he keeps promising me?" At that, his bow falls from his cooling fingers.
Hmm, if I had a whole one of these, I could make a very nice mask. It's a pity it's broken.
This mask is broken. I can do nothing with it. Perhaps you can bring it to whoever fixes Virindi masks, and they can fix it for you.
I can't work with this but if you can get a version that has been crafted into a full mask I may well be able to craft this into an even more detailed version of Koji's personal mask.
Or you could give this to my apprentice after you have it fixed. She'll restore it to be more like the Virindi that it was taken from.
If you can get a full, unbroken mask I may well be able to craft it into something quite extraordinary. But I cannot work with this.
I wish I had two of those so I could get some sleep. My wife likes to burn the candle late.

A find worthy of crafting into a robe! But you still require another arm, two legs and a torso. You should be able to assemble those together without my aid. But only a master such as myself would be able to craft such objects into a fully wearable outfit.

A find worthy of crafting into a robe! But you still require another leg, two arms and a torso. You should be able to assemble those together without my aid. But only a master such as myself would be able to craft such objects into a fully wearable outfit.

A find worthy of crafting into a robe! But you still require two arms and two legs. You should be able to assemble those together without my aid. But only a master such as myself would be able to craft such objects into a fully wearable outfit.

A find worthy of crafting into a robe! But you still require two arms and a torso. You should be able to assemble those together without my aid. But only a master such as myself would be able to craft such objects into a fully wearable outfit.
What a fine mask! Such well-preserved fur!
You know, I really hate these creatures.
HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA!
Oh, that's funny.
Wonderful craftsmanship! We mask makers are a crafty lot!
I hear Elysa holds the most wonderful costume parties. You should wear this if you're ever lucky enough to receive an invitation!
Think of the havoc you could cause in the marketplace!
Do you smell that? This thing stinks!

The chances of you finding a whole Virindi mask were highly unlikely, but it seems you have beat the odds! With this, I can replicate one of my people's ancient masks! Here, take this, and carry Koji's strength in your heart.
This mask will strike fear in to the hearts of all your enemies. Wear it proudly.
A fine specimen. Give me a few seconds here and I will complete a much improved version of my Koji line.
A beautiful specimen! Just a moment ...
Although you watch closely, the mask maker's hands move too quickly and skillfully to follow.

Koji, as you know, has always been a favorite subject of mine. My previous efforts have shown the horror and cruelty of the evils that Koji faced. This year I have crafted an image that I hope shows the balance, majesty and beauty of Koji herself.
What a foul creature.  I hope this head formerly belonged to one of those Drudges that plagues the Shoushi Grotto.
It almost seems as if the ranks of the undead are growing, doesn't it?  Please, be careful.
Tuskers are simple to kill, as long as you use magic against them.  As long as the Virindi use them against us, we can't lose!
Wearing the visage of an undead brings bad luck.  You have been warned.
Currently, the Ursuin are more dominant than the Mattekars.  I wonder if they will eventually hunt them to extinction?
These are rather strange creatures.  I have heard many of them have recently shown up in the desert.  Strange considering they were formerly thought to be swamp dwelling creatures.
This is a strange mask.  It seems to be transparent on only one side.  Turning it inside out completely defies all logic, and makes it's contents invisible.  Fascinating.
Here you go, a new version of the Mosswart Mask.
Here you go, a new version of the Banderling Mask.

Ugh! I should have my apprentice make this nasty thing for you. Here just take one of the masks he already cleaned. You'll notice the stitching isn't very precise, but I can't bring myself to work on these.
Yes. I see... Did you eat something funny?
On your head you say? Well, I imagine it will keep your head nice and warm.
Why do you want to stick this on your head?
%mn looks you over with suspicion.
Are you drunk? Well, here have fun.
You seriously want a mask made from this thing?
Well ok...
Masks chafe if you wear them to long, not to mention you may have more protective head gear you wish to wear.  Perhaps this will suit you better?
Tusker backpacks are a bit morbid.  However, I hear that both Alexander the Deft and Janda Sulifiya are offering them, so here you go.
I'm sorry, this is to tough for me to make into a mask, for the heads of Olthoi are to difficult to carve.  Perhaps the Olthoi hunter in Arwic can make use of it.
I'm sorry, but you'll have to decorate your own.  It is my duty to make masks, not carve pumpkins.
Give me a moment and I will craft a fine costume for you from this body.
I've always had a soft spot in my heart for mites.
They taste great with a little tarragon and melted butter. You wouldn't happen to have carved off any meat when you obtained this head, would you? No? Ah well.
They wait thousands of years to seek vengeance for who knows what ancient crime, and what happens when they finally arrive on Dereth? Some tiny Isparian lops off their head! I love it!
Ridiculous creatures, these chitticks. But they're great in a stew!
You'll be the belle of the ball with this fine costume!
I just learned how to make this costume. I must say, I am most impressed with myself!
Now, this is one fine costume. Go forth and scare some new arrivals!

Greetings to you on this fine day. I am Tsua, mask maker of no small ability. If you provide me with a creature's head or facial covering, I will make it into a mask that will allow you to participate in Osteth's celebration. I have handed some of my duties off to my apprentice. If you wish to receive the original version of the Mosswart or Banderling masks hand your crafted head to my apprentice.
Perhaps you know of the ancient legend of Koji's Sword? If not, I am certain you can acquire a copy at the Library at Hebian-to.
During the ancient days, strong Sho warriors used to decorate their helmets with fearsome guises, in order to instill fear into their enemies.
quest: Hey, you already turned one of these in to me. Let's finish the first one before we make a second mask.
Thanks. Wow! That looks pretty scary, I'm glad we don't have to fight these things too, hehe.
This won't make a mask on it's own, I need a Scarecrow Head to complete it.
Why are you giving this to me?  Just take it, and put it on your head!

greetings: What a foul creature. I have no interest in this!
What a nasty little thing! Enough with the show and tell, you can have it back now!
That's great! Now get it out of my face!
I'm not a collector of skulls! What kind of collector do you take me for?
Wonderful! Maybe I can make this into a drinking mug for you! Then again, maybe I'll just give it back to you and forget I ever saw it!
I have no need for a broken mask.
You probably want to give this to the Olthoi Hunter in Arwic. Perhaps she'll be able to do something with it.
You can't decorate your own?
Just find a carving or whittling knife and go at it!
Wha... that's HUGE! Where did you find that? Be careful when you carve or whittle that, it must be worth a fortune! Unfortunately, I don't buy produce.
Sorry, I'm not going to wear this around town!
There's no way I'm going to wear this!
I wonder if this would fool a banderling.
Thanks for sharing this with me.
Oh! Scary!
Not a bad looking mask.
Something about this mask creeps me out...
Ah yes, the Golden King. Exquisite! What a fine mask this is.
Hmmm, the Assassins Mask, I bet this is nice to have when the desert is restless.
Oh, the Ogre Mask. Somehow the crafter captured beauty in it's ugly features.
King Pwyll looks even more regal in this version of the mask.
You know, this mask is likely to keep people at a distance. No one likes to stand to close to an Assassin.
The mask of the Ogre Magi! I love this mask, but I keep mine locked up at night so I can sleep.
It's as if I'm looking upon King Pwyll himself! Amazing that Alexander could make this from memory.
The Shagar Zharala could have made this. It's a perfect recreation.
Ah!!! A monster!
Oh, hehe, just a mask of Koji's demon. It looks like it's watching me...
Hold on, I'm getting your money.
Keep those rat tails coming!
Another tan rat tail...
Tan rat tails make great boot laces.
Ah, one russet rat tail...
Here you go.
They say grey rat tails are good for the spleen.
Here's your money.
Brown, not bad. I'll get your money.
Here you are, don't forget I have higher rewards for black and red rat tails.
Oooo, this deserves more than a coin reward!
That's the Top Rat reward. I always need more black and red rat tails.
Red! Very good, you get the Top Rat reward for this!
Thanks, hmmm, I think I'll have sausages tonight.
I've been seeing a lot of these...
Next time, see if you can find a blue wasp wing.
Ah, a blue wasp wing!
Thanks, here's your reward.
You found one! I don't see many of these around here...
Here's your reward.
These are my favorite and they are hard to find.
Jingle jingle, eh?
Such a pretty looking wing!
More wings, more coin.
White like the snow. So beautiful, but so dangerous.
And I'll pay the same for more of these.
Let's see, Sandy Spine...
I buy all of the Armoredillo spines.
Spine, bronze... mhmm, here you go.
Find me some Island Spines if you can.
It's a trade then. Here are your potions.
May your magic never fail you friend.
Shore Spine, those are pretty good.
chatter: Have you a drudge charm, swamp stone, rat tail, or such? I'll pay you good money or items if you give them to me. They're hard to come by.
Did you know there are other people who collect other items, like gromnie teeth?  You might find them in some towns.  I'll take them, but I won't pay you for them!
Very rarely, you can get a perfect red phyntos wasp wing.  If you can give one to me, I'll pay you for it.  I will also pay you for the tails of rats.
I'm particularly interested in the spine of the sandy armoredillo.  Get that to me and I'll give you a health potion.  I'll also pay the same for swamp stones and the scalps of banderlings.
There are others who will reward differently for the same items I collect.  Not all types of monsters carry trophies, and of those variants that do, it's very rare.

greetings: This came from the garb worn by one of the traitors? I have no need for it and I have nothing to reward you for defeating them. My apologies. Perhaps someone else affiliated with the Shagar Zharala can given you a prize worthy of your efforts.
My... my master's journal!
Yalik reads over the journal, closes it, and returns it to you.

His final hours were met with glorious battle against our new enemies. For that I am happy for him. This information should not be withheld, please take it to someone of higher rank than I. They will know what to do with this journal.
Our foreman was against this journey from the start. Just the fact that the Order of the Raven Hand displayed an interest in this tower was enough to give him pause.
It seems his concerns were justified. Please take this to someone of higher rank than I. They will know what to do with this journal.
Thank you! As I promised, here is the key. Use it well.
Beyond the door are a series of levers. Once you pass through the gate they bar, you may not be able to return here, so please prepare first.
Also, if you happen to find my master in the depths, please let him know I am safe and continuing my duty up here.
quest: Ah! I see you've brought your emblem with you. Give it here and I'll give you the key to the door over there.
Already so many Zharalim have fallen into the grasp of madness, I would hate to see any more fall.
Finally! People! People who aren't crazed!
Don't look at me like I'm the crazy one. It's all those down below who have gone raving mad! Can you help them?
Wait, you don't look like a Zharalim. Let me see your emblem! No emblem? Then I'm afraid I cannot let you pass. I am not about to let more people fall to the madness of this tower!

If you see any of my brethren in the wilds, be wary of them. Chances are they are maddened by whatever is in the depths of this place. I fear that in that maddened state, they may have fallen prey to some beast. Shreth are all too common in this region.

greetings: Did I say Stout? I didn't.
I don't drink stout. Give me beer!
That repli-jerk in Dryreach likes this stuff. NOT ME!
Not big enough!
I'm not talking to anyone unless I get some beer.
quest: What?! I already gave you what you wanted.
Get lost!
Do you know what you sound like?
Ulgrim fakes a whiny voice, "I'm looking for a splinter. I want a piece of wood. Me, me, me! Look at me, I'm a flippin' ponce!"
Fine! Take it! Just stop talking.
Right, here's your bloody splinter. Now run along.
Ulgrim murmurs, Stupid .... always looking for ... my problem ... can go take ... at a mattekar for all I care.
No!
Stop bothering me with your stupid problems.
What part of the word NO don't you understand?
I'll kill you to death if you don't stop pestering me. See if I dont!

greetings: Let's see what the Mistress of Fate has in store for you!
You must use this at the lower stakes table.
You must use this at the higher stakes table.
You've made a mistake, friend.  This token is only for use at Monty's Den of Iniquity, in the Aluvian lands.
You've made a mistake, friend.  This token is only for use at Gan-Zo's Den of Iniquity, in the Sho lands.
This token is only for use at Gan-Zo's Den of Iniquity, in the Sho lands.
This is the mid stakes table.  Give me a blue token to try your chances!
Here is 1% of the experience needed for your next level.
Here is 100% of the experience needed for your next level.
Give me a Lead Scarab for 1% of the experience needed for your next level or an Iron Scarab for 100% of the experience needed for your next level.

Ahh, I've been waiting for these. Not long mind you. The Lugians are very prompt in their delivery, nothing at all like the vermin I'm used to working with back on Ispar. Never mind the dogs living here on Dereth. This be for Captain K'rank.
Tell 'im that I'm willing to continue this advantageous relationship, so long as he's willing to keep supplying me with these herbs.

Arrr, and welcome to MacNiall's Freehold. Have ye seen them funny statue things the Mosswarts like to worship? I thinks their eyes is kinda pretty. Bring me one, and I'll see what I can do to reward ye.
quest: Errukh, look at the sparkle! Look, youngster, I'll give ye this note for my cousin MacDugal. I hear tell he's taken up residence with our old gang at some place called the Bandit Castle. Bring this note to him, and he'll reward ye right.
Oi mucker, I've already given ye the note to pass on to MacDugal! Don't tell me ye've lost it! Take this bauble back too, simpleton!
chatter: Bloody Pwyll-worshipping lackeys...
Don't believe what the townies on the other island tell ye, the bunch of bleating sheep that they are... Hrm. It's been a while since I seen a sheep.
Well, Jourgensson says you're all right.  Maybe you can help.  Down underneath the castle, there's a prison full of beasties.  That idiot Gwillim dropped some notes and his bag in there.
Now he says he can't mix potions!  Bring the bag back to him, and he'll reward you.  You'll need this to get in there.

greetings: My bellows! Thank you. Take this, with my thanks!
Furthermore, I believe you have proven yourself worthy of a weapons upgrade. This Oil of Rendering will help you achieve one.

Now you should visit the Quartermaster's workshop and buy one of his Training Weapons. They will serve you well in your initial travels, and if you use this special oil on them,I guarantee you will enhance it.

The Quartermaster has locked himself away in his shop for some reason--he must be feeling shy today. Little does he know that I smithed a copy to his key, which I will give to you! You'll find his workshop across the courtyard from where you first entered.
The Academy Blacksmith grins wryly.
Those Sparring Golems are pretty exciting, aren't they? Thanks for the token--I'll return it to the Practice Area for you.
I am a Blacksmith --not a Scribe.
The Academy Foreman would be happy to see this--he's been plagued by these pests for ever so long. Maybe he should take a shower!
No, friend--I must give this to you as a gesture of my friendship. Now I can get back to work! Use this oil on one of the Quartermaster's items--you won't be dissatisfied with the result!
No thanks. I am far too busy to read these days.
This is one of the Training items forged by our Quartermaster. If you use the Oil of Rendering that I gave you on it, you'll find its powers will increase tremendously.

This is a fine weapon indeed. I have always believed that the best weapons are those crafted by one's own hands. Congratulations--you have done a fine job indeed. I would be proud to carry this in battle.
quest: The Blacksmith looks worried and tired.

The Queen and her advisors were correct. The Nexus towns are still under threat. I can only hope that our recent efforts to fortify this area will withstand the assault. Go to the Senior Guard--he will know what's best at this time.
Ah! The Academy Foreman must have sent you over to me. He's always had a good eye for capable folk.

Thank you so much for helping me with those incorrible Mosswarts! Now use the key I gave you to unlock the door to the Quartermaster's workshop. You'll find his workshop across the courtyard from where you first entered. He's selling items that you'll be able to upgrade by pouring the Oil of Rendering on it.

Perhaps you could help me with these thieving Mosswarts. They and their noxious kin have stolen my bellows! How can I contribute to building these fortifications if I do not have them? The last time I saw them, they were running towards the vegetable gardens. Retrieve my bellows for me, and I will reward you!

Wonderful! A new arrival! You should visit the Academy Foreman--he's been having a world of trouble with the Carpenter Wasps over in his construction area. He's nearly at his wit's end...and will be glad to see you.
chatter: Help! Stop thief!

greetings: Thank you.  Here is your reward.

Hello.  Myself and my brothers-in-arms have been assigned to exchange gifts with those that donate undead trophies to the Shagar Zharalim.  We were not expecting the plethora of trophies we have received, so we have adjusted our prizes accordingly.
There have been many strange occurrences in the desert recently.  On occasion, there are sudden sandstorms for no reason.  It is very odd...

I realize that it is dangerous to hunt the more potent Sand Kings without protection.  They cast a plethora of debilitating spells on any aspiring hunter.  With the proper gift, I have been authorized to grant you a gem that can disperse such maladies.
There is nothing more I can do with this.
Heh, I bet I can sell this for quite a bit!  What's that, you want it back?  Bah...
How disgusting!
There is, however, a sage somewhere in the southern mountain range that actually likes those things.  How revolting...
Hmm, I think that might fit on the Niffis Helm.
Are you telling me to dress better?  I don't need your charity!
Small hides are only provide enough material for bracers.
Here you go.
Oh, this should make a very nice breastplate.
There really is a lot of armoredillo hide here. I should be able to make a coat from this.
This hide is very sturdy. I can line this with silk for a fine piece of armor.
Here you go!
I can make a good set of greaves from these.
Reedshark hides make good leggings.
I'll make a pair of mattekar hide sleeves from this. Should help keep you warm.
You look like you want a dependable mattekar hide coat. This should be a good fit.
Wow, this thing reminds me of those strange Hoary Mattekar hides.  Only, not as hoary, or protective, for that matter.  But there is more material here to work with...
Hrm, this is nice!  To bad that you can't act as a sheathe for your dagger.  I saw a guy do that once...
This is a quality piece of work!  With some head gear, you could almost pretend to be a Mattekar!

What an unusual hide. It's a good thing you didn't hand this to me last week. I was making coats out of these hides when I could have been making full robes! Well, you learn something new every day right?
People really seem to prefer these robes over the coats. No wonder, I bet they are far more protective against the elements.
Those small shreths are useless, don't you think?  Good thing they drop skins, otherwise no one would kill them.
Shreths are foul creatures.  But you can make comfortable shoes out of them, so I guess they aren't all bad.
Heh, there is nothing like getting a good shank of hide out of some stupid unsuspecting animal.  There's enough here to make some pants.  Here you go.
Ursuin are smelly creatures that always seem to have enough life left in them to almost fall on you when you kill them.  This is enough hide to cover your midriff.  Here you go.
Ursuin coats are almost like Mattekar coats, they are just harder to get, because Mattekars are weak.
Hmm, this looks like a spring hide!  Well, it seems the Ursuin are starting to really adapt to our climate, eh?
Hmm.  These Spring coats are thinner than the winter ones, but it looks like they give better protection.  I bet it's softer on yer skin too!
Check out the overbite on this sucker!  I bet I can make a pretty decent mace out of this...
Wow, this is a prime piece!  I can make a headpiece out of this one that will protect you and keep your ears warm!
Some days you get the rug.  Other days the rug gets you.
Today, you get the rug!
Wow, this is nice!  Real Sclavus skin is hard to get you know, because there are so many imitations.  Wear these, and make me proud!
This is a nice piece!  You must have gotten it from a pretty large Sclavus.  This will make a pretty nice coat.
With a cut like this, I can make an armored head piece.  It will be so nice, that commanders everywhere will want to wear it!
It is so rare to see such large pieces of Niffis shell!  I'll make this into a functional and stylish shield for you.
This shell must have come from a Niffis.  Tough beasts, they are.  Allow me to make it into a helmet for you.
Ah, a Wisp heart!  This is great!  I can make something that is fairly useful out of this, if you are a mage, that is.
Ah a Pulsating Wisp heart!  These are very powerful.  I can make a very strong orb out of this.
Where did you get this?  I need to go camp there and hunt for these!
This is large enough to craft into a well fitting cuirass I think.
Well then. I think that this may be the first of a great many new robes to come my friend. Make sure to show your friends.
Not quite as sturdy as the tanned red hide that I worked with before, but it's still strong enough and large enough to craft into a nice robe. Wear it well.
Let's see. The hide is thick and leathery, and aside from the small bony protrusions it's in fine shape. I think a nice set of leggings.
There you go.
Another fine specimen. A little thicker than the last shreth hide I was given to work with. Let me have a moment and I'll... Yes, yes that's it!
Where did you get this? It's rather frightening, and rancid smelling. Well, let me see what I can do with it.
I've seen something like this recently. Came from a carenzi though, it mottled and smelled rank. Much like this. Where are you finding these creatures?
Well, I've done the best I can.
What is this!? I've never seen anything like this. It will make a fine robe I think. Give me a moment.
Yes, there it is done.
I've seen some interesting hides pass my way, but the hides that people have been bringing me most recently are the oddest.
A few more threads...and done!
Be careful out there.

Hello, my name's Gillian!  Do you know of any good places to hunt creatures?  I'm looking for standard leather crafter items, plus some wisp hearts, if you find them. Also, if you bring me the hide of an Ursuin Slasher I can make you a comfy Ursuin hide rug.
Did you know that some creatures change along with the seasons?  It makes for prime hunting all year round!
It seems like Dereth is going downhill pretty rapidly.  That's why I'm up here in the Bandit Castle.  After its all over, we'll pick up the pieces.
Thank you. I needed proof that you were new here and not going to steal my ideas. To get to the ruins, follow the pillars going east. Please hurry before the creatures destroy my book.
Oh, once in the ruins, try to find the trail of rocks.
Oh, I'm so relieved that my book isn't damaged. You've saved me months of work.
This isn't for me, it's to Lord Aleval. You should take it to him.
I'm writing a book on the subject of phyntos wasp wings, but alas, I lost it in the ruins east of here. Now I must start all over again!  If you ever find my book please bring it to me.
To get to the ruins, follow the pillars going east. Please hurry before the creatures destroy my book.
chatter: I wonder what it would be like to fly.
I'm writing a book on the aerodynamics of wings.  Did you know Phyntos Wasp wings are over twice as long as their bodies?
I've been constructing a set of wings out of wax and bird feathers. I can't wait to finish so I can test them out!

greetings: Greetings! I have left my master in Glenden Wood to help the craftsmen of this fine land to hone their crafting skills
Prove your knowledge by bringing me a Hollow Atlatl dartshaft, and I shall reward you.
What, you say you don't know how to make a Hollow Atlatl dartshaft?! Why, that is what tests of knowledge are for! Get out there and experiment, my young friend!
Prove your knowledge by bringing me a Hollow Quarrelshaft, and I shall reward you.
What, you say you don't know how to make a Hollow Quarrelshaft?! Why, that is what tests of knowledge are for! Get out there and experiment, my young friend!
Prove your knowledge by bringing me a Hollow Arrowshaft, and I shall reward you.
What, you say you don't know how to make a Hollow Arrowshaft?! Why, that is what tests of knowledge are for! Get out there and experiment, my young friend!
quest: Practice certainly makes perfect. Perhaps you could bring this back to me in a week? I am saving up for a trip back to Glenden Wood at the moment.
You are on your way to becoming a true master!!
I am currently saving for a trip to visit my master back in Glenden Wood, so I can only help you out once per week.

greetings: My mother's antique platter! Thank you so much!
I never thought I'd see this again! You have my thanks!
Look, it's the old goblet I remember so well! Thank you for bringing it back to me!
I always hated this bowl. But my mother loved it, bless her heart. It will make a great addition to our little memorial. Thank you.
This wedding band belonged to the mother of my good friend Hardunna. She'll be thrilled to have this back!
Hardunna and I use to "borrow" this candlestick to go roaming about at night. Ah, those were innocent days.
Hardunna's mother would ring this bell to call us in to dinner. Thank you so much for bringing it back to us!
Hardunna's father, Roland, brought this with him from Ispar. He gave it to Hope, his wife, when they met. I am so glad to have this for our museum. You have my sincere thanks.
You know, since you've been so helpful to me, perhaps you could also help Flinrala. She doesn't talk about it much, but she still grieves for her father, Brogord. He died defending the Redoubt.
