One of his axes is rumored to be in the Cave of Alabree, a bit west of here. Perhaps you could go and take a look? Bring anything you find back to Flinrala - I'm sure she'll be happy to have it.
Here, here are the directions. Wilomine also sells them, in case you lose those.
I'd appreciate your help recovering some items from the old Redoubt.
My parents were killed there when I was but a boy, when Holtburg was overrun with Tumeroks. I was saved, whisked away by the mage Celcynd at my parents' behest.

The Redoubt is directly south of here. We put up an eternal flame at the site, in memory of all the townsfolk who died. Some of us are also trying to get together an exhibit to honor our parents. For instance, my mother had these heirloom dishes she was always polishing. She loved those dishes ...
Anyway, if you could recover any of these items for our exhibit, I will reward you as well as I can.
If you need more help getting to the Redoubt, you can buy directions from Wilomine at the bar.
quest: You found it! Quick, take this to Flinrala! I'm sure she'll be thrilled to have it!
I believe that Alfrin was looking for this! Why don't you try taking it to him?
Flinrala is always talking about this type of thing. Why don't you show this to her?

greetings: Here is the book that Martine wanted me to give you.  If you see him, make sure he knows I did what he required!
I think it's time I moved out of Arwic soon.  There are too many unsavory types around.

Hope you enjoyed you trip through the Tusker Emporium of Deadly Doom. You look thirsty- care for a refreshing umbrella drink? Why not take home a memento of you visit here? I sell a fine assortment of quality merchandise.
Looks like you had fun down here. Why not take home a souvenir T-shirt of your exciting visit to Tusker Island?
So, you survived the trip through the Tusker Emporium of Deadly Doom. You should get a plaque that says so!
The way out of here is that way. Or you could run back up.
Remember, the tables are for paying customers only!
Okay, I guess I'll take it.
I've got lots of other stuff.
Great, thanks. Move along or buy more.
chatter: I have turned over a new leaf!
That Martine isn't around is he?
I want my mommy.

greetings: Thank you.  Here is your reward.

Hello.  Myself and my brothers-in-arms have been assigned to exchange gifts with those that donate undead trophies to the Shagar Zharalim.  We were not expecting the plethora of trophies we have received, so we have adjusted our prizes accordingly.
It seems that the Reavers that plagued us in our ancestral lands are here to plague us as well.  Beware the Dune Reavers, for they are dangerous.

Recently the Zharalim have uncovered lore that enables us to make magical arrows.  If you trade me a mnemosyne fragment, I will be more than happy to grant you some arrowheads. You'll have to assemble them yourself though.  You'll need a bow like mine to use them.
You have recovered my yaoji! Thank you so much!
I never thought I'd see this again! You have my thanks!
The mosswarts love to throw these for some reason. Thank you for bringing this one back to me!
Ah, my favorite katar. Thank you.
Bai Den will be thrilled to have this back! Thank you!
This is Bai Den's favorite bracelet. Those mosswarts keep stealing it - perhaps because it glitters so.
Bai Den was given this ring by his mother. It has great sentimental value to him. Thank you so much for bringing it back to us!
You have our sincere thanks for returning this to us.

Since you've been so kind as to help us, perhaps you could also help our friend Nen Ai. She lives just outside Shoushi, a bit further down the southwest road than the Braid Mansion Ruin you were just at.
Nen Ai has a pet drudge. She has some trouble keeping it fed, however - it has a delicate constitution. Perhaps you could visit her and see if you could help?
Here are the directions to Nen Ai's house. Nin Hong also sells these directions.
Those thieving mosswarts have made off with my yaoji again! And this time they took several other items belonging to myself and my partner Bai Den as well!
Here is a list of the items that are missing. Will you go to the Braid Mansion Ruin, along the road that leaves town to the southwest, and recover our things for us? We would be very grateful.
If you need more help finding the Braid Mansion Ruin, you can buy directions from Nin Hong at the bar.
quest: I believe that Nen Ai, in her house along the southwest road,  was looking for this! Why don't you try taking it to her?
That's some stone you have there. Oi-Tong Ye collects these, I believe - why don't you show it to him?
Oi-Tong Ye is always talking about this type of thing. Why don't you show this to him?

greetings: Where did you find this? It certainly isn't mine! Why are you giving this to me?
My Goodness...look at the time, must be going, bye!
Shurov Thiloi!
quest: The "reformed" bandit has an extremely guilty look on his face. He even looks as if he might run for the hills.
Look! Behind you! Is that the white bunny?!
Shurov Thiloi!

Greetings, stranger. I've done many things to be ashamed of in the past, but I've come here to make a new start near the fair town of Holtburg. I enjoy the peace and quiet of these parts. Would you mind if I asked you to be on your way? I am entertaining some important guests, and I don't want them to be disturbed.

greetings: No! You keep that! I made it for you.
Yes! This is the stuff! I have more than enough to keep my calm for months to come, but I can make some tea for you out of this!
Samuel produces a mortar and pestle and quickly crushes the charred bits of marrow and then stirs the powder into a mug of heated rum.
There you go! One sip of this stuff and you'll forget about all those things that trouble your dreams!
If only...if only I had resigned before this. But now, those things, that place...the things I saw. They'll stay with me forever.
I'll drown them out! I swear I will.
I'm not a coward. You hear me!?
The horror...the horror...
The island - the Virindi came there. They took it over, drove the shadows away, for the most part. They reconstructed the island in their image.
Or so they thought.
Samuel manages a meek smile.
Sit?
You see. The Virindi thought that they could take the island over and cleanse it. They thought that they were more powerful than whatever force controls that place.  But they weren't, you see?
They've been there quite a while now, or they were. They're not there anymore, not the normal Virindi. The twisted ones...they're still there.
Samuel's voice becomes low and takes on a surreal quality.
...and so are his spawn. The spawn of the -
No, no. I don't serve as a Royal Guard anymore. If the High Queen wants the uniform back she can come pry it off of my cold corpse. I'm owed! I saw those things. Those horrific creatures.

It has been so many months since that nightmare of an island changed. So many months, but the horrors are still fresh in my mind. I see the shadow in everything now. More than once has a hen stirred me to fright.
Fortunately, I have found something to help me cope with my fears. Oddly enough, this remedy came directly from the Singularity Caul itself.

Before I left that place, I came across some odd things, maybe mineral deposits, maybe the bones of some long dead creature, I do not know. All I know is steeping the stuff in hot water and cutting with rum has done wonders for my nerves.
If you find anything like that on the Caul, you know - charred bones of some sort - bring them to me and I'll brew you up some of this wonder drink as well!
A few years back - you see? A few years back, this island was found. Apparently, Monarchs had gone there before Bael'zharon walked the world, as a test. Something like that-

This island...it was the home of nothing, but that was not the truth. Beneath the land, shadows lived, multiplied and schemed to take the world for their own. With their master destroyed, driven away and imprisoned by our forces and Asheron -
But he's gone now - you see? He's gone and she drove him off...and now - these things.
Samuel seems to slur his words.
I was once Sam the brave, Sam the Cruel...now look at me. I'm Sam the can't even keep his gruel down.
Mandible turns the grub inside out and prepares a delicacy with practiced skill.
Ooo hah! Grub bite! Have one!

Yeah that's right we tear 'em up.  Never did find no way outa here though. Portal disappeared, got us trapped way back when. We got good at fightin' the bugs. There's more of the bugs now, though. Guess you got down here in your fancy armor. Well, maybe you ain't leavin' either.  Maybe we ain't leavin' too.  Kinda cozy down here.
Ooo hah! I love the smell of burnin' chitin in the morning. But down here ya never know when it's morning.

Yeah, I'm tough but I sure like to eat grub bites. Nothin' better than grub bites. 'cept maybe the foot races we used to have back home. Those was fun. Here we just run from bugs. But then we turn and ambush 'em. Yeah that's right we tear 'em up.
%n hiccups.
Me thanks.
Whatcha trying ta do, kill me!?
Not bad, but leaves me through dry.
AIEEE!!!!!
Hey!  This is good stuff.  Say, givya a tip.  Yas best stay away from dem mines to the south of here.  They make ya crazy like me.
The stranger couldn't possibly look guiltier.
Why are you giving this to me? I don't know what this is, and I don't want it either. Take it back--I'll have nothing to do with it.
This note couldn't be for me--you see, I'm not a farmer.
quest: The stranger nearly jumps out of his shoes.
You're...you're back? Oh my! I didn't expect you to...they were supposed to take care of...so, you survived! Good for you! Now, if you'll excuse me, I have some chores to do.

Greetings, my friend, greetings! Welcome to my humble home. The hurly-burly of Marae Lassel proved too much for me, so I've decided to move here and call Yaraq home. Blend in. Make some friends among the peaceful townsfolk. In fact, I've made a good friend over in the Darkened Halls. He's recently moved here too. Why don't you pay him a visit as well? I'm sure he'd be happy to meet you and make...
I will stay and help fight the Olthoi if you could deliver the note.

You found us! Did the High Queen send you? We came across this group of Olthoi fighters and decided to stay and help them keep the Olthoi at bay.  All the portals in the deepened lairs appeared to lead to these catacombs.  Perhaps the Olthoi are re-grouping!
Please deliver this note to one of the Queen's Royal Guard.

greetings: A wise decision -- one I may ask you to make again sometime.  For now however, I will make good on the promise of advice, with a little bit of secret information thrown in for free.  Consider it another gift, heh.
The advice:  "Always seek to gain advantage when your enemy is involved; double the advantage when the enemy is a friend."
And now, the information.  I suggest you keep this to yourself, lest we end up with every arch mage and their vassal running around this place like gromnies with their heads cut off.
I know of a well-hidden complex of deep tunnels called the Elemental Caverns.  You look like you get around, so I'm sure these directions will be quite easy for you.

In the southern Direlands, there is a dungeon called the Lightless Catacombs.  It is here that a winding valley begins, running westward.  Head west through the valley until you reach two small in ground structures.  One filled with undead, the other housing a portal to Zaikhal.
Nearby, you will find a steep slope that will take you to the top of the mountains.  You will find the entrance to the caverns in the rocky peaks.
I can move with complete invisibility, using no magic trick or power.  I use only skill to move unseen, or to strike, or to evade the onslaught of war magic -- you do know what skill is, aye?
I have learned the deadly and secret arts from Dereth's greatest assassin -- so do watch your back, please.
If you are stealthy enough, you can sneak right up to a banderling who is too busy looking around nervously to notice -- sadly, I have not found this to be the case with dancing drudges.

Well, you do seem to be pretty wealthy, and this is broad daylight, after all -- so how's about you consider loaning me one of those crisp new 250,000 pyreal notes?  Consider it payment for the two gifts I am giving you:  Protection from imminent danger, and a bit of advice to be imparted upon payment.
Should've stayed in Arwic...
You are truly bold.  Let us see how fortunate you are...
You are a daring gambler, I see!  And let us see now how you fare...
You wish to gamble the Golden Gromnie?  The Golden Gromnie is the most fabulous prize offered here!  Come back when you have regained your senses, friend!
Mi grumbles under her breath. You make out a few words, "...stupid Ketnan." She smiles and adjusts her vest.
I don't know why I let myself get talked into this by Ketnan, but here goes. Round and round it goes!

Welcome to my house of chance, now in a much more propitious location!  Will the Great Lady of Chance and Possibility favor you?  Haya Su Ka sells our rulebook and gambling tokens.  My Gamemasters will happily assist you in your quest to gamble tokens.  If you wish to risk one of your precious Pack Monsters, gamble with me, if you feel lucky.

I grieve for proud Ayan Baqur.  I was not strong enough to defend it from the waves of cloaked fiends.  I have tried to locate my people... I think the Virindi are holding them in an underground complex to the east of town.  I am not strong enough to rescue them myself... Please, friend, do what you can to help them.
It is good to be home.  I have the deepest gratitude for the heroes who reclaimed my town from the Virindi.
You are a daring gambler, I see!  And let us see now how you fare...
The Golden Gromnie is the most sought-after prize in all the gambling dens!  Surely you did not mean to try and gamble this away...
Arshid grumbles under his breath. You make out a few words, "...stupid Ketnan." He smiles and adjusts his vest.
I don't know why I let myself get talked into this by Ketnan, but here goes. Round and round it goes!

Enter and be welcome to my lavish new place of business.  I am Arshid, the master of the halls of fortune.  My assistant Ashadi sells a book of rules and tokens for gambling.  Are you favored by the Mistress of Fate?  Try and see!  Buy tokens and try your luck with one of my Gamesmasters!  Or if you feel especially daring, gamble one of your Pack Monsters with me for especially rich prizes!

Just between you and me, but are you seeking entry into the Folthid Cellar?  My studies hint of a very fine dagger within it, of ancient origin.  Beware; it may be guarded, and my heart tells me of treacherous danger within.

Also, you will not be able to give it away once you have it; you can only sell it.  To get in to the dungeon, you will need to convince Lady Folthid to give you the key.  Try giving her a wood heart from a golem.
Ah, I do not drink, but thank you.  I can offer nothing in exchange but some information.
Have you heard the word Falatacot?  It has something to do with Dericost, which Alatar Locke thinks was once a powerful, evil Empyrean kingdom.  I hope to learn more someday!
I am in the employ of Lady Folthid.
If you could spare me some blank parchment, I will be very grateful.  I am studying in my spare time, and I need the parchment.

Ahh, I've been waiting for these. Not long mind you. The Lugians are very prompt in their delivery, nothing at all like the vermin I'm used to working with back on Ispar. Never mind the dogs living here on Dereth. This be for Captain K'rank.
Tell 'im that I'm willing to continue this advantageous relationship, so long as he's willing to keep supplying me with these herbs.

Arrr, and welcome to MacNiall's Freehold. Have ye seen them funny statue things the Mosswarts like to worship? I thinks their eyes is kinda pretty. Bring me one, and I'll see what I can do to reward ye.
quest: Errukh, look at the sparkle! Look, youngster, I'll give ye this note for my cousin MacDugal. I hear tell he's taken up residence with our old gang at some place called the Bandit Castle. Bring this note to him, and he'll reward ye right.
Oi mucker, I've already given ye the note to pass on to MacDugal! Don't tell me ye've lost it! Take this bauble back too, simpleton!
chatter: Bloody Pwyll-worshipping lackeys...
Don't believe what the townies on the other island tell ye, the bunch of bleating sheep that they are... Hrm. It's been a while since I seen a sheep.
Well, Jourgensson says you're all right.  Maybe you can help.  Down underneath the castle, there's a prison full of beasties.  That idiot Gwillim dropped some notes and his bag in there.
Now he says he can't mix potions!  Bring the bag back to him, and he'll reward you.  You'll need this to get in there.

quest: Why yes, I do know Tamian Wilmit. I met him when I was travelling through Rithwic.  Then he came here not too long ago. He seemed unhappy, and driven.  His goal is to find an Empyrean structure that I had shown him evidence of, a sketch I let him have while staying with his family. He did some research while he was here but did not speak much to me about it.

He left me a sealed copy of his journal in case someone came by looking for him.  I think you are not the person he imagined may show up but I believe I should let you have it. He went to look for this structure. He went west.
Hello. I study manuscripts and historical items.

greetings: Thank you for helping a poor begger...

There's a strange rumor about an underground temple in the Direlands that's oddly similar to one in Osteth, near the Sho area.  They say some ancient race of Empyrean must have made them.  But who'd want to live in a swamp?
Thank you, kind soul!
%n kisses your hand in appreciation.

I heard the tumeroks surrounding Dryreach are from the swamp area of the Direlands.  The main swamp in the Direlands is on the eastern shore, but there are apparently swampy areas elsewhere in there, too.
May Asheron keep you from harm.
You are very kind...
Have you heard the name Bael'Zharon?  I keep hearing it on the wind, and it every time it makes me shudder!
Poor Dansha-Ki. She's gotten herself captured by Tumeroks again. Her sister, Yu Vuo-Ki, knows the details. I think Yu Vuo-Ki sometimes wanders the land to the northwest.
Thank you stranger! I can get a good meal and a hot bath with this!
The snake sighs and uncoils from the coin.
"You have lifted the curse. Finally, I may rest." The small snake coils in on itself biting its tail.
Here, a small token of my gratitude.
I don't want to beg, but I need money to buy food with.
chatter: I don't want to beg, but I need some money.

greetings: The big man does not speak, only looks at you with eyes that seem no longer human.
Itala falls before %s's assault as she fought, silently.
Itala glances at Adroth and murmurs, "I told you those boots of yours would give away our position."
Itala winces as she receives %s's telling blow!
This is a dangerous place...
Be careful.

quest: You think, "The man looked me over with a hint of malice in his eye. I'd seen that look before. His type only respected strength. I showed him I meant business."
You think, "He saw things my way. All brawn and no brain. He reminded me of a shreth, charging forward not realizing that it looks a lot tougher than it really is."

You think, "I started to think back over the mistakes that I made getting to this point. The first was thinking that I was getting past this guy. He wasn't an overly large man, more or less my size, really. But he was irascible, kept saying something about only bandits can get in the treasure room. I was a prisoner it appeared...gee thanks for the update big man. Guess he didn't get the memo th...
You think, "I tried to calm him down..."
You think, "It didn't help. He was swinging and there was nothing that I could do about it."
You think, "The world was spinning again. I knew where I'd end up. The bandits had their orders. I was being kept alive for some purpose. I'd find myself back in the cage..."

greetings: Let's see what the Mistress of Fate has in store for you!
This table is only for the red tokens.  If you are not rich enough for these stakes, try one of the lesser tables.
You've made a mistake, friend.  This token is only for use at Monty's Den of Iniquity, in the Aluvian lands.
You've made a mistake, friend.  This token is only for use at Gan-Zo's Den of Iniquity, in the Sho lands.
This token is only for use at Gan-Zo's Den of Iniquity, in the Sho lands.
This is the high stakes table.  Give me a red token to try your chances!
Nope, that's not the stuff I like. I like my drink simple and not all snooty-like.
Shreth piss. Look kid, get me somethin' else.
Look, I don't like the stout. Don't bring me stout, cause I don't like it.
Do you get my meanings that I'm makin' here? Heh?
Jeez, what a meathead!
I leave all the hoity toity drinkin' to that fool over der in that fort. There's a dumb place to go for a drink! Dry-somtin-or-other wasn't it?
Look, I'm thirsty, get me somethin' to drink, will ya?
What is this?! Are you just gonna stand there jabbin' me in the side all day? Huh?
Why don't you make yourself useful? Go tell that unpleasant guy that we ain't comin' back. No how, no way.
quest: You ain't to bright are you? Look I've told you all I know. If I knew somethin I'd have already told you by now. Go talk to that there fancy boy in the desert. He thinks he knows everything.
Ulgrim stirs the beer with a bit of wood and tosses it aside.
Aw, now look what you gone and done. Now I realize that I'm thirsty here. Bring me another will ya?
See what I've done der? I've made it so this cup is empty. There should be beer there, but there's not. Heh?
Hey, hey, watch the personal space there friend. I'm not one of those support mages! I keep my wand in my pocket, thank you very much.
What's with all these lugians in our towns. Don't get me wrong, they deserve all the freedoms and stuff, but just not around here.
Do you smell something?
Phew! You should think about taking a bath there.
Cheers!

greetings: What is this? This is the left tusk, it's hollow. I cannot use this. It has no value on this island.
Excellent work. Of course this is one of the lowliest of the tuskers, but you were brave and showed your dedication to my cause.
Take these. If you want I can change your title to be more indicative of your rank within the resistance. All you need do is hand the token back.
The portal gem will get you back here quickly, until you steal the scroll from the clutches of the mighty Bobo.
Excellent work. Of course this is the lowliest of the tuskers, but you did show your dedication to my cause.
Masterful. The Crimsonback can be quite ferocious you've done more than you know.
Striking down a Goldenback is no easy feat as I am sure you know. With enough people like you around we'll have this madhouse cleared of the Tuskers in no time.
Yes! Finally getting some breathing space. I've been alone here for so long that I'd begun to think that no one would ever come to help.
Bobo, says that these tuskers are heroes because they have helped to free so many of their brethren. But what about us? We're not free. But thanks to your efforts we will be someday.
Serves them right. You've done wonders here. Killing a mighty slave. You are rising quickly through the ranks.
Dispatched a guard, worthy of song back on Ispar if you ask me. I'd sing but the tuskers would know that I recovered from my head wound.
You found a weak spot in his armor. Well fought. I'm glad you made it back to me safely. Now let's get on with business there are more of these brutal foes to be crushed.
Silvers are deadly. You're getting to be a regular hero. The resistance owes you a debt.
But their armor is so strong, how did you ever? Better not to question, you succeeded and that is good enough for me.
Now we're starting to see who the men and women are. Your efforts are applauded through the entire organization.
I keep forgetting I am the organization.
These are the first of the real ring leaders. I hate these damn dirty tuskers, but not as much as the fabled...we'll leave that alone. My thanks.

Now bring me the head of Bobo! Never mind that he calls himself Oolutanga. His minions and Tusker allies can't say that name -- it's too long, has too many vowels. Don't you see? They don't have opposable thumbs! We should be the superior race! We should be ruling them! Don't you get it?
Sorry, I lost it there a little.
Here you go.
So when you bringing me to the mainland?
Is it pretty on the mainland? You know calm, no tuskers, people think life is grand?
So you said something about the mainland and me getting to go there someday, right?
Yeah I heard about this place where people get respect even if they are a little off kilter, something about some guy named Martine, you're not from there are you?
So I was thinking maybe you should talk to some friends see if they'll take me in. Or maybe you have a cottage, I can be quiet you know.
Maybe you should to talk to Bobo. Give him a tusker husk for me.
What do you mean, well maybe you should wear a tusker mask...
It's people! Mushed nanners is people!
It gets very lonely out here. I've had a lot of time to myself.
Where did you find this?
You point to the west, towards the place where you found the body.
Along the shore you say? Let me examine this note a little more closely.
Brighteyes studies the scrap of paper given to him.
You are lucky I have learned about their strange methods of communication, otherwise I don't think there'd be an Isparian alive who could translate this.
It seems this particular fellow was taken "below" and given...uh...great power.
And somehow it...ah...opened his mind -- see here, it is indicated with the symbol they use for light.
And here, the symbol for...fighting or war, I think.  It is repeated over and over - I am not sure why.
I'm afraid I can't figure out much else -- however I am quite concerned with this "enlightened" sycophant.  A revolution among the enslaved masses of these islands would be my dream come true!
It would seem as though he was escaping from somewhere "below," on the large island to the west.
Possibly the Tusker Assault lair?  I have heard that subterranean complex is teeming with the beasts and their thralls.
The head of the Painbringer -- I have never heard of such a beast before!
You say you found this vile creature within the Assault lair?
I wonder...is it possible that blasted tusker king has His paw in this new evil?  More powerful minions is not the kind of revolution I had in mind!
Well it isn't much, but...here, take this --
'Tis a bit crude -- but what would you expect?
Brighteyes leans towards you and whispers, "Dammit %s! I'm a tailor, not a weaponsmith!"
This should show everyone who the real champion of Aphus Lassel is!
quest: Have you brought me proof that your fighting against the tuskers? If so, hand it over so I can give you your reward. But be discreet, they may not understand Roulean but they know when something is up.
I'm Brighteyes. I can't remember my real name. That fool of a Tusker walloped me over the head real good when I arrived here.
I was immediately grabbed after walking through one of those purple swirling portals on Ispar. One of the big walking rugs here grabbed me.
I said, 'Get your hands off me you damn dirty...' then Wunk! A big stone caps me on the head.
They did it to everyone that came here. No people come here anymore though. Stopped about a year ago.
I am the leader and only member of the human resistance here in this world gone mad. If you bring me proof that you're fighting against these...these...tuskers. I will reward you.
Give me one of their tusks and I'll be sure to reward you well.
chatter: Ooo...ooo...eee...aaa...aaa.
Brighteyes looks around nervously.
I have to keep up appearances that I'm just like the other humans here or else they'll cage and collar me.
The Burun Kukuur, Reeshan, has found a way to transfer his girth to an undiscovered area of Izji Qo's temple. His presence can be felt within the temple, but his whereabouts are unknown.
A massive wave of magic swells from beneath the surface of the world in the vicinity of Izji Qo's temple. The Burun King, Reeshan, has surfaced once again!
A massive wave of magic pulses out from Ixir Zi's  temple in the Blackmire Swamp. A second Burun King has found his way to Dereth!

A chain of magical explosions seer the desert sands near Fadsahil's shop. Somewhere in the depths of Liazk Itzi's temple another Burun King has forced his way through the portal and arrived on Dereth!
In the depths of Hizk Ri's temple, a great magic is unleashed. Waves of mana pound the surrounding area, as another Burun King has forced his way onto Dereth!
Kivik Lir's temple is briefly surrounded in a corona of magical energy. Deep within the temple another Burun King has crossed the vast divide!

Off the western shore of the Direlands a soft pulse of energy forms. The energy steadily grows until it crashes into the ocean waters and reveals a partially exhumed temple in the sands. An assault of mana pounds the western surf and then becomes silent. Residents at Ayan Baqur are taken aback at the appearance of a spectral being.

greetings: Let's see what the Mistress of Fate has in store for you!
This table is only for the green tokens.  Try one of the higher stakes tables.
You've made a mistake, friend.  This token is only for use at Monty's Den of Iniquity, in the Aluvian lands.
You've made a mistake, friend.  This token is only for use at Gan-Zo's Den of Iniquity, in the Sho lands.
This token is only for use at Gan-Zo's Den of Iniquity, in the Sho lands.
This is the low stakes table.  Give me a green token to try your chances!
This is not a complete Symbol of Marriage. Please find the other symbols, combine them, and return to me the Symbol of Marriage.
To begin the marriage ceremony, you must first hand me the Symbol of Marriage. If you are in search of the Symbol, a series of tests await you near Arwic.
It gives me great joy knowing those I join in union go forth to make this land a happier and healthier place to be.
quest: You have visited me too recently.  Please reconsider your vows and reread the Wedding Handbook.
Welcome, friends and family! Let us begin the ceremony of Marriage!

You have come here today to demonstrate your commitment to one another.  You come bearing the Symbol of Marriage as proof of that commitment.  I accept this Symbol as a your vow that you agree to love, cherish and honor your spouse for all your time here in Dereth.

You have made your vows under the Symbol of that which you hold important.  Before the witnesses of your friends and family, I now pronounce this union to be made.  There is one last step you must take to make this union complete.
May your marriage bring you great happiness. You should take the time to inscribe the Emblem of Marriage with words that show your commitment to your spouse, then present them.

You who stand here as witnesses are the friends and family of those seeking our blessings today.  You are charged with the task of helping them in their new role of marriage, to support them in their times of need, and to do all that you can to make their marriage a blessed and happy union.
Use this Promise Gem as a final demonstration of your love.  When used, the of Marriage becomes complete.

greetings: You hear faint cackling as a man laughs about his claim.
I warned you against jumping my claim!  Now don't come back, ya hear?!?
Get off my land!
Remember, you didn't get this from me...
Listen, I just "acquired" the Seal of Dericost. It's yours if you can part with any trade note worth 10,000 pyreals.
chatter: Hey, I have something you might want...

greetings: Greetings.
You have no soul.
quest: Aino's eyes light up at the sight of the geode.
Ah. A precious thing indeed.
She produces a few jeweler's tools and reworks the stone, chanting obscure spells to herself as she works. Soon, she hands back a fine gem.
My apologies. It would be unsafe for you to take another Impulse Gem at this time. The minimum period for handling another is one week.

greetings: This is beneath my capabilities. Take it back.
A powerful gem, but only barely worth my attention. Here is a shield for you. Be very careful with it, as it is quite valuable and irreplaceable. You will never find its like again.
A noteworthy gem indeed. Here is a powerful shield imbued with its essence. Be careful. This shield is unique and cannot be replaced.

A gem of unmatched power! I salute your ability. Take this shield to protect yourself in battle, worthy warrior. But take heed, there will never be another shield equal to this. It cannot be replaced! So as it protects you, so must you protect it.
Impressive achievement, finding this gem. Allow me to infuse a shield with its essence. Take good care of this shield, as I doubt you will be able to find another such gem.
A worthy gem. It allows me to craft a powerful shield. May this shield protect you well in the days ahead. But take care with it! It will not be easily replaced!
Most impressive. This gem allows me to craft a shield of exceptional power. Wear it proudly in battle. But all worthy things are rare... So take care not to lose this shield!
This old thing? Why, I can make it so much better for you.

Greetings. My siblings and I traveled here seeking gems of great power. I hear that there are some master armorers who craft suits of armor from fused gems. Those are beneath my notice. Bring me something even more powerful than a scintillating gem, and I will craft a great and unique shield for you. If you have one of my old shields, I will improve it for you.
Nearby, hidden amidst the swamp trees to the east, is the deserted ruin where some lived before Yanshi was founded.  Follow the gaze of the statues.

Unless you have lockpicking or a friend who has the skill, you will need this key once inside. If you recover one of the writings of Jhong Mi and take it to Scholar Dai Ya in Yanshi, he will reward you and give you more information.
Greetings.

Ahhh....fascinating.  I believe this is a part of a rare Ceremonial Weapon, highly prized by Banderling tribes.  For what reason, no one knows; it's the cutting edge of Banderling Studies.  If only you had the shaft as well.  The last I heard it was in a banderling dungeon far west from Sawato.

What a find!  This is the shaft of a unique Banderling Ceremonial Weapon.  They use it in many of their tribal rituals, although for unknown purposes.  If you can find the head of this weapon, and then find a way to reattach the weapon, I would be most interested! Please come see me!  The last I heard the head was in some sort of Maze a ways off east from Uziz.

My word, I am speechless!  Well, not speechless, but certainly amazed!  This is the first Banderling Ceremonial Weapon we have found intact.  I must send this on to the Society at once.  There may even be an Explorership in it for me. In return for this artifact, let me present to you this quality weapon.  It will serve you in good stead for much of your adventuring career.

Oh my.  This is certainly distressing.  But tremendously exciting.  I almost envy him!  To be able to observe them this closely...I, too, have never heard of Banderlings and Mosswarts coming to blows.  I shall have to further ponder what this means.  And I will have to forward this news on to the Society.  If you come across any further word of the whereabouts of Sir Martine, I would be most de...

Well, this explains everything!  Well, not everything.  But it is a start!  I can only surmise that Sir Martine's thoughts on the matter are correct.  A Banderling Ceremonial Weapon!  I am most amazed.  If I could get my hand on such a weapon, it would be an invaluable find!  I wonder what is behind all these machinations.  Is it possible the Mosswarts are acting on their own?  Strange are the...
My heart is heavy.  May Pwyll protect him.  I do not know how to proceed from here.
I do not know what to say.  Whomever this person is writing these, it is certainly not the man I knew as Sir Candeth Martine.  I pray for his soul.
Disgusting.  Why do you engage in such senseless slaughter of these fascinating creatures?  Here, take this back.  I want nothing to do with it.
You are profiting off of the death of innocent creatures!  Away with you!
You beast!  Faugh!  I have no desire to do anything with you!  Get out of here.  We must study these creatures, not kill them!
Hello! If you journey to the Banderling Conquest dungeon far west from Sawato, and bring me back the mace shaft, I may be able to give you some more information.
If you come across any strange Banderling artifacts, please come see me at once.  I am an avid Banderling hobbyist.  And please, no Banderling scalps!  I want to study these creatures, not kill them!
Poor Sir Martine.  I fear the worst.
I'm not looking for these right now.  Perhaps Merlonna over in Bluespire could help you.
Thanks, but this is not quite what I'm looking for.
The last time I was in Greenspire, Shalon told me that he was interested in these.
The last time I was over in Greenspire, Shalon told me that he was interested in these.
This is not quite what I was looking for.
Try asking around for Riketura in Ahurenga. I haven't been there myself, but others have told me interesting tales.
This certainly isn't of Isparian craftmanship.
I think there's someone on the island who can craft this into a weapon.  It isn't an Isparian specialty--perhaps you should try Ahurenga.
This...thing probably has fleas.
Please, take this away.
Interesting trophy...you might be able to make a good backscracher out of it.
No thanks.
I did not ask for feathers.
Take these away...I think I'm allergic to them.
This bag has nothing in it!
I'm no fool, you know.
I didn't know one could find these here on the island.  Nonetheless, there is no room for this in my collection.
Merlonna will be so jealous of my growing collection! Here, take these health potions with my thanks.
Merlonna will be so jealous of my growing collection! Here, take this with my thanks.
If you were to bring me Carenzi Sentry pelts, Tidal Siraluun claws, Drudge charms, or Water Golem hearts, I will reward you with experience.
chatter: Soon my collection will be the envy of all!
Those golems certainly are fierce! I'm putting out a small bounty for Water Golem hearts--I was nearly drowned by one the other day.

Merlonna, Shalon, and I all collect trophies from Carenzis, Siraluuns, and Golems. I even think there might be a Tumerok collector over in their town, Ahurenga. Good thing we're all looking for different variants--otherwise we'd be brawling in the streets!
I'll reward you for Carenzi pelts, Siraluun claws, Drudge charms, and Golem hearts--but only specific kinds.

greetings: My thanks. Some years ago, when the Gharu'n were just arriving here, the young noble Musansayn the Great became the first leader of our people in Dereth, and founded Samsur.  He later disappeared into the desert.
This key will open the door to his famed library.  Follow the road leading southeast - you will see his house off to your left.  If you can find any book remaining there, bring it back to me.
Ah, a fragment of the great work of Khaymahlai.  The historians of Zaikhal must have missed this when they carried off the rest of Musansayn's collection.
The merchant Lubziklan al-Luq will pay well for this.  He wishes his daughter to learn the history of the Gharu'n in Ispar.
If you have time, you might also want to talk to Saqat at the East Outpost. I hear he was looking for someone to help him with a small task.
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Hey, looks like it got rolled in the mud... Anyway, well done!  Here, take these as a reward.
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Looks like good old F.P. went swimming or something.  Here's your reward.
Looks like you've lucked out!  Our man F.P. has finished his book, finally!  Here you go...

I have been contracted by the Dereth Exploration Society to help them in their outreach program towards the Isparians who find themselves newly exiled in Dereth.  Here is a book that explains their mission.  I am also giving you a list describing the locations of the nearest stamp and portals to other towns.  If you collect any of the Society's stamped letters, you may bring them back to me for...

Also, have you a moment to help me recover another item?  Some years ago, when the Gharu'n were just arriving here, the young noble Musansayn the Great became the first leader of our people in Dereth, and founded Samsur.  He later disappeared into the desert.
quest: You must stamp this with a Town Stamp to get a reward.  Please read your Book of Quests to find out how to get a Stamp.
No, this is for you to stamp the letters you find.  Please keep it.
Thank you, you must have journeyed far to get here.  You are a true Explorer!

You will get nothing from me for this. Go explore and find more towns.  The Society Agents in the Sho towns will exchange a piece of jewelry or a wand for this. If you take this to one of the Aluvian towns, you will receive a piece of armor.

greetings: This is not a complete Symbol of Marriage. Please find the other symbols, combine them, and return to me the Symbol of Marriage.
To begin the marriage ceremony, you must first hand me the Symbol of Marriage. If you are in search of the Symbol, a series of tests await you near Arwic.
It gives me great joy knowing those I join in union go forth to make this land a happier and healthier place to be.
quest: You have visited me too recently.  Please reconsider your vows and reread the Wedding Handbook.
Welcome, friends and family! Let us begin the ceremony of Marriage!

You have come here today to demonstrate your commitment to one another.  You come bearing the Symbol of Marriage as proof of that commitment.  I accept this Symbol as a your vow that you agree to love, cherish and honor your spouse for all your time here in Dereth.

You have made your vows under the Symbol of that which you hold important.  Before the witnesses of your friends and family, I now pronounce this union to be made.  There is one last step you must take to make this union complete.
May your marriage bring you great happiness. You should take the time to inscribe the Emblem of Marriage with words that show your commitment to your spouse, then present them.

You who stand here as witnesses are the friends and family of those seeking our blessings today.  You are charged with the task of helping them in their new role of marriage, to support them in their times of need, and to do all that you can to make their marriage a blessed and happy union.
Use this Promise Gem as a final demonstration of your love.  When used, the of Marriage becomes complete.

greetings: I remember these. Martine was working on these before he left. He said that they would be some of the best gauntlets that this world would ever see. Now what was it that he said about them...
Ah yes! He said that with the right insignia, we'd be able to infuse the gauntlets with a fairly potent cantrip.

Also, in an effort to make a name for themselves, the Apprentice Mask Crafters in Sawato, Al Jalima, and Eastham have devised ways to bring out some of the facetted colors of Sunstone. Unfortunately, they still aren't up to the level of mastery they need in order to go into business on thier own.

While I am far too busy providing my services here in our small retreat, I am confident that Pagrok in Candeth Keep can restore your gauntlets to their original luster should they be damaged by the hands of the apprentices.
These are made with the same process as the more potent gauntlets, but they lacked the setting for the amulet. This doesn't make them useless, but makes them less desirable.
One moment please.  The success of choritize distillation relies on steady hands and a clear mind.
All done, here is one flask of chorizite formula, as promised, and a copy of my notes.
Be sure to read the notes I gave you - and remember, the formula is new and largely untested.  More research will be needed to fully understand its properties.
Ah, a visitor!  It is so nice to see a new face around here, especially now that my spirits have been lifted.  I must tell you of my newest findings.
I have been working on a distillation process that transforms chorizite ore into a viscous formula capable of absorbing magical damage.
If you have the inclination, bring me a small amount of the highest quality refined chorizite available, and I will reward you with one application of the formula, and my notes.
The horn of a Fire Auroch, eh? These beasts are impressive, but very slow, which makes them easy to kill. Here, I have carved the horn into a shape suitable for use in a composite bow
Great Mattekars are worthy prey. Take this piece of carved horn. With it you may make a strong weapon.
This is not of flesh and blood. Perhaps someone with a more mechanical mind would be able to do something with it. Ask Barnar the Tinker.

Have you read my work on composite bows? I gave some to my ivory crafter associates. I can help you by carving pieces of horn to go into the bow's stave. If you are interested in crossbows, talk to my friend, Barnar the Tinker.
You've got a very serviceable fishing pole there. I wouldn't try catching large fish with it, but it's a perfect beginner's pole.
Bring me a Golem Jo or Wood Golem Heart and I'll assemble your fishing pole. Hope to see you fishing soon.
You're giving your heart to me? Bwahaha, just joking, this should make a nice pole. I'll just carve it and assemble your fishing pole. Wait here a moment.

There you go. The string part with the hook goes into the water and you hold onto the stick part. I can't tell you how many beginner fisherman just toss the whole thing into the water. Of course they always claim they lost it to some huge whale or something.
Oh, you found one! Nice length, good flex, aye this will do nicely. One moment while I assemble your fishing pole.
There you go. You'll want to watch out for that hook, it gets caught on things pretty easily and when you catch it on a neighboring fisherman they get a little annoyed, hehe.

Oh, I guess you don't need this. If you already have your fishing pole, just give me a C note and I'll license you to go fishing for the day. The license covers all fishing holes run by the Department of Fish and Games.
Don't know why you want other people knowin' you're the master of catchin' small fish, but it's up to you.
The %n salutes %s.
Great job Skipper!!!
You really do have a knack for catchin those little guys.
Arrrr, you're gettin' ta be a mighty fine fisherman.
Congratulations, you now know which end of the fishin' pole to hold.

Some day, I may even tell you how I lost my hand here... What's that... well, no, I didn't actually lose my hand, but it was a close one. Just don't trust that you'll always pull a harmless fish out of the water. Yarrr!
The %n bows to %s.
Tackle Master says, Listen up all you bottom feeders! %s has earned the title Pro Fisherman! You could learn a thing or two from them, yes sir.
By the way, these fish don't count towards a Fish Title Token. They are way too common and easy to catch.
quest: You should be all set to start fishing now. Good luck and remember a true fisherman releases the small catches.
Welcome back chum! Do you need a fishing license today? Just give me a C note and I'll get you all signed up and ready to fish.

You should be all set to start fishing now. Good luck and remember the minnow released today is the big catch of tomorrow. Well, not literally tomorrow, it takes a while for the fish to get big enough, but you know what I mean.
You're all set, I renewed your license for another day.
Welcome back! You'll be wanting a license...
Hmmm, money... put you down on the list... Ok, you're licensed for the day.
Don't forget that I'll buy your catch if you're willing to sell. Good luck and remember to throw the small ones back.
You catch'em, I release'em. Come again!
Hey, you caught 600 Minnows?!!! You just can't catch enough of these little fishies can you? Ok Skipper, I guess you deserve a prize.
You caught 100 Guppies? Not bad, I bet you have quite a collection... unless you eat them. Yuck, guppy breath!
You caught 100 Mollies? Good job! I like them so much that I made a pond for mine at home. Maybe I'll show you how to make one someday.
I see you've learned a thing or two about fishing. You're becoming quite good at this. Not every fisherman catches 100 fish. It takes determination and skill it does. Here, have your reward.
My oh my! I'm truly impressed. You caught yourself 300 Large Fish. You're really becoming a pro at this. Here's your reward my friend.
Hey, would you mind showing me your technique someday?
You need three things to be a good fisherman.

First, you need a fishing pole. I can make one for you, but I'll need a Golem Jo or a Wood Golem Heart to assemble it. I remember my first fishing pole, it was just a stick with some string. I couldn't catch a cold with that thing.
Second, you need a fishing license. I sell licenses for a C note, allowing you to fish for a whole day.
And last, you need patience. Just enjoy the peace that fishing brings and talk to your fellow fisherman, but don't believe all their fish stories, heh.
Here take this fishing guide. It has everything you need to know.
I see you're already licensed to fish. Make sure you have your rod ready and don't crowd the other fisherman. If you still need to get a fishing pole, I'll give you the instructions for a few pyreal.
I license fisherman for a C note. That covers you for an entire day.
If you still need help getting ready to fish I sell a good beginner's fishing guide for only a few coins. Just hand me whatever you can and I'll give you a guide.
I license fisherman for a C note if you care to fish. The license covers all fishing holes run by the Department of Fish and Games.
So you want to go fishing, eh? Ok then, lets see here...

You know, I used to fish back in Ispar. One time I had this giant fish on the line and it was a real fighter. Had to lash... oh, right, sorry, you're all set. Remember the license is only good for a day, so catch a big one before then!

Oh, I also supply the local grocers with fresh fish, so I'll buy your catch from you if you like. I pay a lot more than most grocers will, because I know the fish are fresh. Good luck and remember to throw the small ones back.
Thank you, come again.
You caught 400 Minnows? That's not very impressive, but I suppose I should give you something. Here take this and try catching some bigger fish. I'll just release these little ones.
You know, I just have to release these little ones. Why do you bother to keep catching these anyway? Have you heard of a thing called catch and release?
Just hold your nose when you drink that.
I get these potions wholesale from the healers!
What? No, that potion is still good! They get better with age, like wine.
You notice what looks like a date scratched out on the side of the bottle.

greetings: I find a flaming skull is the best way to deter a hostile creature from attacking you!
Carving a fierce face into a scarecrow head is a sure way to make your opponent dread the fate headed towards them.
Well here goes nothing. Okay paring knife to make the eyes... whoops! No problem, no problem. Yeah that works. Whew!
There you go. See, just like Janda's.
Now let's see, carving knife into the skull to separate the... No that doesn't look right. What about? Nope. Hmm. Oh yeah I had the directions upside down.
Quite simple actually.
Ahh, I have been expecting to see some of these soon. I'll be with you in a moment.
%n begins work on the mask. For a moment the mask looks more like a mummy than a virindi.
Whoops!
Heh, tell your friends. I'm improving, aren't I?
Thank you for having the same faith in my skills as Janda. It makes me happy to know that... Oops...
In his zeal, Bleis accidentally gouges the gauntlets.
I'm so sorry! I don't think the gauntlets are damaged badly, if anything they will just be lightly scarred.

Hello, I'm Bleis, Janda's apprentice.  She's letting me work with skulls, scarecrow heads, mosswart heads, and baderling heads. Finally! Of course I'm still learning, I never thought that apprenticeship would take so long. I'll craft the older versions of the mosswart and banderling masks for you. If you would like the old styles or something unique hand one of the heads to me.

Also, with Janda's blessing, I am learning the art of facetting. She believes I am capable of applying what I have learned. If you have them handy, I will be happy to alter your Sunstone Gauntlets and bring a dark red color to them.

Making masks is a noble pursuit.  While researching it, I learned how to bring out the inner magic in skeleton skulls.  This ability also works on scarecrow heads, but only during the Festival Season.
Let's see what the Great Lady of Chance and Possibility has in store for you!
Your stakes are too high for this table. I only take the green tokens.
Not so fast, friend.  This token is only for use at Arshid's Den of Iniquity, in the Gharu'ndim lands.
Not so fast, friend.  This token is only for use at Monty's Den of Iniquity, in the Aluvian lands.
I am the low-stakes Gamesmaster.  Give me a green token and see what you win!
Remember, if you find anything that looks even slightly mechanical down in those Foundries, bring it to me and I'll see if I can make it into a little statue for you.
quest: I'm afraid I'm all out of spare parts at the moment! I'm waiting on another shipment--if you come back a week from now, I'm sure I can work on your items for you then.

With a sudden gasp, the Arcanum Tinker looks up from the trophy you just handed him and peers into your face. He is suddenly intoxicated with  paroxyms of joy at the sight of you; if he were not such a hardy soul, he would lose conciousness.
YES! It is %s!  Back from the wars, I see, and you've proven yourself a mighty champion, no less! I shall fashion this into a trophy worthy of your stature!
The Tinker sets about his work, then turns to you when he is finished.

This unique statue is for you, to commemorate your valor for destroying the Statues threatening the fair cities of Holtburg, Yaraq, and Shoushi. Please accept it with the thanks and  gratitude of all  the citizens of New Aluvia. The townsfolk of Dereth are forever in your debt.
Hooray for %s!

A gear from one of those Bronze Drudge statues! Wait--somehow it doesn't look the same as the ones everyone was bringing me last month! Well, let's give it a try anyway, shall we?
Chattering excitedly, the tinker upends his worksack and starts rummaging through its contents.
Gears, pliers, metal plates, screws, nuts and bolts,  A-ha! Here we go...
The tinker swiftly snaps the gear into an  assemblage of his spare parts and turns to you in surprise.
A mini-statue--but look! Green, just like the statues in town. Guess those statues are getting weaker all the time. Keep up the good work!

The Arcanum Tinker squints at you and quickly sizes you up.

No, that wasn't YOUR name I heard singing from the hills! You're not the one who killed the Native Cast in the towns' defense! Why don't you give this trophy to the one who truly destroyed the statue? There's a good fellow.

greetings: You were able to do it! Let me see what kind of image you captured of the Arcane Pedestal.
Slithe Tradittor examines the images within the crystal intently...
Ah, yes I can see what its components may be.  They are similar to...
Slithe Tradittor turns the crystal every which way, peering within it...

Thus far I can only say for certain that a Gelidite Dais is required for me to build this device.  Once I have all the components, I should be able to build a scaled down version of the Arcane Pedestal. Go get one now and bring it to me. One may be found in the Gelidite Library.

I still cannot discern the purpose of the Arcane Pedestal, but with a functioning version I may understand it. It must be a thing of great power! Go quickly. Tell no one of the Arcanum about this. This is no affair of theirs.
quest: I made you an Arcane Pedestal recently.  Go away!
I remember making an Arcane Pedestal for you not too long ago. Take this back, and begone!
You have already given me the Dais I need, I do not need another! Why aren't you out collecting those statue parts in the list I gave you?
I made one of those for you recently. I will keep this for my own use. Away with you!
You have the Gear.
Slithe Tradittor quickly constructs an Arcane Pedestal!
This device appears to do nothing. I suppose you want your version. Here it is. Do not speak of this to others. Be gone.
Slithe Tradittor mutters to himself about now being to make many more for his master.
You have found the Coil.
You have obtained the Spring.

Traveler. I have a tale to tell and a task I would put upon you. Were you to take this task on yourself, you will bear witness to things I have seen and a wondrous device I glimpsed but could not fathom or grasp.
For you see, there is an artifact in a place unlike any that exists in Dereth.

I am an explorer for the Explorer Society. In a desert region, I came upon a suspended walkway hung out from the edge of a cliff.  The other end of the walkway was attached not to solid ground but was lost in the spinning light of a portal.  I held my breath and stepped upon the walkway, half expecting it to collapse and throw me to the ground so far below. Yet, the walkway held my weight!  I c...
I must study this device. I call it the "Arcane Pedestal." I even believe I have the means to create a version of it, but first I require an imprint of its morphology.

I shall give you a copy of my notes and an Imaging Crystal. The notes show you the way to that place. The Imaging Crystal can be imprinted with the composition and design of this device.  Return to me with the imprint embedded within the Crystal and I will study it and determine how to create it.
The Arcane Pedestal!  We shall have the Arcane Pedestal!
Yes, this is the first component. I have been studying the imaging crystal and now know what the other components are.
They are the same parts which are within the living bronze statues. Here is a list of the components. Bring them to me and I will construct this device. Remember, tell no one of this.
I do not need this item right now.
I do not need this right now.
The Spring is still required.
Where is the Coil?
I still need the Gear item.
I do not need this now.
You are not powerful enough to help me. Come back when you have reached Level Thirty. Then you may at least attempt the task, though maybe not alone.

greetings: I haven't been this excited since we discovered the Temples of Enlightenment and Forgetfullness! I was able to get some of my thoughts on paper, but the most important pieces were in front of us all along. Pyreal motes and Aqua Incanta -- who would have ever known?

In this book you'll learn the very basics. Thanks to Hiro, who supplied the crucible -- a discovery that he simply grumbles about -- we're now able to brew potent magical concoctions that can be turned into solid forms, much like what the Lugians are able to do. Visit Zarri ibn Khaybi to buy your crucible. Good luck!
Oh, and if you've come about the Isparian weapons, you should speak with my apprentice Alaine.

quest: Greetings. Thank you for showing the wisdom to let the witch suffer her fate. Her transgression against her fellow man is at an end. My teacher has completed the reward for those that show this witch what she deserves.
%n waves his hand in the air, an odd gesture, but one he seems to find amusing.
He has constructed a place for you to train yourselves quickly. Mind you, you cannot stay there. Here, take this.
I cannot allow you passage into the chambers of reward until you have waited for some time to pass. Please return to me after the passage of one week.

I will transport you back this last time. Be careful not to be crushed while within those walls you impudent- I mean, take care and be well, for I cannot send you to that place again, at least for a short while.
You shall have one more passage after this friend. Pray you do not perish within these walls that third time. For if you do you shall be bereft of whatever items you leave behind.
%n looks as though he will begin laughing, but then his face goes pale and blank.
How did you come to me? You have overstayed your welcome here. Return to your precious cities! My master cares not for those that will let her evil go unpunished.
Very well. I shall give you the means to portal to the place that my master has created for you who chose the right. You must obtain a gem from me each time to make the journey.
But be very careful within, for I will not give you more than three gems within the space of one week. The full cycle of days shall be calculated from the third gem I give you.
chatter: The Monster deserves what she gets.
Sacrificing Isparians -- for any cause! -- is evil!
Damned be the monster.

greetings: I take this with gratitude. I'll open the door for you, but be warned, this is a risky venture. If you should fail, you will return to this place outside of the sealed tower...And I give no refunds.
Oh, if you find something of interest I might be able to identify it for you.
You should hurry. I'll close the door for you in a minute.

This is clearly broken. There is one person I know who might have the knowledge and skill to repair this. He lives in the Mite Maze dungeon north of Arwic, located at 41.1N x 57.2E. Sorry I can't be more help.
I thank you, but what I really need is a trade note from any shop worth 5000 pyreals.
I lost this while trying to flee from the dungeon. Thanks for finding it.
While excavating this site, I inadvertently awakened the undead that rest here. I was able to escape the dungeon with my life, but before doing so I found a large audience chamber with treasure.

Offer me any trade note worth 5000 pyreals and I'll give you access to the dungeon. In return, you can keep anything you find in there. I can use the trade note to further my investigation in this site.

From what I was able to uncover so far, I believe this area was once a place used by powerful Gharu'ndim War Mages. Any relics you find may be difficult for you to use. Yet, perhaps you will be able to understand what I could not. You can't go down there if you're not level 20, in fact I wouldn't go down there if I were you. Just forget the whole thing, you're better off that way.

Some papers? While an interesting read I am sure, how am I to know if this is genuine and not some fiction you yourself devised? Very well, I suppose you deserve some reward even if these papers are fabricated.
You have a lot of nerve to deliver this garbage to me. But I am a man of my word. Here. This is for you, even though you don't deserve it.

Fiction! Pure fiction! I could have written a more compelling tragedy. I do have to admit, even though this is surely a fake, you did put a fair amount of effort into it. If anything you entertained me with this garbage. Here, take this.
I know... I know... you at least tried to help me out. You really shouldn't be getting anything from me, but since I'm such a nice guy I'll make an exception for you.
Cultists... Summoning and worshipping shadows... how ludicrous!

So many people have brought me pieces of parchment with melodrama scrawled upon it. One person even brought me a strange stick, whatever that is for, but this... finally! Solid evidence of wrong doing on the plateau!

Wait... what was I getting so excited over? This is just some amulet caked in carenzi refuse. Hardly proof of anything.  You know what? I am so tired of people bringing me dead ends and fallacies! Here! Just take this!
Aurten hastily pulls a writ from his backpack and throws it at you.
Just because you haven't been helpful doesn't mean I won't reward you for the effort. Maybe next time you'll bring me something worthwhile!

Ah hello! Perhaps you could help me. I am new to this island and am not particularly familiar with the landscape. Could I convince you to help me? I need information on the strange incidents occuring on the plateau.
Aurten kneels down and opens a nearby pack. He tilts the pack so that you can see what is inside and then quickly pulls back the pack from your sight and closes it.
What are you waiting for? I promised my superiors I would have a report for them!
Eh! Drink! Watch the frogs!
...raykit flying horse brazier capes!
Sandstretch! Tusker headed bone poo! Filestone! Feh!
Drink!
Feh!
Pyreal hand and fish!
Suddy skunk hut, carenzi 7.1 fishpliers! 71.6 Epileptic spongemonkies!
quest: Super pogo lake-insect nappy trouser eagle ring!
Winter green carenzi pants.
Lucky apple tinker flakes.
Free dead door frogs! Rings in Rings!!! Buggrit! Kill!
Suck intangible gravy jumpers!
Sodding jackson ring! Feh! Dumb electric criers!
chatter: Girls!
Drink!
Sumperbumperhuggies... soddin yipwangler!

greetings: I've got most of the town's fortification drawn out here, but I keep having to change them. Working with the other races is all well and good, but it can be difficult.
The Tumeroks want access to some sort of undergound aquifer they say they have sensed in order to feed this bush they say is important.

The Lugians want everything made of stone and I keep having to tell them that the expense is too great. They just shake there heads and pat their hammers meaningfully. If I survive the building of this town I think I'll change my career.

An Agent of the Arcanum came by and officially informed me that there is a Zoning Ordinance which does not allow us to build a moat around the town.  No sooner than the monsters are cleared out of an area, the bureaucrats move in!
I had designed taller watchtowers but some of the new residents complained they would block their view!  Maybe they would prefer to be eaten when the monsters sneak up on them.

The kiln operators stopped work when the Lugians stacked the stone incorrectly. It seems the Tumeroks won't supply them with enough water which the kiln operators have in their contract as exclusively supplied to them, lest they stop work.
Welcome to the town that you helped build Founder.

Welcome to the town that you helped build Founder. Yes, I did have a different name last time we met. I thought that I would change everything in my life including my name. I liked being Lecor Busier, but I've found that a different name doesn't make you a different person.
I like it up here. Far above the busy town. Come again.
Hehe, you're a Town Builder and I'm a Town Planner.
Thank you for visiting us up here Town Builder.
Goodbye. I seem to have misplaced a few of my things. Oh, well I find them at some point.
I can use this.
Hmm, never seen one of these. I'll take it.
Thank you, I was running short on those.
Let me see that. Yes, I'll take all you have.
You be careful with that.
Your purchase and I'll put these in here and these shouldn't be here they need to go in with the tools. Oh, sorry, anything else?
Here you are, I have a lot of these if you need more.
An excellent buy Town Founder.

quest: I hope you make good use of the sword you obtained so recently.
Ah, so you have returned. Not all do. Did you get a signet from one of the Virindi?  If so, please give it to me.
If you are having difficulty finding the complex, go along Bandit Road and find the note I left.
You got the sword recently, did you not? Or have you lost it already?

Hello. I am Mage Syltyn Rillon, a member of the Explorer Society. Perhaps you are wondering about the sword on the dais in town. I had been a friend of Martine's back on Ispar.  I encountered Martine here, during one of his mad rampages. He knew not who I was, nor did he seem to care and the encounter ended badly for me. Upon arriving at the Lifestone I was angry, yet understood that the Virind...

To obtain this weapon you must first prove your worthiness. There is a Virindi complex north of Bandit Road. I left a note on a tree along Bandit Road, east of Neydisa Castle, marking the location where you should turn north. Go to the complex, navigate through it and bring to me a Virindi Signet. I shall then allow you to take the sword.
Oh, take this.  It will aid you in your journey through part of the complex. Read it carefully.

Thank you. I see you succeeded. You were clever in navigating the dungeon and sufficiently brave to face its denizens. I deem you worthy of receiving the Sword of Frozen Fury.  You may go now and take it from the dais.

If you should desire a weapon that is easier to carry, you may take the sword to Omaro Nagate at the Glenden Wood West Outpost. Omaro Nagate is a skilled weaponsmith and may alter the sword to be a dagger. I wish you safe travels and swiftness of blade when they are otherwise.

greetings: Thank you.  I believe you can succeed.

The Unfinished Temple is to the northwest of here.  We fled pretty far into the ruins before we realized we had to leave.  I think we were at least two levels down when we lost the knives.  Last I was there, I found only one knife.
That is definitely one of my mother's knives!  Thank you.
Here is a letter to take to my sister Jilsaya in Al-Arqas.  She has a task for you.
Long ago, on the way to Al-Arqas, my mother and I came upon a ruin and camped there.  At night, monsters came upon us, and after holding them off for a while, we fled.
We left behind my mother's collection of knives, among the first she ever forged.  They are not worth very much, but I will help you if you get one for me.
Well, look at that. Where did you say you found this?
The Arcanum Researcher studies the mechanism carefully. She rubs it, tries to dent it with a fingernail, even sniffs at the metal.
No, I've never seen anything like this. Although ...
She tilts her head to the side as she thinks.
No, I think I do remember something about a metal like this. Something the undead were working on. Hmmm ...
Why don't you ask the Undead Mechanic, by the waterfall on Marae Lassel? Maybe he can tell you something about this ... umm ... mechanism.

Why, it's you, %s! I have heard of your valiant deeds from afar. The Arcanum extends its deepest gratitude to you for destroying the Statues menacing our towns. Take this gear to the Arcanum Tinker in the Consortium near Xarabydun--he will fashion an award made especially for you.

Why, it's you, %s! I have heard of your valiant deeds from afar. The Arcanum extends its deepest gratitude to you for destroying the Statues menacing our towns. Take this coil to the Arcanum Tinker in the Consortium near Xarabydun--he will fashion an award made especially for you.

Why, it's you, %s! I have heard of your valiant deeds from afar. The Arcanum extends its deepest gratitude to you for destroying the Statues menacing our towns. Take this spring to the Arcanum Tinker in the Consortium near Xarabydun--he will fashion an award made especially for you.

Why, it's you, %s! I have heard of your valiant deeds from afar. The Arcanum extends its deepest gratitude to you for destroying the Statues menacing our towns. Take these nuts and bolts to the Arcanum Tinker in the Consortium near Xarabydun--he will fashion an award made especially for you.
quest: Hail, %s, word of your valiant deeds proceed you! What can I do for you on this fine day? If you carry a trophy from one of the statues infesting the foundries beneath the cities of Dereth, I will reward you with experience for them.
I'm sorry--I have to spend the day packing up all these statue parts so I can send them off to the Arcanum. Come back tomorrow--I'll make sure I have enough empty boxes!

I have the latest reports from the Arcanum with me. Asheron stopped by the Arcanum workshops and gifted the Tinkers with knowledge of Yalaini transmutation magic. Using their new insights, the Tinkers have found the way to penetrate the Foundries from which these statues have come. If you seek out the Arcanum Tinker in the Consortium near Xarabydun, he will be able to tell you more!

Meanwhile, I will still deliver the same rewards for any trophies that you might find on the statues menacing our towns. I will give additional rewards for any interesting items found within the Foundries, for I am sure the Arcanum would be interested in studying them further.
The Arcanum will surely be interested in this artifact! For this I shall reward you with 2000 experience. Thank you!
The Arcanum will surely be interested in this artifact! For this I shall reward you with 18,000 experience. Thank you!
The Arcanum will surely be interested in this artifact! For this I shall reward you with 30,000 experience. Thank you!
The Arcanum will surely be interested in this artifact! For this I shall reward you with 60,000 experience. Thank you!
This is indeed an intriguing item, but I am afraid you are too powerful to benefit from the experience that the redemption of this item would merit.
Although I have seen many items like this in the past weeks, the Arcanum has directed me to bestow the same rewards as before. Thank you for your diligence--the statues may yet be defeated!
This is indeed an intriguing item, but I am afraid you are not powerful enough  to receive the experience that  the redemption of this item would merit.
I know you're excited, but I've only got so many gifts to give out!

Tell you what, if you don't like the gift I gave you, you're an ungrateful... no, I'm kidding. If you don't like it, just give it to me and I'll give you a different gift! And even if the new one is just like the old one, trust me, you'll love this one even more!
Happy New Year! The High Queen has asked me to give out these lovely presents in celebration of the new year. Let's see what we've got for you...
Sorry, I'm only supposed to give gifts to folks who were actually here for the New Year. But stick around! Who knows what exciting things I might be hired to do next year!
Either you're Viamontian or something really strange has happened.
Ah, some lovely balloons! Don't they look festive?
Ooooh, this will be fun! Be careful with this!
Ah, now this is nice! Purely decorative though, I'd hate to see the towns of Dereth if folks tried to drink all of this!
Here we go! A party hat for all occasions!
Wow, this is really pretty! Take good care of it!
Now, if you don't like what you got, you can hand it back to me and I'll pull something else out of my bag.
Of course, it might be just like what you got the first time! Just be sure you like what you've got before I leave here in a month!
Oh, and there's something else. This isn't from the High Queen, though. In fact, I'm not entirely sure she'd approve!
Ah, not your cup of tea? That's all right, I'm sure someone else will love this. Let's see, how about one of these?
chatter: Happy New Year! Isn't it wonderful?
Be sure to get some black-eyed peas from Fispur Ansel or one of his fellow grocers!
I have so many party invitations, I just don't know what to do!

greetings: This is a beautiful gem! Where did you say you found it? In a mud cave on the Vesayen Islands? Not surprising that the moarsmen would hoard items.

It looks almost like a portal gem. But there is something odd about it. Look at the sides of the gems. Those holes look like pegs could fit into them. Did you find anything that would fit in your journeys?

Either way, I can tell this item has some significance. I won't keep it from you, just seeing it was enough to tantalize my imagination. Whether you crush it and open a portal with it now, or hold on to it is wholly up to you.
This is a beautiful looking emerald trinket. How do I know it is made of Emerald? Just because I am cooped up in here doesn't mean I don't know how to use an ust.

This clasp looks like it is hinged, and it has a pair of carved pegs. This was pulled from some muck you say? Others have come by to show me a gem that they recovered that this artifact may very well fit around. I suggest you find one if you can and see if it fits.
Hmmm... as I think about it, this object may also have the makings of an interesting piece of jewelry. If only you had the right kind of string, perhaps you might be able to make it wearable.

What a remarkable finding! This appears to be a cradle for some sort of item. I recall in my travels of Ispar that the Aluvians would make similar objects to place curious or small decorative statues into.

Several people have visited me recently with an object that could very well be placed in this. They said they made the gem by combining a pair of items they found on the Vesayen Islands. I recommend exploring the islands further if you haven't already.

The stone glows, but it looks very fragile. I wonder if it could be powdered and if the powder could be used to enchant a piece of jewelry. But don't take my word for it. What you do with this artifact is your decision and not mine.
This is an interesting structure. A dais made out of jade! Look at the top of it, there are several indentations. This was likely used as a dais for a statue of some sort.

Now that I think of it, several people have come by with a piece of artwork that may very well fit on top of this. They said they got that item from somewhere on the Vesayen Islands, though they were very secretive about where it was they pulled their treasure from.

Another thing to note is the weight and sound of the dais. It feels very light for being make out of stone, and it sounds like it could be hollow. I see no hinges or doors, perhaps you should take this to Hiro outside of Xarabydun, he may know how to open this casing.
But don't take my word for it. Either keep it or take it to Hiro. The choice is yours.
Ah, I fear this text is not of my ken.  This is written in the runes of Dericost, a later civilization.  Kuyiza bint Zayi, one of the scholars of Zaikhal, would be able to assist you.

Indeed, this is the ancient cuneiform of the Falatacot. However, it does not seem to be contemporaneous. If I read this correctly, the text written at a far later period, possibly as late as the High Empyrean Era of Lore.
How curious. Who would be using such an obscure language at so late a date, and why?
My apologies, but I cannot read this.  It appears to be the script of ancient Empyrea.  You should bring this to Bretself the translator, in Cragstone.
Hmm.... Now let's see....
This isn't a good sign at all. If what this says is true. Oh my. See for yourself.
My apologies, but I cannot read this.  It appears to be the script used by the High Empyrean culture of the Age of Lore.  You should bring this to Bretself the translator, in Cragstone.
Interesting find... The language of old Dericost is difficult to translate, but I believe I can do it.  What is this strange material?
My apologies, but I cannot read this. It appears to be the script used by the High Empyrean culture of the Age of Lore. You should bring this to Bretself the translator, in Cragstone.
Ah, I fear this text is not of my ken.  This is written in the runes of Dericost, a later civilization. Kuyiza bint Zayi, one of the scholars of Zaikhal, would be able to assist you.
Revolting! What is this abomination?
No, never mind. I do not wish to know. Take it to Bretslef, in Cragstone.
Hrm. Well, the letters of this are in the High Empyrean language of the Age of Lore. However, they don't seem to form any words.
Interesting!  These letters seem to reference some of the events that recently occurred here in Dereth.  Judging by the end of the notes, I wonder if the author is still alive...
I am sorry, but I cannot read this.  Try talking to the Zaikhal translator, Kuyiza bint Zayi.
