An interesting read, a bit fanatical in spot. I have made notes where they are applicable.
Will wonders never cease? This book was difficult because of the damage wrought upon it. As well the text itself was written in a variation of Dericost, akin to that of the Gelid.
I must apologize. The book... well the book... well it... well... here are my notes. I'm truly sorry.

This appears to be Falatacot in nature, but the language is older. I'm not familiar with the dialect, though some words appear to be very close with many of the writings that I have translated in the past.
Here, I translated as much as I could. I find it rather disturbing.
This is the Faltacot command for open. That is strange.
Ah! I see you have found my note. I asked the barkeeps on the Vesayen Islands to distribute it for me. And since you are here, giving this to me, it appears they did what I had asked.

With all that has been happening of late I can't help but be intrigued by all of this Falatacot nonsense. So far we've seen a good deal about the under handed side of their people. But we know there is a lighter side to them. A less cruel side.

We also know that the Moarsmen, the swamp dwelling creatures that were discovered when portals to the Vesayen Islands first opened, have some sort of connection to them. The Adjanites frequently kept them, though we are not exactly certain why.
I would enjoy the opportunity to learn more about them, but I honestly have very little time outside of my translator duties to devote to researching the moarsmen.
I know! Since you are here, would you mind going back to the Vesayen Islands and look for information for me? I can't leave this building, but I can read as much as I want!

This book appears to be a text regarding the eating habits of the Moarsmen and some creature call the Moars. I am unfamiliar with what the Moar are exactly, but it seems there is some relation between them and the Moarsmen.
Unfortunately, the text is in horrible condition and I am unable to translate it completely. The best I can do is create a summary of the bits I understand.
Since you have helped me further my understanding of the Moarsmen and the Falatacot, I will help you.

This book appears to be a text regarding the hunting habits of the Moarsmen and what seems to be their less advance counterparts, the Moar. The text claims them to be vicious hunters, always on the roam.

The years have not been kind to this text. There are so many pages that I simply cannot comprehend because of their poor condition. The best I can do for this tome is to create a summary of the legible bits.

Finally! Something with substance. As much as I enjoyed reading about the Moarsmen, those tomes pale compared to this one. This looks to be a history of the Moarsmen on Dereth. Hmm... this also seems to only be one part of the history. A second tome may contain the conclusion of the account.
Sadly, the pages dissolve as I attempt to read them, so I was only able to construct a high level summary. The finer details of the text were gone before I could transcribe them.
Had I not seen the first piece of this text, I would have had difficult understanding the context of it. This is the second part of history of the moarsmen on Dereth. Very interesting indeed.

It is a shame that there were no better reproductions of this tome where ever it was you procured this. I will do my best to summarize it, but the text is very difficult to read through the mud caked pages.

This is a refreshing change of pace. I have been receiving so many ancient texts that resemble encyclopedias. This appears to be the story of a young Falatacot Priestess and the Falatacot's first encounter with the Moar.

This story seems to be written in a confusing poetic style. Many of the concepts and actions are interposed, which make it difficult for even a scholar to discern. I will do my best to simplify it into a form that we can easily understand.

I am a scholar of the Empyrean culture that lived in the ruins found throughout the swamps and even the desert.  They were apparently called the Falatacot.  If you have a text of that culture, I may be able to help you.
quest: Fanzen San looks over the scroll, growing alarm in his features.
How many of these are there?  Well, again, thank you for bringing it to me.  Unfortunately, I have nothing to give you this time...
I never knew that Aquamarine could be such a prismatic gem. I always thought it was opaque.

None the less, this is an interesting Adjanite Artifact, to be certain. Though I cannot say for certain what it is exactly. My library on the Adjanites is thin in comparison to what I have regarding the Falatacot.
I do recall, though, that some adventurers can come across a device that these gems could be fitted into.

You may want to return to the Vesayen Islands and search for that contraption. . I did, at one point, possess an interesting cutting tool. Alas, I have already given it away. Come back to me in a few days and I might have found another one.
But what you do if completely up to your decision.
Fanzen San looks over the scroll, with a concerned look on his face.

This is a scroll detailing how to summon a creature known as a Dark Inferno, a shadow twisted manifestation of the element of fire.  It is good that you brought this to me, for I fear the repercussions were someone else to retrieve it.  You are a stalwart adventurer, so I will share some of the knowledge imparted upon me by some of the translated Falatacot texts I have discovered.
He traces a glyph in the air, and you feel light-headed.
You have gained 3 points of Magic Defense skill!
You may want to return to the Vesayen Islands and search for that contraption. If you don't, I found an interesting cutting tool that you could use to break this cluster of prisms from each other.
But what you do is completely up to your decision.

greetings: I have learned how the ancient art of bringing out the power innate to undead skulls.  Either that, or I made a deal with the Virindi for special powers.
You never can tell nowadays...
Scarecrow heads are dangerous, when flaming and thrown at you.  I just wanted to make sure you knew.
There is nothing more wonderful than waking up and knowing that I have a full day of helping people ahead of me. Making things from smelly old heads. Oh, glory!
I've been thinking about joining an acting troupe, what do you think?
I really, really love working with masks. No... really I do. It's the most rewarding job I have ever done, for free. Oh here we go.
%n grumbles, "I need to do something with my life."

Oh great. Thank you. This will be the most fun I've ever had. Let me see gray paint, black paint and white paint. Wow... what an amazing array of colors the virindi use in their attempt to hoodwink us.
%n looks out the window longingly.
%n tosses the mask to you. "There you go."
Hey, thanks! I'm glad that I can be of use for something outside of festival trinkets!
You cringe in horrow as flakes of red sunstone fall to the floor in front of you.
Hmm, well... I guess that did what I wanted to... sort of...

Hi, I'm Zoe, Tsua's apprentice.  He said that I have  polished my basic skills enough to move on to more advanced things. So this year I can craft his old designs for mosswart and banderling heads. Additionally if you give me either a skull or a scarecrow head, I will make a thrown weapon from them.

Making masks is a valuable trade... once a year.  So, to both learn and provide a service to my fellow Isparians, I have taken up the craft of Gem-smithing. If you have a pair of Sunstone Gauntlets, I will take the gauntlets and facet them to bring out the color of the sun in them.
A Black Stone, so easily confused with a Black Rock. Let's see, Mana Potions for the stones.
Wonderful, I've been looking for more of these Black Rocks. Health Potions for the rocks I believe.
This is a very impressive rock!
A heart of mud.
Is it the golem's heart that animates them do you think?
A heart of water.
I am confounded by these solid pieces of water. They aren't cold like ice. Hmmm...
A heart of wood.
The most understandable and natural golem heart. Quite pretty too.
A heart of copper.
Living copper. Did you know golem hearts have hollow chambers much like our hearts.
A heart of granite.
Imagine what it would be like to have a heart of stone.
A heart of iron.
The materials these hearts are made of are purer than our blacksmiths can refine.
A heart of ice! How apt.
At least this one is cold.
A heart of obsidian.
These are among the most beautiful of the golem hearts. See how it shines when I polish it?
A heart of diamond.
The materials toughness seems to have a direct correlation to the golems toughness.
A heart of pure pyreal!
This is very valuable.
A heart of pure platinum!
A heart of... vapor.
These are even more mystifying than the Water Golem Hearts.
Spines are nice.
Thank you.
Spines are good.
Come again.
Spines are great!
Spines are wonderful!
Well, would you look at that? I can probably make a slightly better axe from this.
Oh wonderful, a new spine! Maybe I can .. No .. Well .. Hmm. I'll just hold onto it for now.
A fine quality horn.
May your future see good fortune.
I can resecure this to a haft.
And now you have a Basalt Axe instead.
And now you have an Obsidian Axe instead.
I am interested in armoredillo spines and golem hearts of all kinds.  If you give me one I will craft an item from it, or give you something else of value.
chatter: I can craft you an axe from an armoredillo spine.  Any spine will do.  I'll also return something for a wood or iron heart.
I don't have a use for gromnie teeth.  But I will reward you for auroch horns.
Spines and golem hearts are what I use.  Have any?

greetings: I ask you to find out what happened to my husband and you bring me back a scrap of paper with doodles on it!!!
I can't read this. Is it about my husband?
quest: I'm grateful for what you have done. You told me the truth when a lie would have been easier. I still hold hope that someday my husband and I will be reunited.
My Gareth is gone!
I've told you everything I know about my husbands disappearance. Ask Dalius if he knows more about the Sclavus Temple he found.
What's this?
%mn opens the book and starts to read.
This fits with the story from Gareth's journal. That undead horror seems to believe my husband died from the process she used on him.
I guess my husband's ruse worked and she believed the corpse he left behind was his.
Thank you, I'll keep this in case it has some clue how to help my Gareth.
Do I look like a woman who would forget my own husbands death?!
I have no need of the foul thoughts of that wretched murderess!
%mn throws the journal at you.
Bastard! I will not have my emotions toyed with. Dalius warned me that you might try something like this.
%mn torches the book with a flamebolt.
You already brought me my husbands journal. I know what happened to him. Do not taunt me so cruelly!
%mn shoves the book back at you.
Maybe you have heard of my husband, Gareth Dain?

He hunted these lands looking for treasure and glory, but three years ago he failed to return home. I could find nothing else to explain his disappearance, then one year ago a warrior told me that he had seen Gareth shortly before he went missing. The man said that Gareth had been fighting a group of Sclavus in the crater hills somewhere around here.
I moved to Candeth Keep with the hope that I could find clues to tell me what had happened to Gareth. Recently my husband's dear friend Dalius found a Temple in a crater west of here.

He says that the crater was filled with a howling sandstorm. He bravely fought his way to the eye of the storm to find a Temple protected by Sclavus. I am sure that this must be the same temple that my husband was last seen at.
Please, go and find out what happened to my husband. I just need to know what really happened.
Have you brought word of my husband?
%mn takes the book and reads Fanzen's notes.
This Vitriaka performed some magical process on a...
%mn looks up from the book in shock.
No. No, it can't be! It was someone else!! That undead Beast couldn't take my Gareth!    Nooooo!!!
%mn throws the book at you.
She collapses to the floor in grief. Her body shaking with her sobs.
Gaaareth! My Gareth!!!
Dalius quietly motions you over to him and holds out a hand for the book.
%mn takes the book and stares at the sclavus covering. She slowly opens it and starts to read.
Oh, my lord... Gareth... what did they do to you?!
No! My poor Gareth... She hurt you, she changed you.
%mn points a shaking finger at you.
You killed the Beast that did this to him? Tell me you killed her!!!
You did as I asked. I know the truth now, it's horrible, but I know.
Take this as a small reward and leave me.
%mn hands you a beautiful staff.
chatter: I just wish I knew what happened to him.

greetings: This looks to be a very important report. I think that this should be delivered to Captain K'rank. I do not wish to keep such an important report from his hands.
I have been sent by High Queen Elysa to reward those who have assisted Captain K'rank of Linvak Tukal. If you have proof of this assistance give it to me and I will see that you are rewarded.
quest: Li Fong says, "Hail %tn. I see that you have returned to shatter the morale of the Burun again. Your efforts continue to assist our people in lessening the threat these creatures pose. Here are your rewards."
The key will open whichever chest you choose in that room. Each chest should clearly display what it holds.
Li Fong says, "That is all that I have to give. Thank you again for your efforts, %tn."

Li Fong says, "Hail %tn. Again you take the head of the Burun leader, Morgluuk. You are surely a hero to all. As we have already placed the creatures head outside of the city in your honor, this one will be turned into a trophy that you can display with honor, %tn."
%tn has defeated Morgluuk and received a glorious reward for their efforts.
Filthy creatures these Burun. As promised you are to be rewarded for your efforts.
A brave warrior who has continued our efforts to crush the morale of the Burun and the renegades. You have done well. Here take this and display it proudly.
Li Fong exclaims, "%tn, you have killed the Burun leader, Morgluuk! This head is proof of what you have done. All should know your name."

%tn has slain Morgluuk and returned his head to the Sho capital of Hebian-to. There it is to be placed on a pike as a symbol of victory for the Isparian, Lugian and Tumerok people and a symbol of defeat for the Burun that threaten our way of life. Huzzah, %tn!
You must be rewarded for your efforts.

Li Fong says, "The portal gem will take you into the High Queen's Vault. There you will find many chests that house treasures and weaponry that has been worked on by the finest smiths in the land. Take your gift and use it well, %tn. You are deserved of much praise in this victory."
Li Fong says, "That is the final reward I have for you. You have become a hero to all of Dereth, %tn. I shall never forget your name or your deeds."
Do not bother me about Tamian any more, go talk to someone else about him.

Have I seen Tamian Wilmit? Strange fellow he is, not very able. Seems he can do nothing. I do not understand why Astara is still friends with him.  Tis true, they knew each other on Ispar when younger but he is of no use here. Little in the way of useful skills, he has.

Yes, you may go tell Astara I said so.  He tried to fight me in sword practise. I swatted him finely for he is no good with a blade and he came at me like a rabid Carenzi.  I had to give him a good thrashing, lucky he is we were using wood, not steel. Astara made me stop, also screamed at him, he slunk away like a drudge.
I believe the last time I saw him was over by Ji Tenxien the Tailor. You could ask her.
Hail! A nice day for practising swordplay, is it not?  I plan to hunt later, too.

greetings: This is a good find, however I can do nothing with such a flawed product. Now if you could find a whole mask, then I could work wonders with it ...
I think I can actually use this material to make a great masterpiece! Oh, it's broken ... Never mind.
Hmm ... I think that this would make a fine piece were it not broken. If you can find a way to fix this I might be able to enhance it with another version of my artistic rendition of Pwyll.
Or you could give this to my apprentice after you have it fixed. He'll restore it to be more like the Virindi that it was taken from.
This would make a fine headpiece were it not broken. If you can find a way to fix this I might be able to craft it into something special.
No thank you, I've broken more than my share of tools on the hard carapace of those critters. Here, go see the Olthoi hunter in Arwic -- he can help you out.
What is it you expect from me? I carve heads, not pumpkins!
What do you expect me to make with this? It's an eye patch, not a mask.

A find worthy of crafting into a robe! But you still require another arm, two legs and a torso. You should be able to assemble those together without my aid. But only a master such as myself would be able to craft such objects into a fully wearable outfit.

A find worthy of crafting into a robe! But you still require another leg, two arms and a torso. You should be able to assemble those together without my aid. But only a master such as myself would be able to craft such objects into a fully wearable outfit.

A find worthy of crafting into a robe! But you still require two arms and two legs. You should be able to assemble those together without my aid. But only a master such as myself would be able to craft such objects into a fully wearable outfit.

A find worthy of crafting into a robe! But you still require two arms and a torso. You should be able to assemble those together without my aid. But only a master such as myself would be able to craft such objects into a fully wearable outfit.
What a fine mask! Such well-preserved fur!
You know, I really hate these creatures.
HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA!
Oh, that's funny.
Wonderful craftsmanship! We mask makers are a crafty lot!
I hear Elysa holds the most wonderful costume parties. You should wear this if you're ever lucky enough to receive an invitation!
Think of the havoc you could cause in the marketplace!
Do you smell that? This thing stinks!
This is a rare find. This metal is extraordinary. I believe I can truly make something special out of this. Here, take this, and wear it with pride!
Wow I think I out did myself on this one. Maybe I should take a break ...
Excellent. Let me have a moment or two to craft the pieces needed to complete this mask. There! A little touch here and there, and it's finished.
Excellent! Give me a moment here ...
Although you watch closely, the mask maker's hands move too quickly and skillfully to follow.

I decided to change the heroic theme of my past endeavors. Instead I have crafted a likeness of one of the most feared villains in Aluvian History. This helm represents the helm worn by Lord Alfric of Viamont as he stormed the shores of Aluvia in his warships. Clad in the Bull's visage, he laid waste to proud Aluvia and drove our people into the wilderness.
What a foul creature this is! However, I will not be deterred! I will make the finest of masks from it!
Undead always make me uneasy. If you really want a mask, that's fine, but if you ask me, it's eerie.
Tuskers are very scary foes. But they aren't so scary with their heads cut off!
This head reminds me of my poor departed grandmother. Poor Grandma ...
Wow, this one is pretty frightening. Ursuin remind me a lot of Mattekars, just not as pathetic.
My girlfriend is afraid of snakes. Maybe I should get a mask like that one and wear home to her tonight?
What is this thing? It certainly isn't a monster head! Hrm, it's transparent on the inside ... Ahah! I turned it inside out! Here you go.
Here you go, a new version of the Mosswart Mask.
Here you go, a new version of the Banderling Mask.
I wish I had one of these when I was a kid.
Hahaha, your kidding right?
Oh, I see you're a chicken lover. Well in that case you'll love this hat.
You seriously want a mask made from this thing?
Well ok...
What's that? A mask isn't good enough for you? How 'bout this?!?
Masks are pretty useless. I'm just doing this while I go to school. I can make bags out of tusker heads too. Here you go!
Give me a moment and I will craft a fine costume for you from this body.
I've always had a soft spot in my heart for mites.
They taste great with a little tarragon and melted butter. You wouldn't happen to have carved off any meat when you obtained this head, would you? No? Ah well.
They wait thousands of years to seek vengeance for who knows what ancient crime, and what happens when they finally arrive on Dereth? Some tiny Isparian lops off their head! I love it!
Ridiculous creatures, these chitticks. But they're great in a stew!
You'll be the belle of the ball with this fine costume!
I just learned how to make this costume. I must say, I am most impressed with myself!
Now, this is one fine costume. Go forth and scare some new arrivals!

Hello, I am Alexander the Deft. If you give me a creature's head or facial covering, I may be able to make it into a mask for you. If you would like an older version of the Mosswart or Banderling please hand those heads to my apprentice.
In times far past, many knights emblazoned the image of High King Pwyll on their helmets in order to show others that they fought in his name.
Heh, I bet you're wondering what a handsome guy like me is doing up here in Eastham. Well, this town is better than that Ayan Baqur place! I heard they have a Virindi there!
quest: Hey, you already turned one of these in to me. Let's finish the first one before we make a second mask.
Yes! That's what I need. Ok, here, try this on.
I have a great idea! Go and find me a Scarecrow Head.
Hrmph. This is already a mask, more or less. Wear it with pride! On second thought, don't.

greetings: You think, "I wiped the scroll case clean, the towel was as rancid as a swamp gromnie's breath. I tossed it aside. Then, like a tinkerer applying iron to a client's prized sword, I lifted the scroll case."

You think, "I had the case in my hand, I didn't want to open it for fear that the contents might crumble away to nothing. Besides, in the recesses of my mind I figured this was what the Dame was looking for. I looked around the room and spotted a portal. It beckoned me like the soul cage that imprisons Gaerlan."
You think, "I was happy..."
You think, "...and there was no time like the present to see where the portal would take me."

You think, "The room was full of gold and trinkets, but this was the real prize. It was stuck to the top of a pedestal by hardened and caked mud. I tried to pry the thing off the pedestal to no avail. I needed something to clean it with..."
You think, "The towel!"

You think, "Once again my initial discussion with the Dame flooded into my head. She'd given me a towel. I hadn't known what it was for. Now, it was all clear. I needed to handle this thing right. If I could just get the towel to wipe off the scroll case..."
Your arrival at this time could only be providence.
Could you rush this to Nasun in the North Yaraq Outpost? He is a bit smitten with Mara, and would wish to sign it.
Ha!  Only for fair Mara would Nasun write sooner than I.  And overwritten, as usual.  He does love his vocabulary.
Since you are here, would you do us the honor of presenting this note to Mara, at her father's villa outside Yaraq?  I am sure she will be pleased to receive it.

My friend Mara al-Luq in Yaraq has just received some happy news, and I want to congratulate her.  Could you rush this to Nasun in the North Yaraq Outpost? He is a bit smitten with Mara, and would wish to sign it first.
quest: My apologies for the length of the errand.  I did not think that both Nasun and Mara would ask you to carry mail as well.
Take this, then, and my blessings on your journey.
But you just gave me her letter!  Maybe if you come back tomorrow with a new letter, I will believe that it is her.

greetings: No thank you! I've seen enough of those to last me a lifetime. Do you have any idea how heavy those things are? You keep it!
No more scrabbling in dungeons for me! If you want some of Lilitha's dirty old arrows, you can go get them yourself!
What? You want the story? Well, just west of here is a dungeon called Hunter's Leap. Legend has it that the great hunter Lilitha lived there when she was younger, while she practiced her skills.

I never met her myself, but I have a lot of respect for someone with that kind of spirit. Anyway, when she moved out, she left behind a lot of the bows and arrows she had made -- substandard work, stuff she wasn't happy with. But it's still better than what most of these so-called archers can make today.

I made my living for a long time by collecting the arrows she left behind and selling them. But then the banderlings moved out and a new bunch moved in and my Farmer left and ... I just don't think I want to do that anymore.
But ... if you find one of her old bows, bring it to me and I'll see what I can do for a reward.
I have only the best, you know.   Arrows made by Lilitha herself.
Thanks for stopping by.
"I suppose I can handle that.
Very good.
quest: Very nice, very nice. This is one of the better examples of Lilitha's early work. You were lucky to find this.
This is nice ... but didn't you already bring me one of these this month? Do you have a bunch stockpiled or something? Sheesh! People these days. I'm not giving you anything for this.

greetings: You are too generous.
Tumeroks have some basic building skills and have also taken over many Empyrean ruins in the Direlands, so you'll see numerous walled forts over there.
It's said that some of them are locked, so you might need to find the right key, or know someone who can pick the locks!
Thank you.
It's said that tumeroks are crawling all over the Direlands.  There's even supposed to be a big, hidden, underground fortress somewhere, where the biggest and most powerful tumeroks live.
Is that all you can spare?
Thanks...
Not all types of tumeroks carry insignia, you know.  For example, mere tumerok warriors and tumerok  priests never carry such things.

Have you heard about the imprisonment of the mage Dansha-Ki? I heard she was carrying some pretty strange spell components. Look for her sister, Yu Vuo-Ki, who can sometimes be found wandering around to the northwest of here.
Thank you stranger! I can get a good meal and a hot bath with this!
The snake sighs and uncoils from the coin.
"You have lifted the curse. Finally, I may rest." The small snake coils in on itself biting its tail.
Here, a small token of my gratitude.
Will you help the poor with some money?
chatter: Will you help the poor with some money?

greetings: This key doesn't fit the lock! I wish I had my backpack, then I'd be able to escape. Find my backpack and return here with it. Then I'll have a chance to escape.

I can't believe I let myself get caught by these Tumeroks again. You can't break me free from this cell, but if you can locate my belongings I can use my components to teleport myself away from here. The Tumeroks who took my belongings just left and were traveling north towards Dryreach. You need to hurry, not much time remains before they decide what to do with me...And I'm not sure if they wi...
Shhhh!  I think I hear someone coming!
Welcome. With regret I can only offer you cabbage, as it is difficult to grow anything with all the tumeroks nearby.
Watch your back. The area around here is occupied with tumeroks.
Finally some decent food. Thank you!
I'm sorry I can only offer you carrots and cabbage.
quest: You found my belongings! Now I can portal out of here without the tumeroks outside seeing me.
I owe you a debt I can never fully repay. Please accept this ring and gem as a token of my appreciation. The ring was given to me by my father and has protected me on many occasions.
I owe you a debt I can never fully repay. Thanks again for finding my belongings again!
Do you wish to go to the warehouse?  We are not allowing anyone to enter there now until we investigate what happened. If you have crystals to deliver, bring it to the student who sent you here.
Do you wish to go to the warehouse?  I have been informed there is a problem there.  Maybe you can go see what the matter is.
Do you wish to deliver more crystal to the storage facility? Very well.
You have some crystals to deliver? Go.
Sorry, we are only allowing people who are delivering crystals for Nuhmudira to enter here. Go talk to the student in Glenden Wood, he will inform you what is needed.

greetings: Welcome! Here you see the beginnings -- the fragile embryo -- of the future art community of Dereth.

We are here, my two fine friends and I, to prepare for peace! After all the recent hubaloo, we believe that Dereth is in for a long and glorious Golden Age of Art, in which all Derethians everywhere will forsake their violent ways and instead take up the gentlest and most noble of sciences: alchemy, cooking, and fletching.
We are at the forefront of this artistic revolution, leading the way, dismantling the roadblocks, smoothing the path for the mass of humanity behind us! We live to serve!

We're gathering converts every day, every minute! If you would like to join us, you can start by trying your hand at crafting. Just take an old, disused item that is of no worth to anyone -- for instance, gromnie teeth! -- and fashion it into a beautiful and useful object of art.
Then bring it to one of us, and we will reward your efforts.
quest: This is very good. I am impressed with your efforts. But you must understand that Arwic was not built in a day. You should take more time to consider your art, to place it within the proper historic and economic perspective. Only then will you truly understand art, and be able to fuse form and function for the sake of the people.
Good job! This paste will serve the people in excellent fashion!
Did you make a drudge sneeze in this before bringing it to me? A good paste wouldn't be nearly as chunky.  I'll accept it, but I won't like it!
What an amazing ... er ... paste! You have combined form and function most admirably!
Excellent job! Your desire to serve in the forefront of the revolution is pushing you on to greater glory!
Wonderful! Rarely have I seen such dedication to pursuing a life of artistic leadership!
Amazing! Simply amazing! You have crafted an almost useable toothpaste.
Wow! It's obvious you have spent a lot of time perfecting the noble art of Toothpaste crafting.
The texture and consistency of this paste is unbelievable. You have learned much about this art!
Perfect! Well, nearly perfect. There is always room to learn.

greetings: Kleeoh presses the vial back into your hand.
Dis be powerful stuff!  You not be understandin' the magic of the dead? Haha!
Kleeoh lowers her voice, and leans close to you.
Use dis black poison blood to strengthen da bond you must make.
Kleeoh twists a small lock of fur out of the reeking, moist clump, and tucks it away.  She hands the rest back to you.
You got a lot dere.  I only take what I need, and no more.
I hope you and dat old hermit know what you doing!  Evil maka like this needs a strong bond, and dis big wooly fur is a good start - but I do not know how you will create such a thing.
Aye, you've done well enough with this wretched pocki.
Da blood of da dead will bring you strength in whatever type of maka you trying!
Ah, dis be a special ring.  A loop with a secret catch, to release dis dark poision vial.  Oh, you be thinkin' it be blood in dere?
Aye, blood it was.  But now death it be for those who so much as touch a drip-drop of it.  You be careful now, fussin' around with dis mess.
Kleeoh smiles at you oddly; a strange chill causes you to shiver briefly.
Dere is only one reason why you would be out here messin' with such evil maka.  You be lookin' to make power from idols, you be! Ha!
I know you been talkin' to dat old man.  And I know what you be needin' from here, if you be after the same madness he was.
Some assailers been getting' da jungle sick about them.  Dere furry coat be getting' rough, and da sickness be all over it.

You gonna have to fight the wooly beasts and dere jungle sickness -- and get some fur.  Dey be all over da jungle, like a plague.  You find dem, and bring back to us, bring back to us, bring back to us...
What, you be thinkin' it's easy to make dangerous big maka? Ha ha!
Hello child, I sense dat you be looking for high adventure here where da tusker is king, no? Well let Kleeoh give you da help den. Why ya wonder I hid from ya when first ya came to da island?
Well that be simple, Oolutanga don't be liking those of us dat can think for ourselves. Who's Oolutanga?
You come to da island of da king Oolutanga. A refugee from da halls of a cruel virindi name by Aerbax.
Oolutanga is a special tusker you see. Yes. He be powerful strong and powerful big and powerful smart. He be a tusker dat hates da virindi. He frees his people when he can.
He has a magic about him. A magic dat comes from da hand dat he lost while fighting da former owner of dis island.
%n chortles.
Dey say dat if a person get hold of da hand taken from Oolutanga dey can have three wishes granted. But only in da temple of da king.
You be wanting to go dere den eh?
Well head to da waterfall on de interior of dis island and search for da entrance. Dere you find your way... Dere you find your way.
Read da signs. Dey tell secrets dey do.
Don't they have something stronger here?
Ask Feng to pour us a few of his specials with extra cowbell.
I stopped drinking this stuff. I like the house wine now.
Say, is it raining out? I was thinking about going for a walk around town and doing some shopping perhaps. I'm looking for some cowbell.
This is so much nicer than that sandhole Dryreach.
Nice crackling fire in the hearth. Good company.
I think I'll stay here for awhile.
After all. All work and no play makes Ulgrim something thirsty.
This town hasn't changed a bit. Good ole' Yanshi with it's weird rock.
By the way, my name is Ulgrim. Yes, the Ulgrim. Pull up a chair and buy me a drink friend.
It's really nice in this bar isn't it? Just look at the attention to decorating Feng made.
quest: Sweet nectar, thy name is sake.
I bet you ten sakes you'll never guess where this came from.
You don't know do you?
I'm not telling you. You owe me ten sakes!
Listen, before you walk away from here you'll be wearin' gold girths.
Never question Ulgrim!
Cock of the walk!
I gotta have more cowbell, baby!
Easy guys, I drink my stout just like the rest of you - one sip at a time. Except, once my mugs empty, I make gold gromnies.
I'm tellin' you fellows, you're gonna want that cowbell.
I'm gonna need more cowbell.

greetings: Thank you.  Here is the letter I would like you to give Shin Ro, who is the Archmage's Apprentice in Nanto itself.  He will give you a small reward.
Can you please help me?  Here is the letter I would like you to give Shin Ro, who is the Archmage's Apprentice in Nanto itself.  He will give you a small reward.
My wife is happy to be here, she grew tired of living in Eastham.  If you ask me though that man that gave us the means to build this place...Well he just gave me the shakes...Him and his mask.
Hrm...Something is still missing just can't seem to figure out what that is.
I guess living out here in the wilderness isn't that bad, I just wish that there was more meat around here.  How am I supposed to perfect my meatballs if I can't get meat?
If you're looking to sell something then you should visit my wife, but be careful she's a shrewd one.
I never caught that strangers name, come to think of it I don't think he told us...

quest: The rocks are all too large. You found a smooth stone here within the past month. Perhaps if a little more time passes another such stone will be created by the shifting magma.
The rocks appear to be too large to carry. However, as you search through them you see one that has been formed into a perfectly smooth sphere, about the size of an orb.
You see nothing special in the rock formation here.

greetings: You think, "He looked like a kid running around the holiday pole. The gleam in his eye reminded me of a diamond golem in the noonday sun. He opened the door without hesitation and bowed deeply."

You think, "This guy was something else. They must have been paying him the pocket change that young banderlings carry around. He kept going on about only needing 100 pyreals. 100 pyreals? I had a trade note for that much. Did the Dame know that I'd need it...I'd written it off as a back-handed sum of cash to undertake a dangerous case. Now, I saw the irony of the situation was like statues bui...
You think, "He was looking for a bribe. I just might have the money he needed."
Sorry, I don't frame pictures. You want the Master House Decorator or the Wall Hanging Master to frame these.
Yes, I can mount this for you. Just promise not to ring the thing after it get's dark. There's nothing more disturbing than a bell ringing out in the night.
The Master Furniture Maker mounts the bell onto a sturdy post.
You might want that crack in the bell looked at sometime.
Sure, I can take that off for you.
The Master Furniture Maker unmounts the bell.
There you go. Watch out for bats. They love these things.
Good day to you!  I am Bartholomew, though my friends call me Bart.  After I get set up here, I'll start taking certain items and making them into furniture.
There's nothing finer, than wares made by Steiner!
Let's see what Dame Fortune has in store for you!
You want to try this at a lower stakes table, bud.
Too rich for my blood.  Try this at the high stakes table.
Hey!  What are you trying to pull?  This token is only for use at Arshid's Den of Iniquity, in the Gharu'ndim lands.
Hey!  What are you trying to pull?  This token is only for use at Gan-Zo's Den of Iniquity, in the Sho lands.
I manage the games of chance with the blue tokens.  Give me a blue token and see what you win!
Yes, I can provide transit to the location written here. I believe you will have need of this.  A passing adventurer threw it at my head some time ago, when my portal spell fizzled.
I came here to be free of the madding pace of the Arcanum at Zaikhal. Unless you have urgent business, I'd prefer to be left to my meditation.

If you are another seeking the lost City of Frore, be warned - you will need a substantial party to survive. Should you die, you will be unable to reenter the caves to recover your equipment. Be certain you are prepared.
Many items, such as potions, that you'll find in the world are stackable. This means that they will stack on top of each other in the same slot in your inventory.
You say you found this note near Shoushi? You should take it to Sir Tenshin. He is overseeing the garrision in Shoushi and will be interested in any local developments.
You say you found this note near Yaraq? You should take it to Dame Tsaya. She is overseeing the garrision in Yaraq and will be interested in any local developments.
You say you found this uniform near Shoushi? You should take it to Sir Tenshin. He is overseeing the garrision in Shoushi and will be interested in any local developments.

You say you found this...thing in Yaraq? You should take it to Dame Tsaya. She is overseeing the garrision in Yaraq and will be interested in any local developments. Good thing she has a stronger stomach than I.
This letter is addressed to Sir Tenshin. You should take it to him in Shoushi.
This letter is addressed to Dame Tsaya. You should take it to her in Yaraq.
Sir Rylanan reads the letter from Dame Tsaya with great interest and growing concern.
What terrible news! It sounds as if Tsaya has her hands full down in Yaraq. A human husk, torn from a living being, I shudder to think of it.

Well, I have had some interesting times myself.  I've recently been assigned to Holtburg to build a garrision and be on the lookout for suspicious happenings. There is one fellow on the outskirts of town that I've been keeping my eye on. He's just moved here from Marae Lassel and sometimes comes into town for provisions. He says he's been "reformed", but I can spot a bandit when I see one! Town...
Sir Rylanan unfolds the note and reads it carefully.

So...this was all a plot to kill our Queen's son--through us, her own Guards! We, who have sworn to protect her heir!  I hope you gave those evil doers a good thrashing! Martine will pay for this some day! Let me reward you--you have done the kingdom of New Aluvia a great service on this day. We owe you a debt of gratitude.
quest: Thank you for all your help, traveler. The kingdom is grateful for all you have done. I have not seen anything overly suspicious recently; however, we can never be too sure. Come back in two weeks--there may be trouble again.
You are safely back from Fort Witshire, I see! Were my suspicions correct? Did you find any more clues to this plot?
Back so soon? Have you infiltrated their plot?
You have helped me a great deal my friend--have you taken the letter  I gave you to Sir Tenshin in Shoushi? He should be updated on what has transpired here.
I see you've returned from Asuger Temple in one piece. Did you find anything out of the ordinary while you were there?
You're back! How did your interview with that ex-bandit go? Did you find anything of note in his house?
I see you've just come over from Yaraq. Did Dame Tsaya send a letter with you? She has always been so good about updating her reports.
Greetings! I heard you helped Sir Tenshin a great deal down in Shoushi. You should visit Dame Tsaya in Yaraq now--she is setting up the garrison in Yaraq and should hear about your discoveries.
Thank you, but my hands are full with administrative affairs at the moment. I shall have to ask you to return at another time--perhaps two weeks from now.
What a strange object! Perfectly round, and perfectly smooth!
Sir Rylanan holds the spherule up to the light and stares into the milky glass.
What substance could possibly be swirling around in there? Looks like portal space energy, doesn't it?
Sir Rylanan starts to shake the spherule but suddenly thinks better of it.
I am out of my depth here...the mages of the Arcanum might be able to fathom this object's purpose. I will send it to the Arcanum for analysis.

I believe Sir Tenshin would be very interested to hear about your discoveries. He is heading up the garrision down in Shoushi. This letter will serve as your introduction to him--I have chronicled your discoveries, as well as the contents of the note you found earlier.
Sir Rylanan reads the letter from Dame Tsaya with great interest and growing concern.
I think I am beginning to discern a pattern here. The Hollow Minions are creating their Simulacra by inflating these human husks they've been collecting with concentrated portal space energy...
Sir Rylanan shudders and continues.

And they've been paying that ridiculous farmer down in Shoushi to stockpile an arsenal of stolen Guards uniforms and weapons...they must have a plan to garb these new Simulacra in our uniforms to infiltrate our ranks. Could they be making a gambit to reach our Queen? Those miscreants! But where could their headquarters be?
Sir Rylanan thinks for a moment.

You know...Fort Witshire has been abandoned for quite some time now, but our scouts have found  that a group of Hollow Minions have claimed it and barricaded themselves inside so no one may enter. I'll bet you that's where they are.

We know that Fort Witshire was built on the ruins of an old Empyrean prison and prepared the portal beside me to penetrate the fort by using the underground passages underneath. You seem like just the person to help us with this. You may need this key once you enter Fort Witshire--it was found among Witshire's effects after he left the fort. Find out what those Hollow Minions are up to, the kin...

I've recently been assigned to Holtburg to build a garrision and be on the lookout for suspicious happenings. There is one fellow on the outskirts of town that I've been keeping my eye on. He's just moved here from Marae Lassel and sometimes comes into town for provisions. He says he's been "reformed", but I can spot a bandit when I see one! Townsfolk say they've spotted shady-looking guests co...

You say you found this note in that bandit's house? Surrounded by a pack of Hollow Minions? I knew that fellow was up to no good! Look here...it refers to Asuger Temple, up to the north. Last I heard, the temple was just a Banderling hideout...harmless really. I wonder what sort of trouble might be brewing up there? Find out what is going on, and I'm sure I could find something in the Guard's c...
What terrible news! It sounds as if Tsaya and Tenshin both have their hands full in their garrison towns. Stolen Guards uniforms and human husks, what's next?

Well, I have had some interesting times myself.  I've recently been assigned to Holtburg to build a garrision and be on the lookout for suspicious happenings. There is one fellow on the outskirts of town that I've been keeping my eye on. He's just moved here from Marae Lassel and sometimes comes into town for provisions. He says he's been "reformed", but I can spot a bandit when I see one! Town...

greetings: You say you found this note near Holtburg? You should take it to Sir Rylanan. He is overseeing the garrision in Shoushi and will be interested in any local developments.
My instincts were correct. I wonder who his new patron is? Here, you may have this back. I have already committed it to memory.
You say you found this note near Yaraq? You should take it to Dame Tsaya. She is overseeing the garrision in Yaraq and will be interested in any local developments.
You say you found this strange  object near Holtburg? You should take it to Sir Rylanan. He is overseeing the garrison in Holtburg and will be interested in any local developments.
Sir Tenshin takes one look at the object you just handed and turns a delicate shade of green.

I think I'm going to be ill. You say you found this near Yaraq? Quickly, take it to Dame Tsaya. She is overseeing the garrision in Yaraq and will be interested in any local developments. Go now, and take this with you.
Sir Tenshin reads the letter from Sir Rylanan with no small amount of amazement.

A glass spherule encapulating what looks as if it could be portal space energy? For what purpose? They say that Dereth is full of wonders...but if Hollow Minions are playing around with portal space, no good can come of it. Mark my words...

Come to think of it, I've remarked on some suspicious characters lately myself. Perhaps you can help me. There is a farmer who lives a little ways past the Shoushi South Outpost. He's been a normal townsmember for a very long time, but no one can speak for how he's come into so much wealth recently. Normally it's a cause to celebrate when one's neighbor moves up in the world...but why is he act...
Could you go and check in on him? I am sure there is nothing amiss, but I just want to be sure...
This letter is addressed to Dame Tsaya. You should take it to her in Yaraq.
This letter is addressed to Sir Rylanan. You should take it to him in Holtburg.
Sir Tenshin reads the note you found in the Hall of Hollows.

As I suspected--I thought they would try to infiltrate our ranks to gain access to Queen Elysa. But who would have thought they would be so low as to try to murder Borealean, Thorsten Cragstone's own son? The storm gathers once more...but nevermind. Your efforts have not gone unnoticed this day, comrade. Let me bestow upon you a mark of our Queen's favor, in recognition of your service to the c...
quest: It is always a pleasure to greet those who have helped the kingdom as you have done. Things seem to have died down a little bit--perhaps if you come back in two weeks or so I'll have more news to impart.
Good to see you again. I am glad  to see that you survived infiltrating Fort Witshire unscathed. Did you find anything of note while you were there?
Oh there you are. Need to go back underneath Fort Witshire? The portal is right there.
Good to see you again! Have you taken my letter to Dame Tsaya yet? I think that she really ought to be informed of your discoveries here.
There you are! Have you found out what that farmer's secret is? Let me know if he's been hoarding anything that could be considered...unusual in his house.
Greetings. Sir Rylanan mentioned he might be sending updates to me from Holtburg every so often. Might he have sent one with you?

Oh hello! I've got my hands full at the moment with a little local problem...perhaps you should visit Sir Rylanan up in Holtburg for now. He's heading up the garrison up there and will probably have a task for you.

Well, this is interesting! A Guard's uniform, no less! But I must apologize--I must tend to my duties as senior Guard here in Shoushi today. Keep this for now--but be sure to return and remind me of it in the future when I have more time.
You say you found this Guard's uniform in a hidden room in the farmer's basement? What's more, he had many of them? And he's stockpiling a large armament as well?

How could he have found access to these uniforms? These are the sole property of Her Majesty's Guard--and are dispensed only through our headquarters. They must have been stolen whilst our quartermaster was in his cups...I will alert our Queen of this affair immediately.

I believe Dame Tsaya in Yaraq should be alerted to this affair as well. Please take this letter to her--I have included your recent discoveries. I'm sure she will be highly interested to hear of what you have found.
Sir Tenshin reads the letter from Sir Rylanan with no small amount of amazement and disgust.

This is just too much. Farmers stockpiling arsenals in their hidden basements, Hollow Minions torturing hapless victims and removing the very skin from their bodies, filling spherules with portal space energy, I can't take it! Why was I ever promoted?
Sir Tenshin quickly descends into a short flurry of hysteria, hiccups, and pulls himself together.

There must be connection here...could the Hollow Minions be taking the skins from their victims in order to fill them with the portal space in those spherules Rylanan told me about? All to clothe them in our Guards uniforms? This must be a plot to strike down our Queen! Every one knows that our station here is intended only to be temporary--we're only here to restore stability and then return t...

We have heard that a group of Hollow Minions have recently claimed Fort Witshire and barricaded themselves inside. Now that I think of it, this must be where their headquarters for this plot are located. It has long been known that Fort Witshire was built upon the ruins of an old Empyrean prison. We have been planning to infiltrate the fort by using the hidden corridors deep beneath the fort--a...

Greetings! I've just come to head the garrison here in Shoushi. The townsfolk of this peaceful city must be protected, and everyone should do their share to help! Could you help me to investigate a certain matter?

There is a farmer who lives a little ways past the Shoushi South Outpost. He's been a normal townsmember for a very long time, but no one can speak for how he's come into so much wealth recently. Normally it's a cause to celebrate when one's neighbor moves up in the world...but why is he acting so distantly when he comes to town to stock up on provisions?
Could you go and check in on him? I am sure there is nothing amiss, but I just want to be sure...

A glass spherule encapulating what looks as if it could be portal space energy? And what's this? Husks made from human skins? Poor Rylanan and Tsaya--they have more to deal with than they signed up for, I'll wager.  Hollow Minions playing around with portal space and harvesting the skin off of people's backs--no good will come of it. Mark my words...

Come to think of it, I've remarked on some suspicious characters lately myself. Perhaps you can help me. There is a farmer who lives a little ways past the Shoushi South Outpost. He's been a normal townsmember for a very long time, but no one can speak for how he's come into so much wealth recently. Normally it's a cause to celebrate when one's neighbor moves up in the world...but why is he act...
Could you go and check in on him? I am sure there is nothing amiss, but after hearing all of this I have to be sure...

greetings: I remember finding stones like this within the mine, but they're only useful as doorstops.
Amazing. I always thought these stones were worthless!
Didn't you read the note?  That place is dangerous.  You'll surely die if you go in there.
Now I have to return the note to the dungeon. Thanks a lot!
I tell you what, hand me the skull of the Tortured Soul that hides in the Grievous Vault and I'll give you access to the mines.
You managed to find a lich's head?  That is impressive.
%n looks at a note thoughtfully for a moment.
Perhaps you can go into the Mines, but I can't give you the key to the final section unless you prove your worth. If you bring me the Skull of the High Acolyte I'll help you further.
The Mines are dangerous and much is unknown about what dwells there.  I know not much about it; however, some great evil lurks in there. I can feel it.
Very impressive! You managed to obtain the most unholy of skulls.
%n holds the Skull of the High Acolyte with much admiration.
You have proven your worth to me.
Take these keys. It will give you access to the place many fear.
Lemme alone.  And keep my door closed!

Den-Ru tries to cast healing spell, but is too weak. "Bah. Wear a robe, get sliced open by hollow weapons. Wear armor, become too heavy to move. Well, all you're getting from me is a sackful of those useless damned robes that old fool Celdiseth knits!"

chatter: The sky is split by the sound of thunder. Gaerlan's Citadel rocks under the force of a great assault. As the fury subsides, two voices are carried across the world.
Gaerlan says, "Insolence. How dare you enter my citadel?"
Martine says, "I am here to exact my vengeance, and make amends for what I have done."
The sounds of powerful magic tear through valleys, and threaten to shake buildings to their foundations. As the sounds subside the voices return.

Gaerlan says, "There is no magic you can call upon that I cannot match. There is nothing in this world that you know, that I have not already stolen from your mind. You were a clever tool, nothing more. We are your greater in every way. Why rise against what you cannot hope to stand against."
Martine says, "I am not going to let you eradicate our people. We have fought too long and struggled to survive here."
A thunderous clash of magical energies is unleashed across the skyline above Gaerlan's Citadel and the voices fall silent.
Voices sunder the air as Gaerlan and Martine continue the struggle on the citadel.
Gaerlan says, "You grow weaker. You have yet to breach the citadel proper, yet still you think you will survive. Can you not see the power that I now possess?"
Martine says, "Power is relative, Gaerlan. Yours will wane, and I will not fail. I owe too much to these people to fail."
The mountains in northern Osteth shake under a great force. Around Gaerlan's Citadel a halo of frost erupts and disspates.
Martine says, "So you are weakening..."
Gaerlan says, "Come for me childling, vermin...human."
At Gaerlan's citadel a violent explosion brightens the sky for a moment. Flames erupt from the western side of the citadel as Martine tears through more of Gaerlan's forces.
Martine says, "Nothing can hinder me now Gaerlan. I have routed two of your commanders thus far, and then I shall destroy you."

Gaerlan says, "I have watched you Martine. You have sloughed your true form away, returning to what you once were. Why? Tell me Martine...have you seen the portal that I have created for you? I have given you the way home."
Martine says, "No! Asheron told me that it cannot be done, the research was destroyed."

WorldBroadcast Gaerlan says, "Destroyed? He never found his way there again, and then there were his greater failures to attend to. But even he forgot the other, the one who went native and lived there. Not all minds are so strong."
A maniacal laughter fills the air. Martine's voice cracks and a scream of rage explodes into a sound of metal scraping on metal.
WorldBroadcast Gaerlan says, "The Old Man is a fool, and will be as dead as you shall be, should you continue this foolish crusade."
Acid rains from the citadel as Martine reaches the base of the tower.
Gaerlan says, "At last. Well then vermin, let us see what you have brought me."
Martine says, "I have brought you the end, Gaerlan. I have brought you death."

Gaerlan laughs. "You have once again forsaken your human form. A pity. I should have liked crushing you as I will the lifestones that defend your precious race. You have come to exact your vengeance...come then rodent, let me weigh you and give you the death you crave."
The battle rises through the tower, as the combatants unleash arcane power that threatens to sunder the world. The world trembles. The wizards ascend to the pinnacle of the citadel's tower.
Gaerlan says, "And so I have proven the victor. You have lost...Isparian."
Martine says, "I have yet to lose Gaerlan."

At the crest of the tower a vibrant purple glow begins. An electric hum floods the world. At the citadel a windstorm rushes toward the apex of the tower as Martine prepares to unleash his greatest spell.
Gaerlan shouts above the hum and the rush of wind, "You are no more!"
A twist of elemental energy is released from Gaerlan's hands as he leaps from the top of his tower, the elemental energy surrounds Martine.
As Martine unleashes the magic within him the sky flashes purple. The elemental prison about him holds the blast within for a long moment, and the world falls silent.
Gaerlan says, "Insignificant. Martine is no more, run to your hovels, run to Asheron! Though not even he can protect you!"

The clouds above the citadel clear. The portal that once beckoned at the zenith of the tower is no more. The citadel begins to shake, and grows unstable. It falls toward the earth slowly at first, and then accelerates.
Gaerlan howls with rage as he realizes what has transpired and what is happening.
Asheron bellows, "Yes Gaerlan. I am very much alive, you have no Throne to protect you now. The time for reckoning is at hand."

greetings: This looks to be a very important report. I think that this should be delivered to Captain K'rank. I do not wish to keep such an important report from his hands.
I have been sent by High Queen Elysa to reward those who have assisted Captain K'rank of Linvak Tukal. If you have proof of this assistance give it to me and I will see that you are rewarded.
quest: Alec says, "Hail %tn. I see that you have returned to shatter the morale of the Burun again. Your efforts continue to assist our people in lessening the threat these creatures pose. Here are your rewards."
The key will open whichever chest you choose in that room. Each chest should clearly display what it holds.
Alec says, "That is all that I have to give. Thank you again for your efforts, %tn."

Alec says, "Hail %tn. Again you take the head of the Burun leader, Morgluuk. You are surely a hero to all. As we have already placed the creatures head outside of the city in your honor, this one will be turned into a trophy that you can display with honor, %tn."
%tn has defeated Morgluuk and received a glorious reward for their efforts.
Filthy creatures these Burun. As promised you are to be rewarded for your efforts.
A brave warrior who has continued our efforts to crush the morale of the Burun and the renegades. You have done well. Here take this and display it proudly.
Alec exclaims, "%tn, you have killed the Burun leader, Morgluuk! This head is proof of what you have done. All should know your name."

%tn has slain Morgluuk and returned his head to the Aluvian capital of Cragstone. There it is to be placed on a pike as a symbol of victory for the Isparian, Lugian and Tumerok people and a symbol of defeat for the Burun that threaten our way of life. Huzzah, %tn!
You must be rewarded for your efforts.

Alec says, "The portal gem will take you into the High Queen's Vault. There you will find many chests that house treasures and weaponry that has been worked on by the finest smiths in the land. Take your gift and use it well, %tn. You are deserved of much praise in this victory."
Alec says, "That is the final reward I have for you. You have become a hero to all of Dereth, %tn. I shall never forget your name or your deeds."

You think, "More crying. Either this guy was related to a mite, or he was genuinely afraid for his life. I figured I had learned everything that there was from, Gentleman Jake. Time to choose. Continue on my journey now, or wait until later."
Listen well, you scurvy mutt, I'm Gentleman Jake Hawkins! If MacNiall follows the right way of doing things, then I'm 8 paces to the left. Yar!
Don't forget old Gentleman Jake now, friend.
You think, "The man standing before me looked haggard. As soon as he saw me approaching, he started shaking like a leaf getting ready to be shed in the autumn air."
You think, "Being one to press my advantage, I shook the man down."
You think, "He folded like a simulacrum skin suit falling to the ground..."

You think, "He was begging me not to slap him silly. He wasn't worth the effort. His tale was pretty simple. Lonely kid, came through the portal from Ispar and got involved in the wrong crowd. He'd heard whispers coming down through the chain of command and ran when the kitchen fires grew too hot. Now he was a refugee, living in MacNiall's Freehold. He talked big, but sobbed bigger."
You think, "I was less than enthused, and waited for his blubbering to end."
You think, "When his tantrum was done he handed me a torch..."
You think, "...a signed confession..."
You think, "...and a portal gem."

You think, "The choice was up to me now. Did I chance what lay in the dungeon beyond this gem. The blubbering idiot standing before me told me it was dark. How dark? Dark enough that the torch would be my only light. I wasn't afraid, just wary...maybe this would best wait for a later time."

greetings: Thanks. I have to have something in case you run off with my key.  I'll have you know it was fashioned by the best lockpi... finest craftsman in Uziz!
Straight southeast from here, you'll find an old dry well.  Go down into it, and bring me back some well water.  And don't you believe those stories about the lower caves being haunted!
Hah! My thanks, gentle friend. Here's that 200p I promised you.
Some people believe that since this water comes from an old Empyrean well, it's enchanted. As the Poet said, we're short of everything but foolishness, eh? But if they'll pay, I'll sell.
What's this? This isn't water from the well - it's too clean! You're trying to swindle me, Malik take your eyes! I'll not give you a single Pyreal for this!
Say, I might have 200 nice, shiny Pyreals with your name on them!  I'll have you know this key was fashioned by the best lockpi... finest craftsman in Uziz!
Straight southwest from here, you'll find an old dry well.  Go down into it, and bring me back some well water.  And don't you believe those stories about the lower caves being haunted!
You need not pay me to pass through the gate
Quickly, step inside the gates before the encampment is roused to strike out against us.
You may pass through the gate.

Food. Food is the basis of life. We are all food. You, you I see as a bountiful dessert, layered with chocolate and cinnamon, encrusted with rare fruits and sweetmeats in arcane patterns. You are a work of art! But cloyingly sweet ...
Our purpose here? We are here to ennoble the Derethian soul! To encourage it to rise to its full potential, like a fine, full loaf of the best bread in the oven of the gods!
Tiffany is our fearless leader, the great organizer. She can tell you of our efforts here.
quest: You are moving too quickly. Take your time, consider your technique. A brush like this should fill your entire being for at least a week.
I would be lying if I told you this was a good attempt. Never the less, keep on trying. I am sure you will improve.
Did you use this to brush an ursuin after finishing it? Try harder next time.
This is passable work. You still have far to go before you are a master, but I am encouraged by your ... determination.
Not bad, not bad. Soon you will wield the carving knife with all the elegance of a true cook!
Hmm .. you are learning. I particularly like this detailing here -- like grapes, slowly burnishing their tender skin in the sun, ready to be picked! ... and eaten.
This brush .. this brush is a work of art! Keep refining your technique, and soon I may allow you to touch ... the food itself!
Amazing! Simply amazing! You have crafted an almost useable toothbrush.
Wow! It's obvious you have spent a lot of time perfecting the noble art of Toothbrush crafting.
The bristles of this brush are beautiful. You have learned much about this art!
Perfect! Well, nearly perfect. There is always room to learn.

greetings: I regret to inform you that this material is too tough for me to craft into a robe.  It needs to be made more supple. Applying any type of acid solution to it should make the pelt supple and ready for use.  I have no idea where you might find such a solution however.
Yes, this is some of my finer work.  Enjoy it.
Yes, I believe this should do the trick.  Be careful, though, I have found that the hide reacts strangely to different types of acid.

This is a shoddy piece.  It is certainly not up to my standards.  Besides, it upsets Britana greatly.  She is very uncomfortable when her brother is mentioned.  I think she feels like she has something to prove to him.  I have tried to explain to her that standing in her light, Ketnan is a mere blade of grass underneath a large oak tree.  A beautiful and lovely tree.
I have no use for these, but Britana has instructed me to keep them.  So I shall.

You have succeeded in your quest.  Here is your Canescent Mattekar Robe.  By the way, have you seen where Britana goes late at night?  I think she is out walking with another...never mind, I am sorry to trouble you.
You have succeeded in your quest.  Here is your Canescent Mattekar Robe.

I am worried about Britana.  Lately she talks not so much about fame and fortune, but about love.  I tried to ask her to take a walk out in the moonlight, but she said she did not have time.  Perhaps tomorrow.

Yes, I have agreed to help Britana in her quest to fashion a new Hoary Mattekar Robe.  I don't know where this new Mattekar is rumored to be, you would have to ask Britana.  I have to admit, I had never encountered a woman like Britana before back in my home village.  She is quite the woman.
Ah, you found something. An ancient document... Perhaps it may explain this haunting.

Hmm, I believe the document is written in Yalaini. If you take it to Bretself the Translator who resides in Cragstone, he should be able to translate it for you. Please bring it back to me when it is translated.
The translated version. So, it truly was written in Yalaini!
Have you read this already? This chronicle of terror chills my soul.
Frest Greelving shudders

Alas, it appears my gripe is with the Arcanum builders who constructed the mansion here. This ground is cursed and perhaps should not be inhabited. Yet, perhaps you may be able to do something to stop the horror that grips this place. I understand now that it comes from beneath the mansion. There is... something... down there.  If you can eliminate this terror I would reward you.
I now give you permission to enter my mansion dungeon. Here is the key to the chamber where the portal is, you already know why I secured it. Take good care.
quest: You helped me recently but...
they're back!
Go away and let someone else see if they can succeed.
Are you too scared to continue? If so, I would not fault you.

So, you were able to subdue the entity instigating the horrible occurrences in my house? I am delighted! I expect any spectral beings left haunting the mansion should leave soon and allow me to dwell there in peace.
Alas, I am low on cash at this time but I do have a fine piece of furniture I could give you. It just may remind you that there are are forces in the world, unknown, unknowable, unnameable!
I already have my emerald, which you brought me!
I already have my shirt. But thank you for this one.
I can always use another as I stand here out in the open, listening to the horrors writhing within the mansion.
You gave me my platter. I didn't think I had two of them, but perhaps I did. It primarily has sentimental value. Thank you.

Traveller, please! I wonder if I may call on you to help me? An unnamed evil permeates my mansion. I cannot go back in there! There are some objects of sentimental value I wish to have retrieved from my house. I will reward you if you do.

I shall give you a copy of my journal in which I have recorded the growing horror within that house. It also lists the items I would appreciate you retrieving for me. Also, if you should discover any clues of what is causing this horror, please bring them to me.
Thank you, you retrieved my precious emerald! Here is your reward.
Thank you, yes, that is my favorite puffy shirt! Here is your reward.
Thank you, that is my antique platter! Here is your reward.

greetings: No thanks, I've kindof turned off this stuff since the incident in Dryreach. It wasn't pretty.
I seem to have formed an allergic reaction to stout. I puff up and stop breathing when I drink it.
I wouldn't say no to some wine.
Thanks.
Do you have any red wine?
Greetings! Welcome to the Lofty Spire. Please have a seat and a server will be with you shortly.
If you buy me a drink I'll tell you what you shouldn't order.
You wouldn't believe what happened to me on the way here from Dryreach.
I was running away from some shadows when they suddenly decided to give up the chase.
I thought I had finally caught a break, but that's when I slammed into foot of a tremendous monouga.
He scooped me up and threw me across the desert. Luckily some hard jagged rocks broke my fall.
I was completely lost and crawled through the desert until I came across Uziz. Finally something was going right! I crawled my way into this bar and ordered a drink.
It was then I recognized Maryata the barkeep. It seems I have a small bar tab that was mistakenly unpaid that last time I was here.
She's making me work off the money I owe her by greeting her customers... So, Greetings and welcome to the Lofty Spire... have a seat and buy me a drink.
quest: I'm sorry I don't have more things embedded in my flesh that I can give you, but if you stay around awhile I'm sure it's just a matter of time.
Ahhh!!! That should help with the gout.
Oh joy! Things are looking up! That splinter embedded in my neck has finally come out!
Here, take it as a good luck charm.
Funny thing, I was greeting people outside until this fellow comes up to me and tells me about this terrible secret he wants to protect everyone from.
I couldn't quite figure out what the terrible secret was, but it sure is terrible. So, I'm standing here by the stairs like he asked me to, just in case.
You might want to stand here too.
I bet you don't know that some magical components are quite deadly if ingested.
I sure didn't.
I went to visit the fortune shrine today. Want to hear my fortune?
You will fall into a very deep hole and your broken body will slowly be devoured by the foul things that reside in the lightless places.
That didn't sound so good.
My lucky numbers are 6,6,6.

After I clear up this whole bar tab mess I think I'll go and spend some quiet time in Yanshi. It's so nice and peaceful there. Someone else suggested the Singularity Caul too. That might be nice. I haven't been there in a long time.
Maryata says that as long as I don't break any more mugs today I can go.
I was so happy, I dropped another mug.
She's so nice. She said that didn't count since I wasn't ready. And when I was leaving her office she pretended not to notice when I tripped over that table of mugs.

greetings: The Tursh Totem. If they had escaped with this object...
You have done our Queen a great service. I am only sorry that the totem had to be destroyed in the process. Still, that is better than the alternative.
You deserve a reward for your heroic actions. Please take this replica as a show of our gratitude.
quest: I am sorry, but we have need of adventurers more experienced than you. I am afraid there is little you can offer our queendom at this point in time.

Please, the Queen is in dire need of your assistance! A group of creatures recently assaulted one of the Queen's hidden vaults. The few guards who were able to escape told me that these creatures were after some sort of artifact.

These vaults house numerous objects of immense power. Whoever these invaders are, we cannot allow them to obtain that which they seek. I need you to infiltrate the vault and repel the interlopers. If you happen upon the object they are after, return it to me.
These creatures cut off surface access to the vaults. You will have to enter the sewers beneath in order to break in. Access to the sewers can be found in an old temple at 77.2N, 33.0E.
This is a reward for the service you have done our Queen. We are in your debt.

greetings: Ah, you're back--and you've got that bunny carcass for me?  No mean feat that--those bunnies aren't just cute like everybody supposes...what with those hoppy legs and twitchy little noses!  Now...watch carefully.
%n skins the bunny, cuts the pelt, and quickly sews a bunny slipper.

There ya go! Gotta warn you though--only one per customer. What...you were expecting a pair? Silly rabbit, have you ever seen a two-headed bunny? But I already showed you how to do it--next time you find a rabbit carcass, use this slipper on it and you'll get your pair. Happy hunting and good speed!
quest: Oh hello--get your white bunny slippers yet? I've gotta tell ya, it seems like everyone wants their own pair.  I've had so many requests, I can't take anymore for at least a month!
Now now, the demand for these white bunny slippers has been so high, I'm backordered for a month! Come back then, I might have some spare time to make another for ya.

What's with all the carrots, you ask? Why, I'm luring bunnies! See my slippers?  Why, I was able to run all the way from the Direlands to here, fast as you can say "Lickety-split!" And I can't tell you how nice it is at the end of the day to curl up by the fire with a good book and  these slippers warming my tootsies. And ya know what? I like these so much, I have them in every color of the rai...

Ah, you're back--and you've got that bunny carcass for me?  No mean feat that--those bunnies aren't just cute like everybody supposes...what with those hoppy legs and twitchy little noses!  Now...watch carefully.
%n skins the bunny, cuts the pelt, and quickly sews a bunny slipper.

There ya go! Gotta warn you though--only one per customer. What...you were expecting a pair? Silly rabbit, have you ever seen a two-headed bunny? But I already showed you how to do it--next time you find a rabbit carcass, use this slipper on it and you'll get your pair. Happy hunting and good speed!

greetings: I like the pretty lights...
Sorry, I'm not in the unframing business.
I think you want the Master Furniture Maker, Bartholomew, for this. It's way to big for me to mess with.
Jordan Ibn'Ikia examines the map.

Such a fine map. This looks like the work of Alatar Locke, only he understands line weight so well! This would look magnificent hanging on your wall but it obviously requires a frame. I could frame this for you, however I have run out of wood. If you were to bring me some wood from a woodsman I could frame the map for you. I can hold the map for you until then. The woodsman in Holtburg carries...
Ah yes, these banners are really quite rustic. I find that a framed Tumerok Banner really adds a simple charm to a room. Here, let me frame this with some of my leftover wood.
There you are, enjoy!

Hello! I am Jordan. I deal specifically in wall hangings, and after I am settled into this new shop, I'll start taking items and crafting them into wondrous hangings for your house! For now, if you give me an unframed picture I could frame it for you.
quest: Thank you for obtaining this wood for me. I shall frame your map now.
Jordan Ibn'Ikia skillfully makes a decorative frame for the map
Don't let people mark it all up with their corpse locations, now! Hee hee!
Thank you, but someone else is fetching me a supply of wood.

This token only proves that you're a grave robber. Are you sure you want everyone to know that?
Well, ok, it's your life.
Attention, all!  Let it be known that %s has proven to be a low down good for nothing Grave Robber!

Hail and welcome to the Gharu'ndim branch of the Bestowers' Guild.  Have you come to seek a title?  Speak with Nerezi, my assistant, to learn about our application process.  The base piece for the examination is available in the tent.  But beware, you will only be allowed to conduct the examination once per day, and you can only hold one title at a time.
chatter: Does naming something give us power over it? or just sheild us from impotency over it?

greetings: I'm here to Survey this land under the authority of the Arcanum.
I'm surveying this land for the Arcanum. Please move on, I have much to do.
chatter: The %n looks over the crater and makes a mark on his instrument.
The %n adjusts some metal rings on his device.
The %n sights along a line he has drawn in the dirt.

Welcome to the Aluvian branch of the Bestowers' Guild.  We have chartered ourselves to bestow titles upon worthy applicants.  My assistant Caranis sells instructions and skill puzzle pieces.  On the other side of the room, you can find the base piece for the skill puzzle.  But you may only attempt the test once per day, and you may only hold one title at a time.
chatter: What is in a name other than the significance we give it?

quest: You punching bug?  Punch bug or Nanoc mad.
Good. Now Nanoc make puncher. You go bash bug, make Nanoc happy.
Nanoc fashions a crude, yet effective katar from the materials.
I make puncher already. You want punch?
Good leather. Hold puncher together. Now Nanoc make puncher. You go bash bug, make Nanoc happy.
Nanoc fashions a crude yet effective katar.
I make puncher already for you. You want punch? I keep leather now. You bash bug.
I smash bug.  You need something smash bug with?  Give bug crest to Nanoc.  Give leather gauntlet too. Nanoc need leather. I make something you punch bug with. Punch bug dead, bam!
Good crest.  Still need leather gauntlets.
Good leather. Need crest. Have crest, make puncher.

Honey, have you tasted Olthoi fungus?  We eat it steamed, fried, roasted and burnt. Sure is good. Why, I tell myself every day that I sure can't wait for another meal of Olthoi fungus. And grub bites. Mmmm. Hey, you should use that nice spear I made you and kill some bugs so we can get more fungus and grub bites.
Honey, didn't I make you a spear already? You think they grow on trees? We hardly got any trees here either! I'll keep this. If you break yours in a week or so maybe I'll make you another.

Well, honey, it sure is nice to know there's others fighting the Olthoi with us here.  Can you really kill 'em with that?  I use a nice spear myself.  Goes through bug shell like butter.
